jobs.title: Licensed Behavioral Health Therapist
jobs.description:
Licensed Behavioral Health Therapist

Location: Medford, MA
Schedule: Part-Time (2 days per week)
Salary per annum: $60,000 - $90,000

Position Summary

At MedElite, we bring care to the bedside. Our physicians, advanced practice providers, and specialists deliver primary care and specialty services directly to residents of skilled nursing facilities (SNFs), long-term care facilities (LTCs), and assisted living facilities (ALFs). We are committed to compassionate, high-quality care that respects the dignity of every resident, family, and facility partner we serve.

The Licensed Behavioral Health Therapist provides individual psychotherapy and psychiatric diagnostic evaluations to residents at their bedside across MedElite's partner facilities. Using referral information, chart review, interviews, and collaboration with facility staff, the Therapist assesses each resident's mental health needs, selects appropriate therapeutic approaches, and develops and carries out treatment plans that relieve symptoms, support adjustment to long-term care, and improve quality of life for residents and their families.

Employment type: Part-Time (2 days per week)
Travel: Travels to contracted SNF, LTC, and ALF facilities in Medford, MA

Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities

Assessment

• Completes a psychiatric diagnostic evaluation on each referred resident promptly after referral, per MedElite policy.

• Reviews the facility medical record, MDS data, medication list, and referral reason before each initial evaluation.

• Assesses and documents each resident's cognitive status and capacity to participate in and benefit from psychotherapy, using standardized tools (e.g., BIMS, PHQ-9, GDS, GAD-7) where appropriate.

• Engages family members or responsible parties in assessment when clinically appropriate and with the resident's consent.

• Reassesses residents at regular intervals and when their condition changes.

Treatment Planning

• Develops an individualized treatment plan for each resident with diagnosis, measurable goals, therapeutic approach, and session frequency.

• Reviews and revises the treatment plan as the resident's status changes, and documents the reasons for each revision.

• Coordinates the treatment plan with the facility's care plan and interdisciplinary team (IDT).

• Determines when goals are met or when therapy is no longer effective, and discharges residents from services with appropriate recommendations.

Direct Care

• Provides individual psychotherapy at the bedside using evidence-based approaches suited to older adults and long-term care residents, such as supportive therapy, CBT, problem-solving therapy, reminiscence therapy, and behavioral interventions.

• Addresses common needs in this population, including depression, anxiety, grief, adjustment to placement, chronic illness and pain, end-of-life concerns, and behavioral symptoms of dementia.

• Evaluates the effect of each intervention and adjusts the approach as needed.

• Recognizes and responds to behavioral health crises, including suicidal or homicidal ideation, following MedElite's crisis protocol and promptly notifying the attending provider and facility staff.

• Builds a therapeutic and supportive relationship with residents and families in line with professional standards.

Collaboration and Coordination

• Communicates findings and recommendations to the attending physician or APP, MedElite psychiatric prescribers, and facility nursing and social services staff.

• Shares urgent or crisis information immediately and non-urgent updates within 24 hours.

• Participates in facility care plan meetings, behavioral health huddles, and QAPI activities when requested.

• Recommends non-pharmacological interventions that support the facility's behavioral health care and psychotropic gradual dose reduction efforts.

• Educates facility staff on resident-specific behavioral approaches and provides in-service training when requested.

• Provides referrals and resources to residents and families, and coordinates follow-up care when residents transition to another setting.

Documentation, Billing, and Compliance

• Documents every evaluation and therapy session in MedElite's EHR on the date of service, or within the timeframe set by MedElite policy.

• Records session start and stop times, the therapeutic interventions used, the resident's response, and progress toward treatment plan goals.

• Documents medical necessity and the resident's capacity to benefit from therapy at intake and at each reassessment.

• Selects CPT codes that accurately reflect the service and documented time, including psychiatric diagnostic evaluation (90791) and individual psychotherapy (90832, 90834, 90837), with add-on codes such as 90785 when criteria are met.

• Bills only for services personally rendered, under their own NPI.

• Follows MedElite policies on Medicare Part A stay status and consolidated billing, and verifies payer coverage before initiating services when required.

• Complies with HIPAA, Medicare and Medicaid requirements, state licensing rules, facility policies, and MedElite's compliance program.

• Cooperates with internal chart audits, peer review, and payer record requests.

Professional Conduct and Development

• Works independently across multiple facilities with minimal direct supervision, managing their own caseload, schedule, and travel.

• Represents MedElite professionally with facility partners, treating facility staff, residents, and families with tact, respect, and sensitivity.

• Works through conflicts constructively and escalates facility or patient-care concerns through MedElite's chain of command.

• Takes accountability for their own performance and the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the care they provide.

• Proposes solutions to identified problems and participates in program development, quality improvement projects, and policy work when assigned.

• Assists with orientation and mentoring of new therapists.

• Maintains licensure, completes required continuing education, and stays current on best practices in geriatric and long-term care behavioral health.

• Participates in clinical supervision or peer consultation as required by MedElite policy or state licensing rules.

Qualifications

Education

• Master's degree or higher in social work, clinical mental health counseling, marriage and family therapy, or clinical psychology from an accredited program.

Licensure and Credentialing

• A current, unrestricted independent clinical license in the state of practice, such as LCSW, LPC/LPCC/LMHC, LMFT, or licensed psychologist (PhD/PsyD).

• Associate-level licenses (e.g., LMSW, LGSW, LAMFT) are not eligible, since they cannot bill Medicare independently.

• Must be able to enroll with Medicare, state Medicaid, and contracted payers, and complete MedElite's credentialing process before seeing residents.

• No current exclusion from federal healthcare programs (OIG/SAM) or state Medicaid programs.

• A valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and auto insurance that meets MedElite requirements.

Experience

• Minimum of 2 years of post-licensure clinical experience providing psychotherapy.

• Experience working in a nursing home setting.

• Experience with older adults, medical or long-term care settings, or dementia care is strongly preferred.

• Experience with EHR documentation and time-based psychotherapy coding is preferred.

Knowledge and Skills

• Knowledge of geriatric mental health, neurocognitive disorders, and the behavioral health needs of long-term care residents.

• Familiarity with CMS long-term care regulations related to behavioral health and psychotropic medication use.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to assess, analyze, and interpret complex clinical information.

• Sound professional and ethical judgment.

Work Environment and Requirements

Work Environment: This role is field-based. The Therapist travels daily between assigned SNF, LTC, and ALF facilities and provides services at the resident's bedside or in a private space within the facility. The work involves frequent interaction with residents, families, and facility staff, sometimes in emotionally demanding situations. Documentation may be completed on site or remotely using MedElite-provided technology.

Physical Requirements: The position requires frequent walking, standing, sitting, and driving between facilities. Prolonged sitting and computer work, including keyboard and mouse use for extended periods, and lifting/moving patients when needed. Must be able to follow facility infection control procedures, including use of personal protective equipment.

Cognitive and Emotional Requirements: The role requires excellent comprehension and communication skills, and the ability to organize, synthesize, and act on clinical information. The Therapist must make independent professional and ethical judgments and maintain a high level of emotional stability and maturity.

Training Requirements

• MedElite orientation at hire, including compliance, HIPAA, documentation, and billing training.

• Annual compliance, HIPAA, infection control, and abuse prevention training.

• Facility-specific orientation as required by each partner facility.

Why Work With Us?

• Make a meaningful impact on the lives of seniors

• Work in a collaborative, mission-driven environment

• Enjoy work-life balance with the flexibility of a part-time schedule

• Full administrative support and clinical mentorship

This description outlines the general nature and level of work for this position. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Employees may be asked to perform other duties as needed. MedElite is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Life360's AI ecosystem is being built by three teams working from a shared 2027 vision, each owning a distinct layer:

• AI Platforms — the foundational infrastructure and company-wide AI governance: gateways and MCP connector infra, cost and spend controls, observability and safety guardrails, the agent deployment/orchestration platform, and knowledge graphs.

• AI Dev Tooling (AI DevX) — AI-powered developer tools that remove friction across the software development lifecycle: coding assistance and productivity tooling, automated and agentic testing, and the codified primitives (CLAUDE.md, evals) that make shared and monolithic repos legible to AI.

• Agentic PDLC — agents that remove humans from common, repetitive product-development work: on-call investigation, bug triage, code review, and release, consolidated under a single owner instead of being built ad hoc team-by-team.

These teams deliberately don't own everything. A set of foundational questions — non-human identity and agent authZ, model regression eval frameworks, workflow/agent eval infrastructure, atomic agent-unit definitions, agent standards for what an agent can never do — sit in the shared space between them, ready to be addressed.

About the Job

We're hiring a Principal-level Agentic Engineer to hold the system view across AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC — and to give the unowned middle ground between them an owner. This is not a coordination role. You'll have clear, end-to-end ownership of a defined set of cross-cutting problems, not an open-ended advisory brief. It's an architecture-and-build role for someone who can define what an "agent" is as a reusable unit at Life360, set the standards that make agents safe and evaluable, build an ecosystem that supports our agents, and then help each team build to that architecture. In addition, this role will craft the vision for how our broad agent ecosystem will evolve into the future.

The role operates at two altitudes, and needs to be genuinely strong at both:

• Strategic: set the technical vision for Life360's AI-Native developer ecosystem — the architecture that lets AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC build against shared primitives instead of re-solving the same problems three times.

• Tactical: get into the core components yourself — agent execution frameworks, context and retrieval systems, eval harnesses, identity and authZ for unattended agents — and ship the parts that are too foundational to leave to any one team, or that no team currently owns.

You'll partner closely with the AI Platforms, AI Dev Tooling, Agentic PDLC, and our Product leadership (as their technical counterpart), but you won't report through any single one of them — your mandate is the seams between all of them.

The US-based salary range for this position is $247,000 to $363,000. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

Architect across the ecosystem

• Hold the system view across AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC, so investments compose instead of collide.

• Drive build-vs-buy decisions for PDLC-critical agents, and for ecosystem-wide capabilities where an outside vendor may out-deliver an internal build.

• Build the ecosystem that supports agents as we define them today and shapes how they evolve: execution frameworks, context and retrieval systems, and telemetry that treat token spend as a first-class design constraint.

Define & own the unowned middle

• Define what an agent is at Life360 — a reusable unit, the interface it exposes, and the standards it must meet (human-in-the-loop and blast-radius policy, eval standards, promotion gates) — in partnership with AI Platforms, who will operate the resulting infrastructure long-term.

• Design the non-human identity and agent authZ model that unblocks scheduled and unattended agents across every team.

• Stand up eval and regression infrastructure (framework, CI hooks, result storage) as a shared capability rather than three parallel bets.

Build, hands-on

• Avoid “ivory tower” syndrome by shipping production code against the highest-leverage components yourself — you're a builder first, not an advisor who hands off specs.

• Get close to live bets, such as the on-call investigation agent, to validate the architecture under real usage and economics, and prototype and de-risk the hardest pieces before asking any team to commit engineering time.

Lead without owning the org chart

• Mentor Agentic Engineers and Staff engineers across all three teams on agent architecture, context engineering, and evaluation rigor, and help grow the senior technical bench.

• Write the architecture decision records, standards docs, and playbooks that AI Platforms, AI DevX, and Agentic PDLC can each build against independently, and represent a coherent technical point of view in build-vs-buy and roadmap discussions, even without formal authority over the teams involved.

What We're Looking For

• 12+ years of engineering experience, including deep platform or systems architecture work at consumer scale (50M+ MAU or equivalent preferred).

• Demonstrated experience architecting agentic systems in production — not just using AI coding tools, but designing the frameworks, identity models, and eval infrastructure that other agents run on.

• Direct experience with non-human identity, service-account, or agent authZ models — or a clear, well-reasoned point of view on how to build one.

• Experience designing and consuming structured interfaces for AI systems (MCP-style tool definitions, JSON Schema, OpenAPI) and building for tool-calling and contract-first agent development.

• A track record of building eval and regression frameworks for AI systems — promotion gates, scoring, and CI integration — not just running evals ad hoc.

• Strong architectural instincts across multiple services and teams, with the judgment to know which problems deserve a shared platform investment and which don't.

• Fluency in AI economics — token cost as a design constraint, progressive retrieval, and the tradeoffs between centralizing and forking model usage.

• A track record of driving technical direction across teams you don't manage — through documentation, prototypes, and demonstrated results rather than mandates.

• Excellent written communication: architecture decision records, standards, and playbooks precise enough for other engineers (and their agents) to build against directly.

Bonus Points

• Experience building or operating an agent orchestration or deployment platform, or an MCP-style connector gateway.

• Background in ML infrastructure, model observability, or production AI systems at a company that has been through a comparable AI-native transformation.

• Experience with mobile engineering (iOS/Android) or high-throughput cloud systems, and how agent architecture needs to flex across both.

jobs.title: Regional Director, Global Government Sales
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

REGIONAL DIRECTOR, GLOBAL GOVERNMENT SALES

You'll build and lead the team that brings SpaceXSI to governments in your region. You'll hire the Account Executives, set territory and account strategy, and put in place the operating rhythm and playbooks that make government selling repeatable. You'll also stay hands-on and personally lead the largest pursuits in the region with your team. You'll represent government customers' needs to Product, Security and Policy, and own the regional relationship with Starlink and other SpaceX teams so that joint pursuits run as one coordinated effort.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Build the team. Hire, develop and coach Global Government Account Executives, and set a high bar for who joins.

 - Own regional pipeline and bookings. Set the regional sales strategy and own team pipeline generation and forecast accuracy, through regular forecast, pipeline and deal reviews.

 - Lead the largest pursuits. Work directly with senior government officials on the region's biggest deals, and coach your team through live sales cycles.

 - Make government selling repeatable. Build playbooks for tenders, procurement frameworks, security and sovereignty reviews, partner teaming and post-signature governance, and use them to speed up how fast new Account Executives ramp.

 - Lead the SpaceX partnership and partner ecosystem in the region. Set joint account plans with Starlink and other SpaceX teams, and develop the systems integrators and local partners the region relies on.

 - Win early reference customers in new countries, and bring field insight into positioning, deployment models and pricing.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 3+ years leading a team, including hiring and developing sellers

 - Experience owning a team's pipeline generation and forecast against plan

 - Experience personally closing complex public-sector deals and selling to or advising senior government officials (agency head, deputy minister or equivalent)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Hands-on leadership: you stay close to live deals and turn sellers into consistent performers

 - Playbooks and operating rhythm you've built and run

 - Fluency in public-sector procurement, contracting and compliance in more than one country

 - Enough technical fluency to hold credible AI conversations with technical and senior government audiences

 - Joint pursuits run across a complex, multi-company organization

 - Experience selling AI, cloud, software or data platforms to the public sector

 - Experience building a regional sales team or market entry from scratch

 - Relationships across foreign affairs ministries, regional bodies, or defense and security communities

 - Experience selling integrated hardware, connectivity and software solutions to governments

 - Professional fluency in Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic or French

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

 - Must be willing to travel approximately 30% of the time, mostly internationally.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $212,500 - $225,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $425,000 - $450,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer - Infra + DevOps
jobs.description:
Honor Technology’s mission is to change the way society cares for older adults. As a leader in aging care innovation, Honor provides the technology, tools, and services that empower older adults to live life on their own terms. Honor’s growing portfolio includes its consumer care brand, Home Instead, Inc., the world’s leading provider of in-home care for older adults. With a global franchise network and more than 100,000 Care Pros, Home Instead delivers over 50 million hours of personalized care annually.

Together, Honor and Home Instead are setting a new standard for aging in place, backed by powerful technology, compassionate care, and a commitment to aging on your own terms.

Join us to create a new and better aging experience for our clients, their families, and our Care Professionals.

About Us

Honor exists to expand the world’s capacity to care.

We’re combining high tech with high-touch to deliver better home care for aging adults, better jobs for Care Professionals, and entirely new offerings to support the aging journey, at scale.

Founded in 2014, and now a Series E funded “Unicorn” valued at over $1B, Honor leads the world’s largest home care network with the most advanced care platform. Our August 2021 acquisition of Home Instead has created a global company that’s revolutionizing how society cares for older adults, their families, and Care Professionals.

The Honor Care Platform combines local care and the most advanced technology to bring the highest quality care to more aging adults.

Grow at Honor as part of a united team where everyone shows up authentically, shares ideas bravely, and solves complex problems!

About the Team & Role:

We are looking for a seasoned platform engineer with experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable distributed systems & infrastructure. The platform engineering team builds and manages the infrastructure & core services that powers Honor’s Care Platform. Our charter is focused on providing foundational building blocks to enable the entire engineering organization to deliver reliably and efficiently. We also own build and deployment pipelines of our services, maintenance of various environments and their supporting infrastructure and serve as consultants to build the right abstractions for patterns of problems. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that requires a wide and deep experience in managing applications and infrastructure across cloud services. It requires deep practical knowledge of cloud platforms, advanced software design patterns & architecture, operations and automation, and containerization technologies like Kubernetes. The ideal candidate is driven by providing business value, is comfortable working with systems at varying levels of maturity, and appreciates making nuanced tradeoffs. You will be joining a small team of highly-skilled, enthusiastic, and passionate engineers with an opportunity to create an outsized impact in contributing to the future evolution of Honor’s Care Platform.

What are we looking for in a candidate:

• You thrive in a foundational role supporting diverse, cross-functional teams as your customers, possess exceptional problem solving and analytical skills.

• At least 6 years of professional experience in a platform engineering team within a product-centric company.

• 5+ years’ in designing and implementing foundational patterns and libraries for Python applications, across a range of technologies from API services to event processing

• 3+ years’ experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as CDK (preferred), Terraform and Ansible.

• 3+ years’ experience working alongside a production system running on Kubernetes

• 3+ years of professional experience in cloud engineering, preferably with AWS

• 3+ years’ experience in developing and maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, ArgoCD.

• Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Bash, Python, Go) and software engineering concepts.

• Experience with Helm including but not limited to managing helm charts as well as creating custom charts from existing ones or building new.

• Experience with networking security and secret-management tools (e.g. Vault, AWS SSM).

• Have experience automating the lifecycle management of code from development through production, including code promotion and configuration management.

• Proficient in instrumenting observability through tools such as CloudWatch and DataDog to monitor and optimize application performance across multiple environments.

• Have passion for delivering turn-key developer experience for local development

• Keen interest in developing talent through mentorship

• Strong written and verbal communication, tailored to a variety of audiences

• A strategic thinker with a product-first approach and customer obsession.

Some, or all, of these are true:

• You have experience working with an RPC architecture

• You work at or have worked at a technology startup and familiar with the challenges of evolving platform maturity

• You have first hand experience navigating multiple distributed architecture patterns

• Knowledge of infrastructure security review and compliance frameworks.

Perks & benefits:

• Remote-first work model lets you work from anywhere in the U.S. and occasionally pop into a satellite office

• Competitive salary

• Equity in the company

• Comprehensive medical, mental health, dental, vision, and life insurance

• Employer-matched 401(k)

• Flexible PTO (manager approval)

• Diverse environment, with women making up more than half of the company and half of the management team

• Monthly stipend to offset home office expenses

Honor is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, political affiliation or belief.

What’s next?

Honor is remote-friendly! We're hiring across the U.S., with an entirely virtual interview and onboarding process. Most of our positions are remote/work from home and do not require permanent relocation. As conditions allow, we have office space for in-person collaboration in our San Francisco Bay Area, CA, and Austin, TX hubs. Sets brand positioning, voice, and creative standards; leads integrated campaigns from brief through launch and readout; and brings Product, Branch, Growth, and Insights together around shared quarterly priorities. Co-owns the quarterly campaign calendar with the Director of Growth Marketing: this role originates the strategy, brief, and creative, while Growth owns channel deployment, optimization, and growth metrics. Success is defined by a brand that shows up consistently and campaigns that land on time, grow the business, and delight our members.

Pay Range:

• Sets creative direction for all brand and campaign work, including work executed by agency and vendor partners.

jobs.title: Manager, Forbes on Fifth
jobs.description:
Forbes is an iconic global media brand that has symbolized success for over a century. Fueled by journalism that informs and inspires, Forbes spotlights the doers and doings shaping industries, achieving success and making an impact on the world. Forbes connects and convenes the most influential communities ranging from billionaires, business leaders and rising entrepreneurs to creators and innovators. The Forbes brand reaches more than 140 million people monthly worldwide through its trusted journalism, signature ForbesLive events and 49 licensed local editions in 81 countries.

Forbes is seeking a hands-on, hospitality-first manager to oversee the day-to-day readiness and operations of Forbes on Fifth, our flagship New York event venue. Reporting to the Vice President, ForbesLive, this individual will serve as the venue’s primary on-site steward. They will ensure the space is polished, clean, well maintained, operationally sound, and fully prepared to host a wide range of internal, editorial, partner, licensee, and revenue-generating events.

This is a highly visible, five-day-per-week on-site role for an organized, proactive operator who can balance premium hospitality standards, event logistics, facility coordination, and stakeholder service. The Manager will independently lead non-revenue event operations and partner closely with the ForbesLive team to support venue operations for revenue-generating programs.

Responsibilities:

Venue Readiness, Maintenance & Hospitality

• Serve as the day-to-day operational steward of Forbes on Fifth, maintaining a consistently polished, welcoming, and event-ready environment.

• Conduct regular venue walkthroughs to identify maintenance, cleanliness, safety, furniture, technology, supply, and presentation needs before they affect an event or guest experience.

• Coordinate the timely resolution of facility-related issues with Corporate Facilities, building management, cleaning partners, and other outside service providers.

• Maintain clear visibility into ongoing repairs, preventive maintenance needs, venue improvements, and service requests, escalating issues appropriately and following through to completion.

• Ensure all guest-facing and back-of-house areas are clean, organized, well stocked, and aligned with Forbes’ hospitality standards.

• Anticipate each day’s space, hospitality, and operational needs based on the venue calendar, including room resets, furniture configurations, supplies, deliveries, and staffing.

• Manage venue-specific inventory, including event furnishings, supplies, signage, hospitality materials, and beverage inventory.

• Coordinate the receipt, storage, tracking, distribution, and return of event materials, shipments, samples, books, signage, and other venue-related assets.

Calendar, Space Booking & Stakeholder Service

• Own and maintain the master calendar for Forbes on Fifth, ensuring all reservations, holds, changes, room assignments, and event details are accurate and current.

• Serve as the central point of contact for venue requests, confirming availability, gathering required event information, and managing the intake process from initial inquiry through final confirmation.

• Coordinate room assignments and resolve scheduling conflicts in partnership with stakeholders and ForbesLive leadership.

• Lead venue walkthroughs and planning conversations with internal teams, partners, licensees, and other event stakeholders.

• Translate stakeholder needs into practical venue plans, including room layouts, hospitality requirements, audio/visual needs, staffing, security, catering, photography, and load-in requirements.

Non-Revenue Event Management

• Independently manage end-to-end venue operations for non-revenue events, including internal programs, content productions, and licensee events, and other approved uses of the space.

• Develop and manage detailed event logistics, including vendor timelines, floor plans, room setups, service orders, delivery schedules, load-in, event-day operations, load-out, and room reset.

• Coordinate with vendors and stakeholders to ensure all event elements are delivered to a high standard and within approved scope and budget.

• Support invitations, guest-facing materials, event signage, and other event deliverables as needed.

• Maintain calm, responsive, solutions-oriented leadership on event days, ensuring guests, stakeholders, and vendors have a seamless experience.

ForbesLive Event Support

• Partner with ForbesLive producers and event leads to serve as the venue operations lead for revenue-generating programs hosted at Forbes on Fifth.

• Support venue readiness, vendor access, room setup, hospitality, deliveries, load-in, load-out, and post-event reset for ForbesLive events.

• Coordinate closely with the ForbesLive team to ensure event operations are aligned with approved production plans, client commitments, and guest experience standards.

• Provide knowledgeable, on-site support to help the ForbesLive team execute efficiently in the space.

Vendor, Financial & Compliance Coordination

• Maintain strong working relationships with preferred venue vendors across audio/visual, catering, staffing, security, furniture rental, photography, cleaning, and other operational needs.

• Request and evaluate vendor quotes, prepare event cost estimates, and coordinate event-related expenses with stakeholders before services are confirmed.

• Track invoices, receipts, event costs, and budget codes, partnering with Finance to support accurate chargebacks, billing, and expense reconciliation.

• Coordinate vendor onboarding and renewal processes with Legal, Finance, Facilities, and building management, including agreements, rate cards, certificates of insurance, and other required documentation.

• Support responsible management of hospitality and beverage inventory, including ordering, post-event counts, replenishment, and cost allocation in accordance with company policy.

Systems, Standards & Continuous Improvement

• Build and maintain venue operating procedures, event checklists, intake forms, vendor guides, floor-plan standards, inventory records, and other tools that create consistency and scalability.

• Identify opportunities to improve the venue experience, reduce operational friction, strengthen vendor performance, and elevate service standards.

• Establish clear handoffs and communication practices across ForbesLive, Facilities, Finance, Legal, Editorial, Licensing, and other internal teams.

The Ideal Candidate:

• Experience in venue operations, event operations, hospitality, facilities coordination, hotel operations, or a comparable high-touch guest environment.

• Experience overseeing a premium event venue, hospitality space, cultural institution, corporate event space, hotel, restaurant, or similar setting.

• A hospitality-first mindset with exceptional attention to cleanliness, presentation, detail, and guest experience.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple events, stakeholder requests, vendors, deadlines, and competing priorities at once.

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

jobs.title: Senior GNC Engineer
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

As a Senior GNC engineer, you will be a core driver of the overall spacecraft GNC architecture. You will execute detailed trade studies to find new and novel ways to implement the spacecraft’s orbital guidance, orbital control, and attitude and orbit estimation systems. In the first 3 months, you will support the development/improvement of the MEO navigation, taking lessons learned from the Gravitas mission and applying them to the baseline GNC stack. In the first 6 months you will support the development of new and novel navigation approaches to support future programs – specifically solving navigation for GEO, cis lunar, and interplanetary. In parallel you will support the development of the in-house trajectory design scheme and associated analysis workflow. As we learn more about our system, this will lead to updates to both the GNC stack and the K2 6-DOF simulation. The expectation is that all GNC team members commit code to the 6-DOF sim as well as owning a portion of the GNC flight software.

In the first year, you will support launch and on orbit operations of the Trinity mission – the stacked launch of 3 K2 Mega spacecraft. In parallel, you will continue to support improvements, closing the loop on the design, build, test, fly lifecycle.

Responsibilities

• Work with other engineering leads to develop and validate a novel high level vehicle architecture

• Develop novel algorithms for precise navigation in LEO, MEO, GEO, cis lunar, and interplanetary space.

• Develop simulation and modeling tools to support vehicle and GNC trade studies. This includes mission design, controls analysis, and 6-DOF simulation development.

• Contribute to building the GNC organization by recruiting, hiring, and mentoring other engineers

Qualifications

• Experience with implementing estimation algorithms on for flight software and ground software, specifically Kalman Filters, Extended Kalman Filters, and Unscented Kalman Filters

• Experience performing Monte Carlo based analyses and covariance analysis

• Experience with verification and validation of GNC flight software in an integrated environment, leveraging 6-DOF simulation and HITL testing.

• Experience with GNC sensor sizing, selection, and system design

• Experience with Python, Julia, C/C++, Rust, or Matlab for algorithm development, implementation, and simulation

Nice to Have

• Experience with system identification, leveraging on-orbit data

• Experience with early-stage spacecraft conceptual design, i.e. “clean sheet” design work

• Breadth in control algorithm development

• Experience with reaction wheel, control moment gyroscope, or thruster sizing and algorithm implementation

• Experience with trajectory analysis, modeling, optimization, and mission design for GEO, cislunar, interplanetary missions

Compensation and Benefits:

• Base salary range for this role is $160,000 - $235,000 + equity in the company

• Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level

• Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Diagnostics & Calibration
jobs.description:
Agility’s commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About The Role

Our software team is growing and we are looking for an experienced robotics engineer to own how we assess the health of Digit. You will build the self-diagnostics, calibration, and fleet health tools that tell our manufacturing, test, service, and deployment teams whether a robot is ready to work — and why it isn't. You will root-cause hardware and performance issues on prototype and production robots, turn what you learn into automated checks, and feed the results back to teams across the organization. Your work will directly enable our ability to scale up the world's first production humanoid robot fleet and revolutionize the labor market.

About The Work

• Develop a deep understanding of Digit's hardware through active participation in the bring up of prototype hardware and integration of new sensors.

• Extend Digit's self-diagnostics suite: automated checks of actuators, sensors, and limbs (e.g., actuator efficiency and health, leg stiffness, IMU and force/torque sensor checks) that determine whether a robot is fit to run a workflow.

• Lead root cause analysis on robots from prototype builds, the factory, and customer sites: isolate failures to subsystems, reproduce them with the Systems Test & Validation team, and drive corrective actions with hardware teams and suppliers.

• Turn RCA findings into new checks and pass/fail criteria, and validate that check results predict real robot performance.

• Develop and maintain calibration routines, including camera-based kinematic calibration of arms and legs, that run reliably in manufacturing and service.

• Build fleet health observability: define what robots log, get results into our data pipelines, and maintain dashboards and reports that track hardware health across the fleet over time.

• Build tools that non-engineers can use, such as operator-facing GUIs and reports for manufacturing, service, and solutions teams.

About You

• BS, MS, or PhD in robotics, mechanical, electrical, or computer engineering, computer science, or a related field.

• 4+ years of industry experience developing software for physical robots or comparable electromechanical systems, with substantial hands-on hardware debugging.

• Proven track record of root cause analysis on complex electromechanical systems: separating software, controls, and hardware faults using logs, telemetry, and targeted experiments.

• Solid working knowledge of actuators (motors, transmissions, encoders) and robot sensors (IMUs, force/torque sensors, cameras), and how they fail.

• Strong Python and C++, with experience building diagnostic or test tools used by other teams.

• Data-driven: experience analyzing high-rate robot logs and fleet telemetry, using SQL and dashboards.

• Clear communicator who can turn noisy data into structured reports and procedures for engineering, manufacturing, and service partners.

• Familiarity with Jira, Git, and CI/CD workflows.

Nice To Have

• State estimation or controls background, especially on legged robots.

• Robot calibration (kinematic, camera-to-robot extrinsics) or system identification.

• Computer vision or ML applied to calibration.

This a on-site position based out of one of our Salem office.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Lead / Head of Creative
jobs.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/5fce1e15-71f1-4704-a4f3-daac73a8c5e4/fb4de8d0-215d-448f-834c-f5f9812a4507/Copy%20of%20Careers%20Page%20Visuals%20(4).png]




ABOUT US

Creative Milkshake is a remote-first performance creative agency. We make scroll-stopping short-form ads for some of the world’s most exciting DTC brands on Meta and TikTok - high-volume, fast-moving, and built to convert.

We’re a close-knit team of ~34 people spread across the Netherlands, the Philippines, South Africa, Spain, and beyond. We’ve recently joined the Fieldtrip group alongside inBeat, which means we’re growing - in ambition, in capability, and in the complexity of clients we work with.

Our Amsterdam studio is the creative heart of our production operation. Over the next 1–2 years, we’re expanding from UGC-first content toward elevated branded formats, this role is central to holding the quality bar as we scale.


THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Creative Lead / Head of Creative to own creative quality at Creative Milkshake, from brief to final ad. You'll be the golden thread across Creative Strategy, Production and Post-Production: the person who sets the creative standard, helps every team understand what "great" looks like, and makes sure it shows up in everything we send to clients.

This is a senior leadership role with real creative authority, one step below Director. You'll own the output of the Creative Strategy, Production, and Post teams and be a visible creative voice with clients. We want someone with the gravitas to hold the bar and the adaptability to build on how we work today, not replace it.

Our team is young, kind and very close. Many of them are used to either close direction or to hearing that the work is great. A big part of your job is raising the standard in a way that builds confidence and autonomy, so people want to do better work rather than fear being corrected.


WHAT YOU'LL DO


OWN THE CREATIVE QUALITY BAR

 - Approvals: Be the final creative eye on storyboards, raw footage and final edits before work reaches clients

 - Give specific, hands-on feedback that people can act on: what to change, why, and what better looks like

 - Build and maintain our "what good looks like" library, creative checklists and review standards, so quality does not depend on one person

 - Spot recurring patterns (weak hooks, storyboards that will not shoot, editing habits) and fix them at the root


LEAD CREATIVE EXCELLENCE

 - Lead the teams: Work with the team leads to set direction, coach, and build their creative judgement

 - Create a culture of ownership where people bring problems up early and are trusted to make good decisions

 - Run regular creative reviews and inspiration sessions that give everyone a shared language for quality

 - Help us grow the team and raise the skills bar as we scale


BRIDGE STRATEGY, PRODUCTION AND POST

 - Make sure what strategy writes can actually be shot, and what production shoots gives post what it needs

 - Translate creative strategy into briefs production can walk into the studio with

 - Partner with the Managing Director and Operations on processes, tools and handoffs between teams

 - Use AI and smart tooling to remove admin so people can spend their time on the craft


TURN PERFORMANCE INTO CREATIVE DIRECTION

 - Read paid social performance well enough to guide the team on what to test, iterate and drop

 - Hold strategists to a high standard on how they use data in their briefs and learnings

 - Keep a current, critical relationship with TikTok, Meta and emerging short-form formats


BE A CREATIVE VOICE WITH CLIENTS

 - Present creative rationale with calm authority, including on calls with our more complex and high-profile clients

 - Back the team's work in the room, and constructively challenge when a client direction will not perform

 - Help us win and grow accounts as we move toward more proactive pitching


SHAPE OUR CREATIVE IDENTITY

 - Define and document Creative Milkshake's creative point of view: the formats, instincts and signatures that make our work recognisable

 - Guide creative excellence from UGC-first into elevated social-first content, and approve how we present ourselves externally


WHO YOU ARE

We're not filtering on job titles. The right person might be a Creative Director, an Associate Creative Director, a Head of Creative or Content, or a senior creative producer. What matters is what you've done and how you lead.

 - You have 7+ years in creative with some leadership across social-first, performance or content work, at an agency, a DTC brand or a production house

 - You have great taste! You know when something works well, and how to explain it.

 - You are fluent in production: you know what a storyboard needs to say for a shoot to go well, and you can give feedback that production and post can turn into action

 - You understand paid social and creative performance well enough to guide a team and challenge their thinking, even if you are not a data specialist

 - You have led teams and developed people, ideally mixing experienced and early-career talent

 - You can tell a good ad from a great one in seconds, and explain the difference in a way that helps the person who made it

 - You carry yourself well in front of clients: confident, warm and credible, with strong opinions held without ego

 - You have real conviction and presence, and you are adaptable. You bring a point of view without being set in your ways about how creative is done

 - You have high EQ and give honest feedback without damaging confidence or relationships

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity and pace. We're building systems while operating at volume

 - You're fluent in English; working hours within about 3 hours of CET


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF...

 - You love the craft of short-form content and get genuinely excited about what makes someone stop scrolling

 - You want to build a team's confidence and creative instinct, not just approve work

 - You enjoy being the bridge between strategy, production and post, and fixing how teams work together

 - You like a close-knit, kind, fast-moving culture where people care about the work

 - Helping a studio step up from UGC to elevated social-first content sounds like the right moment to join


THIS ROLE ISN'T FOR YOU IF...

 - Your experience is only in strategy or performance marketing, with no real production or editing exposure

 - Your creative background is mainly brand identity or traditional advertising rather than social-first content

 - You prefer a hierarchical, top-down leadership style or a fully built machine to operate in

 - You're set on one way of doing creative and find it hard to adapt to a new team and context


WHAT WE OFFER

 - A senior role with real influence at a growing agency in the Fieldtrip group

 - Competitive compensation, reviewed yearly

 - Creative Milkshake stipends (mental health, healthcare and internet)

 - Time off: 21 days PTO plus 7 paid sick days, and a company closure over the end-of-year period

 - Maternity/paternity leave

 - Long service incentives (from 2 years)

 - Remote-first, with regular contact with our Amsterdam studio

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management- MFT
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

Why This Role Matters

At OPSWAT, protecting the world’s critical infrastructure is real, urgent, and growing. MetaDefender Managed File Transfer (MFT) is a security-first MFT platform trusted by customers in finance, life sciences, government, and critical infrastructure to move sensitive files safely across IT and OT environments. We are now ready to take MFT to the next level and win against established MFT vendors. As a member of OPSWAT’s product leadership team, you will help set company-level product strategy, influence investment decisions across the portfolio, and be accountable for
the business performance of MFT. This Senior Director role is a rare opportunity to shape the future of MFT, including a next-generation MFT Gateway and a lightweight automation offering, while scaling commercial impact and deepening customer value. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and go-to-market success, with clear ownership and visible impact. It is also a chance to redefine what product management looks like in the AI era. We are not looking for someone who talks about AI. We want a leader who already uses it every day to work faster and smarter, and who can build a team of PMs that does the same. If you are energized by building, innovating, and owning outcomes, this role was designed for you.

What You Will Be Doing

As Senior Director of Product Management, MFT, you will be the executive owner of MFT’s product strategy,
business performance, and growth trajectory. You will:

• Set and own the MFT product vision and roadmap, including the MFT Gateway, automation, and AI-driven capabilities.

• Translate market signals, customer needs, and competitive insights into clear product direction and prioritized investments.

• Drive MFT’s position in regulated and high-assurance markets (e.g., GxP, financial services, federal, OT), including compliance, audit, and integrity requirements.

• Partner deeply with Engineering, ensuring fast, high-quality execution and scalable architecture.

• Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to drive bookings, pipeline, competitive displacements, and customer adoption.

• Serve as a strong, visible product leader across regions, with close partnership with our engineering team in Hungary and Romania.

• Balance innovation with operational excellence, ensuring MFT delivers reliability, performance, and trust at scale.

• Own MFT business results, including revenue, pricing, packaging, and investment priorities.

• Shape company-level product strategy as part of the product leadership team, presenting to the CEO and executive team.

• Represent MFT as its executive voice with strategic customers, partners, analysts, and at industry events.

Build an AI-Native Product Function

You will set the standard for how product management works at OPSWAT, using AI as a core part of how the
team operates:

• Use AI to compress the path from customer signal to shipped feature: synthesizing customer calls, support tickets, win/loss data, and competitive intel into clear insights in hours, not weeks.

• Use AI tools to draft PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and release notes, freeing PMs to spend more time with customers and engineers.

• Prototype workflows and UI concepts with AI to validate ideas with customers before engineering commits.

• Build AI-assisted competitive and market analysis so the team always knows where MFT wins and why.

• Identify where AI belongs inside the product itself, from intelligent automation and anomaly detection to policy recommendations and natural-language administration.

• Define practical guardrails for using AI safely in a security company, protecting customer data and IP.

Grow and Lead a Team of PMs

You will build and develop a high-performing product team as MFT grows:

• Hire, coach, and grow product managers across regions, raising the bar on product judgment, customer empathy, and execution.

• Create a clear career path and a culture of ownership, where PMs own outcomes, not just backlogs.

• Establish lightweight, repeatable product processes for discovery, prioritization, and launch that scale with the business.

• Make every PM on the team AI-fluent through hands-on enablement, shared playbooks, and leading by example.Develop future product leaders who can take on new product lines as OPSWAT grows.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, success will look like:

• A clear, compelling MFT roadmap aligned to market demand and customer value.

• Measurable growth in bookings and pipeline tied directly to product strategy.

• Competitive wins displacing legacy MFT solutions in strategic accounts.

• Strong, trust-based partnerships with Engineering and GTM teams.

• Delivery of the MFT Gateway and automation offerings that position MFT for long-term growth.

• An AI-native product team with measurably faster discovery, documentation, and release cycles.

• A growing, engaged team of PMs with clear ownership and visible development.

• AI-powered capabilities in the MFT roadmap that customers value and competitors lack.

• A product organization that moves with urgency, clarity, and accountability.

• Recognition as a trusted executive voice for MFT inside OPSWAT and across the market.

Who You Are

You are a product leader who blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You bring:

• Proven experience owning enterprise or security products at scale, including business outcomes such as revenue, pricing, and packaging.

• Deep, hands-on experience using AI in your daily product work, and a clear point of view on how AI changes the PM role. Be ready to show us how you use it.

• Experience building AI-powered features into enterprise products.

• A track record of hiring, coaching, and growing product managers into strong leaders.

• Strong understanding of MFT, secure file transfer protocols (SFTP, FTPS, HTTPS), identity and access (SSO, OAuth, mTLS), or adjacent security domains.

• Familiarity with the competitive MFT landscape and the compliance needs of regulated industries.

• A track record of partnering effectively with Engineering to deliver complex products.

• Commercial acumen and experience supporting bookings, pipeline, and customer conversations.

• Comfort operating in a global, distributed environment, including close collaboration with teams in Europe.

• Executive presence, with clear, confident communication and the ability to influence peers, executives, and customers at the C-level.

• Experience operating as part of an executive or senior leadership team, making portfolio-level tradeoffs.

• A mindset rooted in ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.

• 10+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading teams of PMs. Senior Director or Director-level experience is preferred, but we value demonstrated leadership altitude, judgment, and impact above title alone.

Why OPSWAT?

OPSWAT is a fast-growing cybersecurity company with a strong culture of ownership and innovation. We build products that matter, support leaders who take initiative, and invest in those who want to grow. In this role, you will:

• Own a revenue-generating product with a large market and meaningful runway.

• Shape the future of security-first MFT and MFT Gateway innovation.

• Build and lead your own team, and define what an AI-native product organization looks like.

• Work with smart, committed teams across the globe, at a company that rewards using AI to move faster.

• Join the executive product leadership team, with a direct influence on company strategy.

• If you are looking for a role where your decisions matter, your leadership is visible, and your work protects what matters most, we would love to meet you.

OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

jobs.title: Senior Health Informatics Data Analyst
jobs.description:
WELLTH IS A PIONEERING DIGITAL HEALTH COMPANY.

Wellth is a fast-growing, growth-stage digital health company headquartered in Los Angeles. Our mission is to motivate people living with chronic conditions to make healthier choices, every single day.

We use behavioral economics, habit science and technology to motivate lasting behavior change in some of the highest need and most underserved populations in the US (Medicare and Medicaid), drastically changing their quality of life and health outcomes. We have demonstrated results with several large insurers and health systems (e.g. reducing hospitalizations by over 40%), and are now rapidly scaling. Our goal is to be the category leader in improving health outcomes for hard-to-engage populations. A key difference at Wellth compared to other digital health companies is that our users (Members) actually use Wellth every single day - think TikTok tier daily engagement (and data generation!).

But most importantly, our work quite literally saves lives by stabilizing chronic disease patients and preventing disease progression, hospitalization, and other bad outcomes. We are a mission-driven company where you work with incredible talent and see tangible differences directly from your impact.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Join us as a Senior Health Informatics Data Analyst and show the power of healthcare data (claims, medications, labs, quality outcomes) to prove the life-changing impact of Wellth's innovative behavior change programs.  You are a healthcare data subject matter expert, experienced in healthcare datasets and analyses, including health outcomes, ROI, and utilization reduction. Our data team will rely on your guidance for structuring client healthcare data to inform product and program design.

You are passionate about transforming healthcare data into compelling narratives and actionable insights. You will enhance our team's analytical capabilities and identify innovative ways to showcase our impactful work. This includes driving the development of analyses for the commercial team and creating external-facing materials (blog posts, webinars, white papers) highlighting our outcomes and opportunities. You will present analyses to clients during business reviews and collaborate with client data teams on how to best help their members.

Success in this role means advancing our understanding of healthcare data possibilities, conducting analyses that drive client growth, and partnering with engineering in data modeling as a healthcare data expert. This individual contributor role within our data team reports to the Director of Data Engineering and Analytics and requires close collaboration with data engineering, analytics engineering, and commercial teams.




SPECIFICALLY, YOU WILL:

 - Conduct analyses to identify trends, generate actionable insights, and propose strategies that drive success and outcomes for Wellth’s members and payer and provider clients.

 - Be the face of our data expertise! Lead engaging client discussions, present transformative analyses, and provide compelling insights on quality metric performance, CMS measures, and ROI.

 - Develop and present complex reports, dashboards, visualizations and presentations to demonstrate Wellth’s value and support both new business and ongoing partnerships.

 - Partner with commercial and client success teams to provide feedback and identify new ways to leverage data insights to address client-specific challenges, enhancing the value of Wellth’s services.

 - Support the client data onboarding plan and execution including internal and external coordination and communication.

 - Develop and refine targeting algorithms to identify members most likely to benefit from Wellth’s interventions.

 - Provide strategic recommendations internally for new use cases, enhancements to existing analytics capabilities, and ways to optimize data usage to better serve clients.

 - Stay current on healthcare industry trends and analytics methodologies, continuously refining analytical methods to drive more meaningful insights.
   
   


YOU WILL WORK WITH:

 - Commercial, Client Success, and Marketing teams to support client engagements, provide data-driven insights, and ensure that Wellth’s platform delivers measurable value.

 - Product teams to provide data-driven feedback that informs product enhancements.

 - Data engineers, analytics engineers, and client data teams to gather data requirements and deliver bespoke data solutions aligned with client needs.

 - Senior leadership to influence and drive client acquisition and retention strategies through data storytelling and insights.

 - Client data teams to ensure seamless data integration to power our behavior change programs.
   
   


WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

 - 5+ years of experience working with healthcare products and data, having directly worked with medical/pharmacy claims data, patient data, and other health-related data sets.

 - 3+ years of professional experience as a healthcare data analyst in a client-facing capacity.

 - Experience optimizing SQL queries running on analytical databases such as Redshift and Snowflake.

 - Proficiency in BI tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Sisense, with a strong eye for visual storytelling

 - Strong understanding of healthcare quality metrics (HEDIS, Stars) and ROI/financial modeling.

 - Strong communication skills to translate complex data into compelling, easy-to-understand narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Outstanding attention to detail and commitment to quality with experience developing repeatable, scalable processes.

 - Ability to provide strategic insights and proactively identify new ways to leverage data to meet client objectives and optimize quality measures.
   
   


YOU MIGHT BE THE CANDIDATE WE’RE LOOKING FOR IF YOU CAN:

 - Inspire confidence through your data-driven insights and guiding strategies that improve care and reduce costs.

 - Thrive in a client-facing role, driving discussions and building trusted partnerships through your ability to provide actionable, data-driven recommendations.

 - Take ownership of complex data projects and deliver results with minimal oversight

 - Operate as a subject matter expert and thought leader, bringing a strong, informed point of view to drive clarity and execution in ambiguous or complex problem areas.

 - Experience in exploring advanced data analysis techniques, including developing Python scripts for data manipulation and analysis, performing light data science tasks (e.g., statistical modeling, exploratory data analysis), and leveraging AI/ML tools for insights generation.




YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US AT WELLTH.

The benefits of working with us include:

 - Flexible working arrangements, supporting strong remote-first practices and tools with the option to work in our excellent gathering space in Marina Del Rey

 - Competitive salary & commission structure

 - Health, dental, vision insurance, and FSA/HSA plans

 - Ability to have a positive impact on people who need it most

 - Support of a highly dedicated team focused on building the future of healthcare
   
   

Base Compensation: $150-180k



Wellth is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Operations Associate, Part-Time - Boston
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter and winning a Best Carbon Footprint award, we have big goals like being Climate Positive by 2025, Circular by 2030, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way. Our work has gotten love in Drapers and Sourcing Journal, and TIME wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.

We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own sustainable factory in LA. We innovate across categories like accessories, swimwear, and sleepwear, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like this, this and this.

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.

And starting right now, we want to do all that with you.

Work Location/ Schedule:

• Available to work a minimum of 20 hours per week,

• Available to work a minimum of 3 days per week, weekends included.

• Able to work flexible schedule (days, nights, weekends, & holidays if required to meet the needs of the business).

Operations Associate:

As an operations associate at Reformation, your primary role will be to provide support in daily operations, standardize processes in store, merchandising, and maintaining a clean and organized store environment. You will support both the store’s goals and your responsibilities will include assisting with inventory control supporting the store’s success , while creating a positive shopping experience.

What You’ll Do:

• Support the operational efforts required to achieve store goals.

• Maintain seamless store operational procedures.

• Consistently use and understand processes and procedures to track in store inventory accurately.

• Track, receive and process all inbound inventory shipments.

• Complete inventory related tasks as necessary with an elevated attention to detail, including inbound and outbound store transfers, shipment, and omni channel order processing.

• Complete shipment processing - receiving, hanging, steaming, tagging (when applicable) and organizing in the back of house.

• Support the process of completing markdowns when applicable.

• Submit facilities tickets to ensure maintenance, presentation and organization.

• Organize store supplies.

• Ensure the back of house reflects the brand and concept standards at all times.

• Prepare and deliver all customer fitting rooms quickly and accurately.

• Prepare and support all customer purchases in alignment with brand standards, preparing, folding and bagging products.

• Replenish the sales floor when products are sold to ensure visual presentations and inventory levels meet brand standards at all times.

• Support execution of visual merchandising tasks as new products are received, including adjusting visual merchandising when products are sold out or sold through.

• Execute visual displays and mannequins when directed.

• Receive extraordinary customer experience feedback and scoring on service evaluation.

• Contribute to Loss Prevention in all areas of the business.

• Uphold time and attendance policy.

• Bring an ambitious and passionate attitude to work daily.

• Help ensure that the store environment is inspiring and our product is easily accessible.

• Understand the core values and culture of Reformation and reflect these in all efforts.

• Maintain and uphold a professional, healthy, and productive work environment.

What You’ll Bring:

• 1+ years relevant experience in a fastpaced, creative service environment.

• Familiarity with the user functionality of desktop, mobile, tablet and digital technologies.

• Experience working with a sales or retail organization and/or operationally intensive business.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced setting.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact effectively with diverse personalities.

• Driven approach to take on new challenges with the self-motivation for your work and career.

Compensation:

At Reformation, we believe in transparency and equity when it comes to compensation. For this role, the anticipated base hourly range is $17 – $19 per hour, depending on a variety of factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal compensation equity.

Please note that compensation decisions are made thoughtfully and may vary from the listed range to reflect individual circumstances and evolving business needs. Our total rewards package also includes benefits, perks, and opportunities for growth that contribute to overall compensation.

Benefits & Perks:

• Eligible employees get employer-sponsored private medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as commuter benefits to help support your travel to and from work.

• We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays for eligible employees.

• We offer retirement planning support for eligible employees, including the option to invest in Environmental Social Governance-aligned (fancy way to say sustainable) funds.

• We’re a mission-based company with offices in LA, NYC and London, as well as a global retail team, which means you’ll get to collaborate with people all around the world.

• You’ll get access to fertility care support through Carrot, and up to a $5,000 USD reimbursement for related fertility expenses after 1 year of employment.

• We care about the causes our employees care about so we donate to community efforts on a yearly basis.

• We offer a clothing discount, culture events (like our annual Ref Values week and Volunteer Time Off), you know, all the meaningful and fun stuff!

Reformation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the world we want to live in. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status—in accordance with applicable international, federal, state, and local laws.

If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re here to ensure you have what you need to show up as your best self.

Still don’t know if you should apply? We get it—studies show that many women and individuals from historically underrepresented communities hold back from applying unless they meet every single requirement. At Reformation, we’re all about growth, not gatekeeping. If you’re passionate about the role and excited about making fashion more sustainable, we’d love to hear from you. If this role doesn’t totally excite you, consider applying to our general application.
