jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT CAMPFIRE

Campfire is building the next generation of accounting software, helping modern finance teams work smarter, move faster, and spend less time on manual processes.

We're a fast-growing team reimagining how companies manage their finances, and we're looking for ambitious, creative, and data-driven people to help us scale.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to build and scale our lifecycle marketing engine.

In this role, you'll own the strategy and execution of campaigns that engage prospects, activate new users, accelerate conversion, and drive long-term customer engagement.

You'll combine data, automation, experimentation, and compelling messaging to deliver personalized experiences at every stage of the customer journey.

This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on role. You'll partner closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to turn lifecycle marketing into a measurable growth driver.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and a strong operator: someone who can identify opportunities in the funnel, design sophisticated lifecycle journeys, and execute campaigns end-to-end.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the lifecycle marketing strategy

 - Develop and execute lifecycle programs across the prospect and customer journey, from lead nurturing and onboarding to engagement, expansion, and retention.

 - Map customer journeys and identify opportunities to improve conversion, engagement, and customer experience.

 - Build audience segmentation strategies based on customer behavior, lifecycle stage, firmographics, and intent signals.



Build and optimize automated journeys

 - Design, launch, and optimize automated, multi-touch campaigns across email, in-app messaging, and other relevant channels.

 - Create personalized nurture programs that move prospects through the funnel and accelerate pipeline creation.

 - Partner with Sales to build effective lead nurturing, re-engagement, and sales-assist programs.

 - Develop onboarding and adoption campaigns that help customers realize value faster.

Drive experimentation and performance

 - Establish a rigorous testing program across messaging, content, segmentation, timing, and channels.

 - Analyze funnel performance to identify opportunities to improve conversion and engagement.

 - Define and track lifecycle KPIs, including lead-to-opportunity conversion, activation, engagement, pipeline influence, and retention.

 - Translate campaign performance and customer insights into actionable recommendations.

Own lifecycle marketing operations

 - Build and maintain scalable lifecycle workflows, segmentation, and campaign infrastructure.

 - Partner with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations to ensure accurate data, effective integrations, and reliable attribution.

 - Maintain high standards for deliverability, data quality, consent management, and campaign execution.

 - Leverage AI and automation to improve personalization, campaign development, experimentation, and operational efficiency.

Collaborate across the business

 - Work with Product Marketing to translate positioning and product value into compelling lifecycle messaging.

 - Partner with Demand Generation to convert inbound interest into qualified pipeline.

 - Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success to identify friction points and improve the customer experience.

 - Work with Product and Analytics teams to understand user behavior and trigger relevant communications.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4–7+ years of experience in lifecycle marketing, growth marketing, CRM marketing, or marketing automation, ideally in a high-growth B2B SaaS company.

 - Demonstrated success building and scaling automated lifecycle programs that drive measurable business outcomes.

 - Hands-on experience with marketing automation and customer engagement platforms such as HubSpot, Customer.io http://Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, or similar tools.

 - Strong analytical skills and comfort working with funnel metrics, segmentation, dashboards, and experimentation.

 - Experience developing behavior-based and trigger-based campaigns using customer and product data.

 - Strong copywriting skills and an ability to translate complex product concepts into clear, engaging communications.

 - Understanding of B2B customer journeys, lead management, sales funnels, and SaaS growth metrics.

 - Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and a bias toward action.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience marketing to finance, accounting, or other technical B2B audiences.

 - Experience in a product-led growth or hybrid PLG/sales-led environment.

 - Familiarity with SQL, analytics tools, and customer data platforms.

 - Experience using AI tools to scale content creation, personalization, and marketing workflows.

 - Experience building lifecycle programs from the ground up at an early-stage startup.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Support Engineer - Federal
jobs.description:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

About the Role:

As a Senior Technical Support Engineer at Dragos, you’ll be a key contributor to our mission of protecting critical infrastructure from cyber threats. This role is essential to resolving complex technical issues, supporting customer success, and strengthening the reliability of the Dragos Platform. You’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, leveraging your expertise in modern infrastructure, observability tools, and platform integrations. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the industrial cybersecurity space while working with cutting-edge technologies and collaborating across global teams.

Responsibilities:

• Provide advanced technical support for the Dragos Platform, handling escalated tickets that require deep troubleshooting and technical analysis.

• Investigate and resolve complex issues involving Kubernetes, Linux, hardware, cloud infrastructure, and various other components.

• Collaborate with internal teams to share insights, improve support processes, and contribute to knowledge base content.

• Maintain professional communication with customers throughout the troubleshooting process, delivering timely updates and clear explanations.

• Participate in the escalation engineer and weekend on-call rotations (up to one weekend per month), ensuring high availability for critical issues.

• Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting complex solutions, updating internal knowledge bases, and refining support processes.

Requirements:

• MUST be a US Citizen

• 4+ years of experience in technical support, systems engineering, or a related field.

• Proficiency in Linux administration and troubleshooting.

• Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, hardware diagnostics, and cloud platforms (especially AWS).

• Familiarity with tools such as RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus, and Postgres.

• Strong troubleshooting skills across APIs, networking, and hybrid cloud/on-prem environments.

• Genuine enthusiasm for helping customers succeed, with a proactive approach to solving technical challenges in a fast-paced environment.

• A natural curiosity and ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and tools.

• Excellent communication skills and a customer-first mindset.

Bonus Points:

• Experience in OT/ICS environments or industrial cybersecurity.

• Familiarity with the Dragos Platform or similar cybersecurity tools.

• Knowledge of industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).

• Prior experience supporting enterprise customers in regulated industries.

jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn’t adapt to the world. We think that’s backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. We bring together exceptional people with the drive and creativity to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We’re looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in accountability, initiative and shared success. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. We operate with low egos, high velocity, and extreme ownership to build technology that expands access and benefits the many, not the few.



HOW WE WORK

 - Impact over activity: We are building a generational company. We value people who execute on ideas rather than comment from the sidelines. We believe our competitive edge lies in caring about excellence across the entire lifecycle - from research to product. No task is beneath anyone: no one is too senior to test the build, clean the data, or unblock a teammate.

 - Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels.

 - Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint.
   


THE ROLE

Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few.

This is a research role focused on building models that continuously evolve with the world. Our frontier work centers on efficiency, gradient-free exploration, real-time learning, and interface design. The most intelligent systems will increasingly be defined not just by what they know, but by how well they can interact with the world. For the first time, researchers who care deeply about intelligence and efficiency must also be obsessed with the interface through which a model acts. If any of this resonates, we'd love to hear from you.

Our Research Principles

Sweat the details. Technical excellence requires obsessing over every detail. We co-design serving, algorithms, and interface as one system to maximize efficiency and enable real-time adaptation.

Move with conviction. Extraordinary results require extraordinary effort. We operate with urgency as a unified team, concentrating resources on a few high-conviction bets where research and impact intersect.

Metrics that matter. The most intelligent system will increasingly be defined by building an algorithm that can interact with the world. Research ideas are tested through working products. If it doesn't improve what users can do, we question whether it matters. We share what moves the field; we don't optimize for paper count.




WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 - Innovation: You have ideas and you move fast. You care about impact, not just effort.

 - Cross-stack optimization: You collaborate across software, hardware, and algorithmic domains to unlock system-wide efficiency gains.

 - Measure what matters: The ultimate signal of value is real-world impact. Our current algorithms are capable of interacting with the world which is why product thinking is inseparable from research.




SKILLS YOU'LL BRING

We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values:

 - A PhD or equivalent research experience in a computer science field

 - 4-5+ years of industry experience

 - Publishing record at ICML, NeurIPS, ACL, ICLR, EMNLP.

 - Deep expertise in at least one area: model efficiency, real time alignment or algorithmic optimization

 - Systems thinking ability to understand and optimize across the full ML stack

 - Strong programming skills in Python. Experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow)

 - Knowledge of model optimization techniques (RLHF, finetuning)

 - Experience in an industry lab with computing at scale

Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to be perfect, but you do need to be adaptable. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: A dynamic environment with opportunities to take on new challenges, expand your responsibilities, and make an impact beyond your immediate role.

 - Adaption Passport: An annual travel allowance to explore somewhere new, experience different cultures and keep expanding your horizons. It can be used to travel to any country you haven’t previously been to.

 - Lunch on us: A weekly allowance for takeout or grocery delivery, wherever you are in the world. Whether it's stocking your fridge or having dinner delivered, it’s one less thing to think about.

 - Comprehensive benefits: High-quality medical coverage and benefits designed to support your health and well-being.

 - Team offsites and visits to SF HQ: We're a global team, but believe there's real value in spending time together in person. We regularly bring teammates together at our SF HQ and for team offsites in locations around the world, including London, Mexico City, and New York.

jobs.title: Head of Financial Services
jobs.description:
About ROLLER

ROLLER is a global software-as-a-service company designed to help businesses in the leisure and attractions industry operate more efficiently and deliver great guest experiences. ROLLER helps its customers through a full suite of venue management features, including ticketing, point-of-sale, CRM, self-service kiosks, memberships, digital waivers, and more. We are a fast-growing global company with customers in over 30 countries and a wide array of industries like theme parks, museums, zoos, trampoline parks, water parks, aquariums, and wake parks — just to name a few!

At the heart of ROLLER is our team - which consists of 300+ highly energetic, driven, intelligent, and humble professionals, all contributing to help build a great and enduring business. We truly believe that the sky's the limit for us, and we are well on our way toward becoming a global success story. But most of all, we love what we do, and we are looking for like-minded people to join us on this amazing journey!

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Financial Services to own ROLLER's embedded financial services business end to end. Reporting to our Chief Product Officer, you'll run it as a P&L: pricing, partner economics, merchant risk, payments operations and the financial services roadmap, working day to day with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal and our go-to-market teams.

You'll be the senior commercial owner of our relationships with key payments partners, the person Sales brings into enterprise and franchise deals, and the voice of Financial Services to our senior leadership team and in board reporting. It's a hands-on leadership role in a lean team - you'll set the strategy and defend the numbers, and stay close enough to onboarding, payouts, reserves and disputes to know when something is wrong before a merchant tells us.

What You’ll Do

• Own the Financial Services P&L - strategy, annual plan, revenue, margin, pricing and forecast across payments, lending and insurance

• Scale ROLLER Capital and Instant Cash Out - eligibility and offer rules, underwriting and portfolio risk with our lending partner, and the go-to-market that drives adoption - and take Refund Protection and the next products from launch to scale

• Lead merchant risk and fraud - own the framework across onboarding, reserves, fraud monitoring, chargebacks and account actions, balancing loss exposure against merchant experience

• Manage the partner portfolio - commercial terms, revenue share, pricing changes, governance and escalations with Adyen, Stripe, Cover Genius and our hardware vendors

• Shape the financial services roadmap with Product and Engineering - bring the commercial case through our launch process, prioritise with the payments squad, and make sure what we build lands with merchants and pays back

• Own regulatory and scheme compliance - surcharging, interchange pass-through and payment acceptance across our markets, turning regulatory change into clear merchant guidance

• Back Sales and enterprise customers - pricing approvals and deal support, enterprise and franchise-group deals and renewals, competitive positioning, and enablement so Sales, Customer Success and Support can sell and support financial services without you in the room

• Lead and develop the Financial Services team - build the runbooks, coverage and data that keep escalations off your desk, and hire against the plan as the business grows

About You

• You have 10+ years in payments or fintech, including 5+ years leading a function at a high-growth SaaS or technology company with strong tenure - we really value tenure in a scaling organisation as a requirement

• You've owned a P&L - set the pricing, built the forecast, and defended the numbers with a CFO

• You've run payments on a platform model - Adyen for Platforms, Stripe Connect, a PayFac or a marketplace - and you understand onboarding and KYC, settlement, reserves, disputes, and interchange and scheme-fee economics from the inside

• You've done this inside a vertical SaaS platform selling to SMB and mid-market merchants, so payments attach, repricing a back book and the tension between go-to-market and risk are familiar territory

• You've negotiated commercial terms with a major acquirer, processor or financial partner - revenue share, pricing changes, contract renewals

• Sound judgement on merchant risk - you've made reserve, fraud and account decisions under uncertainty and can explain them to a merchant and to a board

• Executive-grade communication - you can write a board-ready section, present to a senior leadership team, and turn a regulatory change into guidance a venue owner can act on

• You build process, playbooks and data in a lean, evolving team rather than inheriting a mature one - and you'll go deep in the operational detail when it matters

• You're comfortable operating across regions and time zones - we run across Australia, the US, Canada, the UK and Europe

• Bonus points for embedded lending or merchant cash advance, embedded insurance, payment hardware economics, hands-on use of AI tooling, or experience in attractions, leisure or hospitality

Perks!

• You get to work on a category-leading product that customers love in a fun, high-growth industry- check our Capterra and G2 reviews.

• Engage in our ‘Vibe Tribe’ - led by our team members; you can contribute to company-wide initiatives directly. Regular events and social activities, fundraising & cause-related campaigns... you name it. We're willing to make it happen!

• Team member Assistance Program to proactively support our team's health and wellbeing - access to coaching, education modules, weekly webinars, and more.

• 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for primary carers and 4 weeks paid Parental Leave for secondary carers

• Highly flexible work environment with an All Access pass to WeWork depending on your location

• Work with a driven, fun, and switched-on team that likes to raise the bar in all we do.

• Individual learning & development budget plus genuine career growth opportunities as we continue to expand!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Nuro Driver Core Software
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About the Team

Nuro Driver Core Software Engineering works across onboard software robustness, efficiency, and software architecture and verification. The team has three pillars: A, Nuro Driver Module Robustness; B, Nuro Driver Module Efficiency; and C, Software Architecture and Verification. The application-software scope includes autonomy and supporting onboard modules.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior C++ software engineer to improve the structure and production behavior of onboard Nuro Driver software. You will work with module owners and infrastructure partners on application-level designs, with particular attention to module boundaries, dependency contracts, testability, and resource constraints. The role is hands-on and does not require sole architectural authority over the stack.

About the Work

• Lead a prioritized cross-module workstream and related architecture pilot from problem definition through implementation, rollout, and measurement.

• Design explicit application behavior for dependency failures, stale data, lifecycle transitions, restart, fault containment, and safe degradation with the relevant owners.

• Evaluate module decomposition, interfaces, and dependency structure. Simplify unnecessary distribution and modernize C++ implementations using supported runtime frameworks.

• Assess compute, memory, data-flow, and scheduling impacts of application changes with Middleware/Performance; translate agreed constraints into component-level targets.

• Design components for meaningful tests, deterministic replay, and simulation. Partner with the existing engineers on input capture, configuration, timing, state initialization, regression tests, and fidelity gaps.

• Write architecture proposals with alternatives, ownership, resource impact, test strategy, and migration plans; drive joint review with module owners, Fleet Infra, Onboard Performance, Simulation, Systems, and Safety.

• Review new or materially changed module boundaries and interfaces, provide rigorous code reviews, and drive adoption of agreed engineering patterns.

• Use AI-assisted development tools where appropriate while remaining accountable for design quality, behavioral correctness, testing, and production readiness.

About You

• Strong modern C++ and Linux systems fundamentals, including concurrency, memory management, inter-process communication, performance, and failure handling.

• Significant experience developing and maintaining production C++ software in a large codebase.

• Experience independently leading ambiguous systems-software projects from initial design through cross-team adoption and measurable production impact.

• Sound judgment about module decomposition, interface contracts, failure boundaries, testability, and resource partitioning, including when an additional process boundary is justified.

• Strong production debugging, testing, observability, and verification discipline.

• Effective written and verbal communication, with demonstrated ability to build stakeholder alignment and provide high-quality design and code reviews.

• 5+ years of relevant production software-engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated scope and impact.

• Demonstrated ownership of a substantial component architecture, modernization, or cross-team software project through implementation and adoption.

• Experience diagnosing and resolving complex reliability or performance issues in Linux-based systems.

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus Points

• Experience with autonomous vehicles, robotics, embedded systems, real-time systems, or another safety-critical domain.

• Experience with deterministic simulation or replay, fault injection, fuzzing, or behavior-preserving validation.

• Experience profiling and optimizing CPU usage, memory allocation, lock contention, latency, or cache behavior.

• Familiarity with publish/subscribe systems, protobuf contracts, module lifecycle frameworks, and resource-aware decomposition on constrained platforms.

• Experience with Clang tooling, static analysis, sanitizers, Bazel, or C++ library/toolchain development.

• Experience applying AI coding tools within disciplined design, testing, and review workflows.

At Nuro, we celebrate differences and are committed to a diverse workplace that fosters inclusion and psychological safety for all employees. Nuro is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and expressly prohibits any form of workplace discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected pay range is between $193,930 and $291,150/year for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package. #LI-DNP

jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Escalations
jobs.description:
Opportunity Overview:

We are seeking a Manager, Clinical Escalations to join our Clinical Process and Standards team. In this role, you will build and lead Cohere Health's Escalations Program within Clinical Operations. You’ll partner closely with Client Success, Clinical Operations, Compliance, and leadership to ensure provider and/or client escalations are resolved effectively and efficiently while protecting Cohere’s operational integrity and regulatory commitments. The ideal candidate brings strong customer service instincts, a structured approach to program development, and a customer focused presence to effectively manage sensitive escalations.

What you’ll do:

• Stand up the Escalations Program: Design and implement a formal escalation framework, including intake processes, triage criteria, severity classifications, tracking mechanisms, and reporting cadences — transitioning this function from the Client Success team into a dedicated program.

• Triage and manage client and provider complaints: Serve as the primary point of accountability for all incoming escalations, ensuring each is categorized, assigned, and resolved according to defined workflows.

• Ensure follow-up and resolution: Monitor all open escalations to confirm that follow-up actions are performed, completed, and documented. Hold internal teams accountable for timely closure.

• Meet mandatory response times: Track and enforce compliance with all regulatory and contractual response time requirements. Proactively flag risks and implement corrective actions when TATs are at risk.

• Handle executive escalations with care: Manage high-sensitivity escalations involving executive-level clients or providers with discretion, professionalism, and a solutions-oriented approach.

• Escalate proactively within the organization: Ensure Cohere leadership is never caught off guard — provide timely, clear communication to internal leaders on escalations that carry reputational, regulatory, or relationship risk.

• Lead and develop the Escalations Analyst: Manage, coach, and support one direct report responsible for escalation tracking, data analysis, and reporting.

• Report on escalation trends and performance: Develop dashboards and regular reporting to track escalation volume, resolution rates, TAT compliance, root causes, and trends. Use data to drive continuous improvement.

• Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Client Success, Clinical Operations, Compliance, Product, Clinical Content, and other teams to address systemic issues surfaced through escalations and improve the overall client and provider experience.

• Develop and maintain escalation documentation: Create and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation playbooks, and communication templates.

What you’ll need:

• Bachelor's degree in healthcare

• Active clinical licensure in state of residence (RN, PT/OT/SLP considered)

• 3+ years of experience in utilization management operations

• Experience in external client, provider, and/or member communications

• Knowledge of healthcare regulations and accreditation (CMS, Medicaid, JCAHO)

• Proficiency with spreadsheet functions, including data analysis and drawing quantitative conclusions

• Experience implementing process improvements

• Ability to function independently and navigate ambiguity to build a cross-functional program

• Strong problem-solving skills with a customer focus

• Passion for improving the U.S. healthcare system and helping ensure every patient receives the best care possible

• Familiarity with ticketing or project management software (e.g., CRM, JIRA, Monday.com) is a plus

• Demonstrated success implementing new programs is a plus

• People leadership experience is a plus

• Experience managing escalations in a multi-client or multi-health-plan environment is a plus

• Familiarity with root cause analysis (RCA) methodologies and corrective action plan (CAP) development is a plus

Pay & Perks:

💻 Fully remote opportunity with about 10% travel

🩺 Medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, and Employee Assistance Program

📈 401K retirement plan with company match; flexible spending and health savings account

🏝️ Flex Time Off + company holidays

👶 Up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

🐶 Pet insurance

The salary range for this position is $116,000 to $125,000 annually; as part of a total benefits package which includes health insurance, 401k and bonus. In accordance with state applicable laws, Cohere is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including but not limited to qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and internal alignment.

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist
jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Paid Media Specialist manages Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns hands-on and is a day-to-day customer-facing contact for Storable's Paid Ads service, which supports small and medium-sized businesses in the self-storage, marine, RV, and campground industries. Most of our work is pay-per-click (PPC) advertising. You will manage hundreds of campaigns, keep them accurate, well-paced, and performing, and explain results clearly to customers. Work is prioritized and rotated across the team through monday.com.

We are looking for an AI-first practitioner who builds agents to take over repeatable work and can show how that makes them faster, more consistent, and able to manage more accounts well. Our team works in Claude, so experience with it is a plus, but we value strong AI fluency and the ability to adapt quickly to new tools. This is a strong fit for someone who wants to grow into a senior paid media role. Familiarity with these verticals is valuable. This role is U.S.-based and remote.

Key Responsibilities

AI-First Ways of Working

• Make AI your default environment for analysis, ad copy, reporting, customer communication, and documentation.

• Identify repetitive tasks across the portfolio and build agents and workflows that automate them end to end, such as account health checks, pacing alerts, and performance recaps.

• Create reusable skills, projects, and playbooks, and share them with the team.

• Connect AI to the tools and data you work in so agents have real context.

• Verify AI output, protect customer data, and keep a human in the loop where it matters.

• Evaluate platform AI features (such as Performance Max, Advantage+, and AI-driven bidding) and know when to rely on them and when to override them.

Campaign Management and Optimization

• Manage setup, optimization, and ongoing health of Google Ads (Search, Display, remarketing, Performance Max) and Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) campaigns across a high-volume portfolio.

• Prioritize your time by spotting accounts that need attention, including underperformance, pacing issues, and seasonal shifts.

• Apply keyword research, search-term analysis, audience, retargeting, and ad-copy best practices consistently across accounts.

• Run structured tests across creative, audiences, bidding, and budgets, and share what works.

• Recommend landing-page and website improvements based on performance.

Customer Communication

• Serve as a primary customer contact for campaign questions, results, and recommendations, escalating complex issues to leadership.

• Lead onboarding calls to capture goals, promotions, service areas, seasonality, and budgets.

• Lead recurring performance reviews and send written recaps with dashboard links and next steps.

• Explain conversions, impression share, budget pacing, attribution limits, and lead quality in plain language, and set realistic expectations.

Measurement and Reporting

• Monitor core metrics (CTR, CPC, CPA, cost per lead, conversion rate, impression share, move-ins, lead quality) and turn them into concise recommendations.

• Manage budget pacing and flag reallocation opportunities.

• Maintain conversion tracking across Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, and GTM, and resolve issues caused by website launches, migrations, or tag changes.

Account Operations and Team Collaboration

• Use monday.com to track assigned work, follow team prioritization, and take part in the account rotation.

• Coordinate advertiser verification, compliance, access, and campaign launches, pauses, transfers, and cancellations.

• Monitor billing profiles, failed payments, and suspensions, and escalate risks that could cause incorrect charges or campaign disruption.

• Follow team QA processes, playbooks, and templates, and help keep documentation current.

• Collaborate with account managers, SEO, analytics, support, sales, website teams, and India-based paid media resources.

Qualifications

Required

• 4+ years of hands-on PPC, paid search, or performance marketing experience.

• Hands-on experience building and optimizing campaigns in both Google Ads (structure, keywords, bidding, budgets, reporting) and Meta Ads (audiences, retargeting, creative, conversion tracking).

• An AI-first, agent-first mindset, shown by concrete examples of agents or automated workflows you have built and the results they produced (i.e., time saved, quality improved, or scale achieved).

• Ability to learn new AI tools quickly and apply them to paid media work.

• Direct customer-facing experience leading performance reviews or onboarding calls and explaining technical concepts to non-specialists.

• Experience managing multiple accounts at once in a high-volume environment.

• Working knowledge of GA4 and GTM, including conversion tracking.

• Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate across U.S. and India-based teams.

Preferred

• Experience with Claude, including building skills, projects, or connected workflows (in Claude, Cowork, or Claude Code).

• Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications.

• Experience in SaaS, agency, or customer-facing digital marketing, ideally with local or multi-location businesses in self-storage, marine, RV, or campgrounds.

• Experience with Yelp, Nextdoor, Microsoft Advertising, or other local channels.

• Experience with monday.com or a similar project management tool.

What Success Looks Like

• Campaigns across the portfolio are accurate, well-paced, and continuously optimized.

jobs.title: Director, Legal Financial Systems
jobs.description:
Harbor is seeking a Director to join our dynamic Enterprise Solutions – Financial Systems team. We work with leading vendors, allowing clients to benefit from our product-specific expertise, strategic insight, and market perspective. We serve as trusted advisors and experienced delivery leaders, partnering with clients to improve financial systems and operations, support data-driven decision making, and deliver technology initiatives.

As a member of the Financial Systems leadership team, you will lead complex client engagements, build trusted executive-level relationships, and deliver strong outcomes across a portfolio of projects and accounts. You will advise law firm leaders on financial systems, operating practices, and technology investments while overseeing project delivery and team leadership. You will also contribute to sales pursuits in partnership with Harbor’s business development leaders. As a Director, you will lead and mentor Managers, Consultants, and Associate Consultants within the Financial Systems practice, with accountability for team performance, consulting delivery, and client experience.

This is a full-time position that can be worked remotely in the United States or United Kingdom.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

• Serve as a trusted advisor to law firm executive leadership, providing guidance on financial systems, operating practices, and technology roadmaps.

• Lead complex financial systems engagements, including implementations, integrations, optimization projects, and ongoing operational improvement.

• Provide deep subject matter expertise in legal financial management platforms (e.g., Elite 3E and related ecosystem solutions), advising clients on industry practices, system capabilities, and governance.

• Establish and maintain executive-level client relationships, serving as a senior point of contact and escalation resource and supporting strong, lasting client partnerships.

• Help clients address targeted process and organizational improvement opportunities as part of broader financial systems engagements.

• Review key project deliverables and provide executive oversight, including solution designs, implementation plans, testing approaches, training plans, governance frameworks, and, where relevant, assessments, business cases, and recommendations.

• Mentor and develop Managers and consulting team members through coaching, career development guidance, performance feedback, and leadership support.

• Oversee resource management and workforce planning across multiple client engagements to support efficient utilization, delivery quality, and employee development.

• Participate in business development in partnership with Harbor’s sales and practice leaders. Contribute subject matter expertise, client relationship context, solution development, proposal responses, and client presentations; sales ownership, targets, and accountability remain with designated business development leaders.

• Identify and develop service offerings, methodologies, accelerators, and intellectual property that strengthen Harbor’s Financial Systems capabilities and market differentiation.

• Monitor legal industry, technology, and market trends to identify relevant opportunities, risks, and recommendations for clients and Harbor.

• Build and maintain relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and industry organizations to support client delivery and the practice’s service offerings.

• Support practice financial management and operational planning, including engagement forecasting, margin management, and resource planning. Provide input to pipeline reviews as requested by practice and business development leaders.

• Contribute to Harbor’s overall growth strategy by identifying cross-functional opportunities and collaborating with leaders across service lines.

• Champion consulting excellence, ensuring adherence to Harbor methodologies, quality standards, and client delivery best practices.

• Maintain personal billable utilization consistent with leadership expectations while helping the team meet utilization, profitability, and delivery expectations.

Experience, Education and Other Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in legal technology, professional services, consulting, or financial systems, including significant experience leading financial systems implementations and optimization programs.

• Demonstrated expertise in law firm financial systems, including implementation, integration, optimization, governance, and change management; experience with strategy, assessment, or selection work is beneficial.

• Proven ability to build trusted relationships with C-level and senior executive stakeholders and influence business and technology decisions.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technology investments and operational improvements to measurable business outcomes.

• Experience leading multiple concurrent client engagements, managing project teams, overseeing budgets, and mitigating delivery risks.

• Experience contributing to business development through client relationship support, proposal development, solution design, and participation in sales pursuits. Direct sales ownership or revenue-generation accountability is not required.

• Proven leadership experience managing consulting teams, developing talent, and building high-performing teams in a client-service environment.

• Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into executive-level recommendations.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, with experience improving financial systems and related business processes.

• Understanding of project and program management principles, including resource planning, financial management, governance, quality assurance, and stakeholder management.

• Experience developing methodologies, service offerings, practice collateral, and thought leadership content.

• Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on engagement leadership with strategic practice responsibilities and collaborative participation in business development.

• Positive, entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and building client value.

• Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Visio) and collaboration tools including Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.

About Us:

Harbor is the preeminent provider of expert services across strategy, legal technology, operations, and intelligence. Our globally integrated team of 900+ strategists, technologists, and specialists navigate alongside our clients – leading law firms, corporations, and their law departments – to provide essential resources and invaluable insights. Anchored in a rich heritage of deep knowledge, steadfast relationships, and mutual respect, our unwavering dedication lies in shaping the future of the legal industry and fostering enduring partnerships within our community and ecosystem.

jobs.title: Security Associate - 3rd Shift
jobs.description:
Schedule (Open Availability Highly Preferred):

• 11:30pm-8:00a Tuesday-Saturday

Pay Range: $20 hourly

About Carvana

At Carvana, we believe buying a car the old-fashioned way sucks — so we're rewriting the playbook. Yes, we're the vending machine people. Yes, we built that on purpose. And yes, we're just getting started.

We're looking for people who want to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit shows up in everything we do — every day, our passion and creativity drive the kind of innovation that moves an industry. We take big swings, set ambitious goals, and challenge each other to make data- and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories. We've been changing the game since 2013, and we're not letting up. Want the full story? Check it out here.

About the team and position

Our Safe & Secure team is the heartbeat of every Carvana location. You're the people we trust to protect our associates, our customers, and the thousands of vehicles that flow through our gates every day. Rain, shine, ice, or 110° heat — the mission doesn't change, and neither does the standard.

This is a boots-on-the-ground role. We bring the strategy; you bring the hustle. From clearing snow during a winter storm to running heat-safety protocols in July, you'll be the reason our site stays open, safe, and moving. Some days you'll be at the gate — the literal face of Carvana to every associate, vendor, and visitor walking through it. Other days, you'll be out on the lot scanning vehicles, knocking out safety audits, or restocking the supplies that keep this place humming.

You won't just monitor a perimeter — you'll own it. That means spotting hazards before they become incidents, building real relationships with the folks on site, and stepping up when something needs your attention. You'll be trained and trusted to act in emergencies, partner with our Inspection Center and Logistics teams, and feed sharp, accurate intel back to your Safe & Secure leadership. Hourly position, reporting to your Safe & Secure Functional Lead or Manager.

What you’ll be doing

• Lead with a service-first mindset in every interaction.

• Live the Carvana values — and make sure they're felt by everyone you work with.

• Be the face of Carvana at the gate for associates, vendors, and visitors.

• Communicate like a pro — clear, calm, active listener, no missed signals.

• Use our Unified Security Platform to monitor live cameras, review footage, and investigate intrusion alerts so nothing on site catches us off guard.

• When things get hot, keep it cool. De-escalate, win with partners, and remember — we're all in this together.

• Run point at the gate using the Safe & Secure App (SAS App) and RFID tech, enforcing ingress/egress procedures every single time.

• Manage and document vehicle movement through the Inspection Center entrance and exit gates.

• Show up when the team needs you. You'll be trained and certified in first aid, CPR, and AED — and we expect you to use it when the moment calls for it.

• Know our emergency protocols cold so you can act decisively when seconds count.

• Keep the site operational in any weather — snow removal in winter, heat-safety protocols in summer, no excuses, no shortcuts.

• Drive a safety-first culture by spotting environmental hazards, running safety audits, and reinforcing best practices with the people around you.

• Scan thousands of vehicles a day to keep operational flow tight — between mobile rover tech and manual handheld scans, every car gets accounted for.

• Cover ground. This role involves serious walking to reach restricted or hard-to-access areas of the lot.

• Run vehicle location research and deliver clean, detailed reports to leadership when operational questions come up.

Key Metrics:

• Unit Loss Rate versus Plan

• Safe & Secure App Execution

• Inventory Control/Accuracy and Tracking

• Safety Incident Performance

What you should know/have

• 1–2 years in a customer service environment

• Strong verbal and written communication

• A track record of solid decision-making in a complex, fast-moving environment

• Ability to build strong working relationships and connect with people quickly

• Ability to organize, plan, and execute multiple tasks at once in a fast-paced setting

• Ability to handle conflict in a positive, productive way

We’d love it if you also have

• Familiarity with CCTV, RFID, Card Access, or other Safe & Secure technology

• Previous experience supporting an OSHA / Safety Team program

• Experience with crisis prevention and/or response plans

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-time hourly position with a competitive wage

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401(k) with company match

• A stack of perks — student loan support, vehicle discounts, pet benefits, and a lot more

• A wellness program built to keep you healthy, physically and mentally

• Real opportunities to grow your skills and share what you know across the org

• A promote-from-within culture with a startup feel — career paths can move fast around here

• A seat at one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you:

• Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• This position is designated as a safety-sensitive position

• Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; the majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels

• Must be able to carry and transport up to 60 pounds up to 20 feet

• Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet, and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance

• Requires excellent visual acuity and manual dexterity

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include, but is not limited to, face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

• Requires frequent driving and computer data entry

• Must adhere to regular and predictable attendance

• The facility is a 24/7 operation, and gates must be manned at all times

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any protected category.

Please note that this job description is not intended to be a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Ambulatory Clinical Care Pharmacist Specialist
jobs.description:
Clinical Pharmacy Specialist (Ambulatory Clinical Pharmacist)

Join our Shields team today! Shields Health Solutions is redefining patient care through health-system integrated specialty pharmacy. We’re hiring an Ambulatory Clinical Pharmacy Specialist who will provide integrated support to patients and physicians through a "hands-on" approach to improve the quality of patient care. This is accomplished by developing personalized relationships with patients and prescribers of assigned clinics to improve medication adherence and promote evidence-based care, with expansion into Gastroenterology (GI) disease states.

The Ambulatory Clinical Pharmacist (ACP) will help advance quality pharmacotherapy care by actively assuring the provision of safe, efficacious, and cost-effective drug therapy for GI populations. The ACP collaborates closely with the team onsite to maximize full suite of clinical services within supported clinics. The pharmacist performs assessments on disease state management and drug therapy education stratified based on medication risk level and approved clinic protocol. ACP role will focus to identify, resolve, and prevent medication-related problems. Additional services will also be offered to overcome identified barriers to medication compliance, injection training and any other obstacle related to adherence.

Sign-On Bonus: $20,000.00

Location: Onsite in Portage, MI

Specialty Area: Gastroenterology (GI)

Salary: An employee in this position who performs the job duties in Michigan can expect a salary rate between $130,000 and $146,400 (Hourly Equivalent: Approximately $62.50 - $70.38 per hour, based on a 40-hour workweek.) plus bonus pursuant to the terms of an any bonus plan if applicable. The actual salary will depend on experience, geographic location, and other factors permitted by law.

SUMMARY:

• Provide medication therapy management for individuals with GI disease states, including medication reconciliation, dose optimization, and medication adherence counseling.

• Collaborate with the interdisciplinary care team to develop individualized care plans that align with evidence-based guidelines and best practices for GI management.

• Monitor and evaluate medication regimens to ensure clinical criteria are met, including therapeutic goals, adverse effects, and drug interactions.

• Identify opportunities for drug therapy optimization and provide recommendations for medication cost savings initiatives when applicable.

• Evaluate and monitor the appropriateness of infusion and injectable specialty therapies for gastrointestinal disorders, including biologic and advanced therapies used in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and related disease states. Assess treatment response, adherence, safety, laboratory monitoring, site-of-care considerations, and opportunities for therapy optimization in collaboration with the gastroenterology care team.

• Participate in quality improvement initiatives by actively participating in clinical outcome studies, REMS compliance/reporting, and ACP-related process improvement projects.

• Optimize resources and workflows with supporting roles handling complex prior authorizations/appeals by providing clinical justification for medication approval, including supporting literature and rationale.

• Collaborate with healthcare providers, including assigned clinic physicians, specialists, and onsite clinic pharmacists, to ensure seamless medication management and coordination of care.

• Support occasional peer-to-peer requests upon demand.

• Perform clinical assessments/educational counseling at drug-level for all patients within high priority clinics on qualified on a targeted medication(s)

• Ensure all clinical criteria are in clinical compliance with guidance from FDA, clinical guidelines, and appropriate evidence-based literature.

• Assist with workflow optimization initiatives, including identifying areas for improvement and implementing strategies to enhance efficiency, productivity, and quality of care.

• Collaborate with other departments and stakeholders to identify operational changes and recommend strategies that enhance productivity, quality, and standards of excellence.

• Advocate for and promote patient safety and medication literacy through patient education and counseling.

• Protects the organization's value by keeping information confidential.

• Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations to promote new line of services.

• Attend and participate in team meetings, conferences, and other professional development activities to stay abreast of current clinical practices and emerging trends.

• Stay updated with the latest advancements in GI and incorporate them into clinical practice.

• Willing to do whatever is necessary for the betterment of the company.

• Other duties as assigned by Manager of Clinical Services.

Experience/ Education:

• Required Licensure/Certification: Applicant must hold a Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) and be a licensed pharmacist in MI prior to employment offer.

• Years of Experience: Completion of a Pharmacy Practice Residency accredited by the American Society of Health System Pharmacists (ASHP) OR three (3) years of clinical pharmacy experience OR Certifications from the Board of Pharmacy Specialties (Preference for BCACP, BCGP, BCIDP, BCPS) OR hold the Certified Specialty Pharmacist credential

• Should additional licensure need to be obtained, the applicant will commit to obtaining the required licensure within a mutually agreed upon timeframe. Continued employment is contingent upon meeting these requirements.

• Skills: Strong clinical knowledge and validated expertise with a focus on GI care and other disease states. Ability or willingness to serve as a subject matter expert in GI among pharmacy peers and hospital or health system partners. Must have the ability to identify barriers to medication adherence and implement and monitor plans to improve medication adherence. The ability to motivate and coach patients to help them achieve better outcomes and identify goals of therapy. Ability to analyze information, exercise good judgment, possess strong verbal communication skills, have deep knowledge of pharmacology developments, and FDA health regulations. Ability to manage processes, exhibit strong technical and clinical skills, maintain constant focus on legal compliance, while being highly productive with a focus on quality and details. Must be computer literate with proficiency and working knowledge of database and reporting tools such as: Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

• Traits: Organized, high-integrity, attention to detail, dependable, quality focus, empathetic, good listener/communicator

• Other: Energetic, highly motivated, team player with strong personal and communication skills; discretion and confidentiality essential as position deals with highly sensitive and private data

California residents employed by or applying for work at Shields have certain privacy rights. Please review our: California Workforce Privacy Notice and Privacy Policy.

By providing your mobile number, you agree to receive text messages from Shields Health Solutions related to job opportunities, interview scheduling, and recruiting updates. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out at any time by replying 'STOP.' Consent is not a condition of employment.

Solid computer skills are required, including proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) for communication, documentation, and data management, as well as, navigating the internet and web-based platforms. Data entry and computer skills will be evaluated through an assessment as part of the pre-employment process.

Shields Health Solutions provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Shields Health Solutions is committed to providing an inclusive hiring experience; if you need assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please email talentacquisition@shieldsrx.com.

jobs.title: Regional Asset Protection Manager, Southeast
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OVERVIEW

The Regional Asset Protection Manager will embrace artificial intelligence as a force multiplier—using AI-enabled tools to enhance analysis, accelerate pattern and anomaly detection, improve investigative efficiency, and support proactive, data-informed decision-making.

This position will support a growing, multi-district portfolio of sanctuaries throughout the Southeast (based in Miami)

RESPONSIBILITIES

Shrink Reduction and Operational Excellence

• Analyze inventory shrink results and work closely with Retail Operations, district leadership, and store leadership to develop strategies addressing external theft, internal theft, fraud, and operational errors.

• Drive shrink-reduction goals throughout assigned districts and consistently communicate company Asset Protection initiatives to field leadership and store teams.

• Assess high-shrink and high-risk sanctuaries to identify sources of loss and develop measurable action plans.

• Conduct comprehensive risk and site-vulnerability assessments to identify deficiencies and recommend measures that protect employees, guests, merchandise, property, and other company assets.

• Assist with strategic initiatives and contribute to the successful development and implementation of Asset Protection objectives.

• Prepare monthly, quarterly, biannual, and annual Asset Protection summaries, including trend analysis of relevant key performance indicators.

• Build effective field partnerships that support sales and operational goals while protecting company assets.

• Support additional Asset Protection projects and responsibilities as assigned.

Data, Technology and Artificial Intelligence

• Leverage exception-based reporting, POS data, inventory reporting, RFID, CCTV, case-management systems, and other analytical resources to identify theft, fraud, operational loss, and emerging risk trends.

• Use AI-enabled tools to increase the speed, consistency, and effectiveness of Asset Protection analysis, reporting, investigations, training, and risk assessment.

• Apply artificial intelligence as a force multiplier to recognize patterns, prioritize investigative opportunities, summarize complex information, and strengthen preventive strategies.

• Identify responsible opportunities to automate repetitive processes and improve the efficiency of the Asset Protection function.

• Evaluate AI-generated information critically and apply sound professional judgment before making recommendations or taking action.

• Ensure AI tools are used responsibly and in accordance with company policies, confidentiality requirements, data-security standards, privacy obligations, and applicable laws.

• Partner with Asset Protection leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to identify, recommend, test, and deploy new technology and process improvements related to shrink, security, safety, investigations, and cash management.

Investigations

• Proactively identify, investigate, and resolve internal and external theft, fraud, organized retail crime, cash loss, merchandise loss, integrity concerns, and other conduct that may result in loss to the company.

• Conduct internal investigations using POS exception reporting, transaction data, inventory information, CCTV, case-management systems, interviews, and other available resources.

• Conduct interviews with subjects, witnesses, and other relevant individuals in accordance with company standards and applicable laws.

• Ensure all internal and external investigations are completed promptly, objectively, confidentially, and in compliance with corporate and legal requirements.

• Partner with Retail Operations, store and district leadership, People & Culture, and Legal to determine appropriate corrective and preventive actions.

• Partner with law enforcement and industry organizations when necessary.

• Prepare clear, accurate, and comprehensive investigative reports, findings, and recommendations.

• Maintain the confidentiality of sensitive employee, customer, investigative, and company information.

Physical Security and Risk Management

• Review, advise on, and manage physical-security standards for sanctuaries within the assigned area of responsibility.

• Manage physical-security systems and required training, including camera systems, intrusion alarms, access controls, keys, safe codes, locking mechanisms, and related technologies.

• Conduct site-risk and vulnerability assessments to identify conditions that could result in employee harm, financial loss, property damage, or business interruption.

• Recommend security enhancements based on risk, incident history, store environment, operating conditions, and business needs.

• Support new sanctuary openings by conducting security assessments, coordinating security-system readiness, and delivering Asset Protection training.

• Manage third-party security providers, post orders, service expectations, and ad hoc security needs throughout the assigned region.

• Optimize the deployment of security resources based on location risk, operating needs, foot traffic, local events, and emerging conditions.

Incident and Crisis Response

• Review and respond to reported incidents involving theft, shoplifting, internal dishonesty, inappropriate behavior, workplace violence, threats, cash shortages, vandalism, robbery, burglary, and other events affecting ALO employees, guests, or assets.

• Maintain awareness of regional conditions that could affect operations, including civil unrest, protests, severe weather, natural disasters, and workplace-violence concerns.

• Provide timely support and guidance to district and store leadership during elevated security or safety situations.

• Coordinate incident responses with Retail Operations, People & Culture, Legal, law enforcement, emergency services, and security providers as appropriate.

• Support incident follow-up, corrective actions, and preventive measures designed to reduce the likelihood of recurrence.

• Remain accessible and prepared to respond to store-based emergencies when necessary.

Field Engagement, Training and Partnerships

• Build strong partnerships with district managers, store leaders, and cross-functional teams throughout the Southeast, United States.

• Coach and educate store teams on Asset Protection awareness, internal and external theft prevention, operational controls, fraud prevention, workplace safety, and incident reporting.

• Deliver Asset Protection and physical-security training for new sanctuary openings and existing locations.

• Serve as a trusted Asset Protection resource for field leadership and store teams.

• Support corporate initiatives by serving as a liaison with law enforcement, government agencies, security professionals, and retail-industry partners.

• Network with Asset Protection and loss-prevention professionals to exchange best practices, investigative intelligence, and information regarding emerging trends.

• Pursue external-development opportunities, including webinars, conferences, professional training, and industry events.

• Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, safety, and responsible use of technology.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree or a comparable combination of education and professional experience in retail Asset Protection, loss prevention, investigations, law enforcement, private security, risk management, or a related discipline.

• Minimum of five years of multi-unit, field-based Asset Protection or loss-prevention experience.

• Minimum of two years of supervisory or leadership experience supporting multiple locations.

• Demonstrated experience conducting internal and external theft, fraud, and integrity investigations.

jobs.title: Revenue Finance & Strategy Senior Manager
jobs.description:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the team and role
The Strategic Finance team at Checkr sits at the intersection of finance, strategy, and execution. We don't just report on the business, we shape it.  We drive strategic decision-making through deep cross-functional partnership, financial and strategic analyses, and domain expertise. We proactively identify opportunities to fuel growth toward Checkr’s goals and deliver the highest impact outcomes.

We are looking for a Strategic Finance Sr. Manager, Revenue to own the financial story of Checkr's growth. You will lead a team of 5, build the consolidated revenue picture across our Sales, Self-Serve, and Channel motions and our Workforce, Mortgages, Consumer, and Trust lines of business, and partner directly with our CEO, CFO, and COO to turn that picture into decisions. This is a rare opportunity to shape how a scaling, category-defining company plans, forecasts, and tells its growth story — internally to product and go-to-market leadership, and externally to our Board of Directors and investors.

What you'll do

• Own consolidated revenue planning and reporting across our mature and new lines of business, serving as the definitive source of truth used internally by Product and GTM leadership and the C-suite, and externally with the Board of Directors and investors.

• Own strategic finance coverage for our Strategic customers, our top 10 customers.

• Build the next-generation StratFin function: architect AI-powered workflows, automated analyses, and intelligence systems that redefine what a strategic finance team can do, and establish this team as a model for the rest of Finance.

• Set strategy: define Checkr's existing and emerging revenue priorities, and quantitatively validate and drive investment toward the highest-ROI initiatives.

• Partner closely with the CEO, CFO, and COO, serving as their trusted right hand on revenue strategy, planning, and performance.

• Lead strategic and long-range planning: own the design and execution of annual, quarterly, and long-range planning processes, and evolve them toward public-company-grade rigor, scalability, and consistency.

• Own our rhythm of business reporting, delivering clarity and actionable insights across GTM and Product teams and C-suite leadership.

• Be accountable for our unit economics model, reporting, and insights. Leverage this to drive investment decisions and external investor relations. Own the budget planning processes for the COO and our go-to-market org.

• Own the revenue performance narrative externally, presenting results and outlook to the Board of Directors and investors.

• Stand up new initiatives from 0 to 1: when Checkr enters a new strategic area, build the initial financial frameworks and decision support, then scale the team and processes to match.

What you bring

• 8+ years of experience in strategic finance, FP&A, investment banking, private equity, or management consulting, with a track record of progressively greater scope and ownership.

• A demonstrated builder with AI: you've built something real with AI — a model, a workflow, an automated analysis — and see it as core to how great finance teams operate, not a novelty.

• Expert-level financial modeling and quantitative analysis, with the ability to translate complex, ambiguous business drivers into clear frameworks and decisions.

• Deep experience in high-growth environments, ideally with consumption- or transaction-based business models, and fluency in the unit economics that drive them, including revenue retention metrics like NRR and GRR.

• Outstanding executive presence: proven ability to synthesize complex financial information into clear, board- and C-suite-ready narratives, and to partner directly with and influence CEO-, CFO-, and COO-level stakeholders.

• A track record of bringing structure to ambiguity — you identify problems before they're handed to you and thrive when the answer isn't obvious.

• Technical fluency with tools like Adaptive, Salesforce, Omni (or similar BI tools), SQL, and modern AI tooling.

• Demonstrates Checkr's core values of Grit, Humility, Transparency, Connection, and Ownership.

• An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through change, and take ownership of outcomes

Pay Transparency Disclosure

We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website.

On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA)

$192,000—$226,000 USD

What We Offer

• A fast-paced and collaborative environment

• Learning and development allowance

• Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement

• 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services

• Flexible PTO policy

• Monthly wellness stipend

At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr
Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. Checkr believes in hiring people of all backgrounds, including those whose histories are impacted by the justice system in accordance with local, state, and/or federal laws, including the San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance.

Applicant Privacy Policy
If you are a California resident or are located in Alberta or British Columbia, our Applicant Privacy Policy applies to our collection and processing of your personal information when you apply for a role with us or otherwise participate in our recruitment process.

For applicants in Massachusetts: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

*Legitimate Checkr emails will always include our official domain name after the @ symbol (e.g., name@checkr.com or name@ext.checkr.com).
