jobs.title: Associate Director, Supply Chain Finance
jobs.description:
Pay Range: $185,000/yr. – $200,000/yr. based on experience and qualifications.

The Associate Director, Supply Chain Finance, reports directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and is the finance business partner for Procurement, Freight & Warehouse. The role owns direct material and packaging costs, translates Procurement and Supply Planning inputs into financial forecasts and budgets, supports new product and customer pricing decisions with accurate cost inputs, partners on freight, warehouse, outside storage (3PL), and co-manufacturing costs, and owns month-end and mid-month KPI reporting for Supply Chain costs. This is an individual contributor role and a key member of the senior finance leadership team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Costing & New Product Development

• Partner with R&D and Marketing to cost new formulas as part of the New Product Development process, from concept through commercialization.

• Support pricing for new deal proposals by building and explaining direct material, packaging, and meat formula costs, along with the related logistics costs.

• Give Sales Finance and Commercial leadership clear cost inputs for margin decisions on new items and customer proposals.

Direct Materials & Market Intelligence

• Serve as the key owner of direct material and packaging costs in the Bills of Materials (BOMs) in D365, including accuracy of standards and the annual cost roll.

• Partner with the Senior Director, Procurement and Commodity Risk, who leads market intelligence on input and packaging costs, to translate market trends and movements into financial forecasts, budgets, and plans.

• Advise Procurement on the cost and benefit of inventory builds, weighing carrying cost and cost of capital to inform what to build, for which lines of business, and for how long.

• Partner with Procurement on purchasing strategy, supplier cost changes, and price variance analysis.

Freight, Warehouse & Co-Manufacturing

• Serve as the dedicated Finance partner for freight, warehouse, outside storage (3PL), and co-manufacturing costs.

• Collaborate with Sales Finance to implement freight surcharges when appropriate.

• Analyze cost drivers, KPIs, and variances to budget and forecast, and recommend corrective actions.

Planning & Performance Management

• Support the Senior Director, Supply Chain on supply planning by reflecting those plans in financial forecasts and budgets.

• Lead the supply chain portions of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), Latest Estimates (LE), and long-range plan for direct materials, freight, warehouse, and co-manufacturing costs.

• Support SKU optimization and rationalization with SKU-level cost and margin analysis, partnering with Supply Chain and Commercial Finance.

• Represent Finance in the supply review of the monthly Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process, keeping cost assumptions aligned with demand and supply plans.

• Monitor results against budget and forecast, explain the underlying drivers, and recommend corrective actions.

• Identify and quantify cost savings opportunities, and track delivery of Procurement and Supply Chain savings initiatives.

Systems, Reporting & Analytics

• Own month-end and mid-month KPI reporting for Supply Chain costs, delivered through Power BI dashboards for Procurement, Supply Chain, Freight & Warehouse leadership.

• Partner with IT and Business Applications on system improvements that strengthen cost visibility and automate manual analysis.

Leadership & Business Partnership

• Serve as the trusted finance advisor to Procurement, Supply Planning, Logistics, and Warehouse leadership, and influence decisions across functions.

• Partner closely with Commercial Finance, Corporate FP&A, Cost Accounting, and the Plant Controllers at Norwood and South Windsor.

• Drive accountability for cost targets and promote a culture of continuous improvement.

WHAT YOU BRING

• 7+ years of progressive finance experience, with significant time in supply chain, procurement, or cost finance (food or CPG manufacturing preferred).

• Strong command of standard costing, BOMs, and direct material cost drivers; experience with meat or other commodity-driven inputs is a plus.

• Experience analyzing freight, warehouse, outside storage (3PL), and co-manufacturing costs, including cost-to-serve analysis and SKU rationalization.

• Demonstrated ability to partner with and influence senior operations and commercial leaders.

• Advanced financial modeling skills; ERP (D365 preferred) and BI dashboard experience.

• Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain cost drivers to non-finance audiences.

• Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting required; MBA or CPA/CMA preferred.

jobs.title: Security Analyst - Governance, Risk, and Compliance
jobs.description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly's Governance, Risk, and Compliance team is hiring a Security Analyst III to facilitate the definition, implementation, and operation of security and privacy programs at LaunchDarkly.

LaunchDarkly is critical infrastructure. Our security team keeps it safe for the global systems that depend on us and the GRC team demonstrates that to earn the trust of our customers. As a member of the team, you'll drive initiatives to assess and reduce security risks to the company, advise stakeholders, and maintain compliance with the frameworks that we adhere to including ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and FedRAMP.

You'll report to the Director of Security and partner closely with stakeholders in Legal, Revenue, and other members of our security team. We expect you to bring a sharp point of view on where AI can take work off the team's plate and make our coverage deeper.

Responsibilities:

• Collaborate with stakeholders to design and operate security controls that comprise the LaunchDarkly GRC program

• Use technology to automate compliance activities like gathering evidence and verifying controls

• Operationalize the health and maturity of the program by tracking metrics based on quantitative and qualitative data

• Drive progress towards results for GRC-related continuous improvement projects

• Contribute to documentation for security standards, policies, and processes

• Support audits and assessments with internal and external stakeholders

• Work with product and infrastructure delivery teams on engineering projects related to GRC requirements

Qualifications:

• Deep cybersecurity, privacy, and risk management knowledge and skill

• Excellent communication skills - written and verbal

• Experience working on collaborative projects

• Depth with modern cloud-based SaaS organizations - specifically AWS control environments

• Information security experience at an organization with significant compliance requirements

• Strong familiarity with security standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, FedRAMP) as well as privacy laws (CCPA and GDPR)

• Familiarity with LaunchDarkly’s collaboration tools like Confluence, Slack, and Github

Nice to Have:

• Considerable knowledge of software development and architecture

• CCSP, PCI QSA, CISSP, or CISA / CISM certifications

Qualifications:

• You're proactive by default. You'd rather spot compliance drift early and fix the cause rather than chase symptoms during an audit.

• You believe good governance is a craft of habits and systems. Small consistent improvements beat heroic one-offs.

• You invest in relationships with the teams you work with.

• You know good governance and compliance relies heavily on trust and communication.

• You're a good partner. You're helpful and direct, you say no with reasons and alternatives, and you don't mistake gatekeeping for rigor.

• You're engineering-curious by nature. You want to understand how the systems work and how to adapt for compliance frameworks.

• You treat AI as part of the toolkit. You're skeptical where you should be, aggressive where it pays off, and you want to work somewhere that's serious about both.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:

• Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area: $152,900 - $210,210**

• Zone 2: Boston, DC, Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Seattle: $137,600 - $189,200**

• Zone 3: All other US locations: $129,900 - $178,640**

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

• Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

• Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

• Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

• Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

• Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com.

Do you need a disability accommodation?

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.

jobs.title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Gerente Sênior de Estratégia GTM e Growth
jobs.description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal, reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões.

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

• Híbrido Nosso time de Go-to-Market 3P | Aluguel & Vendas atua no modelo híbrido, unindo a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto com a troca do presencial no nosso escritório em São Paulo, Vila Leopoldina - Zona Oeste, 1 semana por mês.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

O negócio 3P (Third-Party) do QuintoAndar é uma iniciativa estratégica de crescimento focada na expansão do nosso ecossistema imobiliário por meio de parcerias com corretores em todo o Brasil.

Nossa organização de Go-to-Market (GTM) é responsável por acelerar a aquisição e ativação de parceiros em Aluguel e Vendas, combinando execução comercial, parcerias estratégicas, novos canais de aquisição e iniciativas de crescimento.

À medida que o negócio escala, nosso desafio é construir um motor de aquisição mais eficiente, previsível e orientado a dados. Isso exige a melhoria contínua da nossa proposta de valor comercial, o desenvolvimento de canais de aquisição escaláveis, a otimização de preços e incentivos, e a identificação de oportunidades para aumentar a conversão e a produtividade.

Procuramos um(a) Gerente Sênior de Estratégia GTM e Growth para ajudar a moldar esta próxima fase de crescimento.

Esta é uma função altamente estratégica e prática, com exposição direta à liderança sênior e grande autonomia sobre iniciativas de alto impacto no desempenho do negócio.

Suas Responsabilidade

1. Estratégia Go-to-Market & Planejamento de Growth
Desenvolver e executar estratégias de GTM para acelerar a aquisição e ativação de corretores em Aluguel e Vendas.
Identificar oportunidades de crescimento por meio do dimensionamento de mercado, segmentação de corretores, definição de ICP, inteligência competitiva e priorização geográfica.
Traduzir objetivos estratégicos de negócios em planos de crescimento acionáveis, iniciativas e metas mensuráveis.
Avaliar novos canais de aquisição, modelos de parcerias e oportunidades comerciais.

2. Pricing, Proposta de Valor & Estratégia Comercial
Desenhar, avaliar e otimizar propostas de valor comercial, estruturas de preços e modelos de incentivo.
Desenvolver business cases para avaliar o impacto financeiro, competitividade e escalabilidade de novas estratégias comerciais.
Identificar oportunidades para melhorar a conversão, a eficiência de aquisição e a unit economics.
Trabalhar em parceria com Comercial, Finanças, Produto e Operações para implementar e escalar novos modelos comerciais.

3. Experimentação em Growth & Analytics
Desenhar e liderar experimentos estruturados de crescimento, desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, mensuração e decisões de escala.
Estabelecer métricas claras de sucesso, grupos de controle e análises de coorte para avaliar o impacto incremental no negócio.
Analisar funis de aquisição, taxas de conversão, produtividade e comportamento de parceiros para identificar oportunidades de crescimento.
Traduzir descobertas analíticas em recomendações claras e iniciativas acionáveis.

4. Execução Multifuncional & Operacionalização
Liderar iniciativas complexas de ponta a ponta, garantindo que decisões estratégicas sejam traduzidas em execução operacional.
Coordenar stakeholders multifuncionais entre Comercial, Sales Ops, Produto, Marketing, Finanças, Jurídico e Operações.
Definir planos de implementação, responsáveis, marcos e métricas de sucesso para iniciativas estratégicas.
Identificar gargalos de execução, resolver dependências e garantir que as iniciativas entreguem resultados de negócios mensuráveis.

5. Desempenho Estratégico & Suporte a Decisões Executivas
Desenvolver business cases, análises financeiras e recomendações para apoiar decisões estratégicas e alocação de recursos.
Monitorar o desempenho das iniciativas de crescimento, identificando oportunidades para otimizar ou redirecionar investimentos.
Preparar atualizações executivas concisas e orientadas a dados, comunicando claramente resultados, riscos e recomendações.
Apoiar a evolução contínua do roadmap de crescimento de GTM com base nas prioridades de negócios e oportunidades de mercado.

O que buscamos (Requisitos)

• Sólida experiência profissional em Estratégia & Operações, Operações de Negócios (BizOps), Estratégia de Growth, Consultoria de Gestão, Estratégia Comercial ou funções correlatas.

• Excepcional capacidade analítica e de resolução estruturada de problemas, com habilidade para desmembrar desafios de negócios ambíguos em soluções acionáveis.

• Domínio avançado de Excel ou Google Sheets, incluindo modelagem financeira, desenvolvimento de business cases e análise quantitativa.

• Experiência em estratégias de crescimento, funis de aquisição, pricing, desempenho comercial ou otimização de negócios.

• Capacidade de desenhar experimentos, interpretar dados, avaliar trade-offs e traduzir insights em decisões de negócios.

• Histórico comprovado de liderança de projetos multifuncionais complexos, da estratégia à execução, com impacto mensurável nos negócios.

• Forte visão de negócios, senso de dono, autonomia e orientação a resultados.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders, incluindo a capacidade de influenciar lideranças sêniores e equipes multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais

• Experiência em empresas de tecnologia de alto crescimento, negócios B2B, marketplaces ou SaaS.

• Experiência prévia em consultorias de gestão de primeira linha ou em operações estratégicas de negócios.

• Experiência com estratégia de pricing, desenho de incentivos, otimização de canais de aquisição ou experimentação em GTM.

• Familiaridade com SQL, ferramentas de BI, analytics de CRM ou plataformas de visualização de dados.

• Conhecimento do mercado imobiliário brasileiro ou ecossistemas de marketplaces digitais.

• Experiência de trabalho próximo a times de Produto, Comercial e Finanças para lançar novas iniciativas de negócios.

• Inglês Avançado

Como é nosso processo seletivo?

Desenhamos uma jornada transparente, direta e focada em avaliar seu potencial técnico, comportamental e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e trilhas de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

• Entrevista com People;

• Entrevista com Hiring Manager;

• Case;

• Entrevista com Stakeholder;

• Offer o/

Importante: Avaliamos todas as candidaturas individualmente e garantimos retorno para todas as pessoas. Toda a comunicação é feita por e-mail, então certifique-se de liberar o domínio @quintoandar.com.br na sua caixa de entrada.

Benefícios

Oferecemos um pacote completo focado na sua saúde, bem-estar, família e desenvolvimento:

• Remuneração: Salário competitivo, Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR - para funções elegíveis) e Remuneração Variável (para funções elegíveis).

• Saúde e Bem-Estar: Plano de Saúde, Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Wellhub (Gympass) e QuintoCare (apoio psicológico, jurídico, social e financeiro gratuito).

• Qualidade de Vida: Vale Refeição e Alimentação, Day Off de aniversário, Dia das Mães e Dia dos Pais.

• Flexibilidade: Auxílio Home Office e programa Work From Anywhere (WFA).

• Família e Cuidado: Auxílio Creche, Auxílio Parentalidade Atípica, Licença Parental Estendida e Kit Leiturinha.

• Educação e carreira: Parcerias com instituições de ensino;

Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar

Valorizamos a diversidade e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas por aqui — independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para todas as pessoas! Você verificará que existem algumas perguntas sobre diversidade no formulário de inscrição. Em vagas afirmativas, as informações poderão ser utilizadas para verificar o seu alinhamento com o público-alvo da oportunidade, podendo, nesses casos, ter caráter eliminatório. Para vagas não afirmativas, esses dados serão utilizados de forma anonimizada, exclusivamente para acompanhar e aprimorar nossas práticas de inclusão nos processos seletivos e sem impacto na sua candidatura.

Privacidade e Proteção a Dados

O Grupo QuintoAndar atua em conformidade com as leis de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo, mas não se limitando à Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais - LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018), e garante a segurança de seus dados pessoais. Para saber mais, acesse o nosso Aviso de Privacidade para Pessoas Candidatas. Se tiver dúvidas ou quiser exercer seus direitos como titular de dados, entre em contato com a gente pelo Canal de Atendimento.

jobs.title: Opinion Fact Checker
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

The New York Times Opinion section is looking for a fact-checker to work on guest essays and other work produced by Opinion, with a specific emphasis on data-driven essays. The job, which is staff-editor level, based in New York, is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, experienced in applying data analysis to journalism and has broad-ranging news interests.

The fact checker must have ease in working with and analyzing complex datasets; strong quantitative and statistical reasoning skills; a devotion to the highest standards of accuracy and verification; the ability to dive into unfamiliar material on deadline; and a strong interest in both data and opinion journalism. Collegiality and diplomacy are essential.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

This fact checker will perform functions that include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Verify the accuracy of information and analysis contained in data-driven guest essays and other forms of opinion journalism.

• Eliminating errors, ensuring fairness and accuracy and correcting contradictions and omissions.

• Verifying datasets and other forms of quantitative information and analysis.

• Breaking down quantitative analysis to general, non-expert readers.

• Seeing the work through all stages of the publishing process.

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

• You will report to an Assistant Editor in Opinion.

Basic Qualifications:

• At least 2 years of experience in statistics, public policy, data science, economics, quantitative social science or applied experience at a think-tank, non-profit or governmental statistical agency.

• Experience navigating complex analyses and pushing back to question data sources and analyses.

• Experience in survey research and modelling.

• Data handling experience — fluency in a statistical programming language such as R or Python.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in fact-checking, writing or editing.

• Experience applying data analysis in journalism.

• An appreciation for Opinion journalism and understanding of the broader media landscape.

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.

REQ-020956

Additional Compensation and Benefits:

For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process

$113,945.85—$115,000 USD

jobs.title: Partnerships Ops Associate
jobs.description:
Who is Credible?

Credible is a leading U.S. consumer finance marketplace, transforming the way consumers access and compare financial products. We operate at a consumer and enterprise level. On the consumer side, we help millions of people make smarter financial decisions by comparing personalized, pre-qualified offers across student loans, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and insurance — all without impacting their credit score. On the enterprise side, we power financial product comparison and distribution through deep integrations and partnerships with lenders, insurance carriers, and financial institutions, as well as providing marketplace technology and capabilities to third-party partners and distribution channels.

The Partnerships Operations Associate keeps Credible's lender and financial platform partnerships running: onboarding, reporting, payments, contracts and compliance. You are the operational backbone for the Partnerships & Business Development team, freeing senior partners to focus on growth.

You will work across Partnerships, Partner Marketing, Finance, Product, BI, Compliance and Legal. This is an entry-level role with a clear path into Strategic Partnerships Analyst or Partner Operations Specialist roles.

What you'll do

Partner onboarding and launches

• Run onboarding checklists from signed agreement to launch, tracking open items until the partner is live

• Help partners complete Graphite Connect setup and enter partner details and fees in Salesforce

• Support integration scoping with Product and BI, including feature lists, data passing, and API and filter setup

Reporting, invoices and payments

• Send month-end partner reports, confirm recipients, and follow up on incomplete partner setup

• Upload payment files and review invoices against month-end numbers

• Resolve PO mismatches and coordinate approvals, accruals and one-off payout corrections

• Answer partner questions on reports, invoices and payout status, and flag report discrepancies

Contracts and legal administration

• Manage the LinkSquares workflow: MNDAs, IOs and agreements, signature tracking and follow-ups

• Coordinate legal review and keep past agreements organized and findable

Compliance and vendor diligence

• Support TPRM reviews, security questionnaires, and vendor and traffic-destination reviews

• Manage Asana tickets and audit information requests

• Track disclosure language updates through compliance sign-off

Cross-functional coordination and pipeline tracking

• Route and chase requests across Product, Ops, BI, Compliance and Legal, then relay status back to partners and lenders

• Triage technical issues (API, quoting, anomalies) and decide whether the cause is technical or data related before escalating

• Maintain prospect and partner trackers, and support first-pass review of inbound leads

What you bring

• Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience, in business, finance, or a related field

• 0 to 2 years of experience in operations, account management, finance operations, or a similar coordination role (internships count)

• Exceptional attention to detail, especially with numbers, invoices and contract terms

• Comfort in Google Sheets, including lookups, pivots and basic reconciliation

• Clear written communication with external partners and internal teams

• A system for managing many open items at once, and the habit of following up until they close

• Good judgment on when to solve a problem and when to escalate it

• Discretion with confidential partner, financial and compliance information

Nice to have

• Experience with Salesforce, LinkSquares or another contract management tool, Asana, Looker, or Slack

• Exposure to fintech, lending, marketing partnerships, affiliate or performance marketing

• Familiarity with vendor risk management (TPRM), security questionnaires, or compliance processes

• Experience with procure-to-pay processes such as POs, invoicing and accruals

• Interest in automating repetitive work with scripts, templates or workflow tools

Credible is open to hiring candidates in the following locations: Arizona, California, Maryland, Massachusetts, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas

Why work at Credible?

We combine the intelligence, expertise, and confidence of a financial advisor with the approachability and honesty of a friend. In other words, we’re the friend you always wish you had in finance.

We are optimistic, challengers, trustworthy, clever, and smart. We are open and transparent. We strive to act as advisors by being friendly, objective, and open in our communication. We use language that is intelligent yet approachable. When appropriate, we’ll drop in a bit of wit to position ourselves as a fresh, reliable voice in the financial world.

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Designer, Sweaters
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

Overview:

The Senior Technical Designer, Sweaters is a lead role in the garment fit and tailoring arena of the brand. Your technical expertise will be used in fitting base size models. You will also fit full size runs and be responsible for correcting the fit in multiple ways from Proto 1 all the way to PP (Pre-Production Fit.) Extensive experience in the fit room is a must.

After fitting, draping, and tailoring Alo designs on our standard models, the data derived from the fittings will be used to effectively communicate to the technical garment changes/ updates to various vendors we collaborate with globally.

Responsibilities:

• Comprehends Drape and Performance of Fabric

• Approves Final Fit and Grading for Production

• Comprehends Trim Performance, Sizes in Ligne, and Sourcing

• Assembles Notes with Garment Adjustments

• Can Create Comments in Adobe Illustrator

• Can Implement Comments in PLM

• Lead Fittings and Fit Direction

• Lead Sewing Assembly Discussion for Garment Construction

• Attend Weekly Touch Base Meetings

• PLM Data Pulls Regarding Spec, Style History and Data Implementation

• Organizes Racks and Samples For Their Work Queue By Priority

• Recap Fittings with Designers During Proto Review

• Embodies The Right Team Player Aura

Qualifications:

• 10+ years working as a technical design expert

• A degree in fashion or another field relating to fashion

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant (Shift Lead) - Omaha, NE
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

Veterinary nursing Shift Leads are the glue that holds each shift together—and the spark that keeps it moving. You own the rhythm and flow of each shift, making sure patients get top-tier care and every VEGgie has what they need to thrive. From team huddles and rounds to break coverage and on-the-floor coaching, you’re the steady presence keeping things smooth, safe, and supported. You don’t need to know every detail, but you do keep a big picture view—anticipating what’s next and jumping in wherever needed. You lead with heart, hustle, and a belief that when your team is empowered, great care follows.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Keep a clear pulse on patient status, team bandwidth, and shift-wide needs

• Manage daily workflow and help the team pivot when the unexpected hits

• Ensure shift roles are assigned and adapted as needed, with clarity and care

• Jump in on the floor when help is needed—no task is too small

• Coordinate breaks, assist with conflict resolution, and model calm under pressure

• Lead shift transitions, team huddles, and start/end-of-day wrap-ups

• Communicate clearly, direct questions appropriately, and elevate key issues

• Help the team turn downtime into learning time—or just a moment to breathe

• Flag incidents or notable events with a mindset of transparency and growth

• Work with hospital leadership on coverage, call-outs, and ongoing coaching

WHAT YOU NEED

• Credentialed Veterinary Technician (CVT, RVT, LVT, LVMT) or enrolled in the VEG Credentialing Support Program preferred

• 1+ years of experience in a veterinary technician or assistant role; experience in emergency or specialty medicine preferred.

• Strong grasp of clinical workflow and team dynamics

• Confidence in navigating floor operations while guiding others with empathy

• Excellent communication and conflict resolution skills

• Flexibility and a willingness to step in wherever needed

• Leadership instincts, an ownership mindset, and a desire to grow professionally

• Basic computer skills, comprehension of practice management software and electronic medical record keeping

• Excellent communicator when collaborating with pet parents and your team

• Fine motor skills for handling patients and medical equipment

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation, including base and 401K match

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, QPR training, and access to free therapy or counseling

• Depending on your role, you may be eligible for equity after one year of full time, active employment with VEG, so you can share in our growth and success

• A BIG focus on learning and growth, from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (no really!). Full-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $2,500/year travel stipend. Full-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend.

• Clinical student loan repayment so you don’t need to worry about your student debt

• Paid parental leave; up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary and inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Head of Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Most AI is frozen in place - it doesn’t adapt to the world. We think that’s backwards. Our mandate is to build efficient intelligence that evolves in real-time. We bring together exceptional people with the drive and creativity to push the boundaries of continual adaptation. We’re looking for builders and creative thinkers ready to shape the next era of intelligence.

Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in accountability, initiative and shared success. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. We operate with low egos, high velocity, and extreme ownership to build technology that expands access and benefits the many, not the few.



HOW WE WORK

 - Impact over activity: We are building a generational company. We value people who execute on ideas rather than comment from the sidelines. We believe our competitive edge lies in caring about excellence across the entire lifecycle - from research to product. No task is beneath anyone: no one is too senior to test the build, clean the data, or unblock a teammate.

 - Vulnerable, low-ego collaboration: We believe exceptional work comes from people who challenge, support and push one another to think bigger. Rapid iteration requires stepping into discomfort. We encourage bold, half-baked, and unorthodox ideas. When we disagree, we share feedback directly, never through side channels.

 - Celebrate decisively: Extraordinary effort should be deeply memorable. We celebrate milestones generously and publicly - via spot bonuses, team dinners, spontaneous gifts, and company-wide recognition - to fuel each other for the next sprint.
   


THE ROLE

Our vision is AI systems that are flexible, adaptable, and accessible to everyone. We believe efficiency is what makes this possible. It’s how we expand access and ensure innovation benefits the many, not the few.

As Head of Operations at Adaption, you are the right hand, force multiplier, and ultimate leverage point for the founding team. Your primary directive is simple: make the founders’ day radically lighter so they can focus on high-leverage decisions and accelerating our 0 to 1 trajectory.

You are a true swiss army knife: equally comfortable with jumping on operations, coordinating team strategy or traveling alongside the founders to handle logistics and live execution. You thrive in intense, fast-moving environments where ambiguity is constant, context-switching is mandatory, and being available on short notice is second nature. From high-level strategic initiatives to critical operations, no job is too big or too small if it moves the company forward.




WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 - Founder leverage: Serve as the central point of leverage for the founders. Clear operational friction before it even reaches their desks. Be a trusted intermediary for key asks, anticipating operational needs and proactively coordinating next steps

 - High and low execution: Tackle tasks across the full spectrum of operations— from helping with procurement to coordinating team logistics.

 - Day-to-day operations & scale: Build internal rituals, communication channels, and operations infrastructure to keep a fast-growing, distributed team aligned and running efficiently.

 - Agile context-switching: Rapidly pivot between high-level strategic problem-solving and immediate tactical tasks based on founder priorities and urgent operational needs.

 - Travel & on-the-ground support: Travel directly with the founders for investor meetings, conferences, key hires, and strategic offsites. Manage door-to-door travel logistics, schedule adjustments, and live operational needs on short notice.

 - 0 to 1 special projects: Own high-priority, cross-functional initiatives end-to-end from first principles. Take undefined, ambiguous problems that don't fit into standard job descriptions and build working systems from scratch.
   


SKILLS YOU'LL BRING

We look beyond traditional markers of experience. What matters most to us is what you’ve built and the impact you’ve had. We value demonstrable output, curiosity and alignment with our core values:

 - 1–6+ years of experience in operations, founder's office, or special projects—ideally within a fast-paced, early-stage startup environment. Former founders welcome

 - Hyper-adaptable & available on short notice: Comfortable with irregular hours, fast turnarounds, and last-minute travel demands during critical build phases

 - Exceptional multi-tasking abilities: Proven track record of managing competing priorities, context-switching seamlessly, and keeping key initiatives moving without dropping details

 - Low ego, high agency: A "no task is too small" attitude coupled with the drive to take full ownership of high-stakes projects

 - Strong organizational & logistical instincts: Impeccable attention to detail, proactive anticipation of founder needs, and bulletproof administrative follow-through

Above all, we're looking for great teammates who make work feel lighter and aren't afraid to go out on a limb with bold ideas. You don't need to be perfect, but you do need to be adaptable. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every box.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: A dynamic environment with opportunities to take on new challenges, expand your responsibilities, and make an impact beyond your immediate role.

 - Adaption Passport: An annual travel allowance to explore somewhere new, experience different cultures and keep expanding your horizons. It can be used to travel to any country you haven’t previously been to.

 - Lunch on us: A weekly allowance for takeout or grocery delivery, wherever you are in the world. Whether it's stocking your fridge or having dinner delivered, it’s one less thing to think about.

 - Comprehensive benefits: High-quality medical coverage and benefits designed to support your health and well-being.

 - Team offsites and visits to SF HQ: We're a global team, but believe there's real value in spending time together in person. We regularly bring teammates together at our SF HQ and for team offsites in locations around the world, including London, Mexico City, and New York.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Program Management, Strategy & Operations - Marketing
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

• Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.

• Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.

• Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.

• Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.

• Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.

• Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a Senior Manager of Program Management and Operations  to bring structural rigor, operational efficiency, and scalable execution to our team. In this role, you will be the connective tissue between Marketing and core internal functions like Product Management, Engineering, and Sales. This role reports directly to the CMO.

What You’ll Do

• Own the Operating Cadence: Establish project management frameworks, tracking systems, and operational rhythms to ensure visibility into strategic goals and metrics across marketing.

• Automate Workflows: Leverage modern AI tools and automated workflows to centralize data, streamline project tracking, and reduce manual reporting overhead.

• Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Lead high-impact initiatives end-to-end, bridging organizational gaps across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing.

• Build Feedback Loops: Establish continuous feedback channels between teams to gather insights, assess program results, and optimize future execution.

• Lead Strategic Planning: Spearhead annual planning and QBR inputs for Marketing, translating high-level priorities into actionable operating plans and clear milestones.

• Tackle Ambiguity: Jump into emerging or unmapped problem areas, bringing structure, clarity, and rapid execution to complex challenges.

• Scale Scalable Systems: Refine operational processes and build durable frameworks that minimize friction and increase organizational velocity as we scale.

• Proactively Manage Risks: Identify execution bottlenecks early and surface actionable trade-offs and recommendations to leadership.

• Lead Through Partnership: Serve as a trusted advisor and key operational executor for marketing leadership. Collaborate with the central Business Operations leader and with cross-functional operations leads.

What You’ll Need

• Proven Experience: 10+ years in strategy, operations, program management, or operational leadership within fast-growing technology environments.

• Structured & Execution-Driven: Ability to bring order to ambiguous spaces, build scalable systems from scratch, and keep operations running seamlessly.

• Executive Partnership: Demonstrated track record as a trusted thought partner to executives, capable of driving strategic cross-functional initiatives end-to-end.

• AI-Native Mindset: Passion for leveraging modern AI tools and automated workflows to accelerate execution, synthesize data, and amplify team impact.

• Master Communicator: Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills with a proven knack for distilling complex topics into clear executive updates.

• Bias for Action: Strong sense of ownership and accountability; thrives in fast-paced environments while building scalable and sustainable processes.

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:

$190,000—$205,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

• Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.

• Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.

• Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).

• Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work-life balance.

• Paid Parental & Family Leave: Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments.

• Professional Development: Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth.

• Wellness Benefits: Wellness and work-from-home stipends to support your physical and mental well-being.

• Flexible Work: Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office-based teams.

• In-Office Meals: Complimentary meals at our office hubs.

Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

• Create, distribute, and maintain commission plans and supporting documentation.

• Research and resolve commission discrepancies and employee inquiries.

• Perform commission reconciliations and maintain strong controls over calculation and payment accuracy.

• Partner with Finance, Accounting, Sales Operations, HR, and business leaders on compensation-related matters.

• Support commission accruals, reporting, forecasting, and month- and quarter-end close activities.

• Identify opportunities to automate and improve commission processes, reporting, and controls.

Qualifications:

• 5+ years of experience in sales commissions, incentive compensation, Finance, or Sales Operations.

• Hands-on experience with Xactly or a comparable enterprise incentive compensation platform; Xactly strongly preferred.

• Experience administering complex commission plans across multiple roles and compensation structures.

• Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.

• Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

• Strong analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.

• Ability to interpret compensation plans and clearly communicate commission calculations and outcomes.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and recurring monthly and quarterly deadlines.

What we offer you:

• Wellness benefits to help you focus on what’s most important.

• Extensive development and training offerings to help you grow your career at Veracode.

• Amazing community of professionals who take pride in what we do every day.

Compensation Transparency

In accordance with U.S. pay transparency laws, Veracode provides compensation transparency for roles based in the United States. Click here to view our compensation ranges by grade. Please note, specific compensation may be influenced by various factors including candidates experience, education, and work location.

Job Grade:P3

Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed

At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information.

Here’s our recruitment promise to you:

• Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers.

If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action.

jobs.title: Head of Talent
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Head of Talent to build our talent function from scratch and help define how Mach9 attracts, evaluates, and closes exceptional talent. You’ll work closely with the CEO, CTO, and broader leadership team on high-priority talent initiatives, from headcount planning and compensation strategy to our talent brand and DEI efforts. You’ll also build and manage a growing team, setting the bar for how Mach9 attracts, evaluates, and closes exceptional talent.

This is a truly cross-functional role. You’ll build and lead a team while staying on the ground with candidates, running your own searches across technical and non-technical roles and a range of seniority levels, wherever the business needs you most. It’s a rare chance to join early, shape the talent org alongside the founders, and work on something that matters.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own full-cycle recruiting across technical and non-technical roles: Sourcing, coordinating, and closing.

 - Own the candidate experience end-to-end: Every touchpoint, every piece of feedback, every offer call; we want every person who goes through our process to walk away excited about what we're building, whether or not they join

 - Build the recruiting infrastructure from scratch: ATS, interview rubrics, comp calibration, hiring manager alignment, then keep improving it as we grow

 - Partner with founders on talent strategy and headcount planning: Help the founders translate the business plan into a hiring plan: how many people, in which roles, and in what order. Forecast hiring needs and budget so we’re never scrambling.

 - Lead our talent brand: Define what makes us a place top people want to join, and make sure it shows up consistently in outreach, content, events, and every candidate conversation.

 - Build and manage a growing talent team: Hire and develop recruiters and coordinators, and decide when to add sourcers and specialists as we grow.

 - Budget and vendor ownership: Recruiting spend, tooling, job boards, and agency fees.

 - Track the data that matters: Passthrough rates, time-to-fill, offer acceptance rates. Use it to make better decisions, not just report numbers


REQUIREMENTS

 - 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience; startup experience and experience managing or mentoring recruiters are strong pluses.

 - Builds relationships quickly across all levels (candidates, hiring managers, founders) and adjusts communication style accordingly

 - Creative sourcer who finds candidates others overlook, and tenacious enough to follow through

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Lead, Strategic Programs
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE 

Ramp’s Enterprise Marketing team helps win and grow our largest accounts. Across ABM, Product Marketing and Customer Marketing, we shape how Ramp shows up for enterprise buyers, create campaigns that open doors, and equip Sales with the positioning and customer proof to move deals forward. Our customer programs deepen those relationships through peer connections, executive engagement and partnerships that create value for customers and new opportunities for Ramp.

You’ll own a portfolio spanning our Customer Advisory Board, co-marketing programs, and reference programs and quarterly Know Your Customer program. You’ll build trusted relationships with CFOs, senior finance leadership, and customers’ Communications and Marketing teams, creating opportunities that are valuable to both the customer and Ramp.

This is a hands-on role with meaningful ownership. You’ll set program plans, prioritize competing requests, and build the playbooks and systems that keep customer engagement coordinated. You should know when to make an ask, when to change it, and when to hold off. Customer trust and operational rigor matter equally.

You’ll partner closely with Customer Marketing, Product, Sales, account teams, Creative, and Events to bring customer insight into Ramp, help buyers hear from credible peers, and deliver value back to participating customers.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the planning and execution of Ramp’s customer programs, including the calendar, goals, cross-functional responsibilities, and results.

 - Lead Ramp’s Customer Advisory Board, recruiting members, developing programming and building relationships that deepen customer engagement and advocacy.

 - Run the Know Your Customer program, helping Ramp employees get to know our customers’ businesses by recruiting participating customers and coordinating employee engagement and communications.

 - Develop customer launch and co-marketing programs. Work with customers’ executive, Communications, and Marketing teams to shape the partnership. Secure customer participation and approvals, and coordinate delivery of agreed content and campaigns with Creative and Customer Marketing.

 - Build and scale customer reference and advocacy programs, creating the systems that connect the right customers to relevant sales and marketing opportunities.

 - Partner closely with Events to recruit and prepare customer speakers for Ramp events, conferences, and executive forums.

 - Coordinate customer participation in the Times Square billboard and help customers make use of that visibility.

 - Coordinate customer asks across Sales, account teams, PMM, Comms, Events, and Customer Marketing. Maintain a shared record of commitments, approvals, and recent participation to prevent overlapping outreach and follow through on what we promise customers.




WHAT YOU NEED

 - You’ve built or significantly scaled customer programs at a high-growth B2B company, including personally recruiting, hosting and maintaining relationships with senior customer leaders.

 - You’re credible with Fortune 500 C-suite and VP-level customers and comfortable working directly with GTM and company leadership.

 - You’re comfortable owning a number. You can set goals, report on coverage and engagement, and explain how customer participation supports pipeline or expansion using a defensible methodology.

 - Strong cross-functional partnership with PMM, Events, Creative, Sales, account teams, and Growth Marketing, including aligning responsibilities and resolving competing customer requests.

 - The ability to set direction and personally manage execution against programs objectives.

 - Clear written and verbal communication; you can brief an executive in three bullets and write the memo behind it.

 - AI fluency and practical automation skills that reduce manual work while maintaining sound judgment, accurate records, and customer trust.

 - Systems thinking: experience building intake, readiness and permission standards, workflows, and reporting that other teams actually use.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience in fintech or B2B SaaS, particularly with enterprise customers or finance leaders.

 - Experience launching or scaling a CAB, customer reference program, or advocacy function.

 - Experience partnering with Creative, Content, or Events on customer co-marketing and recognition.






BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

jobs.title: Thermal Design Engineer
jobs.description:
K2 is building the largest and highest-power satellites ever flown, unlocking performance levels previously out of reach across every orbit. Backed by over $1 billion in total funding from leading investors including Altimeter Capital, ICONIQ, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, and T. Rowe Price — and with over $1 billion in signed contracts across commercial and US government customers, we're mass-producing the highest-power satellite platforms ever built for missions from LEO to deep space.

The rise of heavy-lift launch vehicles is shifting the industry from an era of mass constraint to one of mass abundance, and we believe this new era demands a fundamentally different class of spacecraft. Engineered to survive the harshest radiation environments and to fully capitalize on today's and tomorrow's massive rockets, K2 satellites deliver unmatched capability at constellation scale and across multiple orbits.

With multiple launches in 2027 and plans to scale to 100 satellites a year, we're Building Bigger — helping develop the solar system and build toward a Kardashev Type II (K2) civilization. If you are a motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and you're excited about contributing to the success of a high-growth Series D-funded company, we'd love for you to apply.

The Role

As a Thermal Design Engineer you will be a core driver of the detailed thermal design of spacecraft subsystems by running thermal analysis at both the component and spacecraft level. You will also be involved in exploring different thermal management strategies and demonstrating them through test campaigns. Our ideal candidate has experience with in-orbit integrated thermal analysis of spacecraft components using both first principles as well analytical models using software tools (such as Thermal Desktop, Ansys IcePak, and Python for automation purposes). Hands-on experience with thermal testing for spacecraft components such as thermal cycling and TVAC is highly preferred.

Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain thermal models for spacecraft and sub-components using Thermal Desktop and Ansys

• Set up and execute thermal testing ranging from development to qualification

• Work with experienced thermal engineers to learn common modeling practices and support weekly tasks that address business needs

• Work with other engineering subsystems owners to develop robust thermal design for avionics boxes and other electro-mechanical subsystems

• Collaborate with avionics teams to develop thermal models and thermal tests for electronic assemblies

• Work with mechanical teams to develop passive and active thermal control hardware for the spacecraft including radiators, heaters, heat pipes, surface coating etc..

Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience with radiative and conductive thermal modeling of spacecraft systems using Thermal Desktop or similar tools

• 3+ years of experience with selection, sizing, and design of thermal control hardware including, but not limited to, heat pipes, heaters, SSM, OSR, thermal straps, thermal paints, tapes, MLI, TEC, etc.

• 1+ year of experience with thermal cycling and thermal vacuum testing including predictions, setup, instrumentation and thermal model correlation

Nice to Have

• Experience with full-vehicle thermal vacuum testing and model correlation

• Experience with integrated thermal analysis of spacecraft and launch vehicles

• Experience with electrical PCBA thermal modeling and thermal interface materials (thermal grease, gap pads, etc.)

• Familiarity with SMC-S016 standard or equivalent

• Experience with spacecraft primary radiator design and analysis

• Knowledge of Atlassian software environments

• Experience with Python, C/C++, or Matlab for thermal modeling and automated data analysis

Compensation and Benefits:

• Base salary range for this role is $100,000 - $215,000 + equity in the company

• Salary will be based on several factors including, but not limited to: knowledge and skills, education, and experience level

• Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, medical/dental/vision/ coverage, life insurance, paid parental leave, and many other perks

If you don’t meet 100% of the preferred skills and experience, we encourage you to still apply! Building a spacecraft unlike any other requires a team unlike any other and non-traditional career twists and turns are encouraged!

If you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

Export Compliance

As defined in the ITAR, “U.S. Persons” include U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (i.e., Green Card holders), and certain protected individuals (e.g., refugees/asylees, American Samoans). Please consult with a knowledgeable advisor if you are unsure whether you are a “U.S. Person.”

The person hired for this role will have access to information and items controlled by U.S. export control regulations, including the export control regulations outlined in the International Traffic in Arms Regulation (ITAR). The person hired for this role must therefore either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.15 or otherwise eligible for a federally issued export control license.

Equal Opportunity

K2 Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with K2 Space is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Emerging Talent Programs
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is experiencing hyper-growth, and the demand for exceptional engineering, software, and hardware talent is critical to our success. This strategic role is paramount to building and sustaining & retaining a world-class pipeline of early career professionals who are passionate about our mission. As the leader of our Emerging Talent Program Managers, you will be instrumental in defining, architecting, and executing Anduril's emerging talent strategy, positioning us as the employer of choice for the brightest minds ready to tackle the toughest challenges in defense technology. Your ability to empower your team will directly ensure that our Intern, New Grad, and Veteran programs consistently deliver high-quality, impactful experiences that convert and retain top talent.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead & Develop a High-Performing Team: Provide exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentorship to a team of Program Managers overseeing Anduril’s Intern, New Grad, Veteran, and Events initiatives. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional growth within the team.

• Drive Strategic Program Execution: Translate high-level emerging talent strategy into consistent, high-quality, and scalable execution across all programs. Set clear priorities, establish robust operating rhythms, and define delivery standards to ensure programs consistently meet and exceed objectives.

• Oversee Program Management Excellence: Ensure the seamless planning, design, and delivery of all emerging talent programs, from university engagement and event strategy to candidate experience, onboarding, and development. Maintain program integrity, consistency, and alignment with Anduril’s values and mission.

• Establish & Monitor Performance Metrics: Own accountability for key program outcomes, including year-over-year improvements in candidate conversion, program participant retention, and hiring manager satisfaction. Develop and implement robust reporting frameworks to track performance, identify trends, and drive data-informed decisions across all emerging talent initiatives.

• Cultivate Cross-Functional Partnerships: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with critical internal stakeholders, including Recruiting, Engineering leadership, HR Business Partners, Finance, and Legal. Partner effectively to secure necessary resources, align program goals with business needs, and ensure widespread support and buy-in for emerging talent initiatives.

• Optimize Budget & Resource Allocation: Oversee program budgets, working closely with Program Managers and Finance to ensure responsible allocation of resources, maximize ROI, and identify opportunities for cost efficiency without compromising program quality.

• Champion Continuous Improvement: Utilize comprehensive program data (e.g., conversion rates, satisfaction scores, retention data, cost-per-hire) to conduct in-depth analysis. Identify program gaps, scale successful initiatives, eliminate ineffective practices, and continuously iterate to enhance program design and delivery.

• Elevate Program Impact & Reputation: Work with Program Managers to ensure that Intern, New Grad, and Veteran experiences are consistently high-quality, impactful, and reflective of Anduril's innovative culture. Drive strategies that build trust with hiring managers, fostering active participation and advocacy for the programs.

• Strategic Event Oversight: Provide strategic guidance and oversight to the Program Manager responsible for event strategy, ensuring that all emerging talent events effectively attract, engage, and convert top technical talent, aligning with the broader university relations and talent acquisition goals.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in talent acquisition, HR, or program management, with at least 4+ years directly managing high-performing teams responsible for early career or emerging talent programs (Intern, New Grad, Veteran programs).

• Demonstrated expertise in building, coaching, and developing Program Managers or senior individual contributors to achieve strategic objectives.

• Proven track record of designing, implementing, and scaling complex emerging talent programs in a fast-moving, technical, or defense/aerospace environment.

• Strong operational acumen with the ability to set priorities, define operating rhythms, and ensure high-quality execution at scale.

• Exceptional data analysis and interpretation skills, with experience using metrics (conversion, retention, satisfaction, cost, throughput) to drive strategic decisions and continuous improvement.

• Superior stakeholder management and influencing skills, capable of building trust and collaboration with senior leadership, engineering managers, and cross-functional partners.

• Experience managing program budgets and optimizing resource allocation to achieve maximum impact.

• A strategic mindset, capable of identifying gaps, proactively solving problems, and translating high-level vision into actionable plans for your team.

• Comfort operating in ambiguous environments, adapting to change, and leading through periods of hyper-growth.

• Deep passion for Anduril's mission and a commitment to attracting and developing world-class technical talent

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.

• Experience with talent acquisition technologies and HRIS systems relevant to program management.

• Prior experience working within or closely with the defense, aerospace, or national security sectors.

US Salary Range

$183,000—$243,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

If you're passionate about making a difference and believe in the power of technology to transform lives, you’ll feel right at home here.

TITLE:
Career Advisor

REPORTS TO:
Executive Director

Cookeville, TN

EMPLOYMENT TYPE:
Full-Time, Non-Exempt Employee

Career TEAM is looking to hire a Career Advisor that will perform professional work providing career counseling, intensive case management, and follow-up services. Work is performed under the supervision of the Career Services Manager.

Your Impact on Career EDGE’s Success:

• Guide jobseekers through the preparation of individual employment plans (IEP) based on their specific occupational goals

• Counsel clients on available job opportunities, training programs and other services

• Complete Individual Training Account (ITA) vouchers and other documents required for clients entering training

• Refer individuals to appropriate services, training programs or job opportunities and follow-up on those activities

• Conduct orientation sessions, workshops, job clubs and other group presentations for clients

• Follow all policies, procedures and regulations related to eligibility documentation; ensure that case files have originals and/or copies of eligibility documentation

• Maintain accurate individual case files for each registered customer assuring that each file contains all required eligibility documents and meets compliance requirements

• Develop a comprehensive Individual Employment Plan (IEP) for all customers. Provide referral and tracking of eligible customers into contracted programs provided on-site at the One-Stop centers and/or located in the community in accordance with established contracts

• Meet and/or exceed program benchmarks. Participate in all staff related events as required including but not limited to: training, staff meetings and individual supervision

• Complete all required reports

• Approach each day and task with a “ZAG” mindset

• Other duties and projects as needed

This position is expected to be 100% onsite. The selected candidate will be required to work onsite at the listed location.
