• Bachelor’s degree or higher or an equivalent combination of education and experience

• 2+ years of experience combining elements of training, counseling, case management or other services

• 2+ years of substantial case management experience and the ability to read and interpret policies and procedures

• 2+ years of experience with computer proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and Google suite including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Google Mail, Google Calendar, Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Drive

• 2+ years of demonstrated ability working in a dynamic team environment with an aptitude for communication, interpersonal skills to work cooperatively with others, show courteousness, and having a high level of professionalism

• A Demonstrated ability to serve and influence as a role model to customers and motivate them towards achieving goals

• A Demonstrated ability to work in a variety of settings with a culturally diverse customer base with the ability to be culturally sensitive

• Exceptional time management skills to meet deadlines and work under pressure

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills

• A Valid Driver’s License

Additional Skills/Knowledge Career TEAM Would Love for This Role:

• Experience and knowledge of WIOA and TANF workforce development contracts/programs

• Astounding ability to multitask and be proactive

Salary: $40,000-$45,000

Salary is commensurate with education and experience. Career TEAM offers a competitive benefits package including healthcare, dental, and personal/vacation time

Travel: Position may require local travel up to 30% of the time

About Career Team:
Founded in 1996, Career Team, LLC is a private workforce development organization.

Career Team’s outstanding record of building the modern infrastructure powering America's workforce has resulted in numerous honors:

• Named by Inc. Magazine as one of America's 500 fastest growing privately held companies

• Recipient of the US Chamber of Commerce Blue Chip Enterprise Award for innovation

• Featured by 60 Minutes, CNN, Money Magazine, Inc. Magazine and the British Broadcasting Network as an innovative, government funded solutions program

• Invited to the White House after being cited by the National Welfare-to-Work Partnership and National Alliance of Business as a top 10 US training provider

As a socially conscious organization, Career Team has found a healthy balance between for-profit innovation and community enrichment. Looking ahead, the organization will continue to close the nation’s opportunity divide with additional government-funded workforce sites; while also building staff capacity of workforce funding sources and industry providers. See www.careerteam.com for more information.

Career Team is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Background Check Requirements. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check (including criminal, prior employment and education verification). Failure to satisfactorily complete the background check may affect the application status of applicants or continued employment of current employees who apply for the position.

California Consumer Privacy Act ("CCPA").  Career Team is committed to complying with the CCPA and all data privacy and laws in the jurisdictions in which it recruits and hires employees. Career Team collects and uses Personal Information for human resources, employment, benefits administration, health and safety, and business-related purposes and to be in legal compliance. Below are the categories of Personal Information we collect and the purposes for which we intend to use this information:

Identifying information, such as your full name, gender, date of birth, and signature; Demographic data, such as race, ethnic origin, marital status, disability, and veteran or military status; Contact information, such as your home address, telephone numbers, email addresses, and emergency contact information; Dependent's or other individual's information, such as their full name, address, date of birth, and Social Security numbers (SSN); National identifiers, such as SSN, passport and visa information, and immigration status and documentation; Educational and professional background, such as your work history, academic and professional qualifications, educational records, references, and interview notes; Employment details, such as your job title, position, hire dates, compensation, performance and disciplinary records, and vacation and sick leave records; Financial information, such as banking details, tax information, payroll information, and withholdings; Health and Safety information, such as health conditions (if relevant to your employment), job restrictions, workplace illness and injury information, and health insurance policy information; Information Systems (IS) information, such as your search history, browsing history, login information, and IP addresses on the Company's information systems and networks; Biometric information, such as facial recognition, fingerprints, iris or retina scans, keystroke, or other physical patterns; and Geolocation data, such as time and physical location related to use of an internet website, application, device, or physical access to a Company office location.

The Company collects Personal Information to use or disclose as appropriate to:

(1) Comply with all applicable laws and regulations; (2) Recruit and evaluate job applicants and candidates for employment; (3) Conduct background checks; (4) Manage your employment relationship with us, including for: (a) onboarding processes; (b) timekeeping, payroll, and expense report administration; (c) employee benefits administration; (d) employee training and development requirements; (d) the creation, maintenance, and security of your online employee accounts; (e) reaching your emergency contacts when needed, such as when you are not reachable or are injured or ill; (f) workers' compensation claims management; (g) employee job performance, including goals and performance reviews, promotions, discipline, and termination; and (h) other human resources purposes; (5) Manage and monitor employee access to company facilities, equipment, and systems; (6) Conduct internal audits and workplace investigations; (7) Investigate and enforce compliance with and potential breaches of Company policies and procedures; (8) Engage in corporate transactions requiring review of employee records, such as for evaluating potential mergers and acquisitions of the Company; (9) Maintain commercial insurance policies and coverages, including for workers' compensation and other liability insurance; (10) Perform workforce analytics, data analytics, and benchmarking; (11) Administer and maintain the Company's operations, including for safety purposes; (12) For client marketing purposes; (13) Exercise or defend the legal rights of the Company and its employees, and affiliates, customers, contractors, and agents; and (14) to comply with requirements of government grants, including, but not limited to, program and audit requirements.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager - West Coast
jobs.description:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern commerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it hurts your bottom line.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the only AI harness in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

What You’re Applying For

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our team, reporting to our Director of Talent Acquisition. You’ll own hiring across the West Coast and APAC, along with other US-based GTM roles as needed.

This role is remote and must be based in the Pacific Time zone, with flexibility to align portions of your schedule with APAC business hours, particularly Australia.

You’ll own full-cycle recruiting across functions and build strong partnerships with hiring managers, understanding what their teams need and anticipating what’s coming next.  You’ll bring a white-glove approach to both candidate and hiring manager experience: thoughtful preparation, proactive communication, and consistent follow-through.

We’re looking for someone who understands that speed and quality both matter, and that candidate experience is paramount. You know how to create urgency, give hiring managers clear recommendations, and keep candidates engaged through a well-run, thoughtful process.

What You’ll Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting across APAC and the US, from kickoff and sourcing through interviews, offer negotiations, and a thoughtful transition into onboarding.

• Partner closely with hiring managers to understand their teams, and build a hiring approach that reflects their priorities and local market realities.

• Anticipate needs, flag challenges early, and bring recommendations that help hiring teams move forward.

• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from first conversation to onboarding, with personal communication, clear expectations, thoughtful preparation, and timely updates.

• Build targeted pipelines through sourcing, referrals, and creative outreach that gives active and passive candidates a compelling reason to consider Triple Whale.

• Screen resumes, conduct initial interviews, and assess how candidates’ experience, strengths, and motivations align with each opportunity.

• Use pipeline and funnel data to keep hiring managers informed, surface bottlenecks, and recommend meaningful improvements.

• Bring an AI-forward approach to research, sourcing, and recruiting workflows, using tools thoughtfully to create more time for relationship-building.

• Maintain accurate ATS records and clear reporting, with the same attention to detail you bring to every candidate interaction.

What You’ll Bring

• 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, in-house, at an agency, or a combination of both.

• Experience managing global hiring across multiple regions and time zones; experience recruiting in Australia is a plus.

• A home base in the Pacific Time zone, with flexibility to support APAC hiring managers and candidates during their business hours.

• The ability to become a trusted partner to hiring managers and help them make confident, informed hiring decisions.

• Experience balancing higher-volume hiring with specialized searches for niche roles.

• A high bar for candidate experience. You anticipate questions, remember the details, and close the loop without needing a reminder.

• Strong sourcing skills, including experience using LinkedIn Recruiter to engage both active and passive candidates.

• Strong ATS proficiency; Greenhouse and/or Ashby experience is a plus.

• Experience using AI to improve sourcing, research, and recruiting workflows, with sound judgment about where it adds value.

• Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple open roles and competing priorities across time zones.

• High standards, low ego, and a people-first approach to helping Triple Whale grow.

Come make waves with us.

The expected base salary for this role is $120,000-$140,000 per year.  Eligible employees receive medical coverage; a 401(k) with a company match of up to 3%; 30 days of paid time off accrued monthly after the first 30 days of employment; five sick days; and nine paid company holidays. Triple Whale also offers paid parental leave for eligible employees.

Our compensation ranges are set using benchmarks from growth-stage companies and factor in function, level, and location—so everything stays balanced and competitive. The range listed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salary across all U.S. locations.

Triple Whale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Referred?  Got here thanks to a friend? Splash some gratitude their way!  They'll need to submit your application through our referral system to make it official.

jobs.title: Senior UI Artist
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

WHAT WE NEED

We’re looking for a Senior UI Artist who excels at visual hierarchy, color theory, dynamic composition, and typography to help elevate and set the standard for visual excellence in our game. You operate, innovate, and drive UI systems, establishing high-fidelity, game-ready assets while architecting scalable, future-proof UI pipelines. You’ll work closely with UX and UI Technical Designers to translate player needs into beautiful solutions that will delight and impress.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive Asset Creation & Craft: Establish and define clean, high-fidelity visual targets and production-ready UI assets, including icons, menus, HUDs, and exceptional UI motion graphics concepts. Support and drive the visual identity of the project, establishing style guides that serve to elevate the entire UI teams’ execution and alignment.

• Lead Technical Integration: Optimize the asset pipeline and work directly with engine tools to support UI Tech Designers, leveraging a solid understanding of technical UI implementation standards. Solve advanced dynamic scaling, localization, and multi-platform layout challenges while strictly enforcing performance budgets, draw call optimizations, modular texture packing, and project-wide file systems.

• Champion Autonomy & Workflow: Collaborate with UX design to create comprehensive UI art solutions with minimal to no supervision. Take end-to-end ownership of full features by managing complex asset pipelines, anticipating technical bottlenecks, and driving iterative design reviews.

• Foster Collaboration & Communication: Partner with Leads, UI Engineers, UX Designers, and the XD Director to define technical constraints, refine workflows, and align cross-functional teams. Articulate art rationale clearly across disciplines, help drive feature reviews, and mentor peer artists to elevate the overall quality bar of the UI Art team.

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU A GREAT FIT

• Design Mastery: Exceptional eye for core UI art principles, demonstrating expertise in visual hierarchy, color theory, dynamic composition, and typography.

• Production Craft: Proven experience creating high-fidelity, production-ready UI assets, including polished HUDs, icons, and motion graphics concepts.

• Technical Acumen: Deep understanding of technical UI implementation standards, including performance budgets, draw call optimizations, modular texture packing.

• Pipeline Architecture: Experience managing complex asset pipelines, anticipating bottlenecks, and building scalable, future-proof UI file systems.

• Mentorship & Communication: Strong ability to articulate artistic rationale across disciplines and a proven track record of mentoring junior or intermediate team members.

BENEFICIAL QUALIFICATIONS / NICE TO HAVES

• Advanced proficiency working directly in game engines (e.g., Unreal Engine) and associated UI toolsets (e.g., UMG).

• Strong background in motion graphics, animation, or visual effects specifically tailored to UI feedback loops and dynamic compositions.

The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $103,700 and $153,500 per Year. However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for employees in regular roles may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, provided that temporary or intern roles will not be eligible for many of these payments or benefits. Details of participation in compensation and benefit plans (if applicable) will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an "at-will position" and the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform their essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need reasonable accommodation.

Please be aware that Take-Two does not conduct job interviews or make job offers over third-party messaging apps such as Telegram, WhatsApp, or others. Take-Two also does not engage in any financial exchanges during the recruitment or onboarding process, and the Company will never ask a candidate for their personal or financial information over an app or other unofficial chat channel. Any attempt to do so may be the result of a scam or phishing exercise. Take-Two’s in-house recruitment team will only contact individuals through their official Company email addresses (i.e., via a take2games.com email domain). If you need to report an issue or otherwise have questions, please contact Careers@take2games.com.

jobs.title: Senior Events & Community Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIPRISE

AiPrise is the global compliance platform for companies that operate across borders. We cover the full KYB lifecycle in a single API, with AI agents handling the case work that used to eat analyst hours. Customers include Meta, Bridge (a Stripe company), Airwallex, Fireblocks, and Nivoda. We're a YC company (S22), Series A backed by Headline, and growing fast.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Events & Community Manager to own how compliance leaders meet AiPrise in person.

Events are one of our strongest channels. We show up at the conferences where compliance, risk, and fraud leaders gather, and we host our own dinners and roundtables around them. Today that work is spread across the team. It needs an owner.

Our audience is compliance leaders at fintech, payments, stablecoin, and marketplace companies. It's a small, tight-knit world. People know each other, they talk, and they remember who wasted their time. The events that win with them are small, well-curated, and useful. That's the bar.

You'll work directly with our founders, sales, and marketing teams. You report to the Head of Marketing.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - The conference calendar. Which shows we attend, sponsor, or skip, and why. Budget, booth, logistics, staffing, and meeting targets for each one.

 - Pipeline from every event. Pre-event outreach and meeting booking with sales, on-site execution, and follow-up within 48 hours. Every event gets judged on meetings, SQLs, and pipeline, not badge scans.

 - Our own events. Executive dinners, invite-only roundtables for heads of compliance, customer events, and side events around major conferences.

 - Webinars and virtual panels with customers and industry experts.

 - Community. A real network of compliance, risk, and fraud leaders who show up, introduce each other, and think of AiPrise first. Online and in person.

 - Partnerships with conference organizers, industry associations, and co-hosts, including speaking slots for our founders and customers.

 - Vendors and budget. Venues, booth builds, swag, travel, and agencies, with every dollar tracked.

 - Reporting. A clear readout after every event: what we spent, who we met, what it produced, and what we'd change.


WHO YOU ARE

 - 6+ years in B2B event marketing, field marketing, or community, ideally at a startup selling to enterprise buyers.

 - You've run a full conference calendar end to end and can show the pipeline it produced.

 - You've hosted executive dinners and roundtables that senior people actually wanted to attend.

 - You've built a community from scratch, not just managed one.

 - Organized to a fault. You can run three events in three cities in the same month without dropping anything.

 - You think in meetings and pipeline, not attendance. Comfortable in HubSpot or an equivalent CRM.

 - A strong writer. Invitations, follow-ups, and recaps that people actually read.

 - Happy to travel often, including internationally.

 - You treat accuracy as non-negotiable. Every number you report is sourced and reproducible. This is a hard requirement, not a preference.

 - High ownership, high autonomy, fast pace, and real care about the quality of what ships.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in compliance, fintech, payments, crypto, or another regulated industry.

 - An existing network in the compliance, risk, or fraud community.

 - Experience running events in Europe, Asia, or Latin America.

 - Fluency with AI tools for event ops, attendee research, and personalized outreach.


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Our buyers decide who to trust based on who they've met. This role decides where we show up, who we meet, and what it turns into.

This role is in person in our San Jose office, with frequent travel.

jobs.title: HR Infrastructure & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

The Role Overview

PagerDuty is looking for an experienced HR Infrastructure & Operations Manager to lead Recruiting Operations at PagerDuty. This role owns the systems, processes, and data that power how we hire, with a heavy focus on optimizing workflows within Greenhouse and our broader recruiting technology stack. You'll be the go-to expert on configuration, integrations, and recruiting reporting and analytics, and just as importantly, you'll enable recruiters, TA Specialists, Recruiting Coordinators, hiring managers, and interviewers to get the most out of those systems and processes. You'll leverage AI tools and automation to build scalable, intelligent solutions that transform how we hire.

If you are a builder who loves breaking down operational silos, architecting intelligent workflows with cutting-edge AI tools, and driving organization-wide impact, this is your next big challenge. This role will be required to work from our Atlanta office two days per week.

Why This Role is Exciting

• Architect Intelligent Solutions: Act as the technical mastermind behind our HR tech, balancing advanced automation with seamless user experiences.

• Drive AI Fluency: Lead the charge in building AI agents and workflows that eliminate manual friction and unlock predictive insights.

• Navigate & Influence: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership across Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, and Procurement to align compliance with rapid business growth.

• Global Impact: Deliver measurable business outcomes that directly influence company-wide operational efficiency and transform how multiple departments operate.

Key Responsibilities

• Own and optimize Greenhouse as PagerDuty's system of record for recruiting, leading configuration, workflow design, permissions, templates, and ongoing process optimization

• Manage the recruiting technology ecosystem (scheduling, sourcing, assessments, background checks, offer, and onboarding tools), ensuring seamless integrations, automation, and scalability

• Build and maintain integrations between Greenhouse, Workday, and downstream HR/business tools to ensure data accuracy and process efficiency

• Drive recruiting reporting and analytics, delivering dashboards and insights that inform hiring decisions, identify bottlenecks, and measure funnel health and recruiting effectiveness

• Design, document, and continuously improve recruiting processes end to end, from requisition approval through offer and handoff to onboarding

• Enable the recruiting organization and hiring teams, building training, playbooks, and resources for recruiters, TA Specialists, Recruiting Coordinators, hiring managers, and interviewers, and driving adoption of new processes and tools

• Leverage AI and build AI agents to automate workflows, enhance the candidate and end user experience, improve data quality, and surface predictive insights

• Manage vendor relationships for the recruiting technology stack, including renewals, system upgrades, troubleshooting, and optimization

FY28 Project Priorities

Greenhouse Optimization & Workflow Standardization

• Audit and reconfigure Greenhouse to establish standardized global workflows, minimizing manual data entry and removing process silos between Talent Acquisition and HR Infrastructure

• Streamline job, approval, interview plan, scorecard, and offer configurations to improve consistency, compliance, and data quality

Recruiting Tech Stack & Integration Review

• Map the full recruiting technology stack to eliminate configuration bloat, ensure system interoperability, and maximize platform ROI

• Strengthen integrations across Greenhouse, Workday, and supporting tools to reduce manual handoffs

Unified Recruiting Analytics Framework

• Centralize fragmented recruiting data (from sourcing and campaign metrics to final hires) into a single source of truth

• Build operational scorecards and dashboards tracking hiring trends, recruiter capacity, pipeline health, and time-to-hire lifecycle metrics

• Leverage predictive analytics to forecast pipeline bottlenecks and evaluate sourcing effectiveness

Recruiting Enablement Program

• Build role-based training and resources for recruiters, TA Specialists, Coordinators, hiring managers, and interviewers on systems, processes, and best practices

• Establish feedback loops and adoption metrics to ensure processes and tools are used consistently and effectively

What You Bring to the Team

Basic Qualifications:

• 7+ years of progressive Recruiting Operations or HR Operations experience

• Deep, hands-on Greenhouse expertise, including advanced configuration, workflow design, permissions, and reporting (Workday or similar HRIS experience a plus)

• Strong technical skills including system configuration, integration management, and process automation

• Reporting and analytics expertise, with demonstrated ability to build analytics frameworks and dashboards and translate data into actionable insights

• Proven process optimization experience, redesigning recruiting workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and candidate experience

• Experience enabling stakeholders, including designing and delivering training for recruiting teams, hiring managers, and interviewers and driving change adoption

• Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously

• Effective stakeholder management and communication skills across all organizational levels

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with integrations and Greenhouse APIs

• Experience with recruiting tools such as scheduling (e.g., GoodTime, ModernLoop), sourcing (e.g., Gem), and assessment platforms

• Hands-on experience building AI agents or implementing AI-powered solutions in recruiting or operations contexts

• Familiarity with AI platforms (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) and no-code/low-code AI agent builders

• Experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) and SQL

• Background in vendor management and procurement processes

• Experience in high-growth technology companies

The base salary range for this position is 114,000 - 1172,700 USD. This role may also be eligible for bonus, commission, equity, and/or benefits.

Our base salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range, which is subject to change based on primary work location, reflects the minimum and maximum base salary we expect to pay newly hired employees for the position. Within the range, we determine pay for an individual based on a number of factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills/competencies and experience.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific offerings for this role, as well as the salary range for your primary work location during the hiring process.

Hesitant to apply?

We encourage you to submit your resume even if you don't meet every requirement. We value potential and consider each candidate's full professional story. Whether you're exploring a career change or taking your next step, we look forward to reviewing your application. If this just isn’t the right role or time - sign up for job alerts!

Where we work

PagerDuty operates a hybrid work model with offices in 8 major cities: Atlanta, Lisbon, London, San Francisco, Santiago, Sydney, Tokyo, and Toronto. While we offer flexibility within our established locations, we cannot employ candidates residing in:

jobs.title: Director, Fuel Equipment Engineering
jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

As part of the Engineering organization, Mechanical Engineering designs and develops the mechanical systems, components, and equipment that power Valar's advanced nuclear technologies. The team ensures designs are robust, manufacturable, and optimized for long-term performance.

The Role

Our TRISO fuel fabrication line turns U3O8 powder into finished TRISO compacts through three core process families: sol-gel kernel production, chemical vapor deposition (CVD) coating, and high-temperature furnace processing. Each runs on purpose-built process skids that our team designs, procures, builds, and commissions.

The Director of Fuel Equipment Engineering owns the design of that equipment end to end: from early skid design through to fabrication, factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, and handover to fuel production operations.

This role is a hands-on technical authority who understands chemical process equipment, fluidized-bed reactors, and high-temperature furnace systems at a deep level. It is also a team leader who builds and develops the equipment engineering organization as the fuel program scales.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership — Fuel Process Equipment

• Own the equipment design basis for the full TRISO fabrication flow, from U3O8 receipt through finished coated particle

• Oversee technical leads for each equipment family and guide the design and commissioning of that equipment

• Define skid architecture standards: modularity, materials of construction, containment and confinement, maintainability, and remote or glovebox operation where required

• Partner with process engineering to translate process recipes and critical parameters into equipment requirements that deliver repeatable kernel and coating quality

• Ensure equipment designs meet nuclear criticality safety, radiological protection, chemical hazard, and fire protection requirements

Equipment Design, Fabrication & Commissioning

• Lead equipment scope for development rigs, pilot lines, and production lines, from P&IDs and layouts through detailed mechanical design

• Own fabrication oversight, factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), and equipment commissioning

• Drive scale-up from laboratory and pilot equipment to production throughput while preserving product specifications

• Establish equipment reliability, maintenance, and spare parts strategies that support high-uptime production

• Integrate with controls, instrumentation, and facility engineering on utilities, ventilation, off-gas, and process control interfaces

Program & Team Leadership

• Build, lead, and mentor the fuel equipment engineering team across mechanical, process equipment, thermal, and design disciplines

• Define team structure, staffing plans, and competency roadmap as the program scales from development through production

• Manage equipment engineering scope, schedule, and budget within the broader fuel program

• Select and manage skid fabricators, furnace and reactor vendors, and component suppliers; define design, quality, inspection, and acceptance requirements

• Collaborate closely with fuel process engineering, quality, nuclear safety, licensing, facility engineering, and operations to keep equipment, process, and facility designs coherent

Basic Qualifications

• 10+ years of engineering experience designing process equipment for chemical, materials, or high temperature manufacturing systems

• 5+ years of experience managing engineering teams

• Demonstrated hands-on experience with equipment similar to TRISO production equipment

• Experience leading equipment lifecycle from design through to commissioning

• Strong foundation in process equipment design principles, including pressure vessels, piping, gas delivery, heat transfer, materials selection, and effluent treatment

• Experience scaling processes from pilot to production

• Experience managing vendor relationships across multiple project phases

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience managing engineering teams in a start-up or high growth environment

• Direct experience with TRISO or other coated-particle fabrication

• Direct experience with Uranium conversion

• Experience with fluidized-bed CVD, and precursors such as methyltrichlorosilane

• Familiarity handling hazardous material, including gloveboxes, confinement, and nuclear criticality safety

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

Salary

$200,000—$300,000 USD

jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

As a Principal Technical Product Manager in Enterprise Technology, you will own the technical product direction and lifecycle for one or more enterprise technology domains. You will work closely with Business teams and Engineering to define what our systems need to do, set the roadmap in partnership with the teams that own the business process, and make sure the technology keeps pace with a growing global business.

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad influence across complex systems and business processes. You bring deep domain expertise, technical depth and product judgment, and you help set the standard for how Technical Product works across Enterprise Technology. AI and automation are increasingly part of how we work; you are expected to use them directly in your own work and to identify where they create meaningful value in your domain.

What You'll Do

• Own one or more enterprise systems end to end: roadmap, backlog and priority, requirements, and the health of the system over its full lifecycle.

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional business partners to translate operational goals into functional, data, API, and platform requirements that engineering teams can build against.

• Serve as the single accountable owner for how your systems behave in production. You hold system knowledge organization depends on, decide what a problem means for the roadmap, and determine when a change requires Engineering.

• Maintain first-hand technical depth across your systems so that you can analyze data, investigate issues independently, identify recurring operational patterns, and translate system diagnostics into roadmap priorities.

• Understand software partner roadmaps, identify feature needs, handle vendor issues, and align external updates with internal plans.

• Evaluate product impact and drive continuous optimization by tracking usage adoption, platform health metrics, support ticket trends, and core business outcomes to justify future roadmap expansion.

What We're Looking For

• 15+ years of relevant experience, including significant experience in technical product management, enterprise systems or technology product ownership, with at least 3 years at senior or principal scope.

• Demonstrated experience owning the roadmap and full lifecycle of complex enterprise systems, including upgrades, vendor changes and adoption, not only launches.

• Strong technical fluency across APIs, integrations, data, cloud platforms and enterprise applications, and the ability to write requirements engineers can execute against.

• Comfortable working directly with data and systems: SQL or equivalent, reading logs, reproducing and diagnosing issues.

• Experience making prioritization and product decisions across multiple stakeholders, dependencies and competing business needs, and holding the line between what the system must do and how it is built.

• Demonstrated hands-on use of AI-assisted tools in product work, with the ability and willingness to incorporate new capabilities into requirements, analysis, documentation and day-to-day productivity.

• Experience as the accountable owner of a system and the single point of contact for the teams that use it, including diagnosing issues to the point where it is clear whether an engineering change is needed.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders and technical teams across a globally distributed organization without relying on formal authority.

Nice to Have

• Experience with compliance-sensitive or audit-controlled systems.

• Experience with large-scale integrations, integration platforms or data workflows.

• Experience in media, entertainment or streaming.

• Prior experience in engineering, systems analysis, platform administration or another hands-on technical discipline.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

• Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

• Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

• Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance

• Health Saving Account HSA program

• Health care and dependent care FSA

• 401(k) plan, with employer match

#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Distributed Systems
jobs.description:
About Us:

At webAI we firmly believe that the future of AI lies in distributed processing at the edge, bringing computation closer to the source of data generation. Our mission is to build a future where local and private is the default, servers and data centers are optional. Where valuable data and intellectual property remain entirely private, enabling the deployment of large-scale AI models directly on standard consumer hardware without compromising the information embedded within those models. We are developing an end-to-end platform that is secure, scalable, and fully under the control of our users, empowering enterprises with AI that understands their unique business.



About the Role

We are looking for Engineers to drive webAI Public Sector initiatives focused on secure, resilient, and distributed data systems operating at the tactical edge.

In our world, network connectivity isn't guaranteed. Systems must thrive in Denied, Degraded, Intermittent, and Limited (DDIL) bandwidth environments. We are less concerned with formal peer-to-peer or blockchain dogmas and far more focused on practical, robust edge synchronization: building systems that can discover local nodes, store-and-forward critical data across ad-hoc transports (such as Wi-Fi and Bluetooth), and reconcile state once connectivity is restored.

This is real world edge work built for dynamic field settings, rather than sterile cloud data centers or closed SCIF environments. You will architect software running across a hybrid footprint of edge nodes, mobile endpoints, and cloud sync services.



Responsibilities

 - Architect Resilient Transport & Sync Layers: Design and implement store-and-forward transport and data synchronization protocols tailored for low-bandwidth, high-latency, and DDIL field conditions.

 - Ad-Hoc Networking & Discovery: Implement local peer discovery and async I/O transports operating over heterogeneous physical links, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and ad-hoc mesh networks.

 - Field Ready Systems Engineering: Apply delay tolerant networking (DTN) principles and local conflict-free data synchronization (e.g., CRDTs and content-addressable storage) to ensure mission critical applications function offline indefinitely.

 - Integration with Core Components: Integrate applied software components deployed at the edge with core infrastructure. 

 - Performance & Resource Optimization: Employ memory management and debugging techniques against resource-constrained systems to improve our network.

 - Security & Cryptographic Primitives: Understand and implement various authorization and authentication security patterns, suitable for DDIL and contested environments.

 - Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, mobile, and forward-deployed teams to validate end-to-end functionality under simulated and live field constraints.



Qualifications

Core Requirements:

 - 5-7+ years of software engineering experience building robust systems software or distributed networking services.

 - Core Languages: Strong proficiency in Rust or other systems level languages (Go, C, or C++).

 - Resilient Networking Expertise: Demonstrated experience with store-and-forward architectures, delay-tolerant networks (DTN), async I/O, or local device-to-device transport layers (e.g., BLE, TCP/IP, socket-level async networking).

 - Edge & Offline First Mindset: Practical experience solving synchronization challenges under intermittent, contested, or low-throughput network constraints (DDIL).

Nice-to-Haves / Pluses:

 - Familiarity with hybrid mobile/cloud application architecture and state reconciliation.

 - Hands-on experience testing and evaluating wireless networking hardware and software in physical field or operational testing environments (outside of traditional lab/SCIF environments).

 - Background in content-addressable data structures, Merkle DAGs, or CRDTs.

 - Expertise in embedded hardware or robotics orchestration.



Why webAI?

At webAI we do our best to live out our core values we have put in place as the foundation on which we operate as a team. We are looking for people who are interested in personifying the same:

 - Truth - that which is true or in accordance with fact or reality; it’s not always easy, it’s not always pleasant, but we try to live by what reality is so we can accomplish something really cool

 - Ownership - the act, state or right of possessing something; we want you to fully own your responsibilities in this company, and continue to help define what fits in that purview and how we can help you be your best

 - Tenacity - persistent determination; we are really fired up about what we are trying to do here, and would love to have those who are fired up about what they do, to join us. If you really dig our mission, we certainly don’t mind that cherry on top

 - Humility - the quality of having a modest view of one’s value or importance; do we hope webAI can change the world? Certainly, but we know the only way to accomplish that is to not worry so much about the company’s accomplishments or status, but instead put all of that importance on building a world class team and treating them as such. We believe that’s the ultimate formula for success



Benefits:

We strive to provide competitive benefits to all employees. The benefits listed in this posting generally apply to U.S.-based employees. For employees hired outside the United States, benefits may vary based on local law, country-specific requirements, and the employment platform or entity through which the employee is hired.

 - Competitive salary and performance-based incentives

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits package
   
   - Including a high-deductible HSA option with $200/month company contribution

 - 401k match (US-based only)

 - Equity options

 - Flexible PTO Policy

 - Parental leave for eligible employees

 - Continuing education support

 - Basic, company-paid life insurance

 - Supplemental life insurance

 - Company-paid short and long term disability

 - Free parking for in-office employees



webAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Quality Engineer to join CMT’s IoT Operations team and lead supplier and field quality initiatives. This role will oversee vendor quality management, incoming inspection processes, and the resolution of physical and cosmetic product defects, driving root cause analysis and implementing lasting improvements to product quality and supplier processes.

Working cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Customer Success, Quality Assurance, Hardware Engineering, and external manufacturing partners, you will serve as the primary point of contact for supplier and field quality matters. This role requires independent judgment, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to drive continuous improvement in a high-volume IoT hardware environment.

CMT is looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to help us change the world. CMT has helped protect over 65 million drivers and prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. We build AI to solve some of the most difficult challenges in mobility — understanding and reducing risk, detecting crashes, and getting people life-saving help. The problems are hard. The impact is real. No matter your role, your work will matter at CMT.

Responsibilities:

• Use independent judgment and discretion to lead and continuously improve CMT's vendor quality management program, including supplier classification, performance metrics, documentation standards, and audit requirements

• Oversee vendor qualification and onboarding, evaluating supplier quality plans, compliance requirements, and readiness in partnership with Supply Chain and Quality leadership

• Plan and conduct supplier audits, identify quality risks, and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives

• Manage supplier performance through quality scorecards, business reviews, and accountability for established quality standards

• Own incoming inspection processes, including sampling plans, acceptance criteria, non-conformance management, and inspection procedures

• Lead root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions for supplier defects, incoming non-conformances, and field quality issues

• Establish and maintain cosmetic and physical quality standards, ensuring alignment across Hardware Engineering, suppliers, and inspection teams

• Analyze quality trends and KPIs to identify systemic risks, prevent recurring issues, and improve product and supplier quality

• Maintain quality documentation, procedures, and records within PLM/QMS systems, ensuring compliance, document control, and audit readiness

• Represent Quality in cross-functional discussions, influencing supplier decisions, product quality standards, and operational improvements

• Mentor junior engineers and technicians and support coordination of broader quality initiatives

• Complete any additional tasks as they arise

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent years of experience and/or certification in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; or equivalent years of experience

• 4+ years in quality engineering, supplier quality, or a related role in a contract manufacturing environment

• Demonstrated proficiency with quality tools and methodologies — root cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, fishbone), corrective and preventive action processes, inspection sampling plans, and MRB disposition

• Experience managing quality relationships with component suppliers or contract manufacturers, including qualification, auditing, and performance management

• Ability to exercise sound judgment on complex and ambiguous quality problems with minimal supervision, and to make and defend risk-based decisions

• Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to lead multiple concurrent workstreams across vendors, inspection activities, and field investigations

• Comfortable working from data: able to define, compile, and interpret quality metrics and use them to drive decisions and influence stakeholders

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting findings and recommendations to Supply Chain, Engineering, Customer Success, and suppliers

• Ability to travel up to 20% for supplier visits, facility audits, and other quality activities as required

Nice to Haves:

• Experience building or maturing a vendor quality management program, supplier auditing program, or supplier tiering/classification system

• Hands-on experience with PPAP, APQP, FMEA, or other supplier quality processes for custom-manufactured components

• Working knowledge of IPC-A-610, IPC/WHMA-A-620, or similar electronics quality standards

• Experience with injection molding for cosmetic components

• Experience with PLM systems (Arena or similar) for document and change management

• Experience applying statistical methods for quality analysis (SPC, process capability, sampling plans, measurement system analysis)

• Experience with data visualization or reporting tools (Tableau, Databricks, or similar)

• Working with database query languages (SQL, MSSQL, etc.)

• Lean or Six Sigma Green Belt or higher, or ASQ CQE certification

• Experience with high-volume IoT or consumer electronics manufacturing

• Experience mentoring or training junior engineers or technicians

Compensation and Benefits:

• Fair and competitive salary based on skills and experience, and annual performance bonus

• Equity may be awarded in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)

• Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance, matching 401k, short-term & long-term disability and parental leave

• Unlimited Paid Time Off including vacation, sick days & public holidays

• Flexible scheduling and work from home policy depending on role and responsibilities

Base Salary Range

• The base salary range for this position is: $102,800 to $128,500. This range is specifically for Cambridge, MA

Additional Perks:

• Work on a mission with real impact: crashes prevented, injuries avoided, lives protected around the world

• Join an industry leader — 65 million drivers protected, powering 140+ programs across 25 countries

• Recognized innovator in mobility AI, earning top honors including the TIME Industry Leader in AI, a Gold Edison Award, and the Artificial Intelligence Excellence Award for AI for Social Good. CMT is also Great Place to Work Certified

• Be part of the team inventing the future of mobility and road safety

• Move fast, own outcomes, do work that matters

• High ownership, small teams, and direct access to leadership — no layers between your work and its impact

• Unlimited PTO, flexible scheduling, competitive salary, annual performance bonus, RSUs, and full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401k match

• Summer Fridays provide team members with half days to recharge

• Join one of our employee resource groups: Black, AAPI, LGBTQIA+, Women, Book Club, and Health & Wellness

• Comprehensive wellness, education, and employee assistance programs

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

At CMT, we believe the best ideas come from a mix of backgrounds and perspectives.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a workplace and culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their unique talents and perspectives. Diversity is essential to our success, and we actively seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our growing team.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability state. CMT is headquartered in Cambridge, MA. To learn more, visit www.cmtelematics.com and follow us on Instagram @cmt.ai

About Cambridge Mobile Telematics:

Cambridge Mobile Telematics (CMT) is the world’s largest telematics and AI company for safer mobility. Its mission is to make the world’s roads and drivers safer. The company’s AI-driven platform, DriveWell Fusion®, proactively identifies and reduces driving risk, leading to fewer crashes and injuries. To date, CMT’s technology has helped prevent over 126,000 crashes worldwide. CMT enables partners to measure risk, detect crashes, provide life-saving assistance, and streamline claims. Headquartered in Cambridge, MA, CMT operates globally with offices in Budapest, Hungary; Chennai, India; Seattle, Washington; Tokyo, Japan; and Zagreb, Croatia. Learn more at www.cmt.ai.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management
jobs.description:
Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com.

In modern MarTech, enterprises are drowning in fragmented channel tools. A multi-location brand (with 500 or 5,000 locations) buys one vendor for reviews, another for SMS, a third for local social, and another for email. The result? A disjointed brand voice, operational gridlock, and marketing teams manually swivel-chairing between dashboards.

Our Consumer Experience (CX) Portfolio encompasses Reviews, Social, Email, SMS, Campaigns, and Compliance/Supervision.

Our thesis for the Consumer Experience portfolio is: A brand's verified facts (its Knowledge Graph) and its marketing messages must orchestrate across every consumer touchpoint as a single, coordinated motion with customer feedback closing the loop.

We are looking for a Sr. Director of Product Management to take six distinct channel products and forge them into a unified, AI-orchestrated execution engine.

What You'll Do

You will own the product strategy, execution, and commercial growth for the entire Consumer Experience surface area.

• Orchestrate the Unified Campaigns Engine: Transform Yext from a vendor selling siloed channel products into an indispensable platform where a campaign moment (a new location, a review trend, a local event) becomes coordinated execution across Email, SMS, Social, and Reviews. Build the "Campaigns" layer that makes that happen, powered by shared compliance rules and a single audience infrastructure.

• Close the Consumer Feedback Loop: Pioneer the data loop where inbound consumer signals (reviews, survey responses, social replies) are converted into structured Knowledge Graph data that immediately sharpens and adapts outbound messaging.

• Drive Commercial Expansion: Your success will be measured by transforming channel point-solutions into a cohesive platform that drives cross-sell and continues to lift Net Revenue Retention.

• Lead and Coach: Lead an existing team of Product Managers and grow the bench. Make AI-native work the default: PMs prototype and validate with working models, without waiting on a designer.

How You Will Operate: The Leadership Profile

This is not a role for a consensus-seeker or a passive roadmap administrator. We are screening for three distinct leadership attributes:

1. Visionary Product Architecture

You don't wait for executives or enterprise customers to hand you a feature list. You look at market chaos, synthesize customer pain, and identify the non-obvious architecture that solves the root problem. You can establish and execute on a vision for your portfolio that stays aligned to the company and product direction. You know when to fund shared infrastructure before the products that need it exist.

2. Radical Agency

You do not wait for permission to fix broken workflows, sunset dead features, or make the call when teams disagree. You operate like the GM of your portfolio: naming the constraint, deciding, and owning the outcome.

3. High-Conviction Opinions

You bring a clear point of view on where enterprise software and customer engagement are heading. You hold that view before the data exists. You change your mind for evidence, not seniority. When you lose an argument, you commit, say what you still disagree with, and bring it back when the facts change.

• Prioritization: You have the discipline to evaluate one-off feature requests critically, always protecting long-term platform scalability and cohesive user experience over short-term wins.

• Collaborative Rigor: You partner deeply with technical and commercial leadership to debate architecture and strategy. You hold strong convictions and update them when the evidence changes: new data, technical constraints, or shifting market realities.

What You Have

• Proven B2B SaaS Product Leader: You have managed and scaled multi-product B2B portfolios, ideally in MarTech, CRM, Customer Engagement, or Enterprise Data platforms.

• Systems Thinker: You understand relational data, APIs, and modern AI/LLM retrieval layers. You can design products that scale

• AI Product Judgment: You've shipped AI features into real workflows and designed for when they're wrong. You know what the model should not do.

• Player-Coach & Talent Magnet: You have managed PMs, elevated their craft, and instilled an obsession with speed, customer discovery, and rapid prototyping.

• Commercial Acumen: You understand packaging, pricing dynamics, and unit economics. You view product adoption through the lens of enterprise retention and expansion.

#LI-PV1

Pay ranges at Yext are established based on an analysis of salaries for positions with a similar level of accountability and impact in the relevant labor market. Salary levels are expected to change to reflect an employee’s job performance (results and impact) over time. Salaries at the time of hire are typically offered in the lower to middle of the above-referenced range in order to provide the opportunity to reflect performance-based increases over time. In addition to base salaries, employees at Yext are typically eligible for a comprehensive package of benefits including medical, dental and vision benefits; life insurance; short term and long-term disability; 401(k) retirement plan; and vacation and sick leave. Successful candidates may also be eligible for variable pay programs based on performance relative to goals and targets.

Annual Base Pay Range

$307,500—$485,500 USD

Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers.

It is Yext’s policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form.

Security Alert

All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. Instead, please report the communication to security@yext.com.

jobs.title: Senior Global Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll own compensation for a defined part of the business and be the person leaders come to when a pay decision is hard.

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You'll lead benchmarking projects end to end, run pay equity analyses, design and maintain salary bands, and advise HR Business Partners and managers on offers, promotions, and retention.

Main responsibilities:

• Lead market analysis. Own survey participation and run independent market analyses that inform pay range design and individual pay decisions

• Design pay structures. Build and maintain salary bands, equity bands, and variable pay structures that track company strategy as it changes

• Run pay equity reviews. Analyze pay equity, model remediation scenarios, and partner with People Analytics and Legal to close identified gaps

• Partner with the business. Act as the primary compensation contact for your client groups, advising on offers, promotions, internal moves, and retention cases

• Deliver compensation cycles. Lead operational delivery of merit, bonus, and equity cycles for your client groups, from planning through communication

• Model and plan scenarios. Build financial models that project compensation spend and quantify the impact of proposed program changes

• Interpret policy. Apply compensation policy consistently, exercise judgment on gray areas, and escalate genuine exceptions with a recommendation attached

WHO YOU ARE

• 5+ years of compensation experience in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment, including pricing new roles with no established benchmark

• Advanced Excel and Google Sheets modeling with large datasets, with an emphasis on dynamic, QA'd models

• Demonstrated market pricing and benchmarking experience using tools such as Radford, Pave or Mercer, including building and maintaining salary structures and equity bands

• Experience administering broad-based and variable or incentive compensation programs

• Fluency with AI tools and a bias toward automating analytical work

• Clear communication: you turn complex analysis into recommendations people can act on

• Sharp attention to detail, sound judgment with sensitive data, and strong ownership

• Experience with HRIS and compensation systems such as Workday

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $84,000 - $120,000/annually, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $96,300 - $130,000/annually (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

jobs.title: Copy of Full-Time Work Crew Supervisor
jobs.description:
Work Crew Site Supervisor

In Person at our Oakland CA office

The Opportunity

Anticipated deadline to submit application: Friday November 20, 2026 at 3:00pm (PST) Position may close early if application limit is met. Apply promptly for full consideration.

We’re looking for a Site Supervisor to help us live our mission to prepare people with recent criminal convictions for securing employment each year.

Site Supervisors support, supervise, and train work crews of 5-10 individuals, creating an uplifting work environment that ensures team member safety, providing on-the-job coaching, encouraging and empowering team members to seize each opportunity for building knowledge and skills, and balancing engagement and accountability across the crew.

This role is perfect for you if you enjoy a non-traditional workspace, like being on your feet, and love being outdoors.  Ideally, you have experience teaching, coaching, mentoring or motivating youth or groups of adults as we know you’ll be able to make a real impact in our participants’ lives.  You’ll help create greater stability for our participants as they get back on their feet.

Please note: Site Supervisor work hours are typically 7:00AM-3:30PM (M-F) with the work conducted outside in all weather conditions.  Weekly overtime is built into the role.

Who We Are

The Center for Employment Opportunities (CEO) provides employment services to people recently released from incarceration. Across the United States, 8,000-9,000 people participate in CEO each year, transitioning to employment that supports themselves, their families, and their communities.

What began as a demonstration project of the Vera Institute of Justice in the 1970s to address employment barriers facing the formerly incarcerated following release in New York City has grown into the leading reentry employment organization in the country, where over 30,000 formerly incarcerated individuals have secured full-time employment since 1996.

Who You Are

• You have strong organizational skills and can delegate, prioritize, and manage your team’s time effectively to meet project deadlines; you operate under pressure with ease

• You pride yourself in your ability to communicate and resolve conflicts effectively with individuals of varying backgrounds and experiences. You recognize the value of continuous communication, looping others into project status and any arising challenges

• You have a proven track record of leading teams to achieve success

• You enjoy supporting others to solve routine challenges; personally you’re mechanically inclined, able to diagnose issues with equipment and propose solutions to solve/address

• You’re deeply passionate about and committed to social justice

• You’re respectful, fair, and patient

• You believe in hard work, efficient and friendly customer service, and teamwork and collaboration to drive results

• You exercise compassion toward the team you’re leading and balance this with a straightforward approach that ensures you meet the needs of your customers

• You foster strong team spirit and enjoy providing 1:1 support to team members who may need a little extra encouragement

The Nitty Gritty Qualifications

• Valid driver’s license with good driving record

• Must be able to: Consistently lift and move objects up to 75 pounds; stand, kneel, bend, and climb in order to complete projects; work outdoors; walk or stand for long periods of time; drive a 12 passenger van with an attached trailer; operate a smartphone

• Previous safety training preferable, though training will be provided to hired candidate

Additional Responsibilities

Key responsibilities of the Site Supervisor include but are not limited to:

• Leading a work crew in public beautification projects: litter abatement, landscaping, and sometimes other projects.

• Comply with company time and attendance (T&A) processes, which includes ensuring that participants accurately record their work time, ensuring that participants receive any required rest breaks and meal periods, and timely reviewing and approving participant time records on a daily basis.

• Ensuring customers’ work orders are completed to a high standard on a daily basis

• Establishing and maintaining positive staff morale through modeling sound leadership and teamwork

• Assigning job duties to crew members and setting reasonable goals for completion

• Monitoring crew members on job performance and productivity, providing appropriate feedback and/or additional training as needed

• Maintaining line of sight of all participants

• Maintaining a safe, secure, and healthy work environment by following and enforcing standards and procedures and complying with legal regulations and by reporting any matters that threaten the smooth operation of the training crew to your supervisor

• Completing any necessary daily reporting tasks

• Special projects and related duties as assigned

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation for this position is $27.2528/hr. Daily overtime is possible with a rate of $40.8792/hr."

We recognize that salary is a part of the overall compensation package and also provide a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental coverage, as well as professional development opportunities and training, including regular training opportunities in Motivational Interviewing (MI). MI is one evidence-based skill that reentry and human service professionals can utilize when supporting participants to achieve their goals.

We also offer paid parental leave, participation in a retirement plan, sick and vacation leave, paid holidays and more. We are a workplace that promotes continual learning and teamwork, offering lunch and learns, team outings, holiday gatherings and more for our staff.

More About Us

Center for Employment Opportunities believes that everyone deserves the chance to shape a stronger future for themselves, their families, and their communities. People who are justice involved are highly encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels. CEO is committed to the CROWN Act, and creating an open space where our employees can present as their true authentic selves.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, gender, gender identity, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military status, prior record of arrest or conviction, citizenship status, current employment status, caregiver status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. We value diverse experiences, including with regard to educational background and justice system contact.

Please note that due to the volume of resumes received, we are unable to contact each applicant regarding the status of each position or reply to candidates' inquiries via phone or email.
