jobs.title: Behavioral Health Lead (LICSW)
jobs.description:
Over the past 30+ years, Rhode Island Primary Care Physician’s Corporation (RIPCPC) has grown to become the largest independent provider association of primary and pediatric care in the state, delivering exceptional care to over 200,000 Rhode Islanders. RIPCPC delivers support services that are essential to providing high quality, cost-effective medicine to patients, while also preserving community-based practices. In 2023, RIPCPC joined Akido Labs, becoming a key east coast hub for healthcare innovation within the Akido Care medical network.

Akido Care’s fast-growing medical network is known for its ability to integrate innovative technology into the healthcare infrastructure, relieving the frustrations felt by everyone involved in care delivery, from medical providers and their staff, to the patients and their families.

We're building a dynamic, diverse and driven team as we continue to grow and broaden our impact. We are seeking passionate people who care deeply about helping patients and communities. We hope you’ll join our team!

The Opportunity

RIPCMG is seeking an experienced Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW) to serve as its Behavioral Health Lead. This is a working clinical leader role. About 80–85% of the week is direct patient care, The remaining 15–20% is spent leading the RIPCPC Integrated Behavioral Health team of LCSW and LICSW clinicians, running the behavioral health program day to day, and serving as the organization’s point person for behavioral health regulatory and payor contract matters.

The Behavioral Health Lead practices in two modes. The first is longitudinal care: carrying a panel of patients who need ongoing psychotherapy. The second is integrated behavioral health: working inside the primary care team through warm handoffs, same-day consults, brief interventions, and the Collaborative Care Model (CoCM). The right candidate is comfortable moving between a scheduled therapy hour and a hallway handoff in the same afternoon, and knows how to decide which patients belong in which model.

Although employed by RIPCMG, the Behavioral Health Lead works across both organizations: practicing in the medical group, supervising the IPA’s behavioral health clinicians, and making sure behavioral health services meet state requirements and the terms of each health plan contract. This person will shape how behavioral health is built into a growing organization: the workflows, the referral criteria, the measurement, the team, and the contracts that pay for it. It is a chance to build a program, not just join one.

What you’ll do

• Carry a longitudinal panel of children, adolescents, and adults who need ongoing treatment, including diagnostic evaluation, treatment planning, and individual, family, and group psychotherapy using evidence-based approaches.

• Deliver integrated behavioral health in the primary care setting: accept warm handoffs, provide same-day consults and brief interventions, and help primary care clinicians manage behavioral health needs within the visit.

• Serve as behavioral health care manager for patients enrolled in Collaborative Care. Engage patients, administer validated measures (such as PHQ-9, GAD-7, and age-appropriate tools), track every patient in the registry, treat to target, and bring the caseload to weekly review with the psychiatric consultant.

• Communicate psychiatric consultant recommendations to the treating primary care clinician and follow through on changes to the care plan.

• Conduct suicide and safety risk assessments, develop safety plans, and coordinate with crisis resources such as BH Link, Kids’ Link RI, and mobile crisis services when needed.

• Coordinate referrals to higher levels of care and community services, and move patients between longitudinal therapy, brief intervention, and Collaborative Care as their needs change.

• Meet productivity expectations of [15-18] billable encounters per week plus an active Collaborative Care caseload of about [25–30] patients, adjusted for supervision load.

• Complete timely, compliant documentation for psychotherapy and Collaborative Care, including accurate time logs, so that minutes are never counted toward two services.

Team leadership and supervision

• Provide clinical supervision to the RIPCPC Integrated Behavioral Health team of LCSW and LICSW clinicians, including case consultation, documentation review, and oversight of high-risk cases.

• Provide licensure-track supervision to LCSWs working toward the LICSW, consistent with Rhode Island Board of Social Work Examiners requirements, and complete supervised-experience verification for the Board.

• Lead a weekly team huddle and caseload review. Assign new referrals by acuity and fit to longitudinal therapy, integrated care, or Collaborative Care.

• Provide clinical input on hiring, onboarding, training, coverage, and performance for RIPCPC clinicians, in partnership with RIPCPC leadership and Human Resources, which retain employment authority.

Program operations and quality

• Own behavioral health workflows across RIPCMG sites: referral intake, warm handoffs, Collaborative Care consent and enrollment, registry management, step-up and step-down criteria, and crisis response.

• Track and report access (time to first appointment), caseload, productivity, and outcomes, including PHQ-9 response and remission and HEDIS behavioral health measures such as depression screening and follow-up, depression remission or response, and follow-up after emergency department visits for mental illness.

• Partner with billing and compliance on payor coverage for psychotherapy and Collaborative Care services, documentation standards, and periodic chart audits.

• Educate primary care clinicians and staff on referral criteria, warm handoffs, and how to work with the behavioral health team.

• Represent behavioral health in RIPCMG and RIPCPC leadership meetings and with community partners.

Regulatory and payor contract lead

• Serve as the point person for behavioral health regulatory questions across RIPCMG and RIPCPC, including Rhode Island licensure and supervision rules, state Medicaid and health plan requirements, confidentiality rules for behavioral health and substance use records, and mental health parity.

• Track changes in federal and state behavioral health rules and payor policies, including coverage and billing rules for psychotherapy, Collaborative Care, and behavioral health integration services. Translate changes into workflow, documentation, and training updates.

• Serve as the behavioral health subject matter expert for payor contracting. Review proposed contract terms, fee schedules, and quality requirements for behavioral health services before signing, and flag operational or financial risks.

• Act as the named behavioral health contact for health plans on credentialing questions, behavioral health quality programs, delegated oversight, and audits. Prepare policies, evidence, and corrective action responses as needed.

• Partner with Credentialing to keep behavioral health clinicians enrolled with each payor, and confirm which services each license type can bill under each contract.

Who you are

Required

• Master of Social Work (MSW) from a program accredited by the Council on Social Work Education.

• Active, unrestricted Rhode Island LICSW license at time of hire.

• Five or more years of post-master’s clinical experience, including at least two years in integrated primary care, Collaborative Care, or another medical setting.

• Experience providing clinical supervision to licensed clinicians, and eligibility to provide licensure-track supervision under Rhode Island regulations.

• Working knowledge of behavioral health billing, payor coverage rules, and Rhode Island regulatory requirements for behavioral health services.

• Clinical experience treating children, adolescents, and adults.

• Skill in both brief, solution-focused interventions and longitudinal, evidence-based psychotherapy.

• Experience with measurement-based care, suicide risk assessment, and safety planning.

• Comfort with electronic health records, registries, and basic performance reporting.

Preferred

• Formal Collaborative Care training (for example, through the University of Washington AIMS Center) and experience as a behavioral health care manager in an operating CoCM program.

• Experience launching or expanding an integrated behavioral health or Collaborative Care program, including workflow design and billing setup.

• Pediatric and adolescent integrated behavioral health experience.

• Training in modalities such as CBT, TF-CBT, DBT, motivational interviewing, or parent-child interventions.

• Experience supporting payor contracting, credentialing, delegated audits, or regulatory compliance for behavioral health services.

• Working knowledge of the Rhode Island behavioral health system, including crisis services and Medicaid managed care.

• Bilingual English/Spanish.

Physical Demands: Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to thirty pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

Salary range

$105,000—$125,000 USD

Rhode Island Primary Care Physician’s Corporation (RIPCPC) is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

jobs.title: SMB Sales Development Representative - US-Based
jobs.description:
About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.
Job Summary:
As an SMB Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by opening new opportunities with small and midsize businesses and by bringing back clients who have gone quiet. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will work three motions: cold outreach to a prioritized list of companies with $5M to $300M in annual revenue, reactivation of dormant clients, and call backs to prospects who missed a scheduled Client Advisor call. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through outreach and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our SMB sales team. If you are a self motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.
Responsibilities:
The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Exercise discretion and independent judgment.
Sales: Understand current and future demand across the SMB and midmarket segments. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position Toptal with SMB clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal’s perspective on innovation and talent topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
Begin the Relationship: Through lead generation activities and cold calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales ready leads and opportunities from a prioritized list of companies with $5M to $300M in annual revenue. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
Reactivate and Recover: You will restart relationships that have gone quiet. When a dormant client has not restarted an engagement with its Account Manager, the account moves to the SDR pool, and you reach out, book the meeting, and bring the client back. You will also call back prospects who missed a scheduled Client Advisor call, starting 7 days after the missed call, and book a new meeting.
Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future SMB clients, you will build rapport through strategic outreach and a well rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team, SMB outbound Account Executives, Account Managers, and Client Advisors to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Account Executives close the opportunities you source, and Account Managers take over each account once the engagement starts. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal. As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.
In the first week, expect to:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
Work with cross functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on companies of every size, from fast growing SMBs to the world’s largest enterprises.
Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal.
Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.
In the first month, expect to:
Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role play scenarios.
Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and our outreach and productivity tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Nooks, and Claude).
Integrate into your pod, partner with SMB outbound Account Executives, Account Managers, and Client Advisors, and begin working your prioritized account list.
Learn the process for each motion: new business outreach, dormant client reactivation, and missed call follow up. Implement an outreach process and hit your first month objectives.
Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.
In the first three months, expect to:
Complete your ramp on the SDR team and attain your metrics, which include calls, emails, Sales Accepted Leads (SALs), and pipeline created.
Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within target accounts, dormant clients, and missed call leads that result in revenue generating engagements for Toptal.
Hit activity, SAL, and pipeline objectives.
Become proficient in using our sales tools.
Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.
In the first six months, expect to:
Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
Build new and existing client relationships, bring dormant clients back, and continue to execute account plans.
Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.
In the first year, expect to:
Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the prioritized account list, alongside clients brought back through reactivation and missed call follow up.
Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.
Qualifications and Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree is required.
1 to 3 years of experience as an SDR or outbound Account Executive in SMB or midmarket sales.
Knowledgeable. Broad understanding of business challenges encountered by small and midsize businesses.
Critical thinking. Critically think through the challenges clients face to create new opportunities from target accounts, dormant clients, and missed call leads.
Perseverance. Be relentless and push towards your goal.
Passion. Enthusiasm and ambition to succeed in this role, as it can be difficult if you hate rejection.
Curiosity. A desire to understand people, their problems, their companies, and their industries.
Conscientiousness. We’re not doing a simple SaaS sale, so discussions may get technical. Understanding sophisticated issues and explaining them to clients is important.
Motivated. Be highly motivated and continuously strive for personal and professional improvement.
Resourceful. Think about target accounts as your own business. We want self starters who are passionate about hunting for new accounts, and who thrive with the freedom and accountability of leading their portion of the business.
Proactive. Understand our mission and do the work required to drive us to that goal, by following a process and being creative.
Urgency. SMB deals move fast. You follow up quickly on every lead, reactivation, and missed call.
Communication. You must exhibit outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Communication is the lifeblood of both internal and external relationships. Demonstrate excellent communication in all forms, across a wide variety of personality types, roles, and geographies.
Team. Nothing we do is done in isolation. Success depends on your ability to work as a team both within Toptal and within your client accounts.
Ownership. Exhibit ownership of accounts, successes, and failures.
Problem Solver. Life throws in minor challenges beyond the primary problems this role is meant to solve. You must have the ability to take those in stride and persist despite setbacks.
Prioritization. The nature of this role requires that you understand the priorities and timelines associated with each of your accounts and execute appropriately with those in mind.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
Essential Job Functions
Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
Work independently with minimal supervision.
Use all required digital collaboration tools.
Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.
US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt
This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on sales development results. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

jobs.title: PT Key Holder: Fillmore
jobs.description:
Who We Are

For too long, the bra industry was stuck in outdated ideas, forcing women to choose between feeling sexy or comfortable. So in 2013, Heidi Zak and Ra’el Cohen created Thirdlove–a third, better option designed to help women look and feel their best.

Prioritizing real-world fit over outdated standards, Thirdlove disrupted the industry by inventing half-cup sizes and the Fitting Room® quiz. The result was a more precise fit that offered comfort without sacrificing style. As our next step in innovating the bra industry, Thirdlove is expanding our retail stores nationwide, giving customers a place to get fitted in a comfortable, welcoming environment and feel supported by our team while they shop.

How We Work

Our culture is inclusive, collaborative, fast-paced, and customer-focused. If you care about helping customers feel confident and comfortable, we encourage you to apply.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a Part Time Key holder to operate as the frontline leader responsible for delivering the Thirdlove in-store experience while supporting the Store Manager and Assistant Store Manager with opening/closing responsibilities and daily operations.

This role serves as a mentor on the floor, modeling service behaviors, supporting team accountability, and ensuring smooth execution across sales, fitting, and client engagement. The Key Holder brings strong emotional intelligence, product knowledge, and operational awareness to every shift, helping the team deliver results while staying true to Thirdlove’s values of body confidence and inclusion.

What You Will Own And How You Will Make A Difference

Client Experience & Selling

• Deliver a warm, welcoming, and personalized fitting and shopping experience in line with the Retail Excellence Protocol.

• Support fit consultations, product education, and conversion through proactive, client-focused behaviors.

• Assist team members during shifts to refine selling language, service posture, and product confidence.

Leadership & Daily Execution

• Support daily zoning and break schedules to ensure optimal floor coverage and client support.

• Identify and escalate guest issues, operational concerns, or team coaching moments to ASM/Store Manager when needed.

Operations & Store Standards

• Execute opening and closing responsibilities, including POS reconciliation, security checks, restocking, and store readiness.

• Support inventory tasks such as processing shipment, cycle counts, and damages as assigned.

• Ensure promotional signage, floor moves, and merchandising standards are accurately maintained.

Who You Are and What You Have

• 1–2 years of retail experience, preferably in a leadership or elevated associate role

ThirdLove Offers You

Diversity

ThirdLove is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at the company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetics, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

ThirdLove is an E-Verify employer and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. For more information please visit E-Verify.

$21.50 per hour

jobs.title: Chaplain |As Needed
jobs.description:
Bethesda Brings out the Best in Talented, Caring People!

At Bethesda, more than 1,200 employees dedicate their careers to improving the lives of others.

As a team member at Bethesda, you'll enjoy great benefits such as: 403b, daily pay, bonuses, career advancement opportunities, and holiday pay.

Medical, dental, vision, prescription, and life insurance available for regular status full and part time employees.

Summary

The Chaplain is responsible for all activities of the spiritual services program and the delivery of spiritual services to patients/families.  Provide direct spiritual support and/or counsel to patients/families in keeping with their beliefs.  Work with staff, clergy, and community groups to enhance their sensitivity to the spiritual concerns of patients/families experiencing terminal illness and loss.  Participate in patient care plan meetings by exploring and assessing the potential spiritual needs of patients/families and reporting on services as indicated.  Participates in the admissions process by performing informational visits with patients and families and assisting with legal contract signing.  Maintain proper records of visits to patients/families as per policy and regulation.  Maintain contact with clergy or appropriate representatives of patients/families as indicated. Develop and maintain a resource group of clergy to whom specific aspects of spiritual care may be delegated and arrange on-call availability of chaplain services.  Participate in the Support Services on call rotation to meet the needs of Hospice patients 24 hours a day.  Perform occasional liturgical assignments such as the annual Service of Remembrance and monthly memorial services with staff.  Provide educational programs for community clergy, religious and lay representatives as requested for outreach or educational purposes.  Conduct or make arrangements for funeral or memorial services when requested.  Provide bereavement follow-up services as defined by established procedures.  May be assigned other duties as appropriate.

Job Qualifications

• Graduate of accredited seminary or school of theology or appropriate certification in hospital or pastoral ministry

• Master's degree preferred

• Must meet state requirements

• One-year experience in hospice preferred

• Expertise with both written and oral communications, documentation requirements, and program management

• Ability to be open, sensitive, flexible, and ecumenical

jobs.title: Sr Buyer
jobs.description:
Summary

Coordinates activities involved with procuring, tracking, and expediting goods and services such as raw materials, equipment, tools, parts and supplies.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Confers with suppliers to obtain product or service information such as lead time, price, availability, and delivery schedule.

• Negotiates or renegotiates price, schedule, terms & conditions, etc. and administers contracts with suppliers and other supply chain representatives.

• Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish job tasks and goals associated with supply chain procurement and management.

• Negotiates and manages specialty and high value contracts with limited supervision.

• Estimates values according to knowledge of aerospace market price and determines method of procurement such as direct purchase or bid.

• Analyzes supplier proposals, financial reports and other data and information to determine reasonable prices and prepares purchase orders or bid requests.

• Reviews bid proposals and negotiates contracts within budgetary limitations and scope of authority.

• Monitors design, development and production of complex monuments, assemblies, production articles and parts to ensure they are built per drawing specifications and meet all quality standards.

• Maintains procurement records such as items or services purchased, costs, delivery, product quality or performance and inventories.

• Maintains and reviews computerized records of items purchased, costs, delivery, product performance and inventories.

• Discusses defective or unacceptable goods or services with inspection or quality control personnel, users, suppliers, and others to determine source of trouble and take corrective action.

• Arbitrates claims and resolves complaints generated during performance of contract.

• Approves invoices for payment and expedites delivery of goods to users.

• Maintains regular attendance including being at work, being on time to work and working full shifts.

• Other duties as assigned.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Greenpoint Core Competencies

• Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and accepts constructive criticism/feedback and changes approach or method to best fit the situation.

• Communications - Expresses ideas and thoughts effectively in verbal and written form, exhibits good listening and comprehension, keeps others informed and uses appropriate communication methods.

• Dependability - Responds to requests for service and assistance, follows instruction and responds to management direction, takes responsibility for own actions and doing the best job possible, keeps commitments, and maintains reliable attendance.

• Initiative - Sets and achieves challenging goals, demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles, measures self against standard of excellence, recognizes and acts on opportunities, and takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.

• Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities, exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, gives and welcomes feedback, contributes to building a positive team spirit, and puts success of team above own interests.

• Work Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, displays commitment to excellence, looks for ways to improve and promote quality, applies feedback to improve performance, and monitors own work to ensure quality.

Job Core Competencies

• Cost Consciousness – Works within approved budget, develops and implements cost saving measures, contributes to profits and revenue, conserves organizational resources.

• Judgment – Displays willingness to make decisions, exhibits sound and accurate judgment, supports and explains reasoning for decisions, includes appropriate people in decision-making process, and makes timely decisions.

• Negotiation Skills – You clarify interests and positions of all parties and adjust tactics to achieve desired results; you manage conflict, manipulation, and strong emotions; and you develop alternative options for mutual gain while building consensus through give-and-take.

• Problem Solving-Identifies problems in a timely manner, gathers and analyzes information skillfully, develops alternative solutions, resolves problems in early stages, works well in group problem solving situations.

Summary of Education, Experience & Certification

Bachelor’s degree and 5-7 years’ experience purchasing various aerospace commodities; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience with the procurement of raw materials, parts, and commodities related to VIP aircraft interiors.  Aerospace experience required.

Employees working on programs subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations must qualify as a US Person which is defined as a US Citizen, a Permanent Resident who does not work for a foreign company/foreign government/foreign governmental agency or organization, or a political asylee for legal compliance purposes.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Proven ability to develop and maintain relationships with internal and external customers.

• Proven ability to negotiate prices.

• Ability to work well independently and cross-functionally as part of an established and growing team.

• Strong communication, time management and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

• Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and materials specifications is required.

• Demonstrated experience with MS Office, MS Outlook, MS Dynamics AX, order processing systems such as MRP or ERP

• Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions and percentages.

• Ability to sit for extended periods of time, use hands to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and have close/color vision ability to adjust focus.

• Ability to travel as required.

• Ability to work outside of core business hours as required.

The expected WA salary range for this position is between $80,168.00 - $103,000.00 USD. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, education, location, and other factors permitted by law.

About Greenpoint Technologies
Greenpoint delivers nose-to-tail VIP Jet aircraft interiors for private clients and Heads-of-State.  We are proud to be known in the aerospace industry for our design and engineering innovation, award-winning company culture, and on-time delivery of our beautiful products. We use leading-edge tools and employee-built processes to deliver extraordinary, one-of-a-kind custom aircraft interiors.  It’s complex work, but we work smart.  In return for hard work, collaboration, and creativity, our people experience a culture custom built for high achievers:

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations, GTM
jobs.description:
Behind many of life’s most important transactions like buying a house, applying for a mortgage, getting a small business loan, or refinancing a credit card, is a network of credit relationships. Setpoint provides critical infrastructure for relationships between the world’s largest banks, credit funds and capital markets counterparties. Because when capital works together, ambition goes further.

Strategy & Operations, GTM

Location: New York, New York | Hybrid (Tuesdays/Thursdays)

About the role

Behind many of life’s most important transactions like buying a house, applying for a mortgage, getting a small business loan, or refinancing a credit card, is a network of credit relationships. Setpoint provides critical infrastructure for relationships between the world’s largest banks, credit funds and capital markets counterparties. Because when capital works together, ambition goes further.

About the role

We are looking for a Strategy & Operations, GTM hire to join our team. This role sits at the intersection of sales, operations, and AI. Today, much of what happens in our deals lives in email threads, Slack channels, and call recordings, and only part of it reaches HubSpot through manual rep updates. You will build the company intelligence layer that captures all of it, and the AI agents on top of it that keep our CRM current, surface insights for leadership, and give reps their time back to sell.

Who will love this job

• An AI builder – you reach for Claude, GPT, and automation tools first, and you have built workflows, agents, or internal tools that people use every day

• A systems thinker – you see the CRM, inboxes, Slack, and call recordings as one data set and want to connect them

• A data-driven strategist – you use metrics to shape sales process and go-to-market strategy, not only to report on them

• An owner – you find the manual, low-value work that slows reps down and remove it without being asked

• A strong collaborator – you work across sales, marketing, product, and finance, and can explain technical work to a non-technical audience

What you’ll do

• Company Intelligence Layer - Design and build an always-on intelligence ecosystem that captures what happens across email, Slack, and call recordings and connects it to HubSpot, so the full history of every account and deal lives in one place instead of in reps' inboxes and memories

• AI Agents for the Sales Team - Build and maintain agents on top of that data that do work on reps' behalf: monitoring calls, updating projected close dates, deal stages, and product mix in HubSpot, flagging at-risk deals, and drafting follow-ups

• Systems & Data Integrity - Own HubSpot (our CRM) end to end. Move the CRM from rep-entered data to system-maintained data, with clear field definitions, automated hygiene, and an audit trail so leadership can trust what it sees

• Reporting & Forecasting - Partner with sales leadership on pipeline management, quarter-end close, and the forecast that feeds financial planning, executive, and board materials. Build dashboards and reports that give visibility into key sales metrics

• GTM Strategy & Analysis - Analyze performance across the sales process, pricing, product mix, and ideal customer profile, and turn the findings into recommendations for leadership

• Account Management - Manage account distribution so reps keep a healthy pipeline, equitable account assignments, and a balanced mix of core ICP and experimental accounts. Use AI-driven enrichment to fill account data gaps that support qualification

• Enablement & Cross-Functional Collaboration - Roll out new tools and processes to the sales team with clear guides and training, and work with marketing, finance, product, and implementation to keep systems and processes aligned

You should have

• 4-6+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a related role (ex. Business Operations, GTM Strategy)

• Hands-on HubSpot experience (required), including workflows, custom properties, integrations, and reporting

• A track record of building with AI: you have shipped workflows, agents, or internal tools using Claude, GPT, or similar models, and can walk us through what you built

• Experience working with unstructured data such as call transcripts, email, and chat, and turning it into structured fields a system can act on

• Strong analytical skills, with experience modeling sales data, reporting, and forecasting

• Comfort with APIs, SQL, and scripting in Python or JavaScript; experience with automation platforms (ex. n8n, Zapier, Make) or agent frameworks is a plus

• Ability to manage multiple projects and work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is preferred

New York Only:

Compensation: $130,000 - $150,000 OTE, dependent on multiple factors, which may include the successful candidate's skills, experience, and other qualifications.

About Setpoint

Setpoint is the new operating standard for asset-backed finance. Our collaborative, AI-native platform brings capital providers and borrowers together around the same verified information: extracting and verifying asset and servicer data, automating reporting and compliance, and surfacing risk and opportunity in real time. Leading institutions use Setpoint to strengthen oversight, reduce risk, and make better decisions across $550B+ in financed assets.

In August 2024, Setpoint announced the successful completion of its $31 million Series B funding round. 645 Ventures led the round, with significant strategic investments from Citi and Wells Fargo, alongside Andreessen Horowitz, NextView Ventures, Floating Point, Henry Kravis, Zillow founder’s 75 & Sunny, Vesta Ventures, Fifth Wall, Eltura Ventures, and Outrunner Capital.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Accounting
jobs.description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Posting Open Date: 11/10/26

Anticipated Posting Close Date*: 1/1/26

*Job posting may close early due to the volume of applicants.

Senior Manager, Accounting

Fastly’s Accounting team is looking for an impact-driven Senior Manager, Accounting with a strong public company background to help shape how we close, consolidate, and scale our Controllership organization. Reporting to the Assistant Corporate Controller, you will lead and mentor a high-performing team responsible for orchestrating the consolidated US GAAP month-end close and overseeing critical operational accounting areas—including operating expenses, sales commissions, cash and investments, and network infrastructure assets.

This is a high-impact role for an experienced accounting leader who pairs deep technical and operational acumen with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business insights. The ideal candidate leads with strong operational instincts and brings a proven track record in close orchestration, team mentorship, workflow automation, and cross-functional partnership across a global organization.

What You'll Do:

• Leadership & Team Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of accounting professionals, setting clear operational priorities, balancing close workloads, and fostering professional growth.

• Close Management: Direct the end-to-end monthly and quarterly close cadence for Fastly’s primary consolidated US GAAP reporting—governing the close calendar, checklists, recurring allocations, journal entry workflows in compliance with SOX and internal accounting policies.

• Network Infrastructure & Fixed Assets Governance: Provide strategic oversight for global network hardware and capital assets—to govern capitalization thresholds, multi-location CIP-to-in-service timing, and ASC 360 impairment/disposal evaluations alongside our Global Network Infrastructure and FP&A leaders.

• Operating Expenses & FP&A Alignment: Direct end-to-end OpEx accounting workflows—partnering closely with FP&A and business leaders to evaluate spend trends, validate complex vendor accruals, anticipate variance drivers, and deliver complete, accurate monthly reporting.

• Commissions Accounting: Supervise the accounting, policy application, and monthly amortization models for deferred contract acquisition costs in close coordination with the Commissions team and FP&A.

• Cash, Investments & Treasury Accounting: Direct timely and accurate domestic and global operating cash reconciliations and corporate investment portfolio accounting (ASC 320 / ASC 820), verifying valuation accuracy, interest accruals, and balance sheet classifications.

• Balance Sheet Governance & Executive Flux Analysis: Safeguard general ledger integrity and chart of accounts hygiene; review complex reconciliations and deliver executive-ready balance sheet and P&L flux commentaries that effectively articulate core business drivers to leadership.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as a trusted advisor to Global Network Infrastructure, FP&A and other business leaders—aligning emerging commercial initiatives with US GAAP standards and supporting key strategic financial decisions.

• Audit Readiness & SOX Compliance: Lead coordination with internal and external audit teams, maintaining an audit-ready posture, championing internal control design, and ensuring timely resolution of technical inquiries.

• Process & Systems Optimization: Champion close acceleration and scalability by identifying automation opportunities, refining NetSuite workflows, and adopting modern controllership tools to eliminate manual spreadsheet dependencies.

What We're Looking For:

• Experience: 8–10+ years of progressive accounting experience in public accounting and/or high-growth public technology companies, including 3+ years of direct people management.

• Education & Credentials: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; active CPA license preferred.

• Close Leadership & Systems Acumen: Proven experience managing complex multi-entity closes and workflow automation within NetSuite ERP (or equivalent tier-one ERP systems).

• Cross-Functional Influence: Demonstrated track record building collaborative, high-trust partnerships with Supply Chain, Infrastructure Engineering, FP&A, and executive stakeholders.

• Technical Rigor: Deep working knowledge of US GAAP and SOX internal controls, with demonstrated strength across ASC 340-40, ASC 360, ASC 320/820, and operational expense accrual governance.

• Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex accounting matters, variance analyses, and operational trade-offs into crisp, decision-ready insights for senior leadership.

• Growth & Scaling Mindset: A proactive builder who thrives in dynamic environments, with a passion for designing scalable processes and mentoring team members.

We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

• Practical experience identifying and deploying automated workflows or AI tools that have accelerated close velocity and eliminated manual review.

• Hands-on leadership overseeing high-volume network infrastructure and hardware assets using NetSuite’s Fixed Assets Management (FAM) module.

• Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology company

Work Hours: This position will require you to be available during core business hours.

Work Location(s) & Travel Requirements:

The preferred location for this position is San Francisco Bay Area, CA.

Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home.

There is a strong preference for Hybrid near a local office.  However, we may be willing to consider remote candidates within the US.

jobs.title: Provider Onboarding Coordinator (Credentialing)
jobs.description:

We’re hiring a full-time remote Provider Onboarding Coordinator (Credentialing) to support onboarding aspects of provider credentialing at Sailor Health.  - Sound judgment on urgency and ownership. You know when something is a drop-everything issue versus one that can wait a few hours, and you know what's yours to solve versus what you should escalate.

WHY SAILOR HEALTH

If this sounds like you, we’d love to connect. Join us in redefining what it means to age with dignity, connection, and mental wellness.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Cambium is a modern American wood manufacturer, distributor, and technology company connecting and modernizing the wood economy. We work with architects, builders, and leading brands across the built environment, including Amazon, Room & Board, and Equinox. Our work has been recognized by Time's Best Inventions and Fast Company's Innovation by Design Awards. Technology is how we match supply to demand across a fragmented industry.

The American hardwood industry has lost more than half its sawmills in the last two decades. Quality trees go to waste, and the US imports more lumber than it produces, even though domestic capacity could meet nearly all of our needs. Until now, this industry forced a choice: local relationships or national scale, meaningful materials or modern efficiency. We don't think those are real tradeoffs. We're building the infrastructure to prove it, with modern software, better supply chains, and a clear view of what comes next: a wood economy that's local, efficient, and built to last.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Mass Timber movement is a fast-growing trend in construction that builds offices, schools, and warehouses from wood instead of steel and concrete. Operators in Mass Timber place a high value on responsibly sourced wood, and that’s why several Fortune 100 companies are already buying their wood from Cambium.

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the software we use to validate and visualize sustainable sourcing practices. You’ll collaborate with our go-to-market team to unlock product-market fit and turn software into a major growth lever for the Mass Timber business unit.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the product roadmap for the Mass Timber business unit.

 - Run lots of discovery. The most important part of your job is defining the problems we need to solve and uncovering the right solutions. You’ll partner with Design and Engineering to interview, experiment, ship, and iterate.

 - Become a domain expert. Your goal should be to be able to answer questions about Mass Timber from anyone in the business.

 - Drive a steady release drumbeat. We believe learning fast requires shipping fast. The Technical Program Manager owns delivery, and you’ll work closely with them to make sure their sprint map matches your roadmap.

 - Organize and run impactful meetings. These will be with your partners in Engineering and Design, as well as with stakeholders from across the business. Meetings are expensive, so you should take the care to plan them deliberately.

 - Spend time with the data. You’ll need to deeply understand the supply chain data we’ve already collected, and build the repeatable process by which we collect more.
   
   


YOU MAY ENJOY THIS ROLE IF…

 - You like discovery. This is where we are counting on you the most. You need to be obsessed with talking to customers, relentless about figuring out what problems to solve, and ruthlessly skeptical about whether your solutions are good enough.

 - You like working closely with engineering and design. We believe strongly in empowering our engineers and designers with context, and solving problems collaboratively. Your teammates should be helping shape your PRDs from the first draft.

 - You like defining your own surface area. We don’t know exactly what platform slices you need to own to be successful. You’ll need to help us figure that out, and you’ll need to be flexible as the business needs change over time.

 - You like working on go-to-market strategy. Some PM jobs don’t involve working with Sales. This isn’t one of them; Sales will depend on you to help figure out how to bring your product to market.

 - You believe in “strong opinions, loosely held.” Our team works through problems with lively discussion, and we encourage disagreement. We don’t care who is right; we care about finding the right answer.
   
   


YOU MAY NOT ENJOY THIS ROLE IF…

 - You like writing highly prescriptive specs and tickets. Your engineering teammates are counting on you to provide context and define outcomes, not to pre-solve every edge case.

 - You want to run Agile rituals. That job lives with our Technical Program Manager.

 - You prefer working on established products. You won’t be handed a blank slate, but you also won’t be getting a thriving userbase. There’s a lot of whitespace you need to fill.

 - You prefer working with technical audiences. We’re a lumber company. Outside of the product and engineering teams, most of your coworkers don’t have a background in the software industry. They won’t know your jargon or use your frameworks; you’ll need to learn theirs.
   
   


MUST HAVES

 - 5+ years of product management experience

 - Experience working on products targeted at large, non-technical enterprise customers

 - Experience working on data-heavy products

 - Excellent writing skills (we’ll ask to see some examples)
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience working closely with Sales or a go-to-market team

 - 0-1 or 1-10 product experience

 - Experience in physical products, construction, or building materials

 - Experience at a startup

 - Demonstrable integration of AI into your day-to-day workflows

 - A sense of humor (our team jokes around relentlessly)
   


THE DETAILS

 - Reports to: Aaron LeClair, Interim CTO

 - When: We're looking to fill this role immediately

 - Where: San Francisco, 3x/week in our beautiful Presidio office!

 - Travel: Approximately once per quarter
   


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Equity options package

 - Unlimited PTO and a flexible schedule

 - 401k matching

 - Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance

 - A smart, diverse team driven by a climate mission

 - An opportunity to play a core role in defining a fast-growing company

 - Volunteer tree planting days

Cambium is committed to building an inclusive organization that reflects the diverse communities our team works to serve. We believe that diversity in all its forms (gender, race, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, veteran's status, disability and more) is essential to imagining and actively building a more just and sustainable future for all. We hope you feel welcome here. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, RF and Technical Surveillance Countermeasures
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Part of that footprint is the radio spectrum around and inside each site: what transmits there, what listens there, and what the equipment itself gives off. You'll be the engineer who owns that domain end to end: on-site RF monitoring and detection, technical surveillance countermeasures (TSCM) and emanations security, from the threat basis through the systems that make the spectrum observable, to sign-off before a site opens.

The engineering is in the monitoring and in the tooling that proves the controls hold: the sensors, receivers and their placement, the site baselines, and the detection logic that turns a rogue transmitter or an unexpected emitter into an alert an analyst trusts. External specialist partners do the hands-on sweep and measurement work; you write the scope, direct them on site and decide whether their report stands. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, sensor health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations, construction and legal teams, and directly with site operators and landlords. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure.

Key responsibilities

• On-site RF monitoring and detection: design and develop the monitoring at each site: sensor, receiver and antenna selection and placement, the spectrum monitoring architecture, site RF baselines and what keeps them current, and detections that reach the team's security monitoring platform as alerts analysts keep trusting

• Tools, automation and AI agents: build the detection and classification tooling, the instruments and software for checks between sweeps, the findings and evidence records behind them, and the agents that triage alerts and watch sensor health. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it

• Technical surveillance countermeasures: own TSCM end to end: sweep cadence by space sensitivity, event-driven triggers such as fit-out, room turnover or an incident, scope and acceptance criteria per sweep, and findings handled with evidence and closure an assessor accepts

• Emanations security: set the posture for sites: the assessment method, zoning and separation, and shielding, filtering and protected cabling where warranted, written into the team's design and build standards so a site can build to them and an assessor can verify them

• Wireless and device policy by zone: detect which radios are actually present where (cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, IoT, trunked radio) and produce the evidence that the policy holds on the floor

• Specialist partners: write the scope and the deliverable standard for sweep and assessment work, direct it on site, and decide in the acceptance review whether a report stands

• New sites and leases: carry RF and emanations requirements into design reviews, lease terms and pre-opening reviews, and sign off RF and emanations, including the pre-opening sweep and assessment, before a site opens

Minimum qualifications

• Have built at least one RF monitoring or detection system end to end, from receiver and antenna choice through the software that turns captures into alerts

• Understand RF at the engineering level: propagation, modulation, spectrum analysis and antenna behavior, with hands-on use of the instruments that measure them, such as spectrum analyzers and software-defined radios

• Have planned and conducted TSCM sweeps yourself and can explain, from having done the work, what a sweep can and cannot find and how an adversary would get past it

• Have done RF security, TSCM or emanations work hands-on for data centers, critical infrastructure or a large hardware fleet

• Read and review code, design the data systems behind detection and monitoring tooling, and build automation (often with AI coding agents) using Git and code review

• Understand compromising emanations and what zoning, shielding and filtering each buy and cost, and write requirements for them that a construction team or a landlord can build to and an assessor can test

• Direct a specialist vendor without deferring to them: write the scope, check the work, reject a weak report

Preferred qualifications

• Experience assessing compromising emanations and shielding or filtering tradeoffs in a live facility, and applying a formal emanations or counter-surveillance standard, government or commercial (TEMPEST, ICD 705 style construction requirements, or a corporate equivalent)

• Have built signal classification or spectrum analysis pipelines at scale, or tuned RF detections for a security operations workflow so operators kept trusting them

• Familiarity with airspace or drone RF detection, and with where it stops and on-site monitoring starts

• Experience at sites you did not fully control: colocation or multi-tenant facilities, where the RF environment and the walls are not yours alone

• Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual security work

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
ABOUT E2B

E2B is a fast-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 8-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As E2B’s first engineer responsible for Trust & Safety, you’ll own and develop systems that protect our platform and customers from fraud and abuse. Your work will span payment fraud, account abuse, and misuse of compute resources, performing investigations and building detections using automation to respond.

You’ll have room to shape how we approach trust and safety as the platform grows. This is a hands-on role that combines data analysis, security investigations, and engineering. You’ll turn investigation findings into stronger detections, tools, and response processes while adapting to new patterns of abuse.

Responsibilities include:

 - Build and improve detections for payment fraud, account abuse, and misuse of free credits.

 - Investigate third-party abuse reports, evaluate the evidence, and take appropriate action.

 - Analyze logs, query data, and connect activity across systems to understand patterns of abuse.

 - Build tools and automation that help us detect, investigate, and mitigate abuse more effectively.

 - Shape our trust and safety policies and response processes, balancing effective enforcement with the needs of legitimate customers.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience in trust and safety, abuse prevention, or risk with a security focus, including hands-on investigation and mitigation.

 - Strong analytical skills and the ability to work with logs, query data, and reason through ambiguous activity.

 - The engineering ability to turn investigations into practical detections, tools, and automation. We use Go, but prior Go experience isn’t required.

 - An understanding of malicious traffic and attacks, with the judgment to evaluate abuse reports and decide how to respond.

 - Experience owning problems from investigation through implementation, with the independence to build an approach as well as operate it.


BONUS POINTS FOR:

 - Experience building abuse prevention systems at a startup or growing technology company.

 - Experience handling fraud or abuse on a cloud infrastructure or self-service platform.




WHAT IT’S LIKE TO WORK AT E2B

We’re a fast-growing startup with in-person (4 days on-site, 1 day WFH) offices in San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic. jobs.title: Strategic Operator
jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co http://Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co http://Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co http://Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co http://Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Vibe is a streaming TV advertising platform, and our biggest projects now touch every team in the company, plus teams at our largest partners. As a Strategic Operator on our Strategic Initiatives team, you’ll own delivery on those cross-functional projects and launch new revenue initiatives from zero to one, reporting to our VP of Strategic Initiatives. Right now, these projects have no single owner tracking delivery, sizing the impact when a team slips, and escalating to unblock, so that’s where you come in. You’ll co-own high-stakes work side by side with our executive team, take new ideas from first test to a working process, and have a real path to grow into leading a team.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Drive cross-functional projects

 - Own delivery on company-wide projects that span every team at Vibe and our largest partners

 - Coordinate product and GTM teams to keep shared projects on schedule

 - Track progress across every workstream so issues surface before they cascade

 - Size the business impact of slippage to guide re-prioritization across teams

 - Escalate blockers to the executive team with a clear recommendation

Launch 0→1 revenue initiatives

WHAT YOU NEED

 - A track record of owning cross-functional projects A to Z, hands-on: coordinating teams, sizing the impact of slippage, re-prioritizing, and escalating to unblock

 - Experience leading a 0→1 initiative tied to revenue, including building the process or team behind it

 - Experience moving projects forward with people who didn’t report to you, including executives, without needing to be the face of it

 - Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work, with the ability to explain how they change your output


NICE TO HAVES

 - A background in strategy consulting, as long as you’ve also operated hands-on in a fast-moving company since

 - Experience in streaming TV advertising, connected TV (CTV), or martech, so you can get up to speed on our business fast

 - Working proficiency in French, helpful for working day to day with our Paris-based leaders and teams


OUR VALUES

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.


WHAT WE OFFER

For candidates in New York, NY, the pay range for this role is $120,000–$230,000.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

 - Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

 - Full health coverage — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

 - 401(k) with matching — We invest in your future, not just your output.

 - Flex PTO — Take the time you need. We measure results, not hours.

 - Parental leave — Paid leave for all parents.

 - Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

 1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We’ll share context; you’ll share yours.

 2. Manager interview — Meet the person you’d work with directly.

 3. Take-home assignment + live debrief — A real problem, not a trick. We’ll work through it together.

 4. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we’re holding a consistent, high bar.

 5. Offer — Fast. We don’t let good decisions sit.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, Intercompany & Consolidation
jobs.description:
About Triumph

Triumph operates a digital platform for physical collectibles and an arcade-style mobile gaming business. Our flagship app ranks among the top in the gaming category on the App Store, with hundreds of thousands of monthly active users and hundreds of millions of games played. Money moves through the business at real scale: billions of dollars in volume each year, across multiple banks and payment processors.

Position Overview

We're hiring a Senior Accountant to own intercompany accounting and consolidation across Triumph's legal entities. You'll run the full intercompany cycle, from recording and reconciliation through eliminations and settlement, and serve as the business owner for intercompany accounting in NetSuite. You'll work closely with Accounting Operations, Technical Accounting, Tax, Treasury, and Financial Systems, and you'll play a central role in building scalable consolidation infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

 - Intercompany accounting. Own the full intercompany cycle across all legal entities, including management fees, transfer pricing, capital injections, cost allocations, loans, royalties, and transfers of inventory, fixed assets, and services:

 - Record transactions at approved transfer prices and agreed terms, with both sides booked consistently.

 - Reconcile balances monthly and resolve mismatches before close.

 - Prepare elimination entries, including unrealized profit on inventory and asset transfers, and enforce period-end cut-off across counterparties.

 - Coordinate intercompany settlements and netting with Treasury, and manage FX revaluation of intercompany balances.

 - Maintain intercompany agreements, charge schedules, and supporting documentation for every balance.

 - Policies and documentation. Design, document, and continuously improve the intercompany accounting policy, procedures, and process documentation, and ensure consistent treatment across entities.

 - NetSuite ownership. Serve as business process owner for NetSuite intercompany accounting, making sure eliminations occur at the right levels for consolidation. Partner with Financial Systems on configuration, enhancements, and automation of global intercompany processes.

 - Cross-functional partnership. Act as the link between Accounting Operations, Technical Accounting, and Financial Systems so that consolidation requirements are built into system design. Support Tax on transfer-pricing policies and intercompany dispute resolution, and support Treasury on entity formation and capital injections.

 - SOX controls. Own intercompany-related SOX controls. Make sure they are properly designed, evidenced, and operating effectively, and partner with Internal Audit and external auditors on testing.

 - Year-end audit. Prepare consolidation-related deliverables for the year-end audit and serve as a key contact for auditors on consolidation matters.

Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

 - 4+ years of progressive intercompany accounting experience, including significant time on consolidations for multi-entity companies.

 - Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP consolidation principles, including ASC 810 (consolidation), ASC 830 (foreign currency), and ASC 805 (business combinations), as applicable.

 - Experience accounting for intercompany inventory, including transfer pricing and elimination of unrealized profit in inventory.

 - Experience partnering with Technical Accounting, Accounting Operations, FP&A, Tax, and Financial Systems teams.

 - Clear communication: you can explain complex consolidation and technical accounting concepts to non-accountants.

 - High attention to detail and comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where processes are still evolving.

 - In office 5 days a week at San Francisco HQ.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with the NetSuite Advanced Intercompany module and automated eliminations.

 - Experience with consolidation or close automation tools

 - Experience with multi-currency, multi-entity structures spanning international subsidiaries

 - Experience with equity accounting for non-controlling interests, joint ventures, or variable interest entities.

 - Experience in a retail, e-commerce, or inventory-heavy business (e.g., consumer products, collectibles, multi-channel retail).

Why Triumph?

 - Build the intercompany and consolidation function at a profitable, fast-growing company, with direct visibility to finance leadership.

 - Hands-on exposure to consolidation, systems design, and international accounting that would take years to get at a larger company.

 - A passionate team that is proud of our work.

 - Competitive salary and benefits (healthcare, vision, dental, 401(k), and more).

• Performs other related duties as assigned.

• Master's degree in Social Work (MSW) from an accredited program.

• Minimum of two (2) years of experience working with older adults, frail elderly populations, or individuals with complex medical, behavioral health, or psychosocial needs.

• Demonstrated ability to conduct comprehensive psychosocial assessments and develop participant-centered care plans.

• Demonstrated ability to provide case management, counseling, crisis intervention, advocacy, and resource coordination within the scope of practice.

• Experience coordinating care across interdisciplinary teams and facilitating care conferences with participants, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage participants, caregivers, community resources, and cross-functional teams to deliver coordinated, participant-centered care.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and ensuring timely follow-through.

• Experience using Electronic Medical Records (EMRs) and the ability to quickly learn organizational documentation systems.

• Proof of a valid driver's license, reliable personal transportation, and automobile insurance that meets applicable state requirements, with the ability to travel throughout the service area.

jobs.description:

For too long, the bra industry was stuck in outdated ideas, forcing women to choose between feeling sexy or comfortable. So in 2013, Heidi Zak and Ra’el Cohen created Thirdlove–a third, better option designed to help women look and feel their best.

Prioritizing real-world fit over outdated standards, Thirdlove disrupted the industry by inventing half-cup sizes and the Fitting Room® quiz. The result was a more precise fit that offered comfort without sacrificing style. Building on that approach, Thirdlove is expanding its retail footprint nationwide, creating customer-first stores where personalized fittings, expert support, and a comfortable shopping experience come together.

Our culture is collaborative, fast-paced, customer-focused, and welcoming. If that sounds like an environment where you would thrive, we encourage you to apply.

Team Collaboration: Work closely with team members, providing support during new store openings, events, and coverage needs across the retail team. Support the initiatives of the leadership team to drive sales, client engagement, team engagement, visual merchandising, and operational excellence.

Thirdlove Offers You

• Employee Discount

ThirdLove is an E-Verify employer and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. For more information please visit E-Verify.
