jobs.title: Licensed Veterinary Technician - LVT
jobs.description:
World Class Medicine.
Purpose-Driven Partnership.

Veritas Veterinary Partners offer exciting career opportunities in state-of-the-art facilities across the U.S. Our hospitals are staffed by board-certified specialists, create a collaborative environment where you can work alongside like-minded, caring professionals. If you're passionate about veterinary medicine, this is your chance to thrive in a dynamic, high-quality setting.

At Veritas Veterinary Partners, our mission is to build a network of trust and opportunity for veterinary professionals nationwide. We specialize in supporting Specialty and Emergency care hospitals, aligning with your unique goals and medical standards. Veritas, founded by Thomas Scavelli, DVM, DACVS, is dedicated to recruiting top-tier talent and fostering collaboration within our community. With a focus on exceptional care, we bring together highly trained veterinarians, technicians, and teammates committed to our patients’ well-being.

We believe in Truth in Medicine and Trust in Partnerships, ensuring we always provide the highest standard of care. Come join us and make a meaningful impact on the community you serve.

Greater Staten Island Veterinary Services is excited to welcome a Licensed Veterinary Technician (LVT) to our busy emergency and specialty hospital!

Why Choose Greater Staten Island Veterinary Services

Greater Staten Island Veterinary Services (GSiVS) is part of a family of hospitals that has existed for more than 30 years. Located nearby are Garden State Veterinary Specialists Eatontown, Garden State Veterinary Services Woodbridge and GSVS Veterinary Emergency Care Toms River.

The strength of the GSVS family lies in its people. With many spending decades at these hospitals, GSVS teammates benefit from rare continuity that nurtures a supportive, team-driven environment and seamless collaboration across roles.

Located at: 3135 Victory Blvd., Staten Island, NY 10314

Position Summary

Veritas Veterinary Partners seeks a skilled and compassionate credentialed technician to deliver high-quality clinical support at a partner hospital. The credentialed technician works under the direction and supervision of licensed veterinarians to provide professional health care support across a full range of clinical tasks.

Consistent with AVMA policy, the veterinary technician's role is to provide professional health care in conjunction with the veterinarian, and all duties are performed under the direction, supervision and responsibility of licensed veterinarians in compliance with federal, state and local laws. Active credentialing as an RVT, LVT or CVT in the state of practice is required. Credentialed technicians may not diagnose, prescribe, perform surgery or engage in any other activity prohibited by the applicable state veterinary practice act.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Patient Assessment and Triage

• Perform patient intake assessments including obtaining history, recording vital signs and preparing exam spaces under veterinarian direction.

• Assist with triage of emergency and urgent cases, communicating patient status to the veterinarian promptly and accurately.

• Monitor hospitalized patients for changes in condition and report observations with clinical precision.

• Maintain accurate and complete patient records within the practice management system.

Clinical Procedures and Treatments

• Perform the full scope of credentialed technician duties including venipuncture, IV catheter placement, medication administration, anesthesia monitoring and patient assessment as directed by the veterinarian.

• Collect and prepare diagnostic specimens for in-house and reference laboratory analysis.

• Support surgical and emergency procedures with clinical competence and composure.

• Administer prescribed medications via all appropriate routes under veterinary direction and in compliance with DEA and state pharmacy regulations.

• Support controlled substance handling, documentation and inventory compliance under the direction of the supervising veterinarian or technician manager.

Client Communication

• Communicate patient updates, care plans and discharge instructions to clients with clarity, compassion and clinical accuracy.

• Reinforce veterinarian recommendations, medication instructions and home care guidance in client-accessible language.

• Escalate clinical questions beyond technician scope to the veterinarian promptly and transparently.

Team Support and Mentorship

• Support and guide patient care associates, veterinary assistants and kennel attendants in daily clinical tasks, serving as a clinical resource and role model.

• Participate in the orientation and on-the-job training of new patient care team members as directed.

• Collaborate with the technician supervisor or manager on patient care workflows, team efficiency and quality of care initiatives.

• Contribute to a team culture that values openness to feedback and continuous clinical growth, remaining receptive to direction and sharing knowledge generously with teammates.

Qualifications

Required

• Active credentialing as an RVT, LVT or CVT in the state of practice.

• Graduation from an AVMA CVTEA-accredited veterinary technology program and successful completion of the Veterinary Technician National Examination (VTNE).

• Demonstrated clinical proficiency across core technician competencies including anesthesia monitoring, venipuncture, IV catheter placement, medication administration and patient assessment.

• Strong observational, critical thinking and communication skills.

• Commitment to working within the legal and ethical standards of the veterinary technician profession as defined by the applicable state practice act.

Preferred

• Experience in a specialty or emergency veterinary hospital.

• Familiarity with specialty-specific clinical protocols in areas such as emergency and critical care, internal medicine, surgery or oncology.

• Prior experience mentoring or training veterinary assistants or patient care associates.

• Active participation in continuing education through NAVTA, state veterinary technician associations or specialty academies.

CORE Competencies

At Veritas Veterinary Partners, we harness the hearts, minds and effort of our teammates, united in our CIRCLE of Core Values, to help us unlock our full potential.

• Compassion — We lead with heart in every interaction. For our patients, this means attentive care. For clients, it means guiding them with understanding. For each other, it means creating a culture founded on respect and trust.

• Integrity — We always do what's right. Through accountability, honesty and transparency, we uphold the highest ethical and medical standards and honor the trust placed in us in every decision.

• Respect — The best outcomes come from working together with heart and valuing every perspective. By honoring each other's expertise, we create an environment where collaboration thrives and ideas emerge at every level.

• Community — We harness the strengths of our people to build a culture where everyone is seen, heard and valued. This unity fosters trust across teams and assures clients their pets are cared for by one team.

• Leadership — We set the standard for exceptional care by combining sharp minds, medical expertise and compassion. Through best-in-class tools, collaboration and a growth mindset, we uphold our role as leaders in specialty and emergency veterinary care.

• Evolution — We stay curious, adaptable and seek ways to elevate patient care. By committing to a growth mindset and supporting each other, we unlock the fullest potential of individuals, teams and our organization.

Work Environment

This position is onsite full-time at a partner hospital. The role requires frequent physical activity throughout clinical areas including standing, lifting and animal handling for extended periods. The credentialed technician will regularly work with patients in varying degrees of illness or injury, assist with emergency and surgical procedures and interact with clients in emotional distress.

Exposure to anesthetic agents, biological specimens, controlled substances, clinical noise and the general intensity of a specialty and emergency hospital is expected. Continuing education requirements for credential renewal are the responsibility of the individual technician. Hours include evenings, weekends and holidays consistent with 24-hour hospital operations.

Compensation & Schedule

• Pay: $30/hr - $40/hr + Overnight differential

• Sign-on bonus for full-time LVT

• Access earned wages before payday with DailyPay

Benefits

• Medical, vision and dental insurance options, with some plans available at little to no cost

• 401(k) with employer match

• Paid time off and paid parental leave

• Covered licensing fees and continuing education allowance

• Mental health support through Talkspace and ComPsych

• Pet insurance and generous discounts for teammates’ pets

• Uniforms allowance

• Teammate referral bonus program

Base Pay

$30—$40 USD

Veritas Veterinary Partners is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with the requirements of all applicable federal, state and local laws, we welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. All current positions require the ability to speak, read, and write English proficiently. Additional fluency in other languages is preferred but not required.

For CA applicants please visit our Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Head of Fraud Intelligence
jobs.description:
SentiLink https://www.sentilink.com/ helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/companies/sentilink/?list=fintech50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260330439998/en/SentiLink-Named-a-2026-FICO-Industry-Vanguard-Decision-Award-Winner-for-Leadership-in-Identity-Theft-Detection. We were also the first company to go live https://resources.sentilink.com/blog/sentilink-makes-history-as-first-ecbsv-provider with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress https://resources.sentilink.com/media/dr.-david-maimons-congressional-testimony-on-emerging-fraud-threats-and-the-evolving-fraud-landscape on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

Role:

The Head of Fraud Intelligence is responsible for transforming SentiLink's Fraud Intelligence Team (FIT) into a high-impact fraud intelligence function. This leader will oversee the evolution of FIT's operating model, ensuring the team delivers high-quality fraud labeling, generates actionable fraud intelligence, develops future technical talent, and creates measurable business impact through fraud prevention initiatives.

This role requires a unique combination of operational rigor, fraud curiosity, analytical thinking, innovation, and talent development. The successful candidate will raise performance standards, implement best-in-class, scalable operational processes, and strengthen cross-functional partnerships to ensure FIT serves as an efficient operational machine, a trusted source of fraud expertise, and a pipeline for future leaders across the organization.

Success will be measured by improvements in operational performance, development of high-potential internal talent, increased fraud prevention impact, and FIT's growing influence across Product, R&D, Analytics, GTM, and other business functions.

This is a remote, US-based role.

Responsibilities:

 

 - Establish clear performance baselines and operational metrics for FIT, including labeling volume, quality, turnaround time, cost efficiency, SLA adherence, and downstream business impact.

 - Design and implement scalable quality assurance processes, including sampling methodologies, review frameworks, feedback mechanisms, and escalation procedures to continuously improve labeling accuracy and consistency.

 - Reimagine FIT's operating model, workflows, tooling, and team structure to improve efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes.

 - Build a best-in-class entry-level talent program by defining hiring profiles, onboarding experiences, training programs, and career development pathways for Fraud Intelligence Analysts.

 - Create a repeatable progression framework that enables FIT team members to develop technical, analytical, and fraud expertise while preparing them for advancement and internal mobility opportunities.

 - Develop credible measurement frameworks that connect FIT activities to measurable fraud prevention outcomes, including model improvements, fraud detection enhancements, typology development, and customer impact.

 - Launch and scale initiatives that transform frontline fraud observations into actionable insights for Product, R&D, Analytics, GTM, and customer-facing teams.

 - Serve as a trusted fraud subject matter expert and strategic partner across the company, building strong relationships with stakeholders and ensuring FIT's insights influence key business decisions.

 - Establish recurring reporting, fraud trend analysis, and knowledge-sharing programs that elevate fraud awareness and expertise throughout the organization.

 - Leverage AI, automation, and process optimization opportunities to increase team productivity, improve quality, and enable FIT to focus on higher-value fraud intelligence work.
   
   

Requirements:

 - 8+ years of experience in fraud operations, fraud intelligence, risk management, trust & safety, investigations, analytics, or a related domain, including significant people leadership experience

 - 4+ years of management experience overseeing a team of Fraud Analysts

 - Demonstrated success leading operational teams responsible for high-volume, quality-sensitive workflows and measurable business outcomes.

 - Strong fraud judgment with a deep interest in understanding evolving fraud patterns, typologies, and prevention strategies.

 - Proven ability to design and improve processes, operating models, quality systems, and performance measurement frameworks.

 - Experience developing and coaching early-career talent, building high-performing teams, and creating internal mobility pathways.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and drive decision-making.

 - Technical fluency and comfort working closely with product, analytics, engineering, machine learning, and data science teams.

 - Experience leveraging AI, automation, workflow tooling, or operational technologies to improve productivity and quality.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and align diverse stakeholders around shared goals.

 - Strong ownership mindset with a track record of driving change, executing against ambitious goals, and holding teams accountable to high standards.

 - Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

 - Curiosity, first-principles thinking, and a continuous improvement mindset focused on learning, experimentation, and long-term impact.
   
   

Compensation:

 - $180,000-$240,000/year + equity + benefits


PERKS:

 - Employer paid group health insurance for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) plan with employer match (or equivalent for non US-based roles)

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Regular company-wide in-person events

 - Home office stipend, and more!




CORPORATE VALUES:

 - Follow Through

 - Deep Understanding

 - Whatever It Takes

 - Do Something Smart

jobs.title: Security Engineer, IAM
jobs.description:
Role Description

Security Engineers at Dropbox safeguard our digital ecosystem alongside a diverse team of professionals dedicated to protecting our products and users. Trusted by millions, our mission is to integrate security seamlessly into Dropbox, empowering confident collaboration.

In this role, you’ll build and operate the identity and access controls that help Dropbox employees, services, and AI agents access what they need securely. You’ll combine security engineering and automation to strengthen authentication and authorization, enforce least privilege, and simplify identity lifecycle management across our infrastructure. Working closely with Infrastructure, Corp Engineering, Developer Platform, and Incident Response, you’ll make secure access easier to use and maintain reliable IAM services as Dropbox adopts new AI tools and agentic workflows.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

• Design, deploy, and operate IAM controls across Dropbox’s cloud and on-premises infrastructure

• Design and implement secure identity, authentication, and authorization controls for AI agents and other non-human actors

• Implement least-privilege access using RBAC, ABAC, permission boundaries, service control policies, and just-in-time access

• Design secure integrations using SAML, OAuth 2.1, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and SPIFFE/SPIRE

• Automate identity lifecycle processes to ensure access is granted, modified, and revoked promptly

• Develop identity guardrails using infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code

• Build monitoring and alerting for anomalous authentication, privilege escalation, credential misuse, and unauthorized access

• Partner with Incident Response to investigate identity-related incidents and rapidly revoke compromised access

• Conduct security reviews and threat modeling for new identity architectures and integrations

• Maintain IAM services with strong reliability, documentation, operational ownership, and on-call support

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

• 5+ years of security engineering experience, including substantial IAM or identity-security experience

• Hands-on experience with Okta, Okta for AI Agents and Sailpoint, or comparable technologies

• Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, least privilege, zero trust, and identity lifecycle management

• Experience with SAML, OAuth 2.0/2.1, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and MFA

• Experience designing RBAC or ABAC authorization models

• Experience securing human and non-human identities, including services, workloads, automation, and CI/CD systems

• Experience with agentic frameworks and MCP tool integration

• Experience implementing access reviews, privileged-access controls, and joiner/mover/leaver workflows

• Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Go, Java, Ruby, or Bash

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code, policy-as-code, APIs, and security automation

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with workload identity technologies such as SPIFFE/SPIRE, Kubernetes service accounts, or cloud workload identity.

• Experience securing identities and authorization for AI agents and other autonomous systems.

• Experience with just-in-time access, zero-standing-privilege, or privileged-access management platforms.

• Familiarity with identity threat detection and response.

• Experience building IAM controls for multi-account cloud environments.

• Familiarity with NIST SP 800-63, NIST SP 800-207, CIS benchmarks, and relevant identity-security guidance.

• Experience supporting compliance programs such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FedRAMP.

• Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, or equivalent.

• Contributions to the identity or security community through open-source projects, publications, or conferences.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

• Awareness: Understand yourself and others.

• Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.

• Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.

• Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

This role is not available in Zone 1

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, Ohio, Kentucky, Mississippi, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

Purpose:

We are looking for an experienced Nurse Practitioner to provide primary care to homebound and palliative care patients in the Atlantic City County, NJ region. You will apply medical techniques and principles under the supervision of a physician and you will care for a diverse set of patients with chronic diseases.

What You'll Do:

• Provide high quality care to primary and palliative patients in and around (Atlantic City, NJ)

• Assess patient's health by performing physical examinations; obtaining, updating, and studying medical histories and creating the best plan for care.

• Effectively communicate with office staff and clinical operations across various internal platforms

• Provide high quality, patient centered care to a panel of patients

• Attend quarterly medical staff meetings

• Develop impressions, diagnosis, and treatment plans

• Foster trust and consult with patients, families, and caregivers during visits

Paraprofessional

Aspire Living & Learning — Openings in Windsor, Colchester, Williston, and Burlington
Pay: $19.22 to $26.28 per hour depending on experience/education
Job Type: Full-time, year-round (Part-time also available!)
Schedule: Monday–Friday, between 7:30 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.
Work Location: In person
Please note: this role is internally recognized as a Behavior Therapist

Start a Rewarding Career as a Paraprofessional

Aspire Living & Learning is hiring compassionate, dependable, and energetic Paraprofessional to support children, adolescents, and young adults with developmental disabilities, including individuals on the autism spectrum.

This entry-level position provides hands-on experience in applied behavior analysis (ABA). No prior ABA experience is required. Aspire Living & Learning provides comprehensive on-the-job training, ongoing supervision, and support to help qualified employees pursue Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) certification.

Experience in customer service, sales, education, healthcare, business, human services, marketing, communications, maintenance, government, or another field may be valuable in this role.

About the Paraprofessional Role

Paraprofessionals work under the supervision of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) and/or special education teacher. You will implement individualized behavior support plans, education plans, and service agreements while helping clients develop communication, social, academic, motor, and daily living skills.

Clients may demonstrate mild to severe behavioral challenges, including aggressive or self-injurious behavior. The role requires patience, emotional maturity, physical fitness, attention to detail, and the ability to remain calm in high-pressure situations.

Paraprofessionals may work in:

• Aspire Living & Learning clinics

• Public and private school settings

• Client homes, as assigned

• Community environments

Key Responsibilities

• Implement individualized behavior support plans using applied behavior analysis techniques

• Teach communication, social, motor, play, cognitive, and self-care skills

• Support clients with daily living and personal care routines

• Reduce challenging behaviors through approved intervention strategies

• Collect accurate data on behavior, progress, and skill development

• Follow written treatment plans, protocols, and safety procedures

• Use prompting, discrete trial teaching, and naturalistic learning techniques

• Apply prevention, redirection, and physical intervention procedures when necessary and properly trained

• Maintain focus and attention for extended periods

• Collaborate with behavior analysts, special education teachers, families, and other team members

• Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and ongoing supervision

• Adapt to daily schedule changes and changing client needs

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree preferred; a combination of college coursework and relevant experience may be considered

• Previous experience in ABA, education, healthcare, human services, behavioral health, or direct support is helpful but not required

• Valid driver’s license

• Reliable transportation

• Proof of automobile insurance

• Vehicle capable of transporting clients in the back seat

• Ability to travel within approximately 45 minutes of Windsor, Vermont

• Ability to pass a background check

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills

• Physical fitness and coordination

• Ability to demonstrate approved physical prevention and redirection techniques

• Willingness to assist with personal care routines when necessary

• Ability to manage multiple details and follow instructions accurately

• Flexibility to work Monday through Friday between 7:30 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.

• Ability to respond professionally to day-to-day schedule changes

Compensation and Benefits

• Hourly pay: $19.22–$25.43, based on education and experience working under a BCBA

• Bachelor’s degree with no prior experience: $20.61 per hour

• Guaranteed year-round schedule of 37.5 hours per week

• Opportunities to work up to 40 hours per week, including meetings and training

Apply Today

jobs.title: Business Supervisor
jobs.description:
Business Supervisor

Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Business Supervisor to support our Eli Lilly business, helping bring culturally relevant creative work to life for brands that impact people’s health. This role is hybrid and requires 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office, with 1 day remote.

Position Summary

The Business Supervisor (BS) is the day-to-day client partnership lead, responsible for managing client communication, translating business needs into actionable direction, and ensuring clarity across internal teams. Serving as the critical connection point between Business Leadership and Program Management, the Business Supervisor helps create exceptional client experiences while enabling efficient delivery.

This role operates with guidance while independently managing day-to-day client relationships and workstreams. Business Supervisors build trusted client partnerships, drive alignment across disciplines, proactively manage expectations, and help ensure every engagement is strategically grounded and executionally set up for success.

What You'll Do

Client Partnership & Communication

• Own day-to-day client relationships and communication across assigned workstreams.

• Lead routine client meetings, status calls, working sessions, and follow-up communications.

• Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful partnership.

• Ensure every client interaction is organized, productive, and aligned against business objectives.

Translation & Alignment

• Translate client needs, feedback, and business objectives into clear direction for internal teams.

• Partner closely with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Business Directors to develop and refine creative briefs.

• Ensure cross-functional teams understand priorities, expectations, success metrics, and next steps.

• Create alignment between client goals and agency recommendations throughout the life of a project.

• Build a working understanding of the client’s brands, patient audiences, competitive landscape, and business priorities to inform day-to-day client partnership and internal direction.

Creative Development Support

• Prepare clients for presentations and key decision-making moments.

• Help articulate strategic and creative rationale in a clear, compelling, and client-ready manner.

• Anticipate client feedback and guide internal teams on effective responses.

• Support creative development by ensuring work remains aligned to client objectives, approved strategy, and client-provided medical, legal, and regulatory guidance.

Risk & Expectation Management

• Proactively identify risks, ambiguities, or changing client needs before they become issues.

• Manage client expectations through transparent communication and thoughtful problem solving.

• Resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating only when appropriate.

• Ensure alignment between what clients expect and what teams are prepared to deliver.

Team Contribution & Development

• Mentor junior Business Leadership team members in client communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.

• Support Business Directors in strengthening client relationships and identifying opportunities for organic growth.

• Foster a collaborative, accountable, and positive team environment across disciplines.

• Model strong judgment, professionalism, and ownership in client-facing situations.

Partnership with Program Management

• Partner closely with Program Management to ensure alignment between client expectations and delivery plans.

• Support scope definition by helping clarify client objectives, priorities, and desired outcomes.

• Maintain awareness of timelines, budgets, and executional progress while allowing Program Management to lead delivery.

• Work collaboratively to ensure clients receive a seamless experience from strategy through execution.

• Partner with Program Management and client stakeholders to clarify review requirements, consolidate feedback, and ensure teams understand approval decisions and their implications.

Minimum Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, consulting, or related client leadership roles.

• Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships and manage day-to-day business communications.

• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Strategy, Creative, Production, Context, and Program Management.

• Ability to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.

• Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to a collaborative team culture.

• Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative development, and client service best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.

• Experience supporting healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated brands is a plus, but not required. Curiosity about the category and an eagerness to learn are valued.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $83,000 - 100,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

Edmentum is a dynamic educator and student-focused company dedicated to tech-enabled learning solutions. Our goal is to ensure that all students have access to flexible learning environments and educators have the tools they need to support their students. We are on a mission to create innovative, proven learning technology, partnering with educators to ignite student potential. You’ll thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your ideas matter, your contributions are recognized, and your impact is felt.

Where You'll Work: This is a field-based role supporting school and district partners throughout Southeast Virginia. The ideal candidate will be based in or near Roanoke, VA, and will spend three days per week traveling within their assigned territory, typically within a two hour radius, with the remainder of the time working remotely from a home office.

What You’ll Do

• You’re a strategic thinker who can connect customer needs with organizational value.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co http://Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co http://Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co http://Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co http://Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Vibe is a streaming TV advertising platform, and our executive team now spans New York and Paris. Right now, every leader books their own meetings, chases their own invites, and handles their own logistics. That’s time that should go into running the business. As our first Executive Assistant, you’ll own calendars, travel, and logistics for the full executive team, reporting to our VP of Strategic Initiatives. It’s the first role of its kind at Vibe, so there’s no playbook: you’ll shape how it works from day one, sit at the center of our leadership team and biggest partnerships, and have real room to grow.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the executive calendar

 - Own calendars end to end for the executive team

 - Coordinate scheduling across the full executive team in New York and Paris

 - Flag calendar conflicts early, with a clear recommendation on what to move or postpone

 - Partner with executive assistants at Walmart and other external partners to keep cross-company meetings on track

Run travel and logistics

 - Plan complex executive travel between New York, Paris, and partner sites across the US

 - Organize executive offsites from first booking to final agenda

 - Handle every room, restaurant, or venue booking the executive team needs

Make every meeting count

 - Prepare briefing materials ahead of key executive meetings

 - Drive meeting follow-ups so decisions turn into action

Grow with the business

 - Define how the role works at Vibe as our first Executive Assistant

 - Learn our key projects well enough to help leaders prioritize their time

 - Track cross-functional project progress as the role expands toward executive business partner work


WHAT YOU NEED

 - 5–6+ years supporting founders or C-level executives who clearly trusted your judgment

 - Experience in this role at a hypergrowth or scale-up tech company

 - Experience owning several executives’ calendars end to end, including complex US–Europe travel and coordination with EAs at large partner companies

 - A track record of owning prioritization: you’ve pushed back on executives, recommended what to move or postpone, and tracked projects beyond the calendar

 - A reputation for reliability: senior leaders counted on you to never drop a ball, even under pressure and direct feedback

 - Hands-on use of AI tools in your daily work, with the ability to explain how they change your output


NICE TO HAVES

 - Working proficiency in French, helpful for supporting our Paris-based leaders and partners day to day


OUR VALUES

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.


WHAT WE OFFER

For candidates in New York, NY, the pay range for this role is $70,000–$130,000

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

 - Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

 - Full health coverage — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

 - 401(k) with matching — We invest in your future, not just your output.

 - Flex PTO — Take the time you need. We measure results, not hours.

 - Workspace worth showing up for — Our Flatiron office is full of natural light, we’re in 4 days a week with flexibility built in, and our amazing workplace experiences manager keeps the space.

 - Parental leave — Paid leave for all parents.

 - Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

 1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We’ll share context; you’ll share yours.

 2. Manager interview — Meet the person you’d work with directly.

 3. Take-home assignment + live debrief — A real problem, not a trick. We’ll work through it together.

 4. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we’re holding a consistent, high bar.

 5. Offer — Fast. We don’t let good decisions sit.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.


REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR QUALITY INSPECTOR – AVIONICS

Based out of Rocket Lab's Headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Senior Quality Inspector - Avionics will be responsible for performing inspections using prescribed criteria to ensure our products meet the highest engineering and production standards. Your ability to identify non-conformances, solve problems, and communicate effectively will be critical in driving continuous improvement and maintaining the highest quality standards.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

• Conduct complex inspections of electronic and electrical components, including purchased parts, PCBAs, wire harnesses, electro-mechanical assemblies, and other avionics systems.

• Develop and follow detailed work instructions for receiving inspections of PCBAs, harnesses, electro-mechanical components/assemblies, and test reports.

• Identify and document issues and non-conformances in Rocket Lab’s internal quality monitoring systems, including the Issue Tracking System, Manufacturing Execution System (MES), and/or ERP systems.

• Collaborate with engineering, quality, and production teams to address and resolve quality concerns.

• Support internal audits and prepare production areas for external audits, including tracking and closing corrective action requests.

• Monitor and ensure compliance with tool calibration systems and maintain calibration tracking.

• Promote a “Built-in Quality” philosophy by consistently detecting and addressing non-conformances to prevent defects from reaching downstream customers.

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5+ years of experience working in quality assurance role in an electronics manufacturing environment

• Current IPC-A-610 certification

• Current or previous IPC/WHMA-A-620C and/or AC 43.13 certification

• Strong ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, schematics, and wiring diagrams.

• Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to producing work of the highest accuracy.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Familiar with ISO9000 and/or AS9100 requirements

• Experience with IPC J-STD-001 with space addendum

• Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

• Active U.S. Security Clearance or the ability to obtain one

• Experience working on flight hardware, satellites, or other high-reliability systems

SHIFT HOURS

• 5:00 AM - 3:30 PM Monday – Thursday

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Stand and walk for entire shift (8+ hours) on various work surfaces

• Climb ladders and work at elevated height small spaces, awkward positions, and tight areas as needed

• Perform repetitive motions including bending, twisting, reaching, grasping, pushing, pulling, and stooping

• Use hands with precision to handle, control, and operate tools, instruments, and equipment

• Lift, carry, push, and pull materials and equipment up to 25 lbs.

• Work in varied environments including production floors, equipment areas, and field locations with exposure to noise, temperature variations, and moving machinery

• Flexibility to work extended hours, weekends, and varied shifts as operational needs require

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

Hourly Pay Range (CA Only)

$33—$41 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience.

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior 3D Technical Artist & Motion Designer to join the Lucid UX/UI team and help define the next generation of digital vehicle experiences.

This role sits at the intersection of 3D design, motion, real-time rendering, and product development. You will create high-quality vehicle visualizations, real-time 3D assets, animations, and motion experiences for customer-facing applications while ensuring that content performs efficiently within demanding embedded compute environments.

You will work closely with UX/UI Designers, Vehicle Designers, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to establish both the visual quality and the production processes required to bring sophisticated 3D experiences into production.

The ideal candidate combines a strong visual eye with deep technical fluency. You should be equally comfortable refining lighting and materials in a 3D scene, rigging and animating a vehicle, optimizing an asset for a constrained GPU target, collaborating with engineers on implementation, and using emerging AI tools to accelerate and improve the creative workflow.

What You'll Do

Real-Time 3D & Visualization

• Create high-quality real-time 3D vehicle models, renderings, environments, and visual experiences for customer-facing UX applications.

• Develop and maintain real-time content using Unreal Engine or comparable real-time 3D engines.

• Build production-quality content in Cinema 4D, including modeling, materials, lighting, cameras, animation, and rendering.

• Create and optimize materials, textures, lighting, shaders, geometry, LODs, and other 3D assets for real-time applications.

• Establish lighting and rendering approaches that maintain a premium visual character across a range of display and compute configurations.

• Rig and animate vehicles, vehicle components, cameras, and other objects required for interactive product experiences.

• Produce polished motion graphics and animated 3D sequences that communicate system states, vehicle behaviors, transitions, and product functionality.

Production & Optimization

• Prepare and optimize 3D assets for resource-constrained production compute targets, balancing visual fidelity, frame rate, memory, loading performance, thermal considerations, and system limitations.

• Develop scalable asset pipelines that allow complex vehicle geometry and design data to be transformed into production-ready real-time assets.

• Work with engineering teams to identify performance bottlenecks and determine appropriate trade-offs between visual quality, geometry complexity, texture resolution, lighting, effects, and runtime performance.

• Define standards and best practices for asset creation, naming, organization, versioning, optimization, and delivery.

• Support the integration and validation of visual assets throughout development and production.

Motion & Experience Design

• Work with UX and interaction designers to translate experience concepts into sophisticated motion behaviors, transitions, visual states, and 3D interactions.

• Support design concept ideation and rapid prototyping by translating early UX concepts into compelling 3D visualizations, motion studies, and interactive prototypes that help teams explore, evaluate, and communicate new vehicle experiences.

• Develop prototypes that allow teams to evaluate motion, timing, camera behavior, lighting, materials, and real-time interactions before committing them to production.

• Help establish a coherent motion and 3D visual language across vehicle interfaces and related digital experiences.

AI-Enabled Creative Workflows

• Use AI-assisted creative tools as part of the day-to-day design and production workflow for ideation, visualization, asset development, iteration, and optimization.

• Explore emerging generative AI and machine-learning-based workflows that can shorten the path from concept to production-quality 3D content.

• Help establish responsible, repeatable workflows that combine traditional 3D production techniques with new AI capabilities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner closely with UX/UI Design, Vehicle Design, Engineering, Product, and other stakeholders from early concept development through production.

• Manage the flow of 3D assets and requirements between design and engineering teams.

• Translate creative objectives into technically achievable solutions and clearly communicate technical constraints back to designers and stakeholders.

• Participate in design reviews and technical reviews, presenting work and explaining visual and technical trade-offs.

• Help establish processes that enable design and engineering teams to work efficiently with complex vehicle and 3D data.

What You'll Bring

• 5–8+ years of professional experience developing and shipping high-quality 3D content for customer-facing digital products.

• Demonstrated experience shipping real-time 3D content on resource-constrained compute platforms, such as automotive, embedded systems, mobile devices, game consoles, AR/VR devices, or comparable environments.

• Advanced experience with Unreal Engine or a comparable real-time 3D engine.

• Strong professional experience with Cinema 4D and Adobe After Effects, including the development of high-quality 3D, animation, and motion-graphics content.

• Expert understanding of real-time 3D fundamentals, including modeling and topology; UVs and texturing; PBR materials and shading; lighting; rigging; animation; cameras and composition; LOD and geometry optimization; texture and memory optimization; and real-time rendering performance.

• Strong motion-design sensibility, including timing, easing, transitions, choreography, and visual storytelling.

• Experience developing sophisticated vehicle, product, or hard-surface visualization is highly desirable.

• Ability to work with high-complexity source assets and transform them into efficient, production-ready real-time content.

• Experience collaborating directly with software and graphics engineers to diagnose and resolve performance or rendering issues.

• Fluency with contemporary AI-assisted creative tools and workflows, coupled with curiosity about how generative AI will change 3D and motion production.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across creative and technical disciplines.

• A portfolio demonstrating both exceptional visual craft and technical execution, including examples of shipped real-time 3D and motion content.

Nice to Have

• Experience developing automotive HMI, digital cockpit, ADAS visualization, navigation, charging, or vehicle-state experiences.

• Experience working with vehicle CAD and converting engineering/design geometry into optimized real-time assets.

• Experience with shader development, procedural materials, particle systems, or other real-time visual-effects workflows.

• Familiarity with tools such as Houdini, Blender, Maya, Substance 3D, or comparable 3D content-creation applications.

• Familiarity with scripting or pipeline automation using Python or similar technologies.

• Experience developing content for embedded GPUs or other environments where GPU, CPU, memory, bandwidth, and thermal constraints directly influence design decisions.

• Experience building reusable tools, templates, or pipelines that enable designers to produce and iterate on real-time content more efficiently.

What Success Looks Like

You will help create a production pipeline where ambitious 3D UX concepts can move efficiently from vehicle design data to creative exploration, real-time prototype, optimized production asset, and shipped customer experience.

Success means not simply producing beautiful renders. It means ensuring that the final experience retains its visual intent when running reliably on production hardware, while building a collaborative process that allows UX, Design, and Engineering to iterate quickly.

jobs.description:
Dexis is a dynamic professional services firm dedicated to partnering with government and community leaders both in the U.S. and internationally to achieve critical social outcomes in a rapidly changing world.

At Dexis, you will experience a corporate culture of inclusiveness, respect, fairness, and trust. You will be given the means and mentorship needed to succeed, and your creativity will be rewarded.

About the Project

This project will provide a broad range of assessment, monitoring, and evaluation (AM&E) support to DSCA. Project tasks will include desk and field research, analysis, data collection and visualization, strategy development, policy writing and coordination, and AM&E capacity building.

Responsibilities

AM&E Analysts II will support the design, coordination, conduct, and reporting of Security Cooperation analyses. They will work with key stakeholders to ensure efforts stay up to date with emerging AM&E techniques, tools, and approaches in specific subject matter. Key responsibilities include:

• Supporting the leadership team in identifying priorities and solutions to problems

• Providing qualitative and quantitative analysis of security cooperation programs

• Assisting with the development of indicators and metrics that enable evaluation of security cooperation programs

• Drafting reports, presentations, and other deliverables for senior leadership review

• Supporting the design and development of visual graphics (e.g., illustrations, layouts, designs) that distills key information in a clear, concise manner

• Supporting the development and maintenance of project processes and plans

• Travel up to 25-50% domestically and internationally as determined by client and portfolio requirements and demands on regional team, while adhering to approved budget, cost reasonableness requirements, and all applicable corporate and federal travel regulations

• Strong oral and written communication skills to deal effectively with mid and high-level partner contacts, the host government, and local communities
