jobs.title: Manager, Hardware Validation (Onsite)
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As a Manager on the Product Integrity team, you'll lead the engineers who prove Axon's hardware is ready for the field. The Manager, Hardware Validation owns the hardware validation plan and team for all Axon products. This role blends people leadership with hands-on technical ownership: coaching a team of validation engineers, setting the technical bar for test rigor, and partnering across Hardware, Firmware, Manufacturing, Quality, and Program Management teams to ensure products meet functional, environmental, reliability, and safety requirements at every program milestone.

What You'll Do

Location: Onsite at our Phoenix, Deer Valley location

Reports to: Senior Director, Product Integrity

Direct Reports: Hardware Validation Engineers

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of hardware validation engineers, setting technical direction, priorities, and career growth plans.

• Own the validation plan for assigned product programs, from requirements definition through prototype, development, and production release.

• Define and drive execution of test plans covering functional, environmental (thermal, vibration, ingress, drop/shock), EMC/EMI, reliability, and safety compliance testing.

• Partner with Hardware Engineering, Firmware, Manufacturing, Quality, and Regulatory teams to identify design risks early and drive root-cause investigations to closure.

• Support test lab infrastructure needs, including equipment, fixtures, automation, and data systems, for assigned product lines.

• Track validation metrics and exit criteria for program gate reviews, and report status and risk to the Sr. Manager, Hardware Validation.

• Support relationships with external test labs and certification bodies (UL, FCC, CE, MIL-STD, IP ratings, and similar) for assigned programs.

• Drive continuous improvement in test coverage, cycle time, and defect escape rates within the team.

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in hardware test, validation, or reliability engineering.

• 2+ years of experience leading or managing engineers in a validation, test, or reliability function.

• Hands-on experience with environmental and reliability test methods (e.g., HALT/HASS, vibration, thermal, ingress, drop/shock, EMC).

• Working knowledge of industry and regulatory test standards (MIL-STD, IEC, ISO, ASTM) and EMC/regulatory certification processes.

• Experience with test automation, data acquisition systems, and statistical analysis of test results (e.g., DOE, reliability modeling, Weibull analysis).

• Strong communication skills, with experience presenting test results and technical trade-offs to cross-functional stakeholders.

• Experience with connected/IoT hardware, wearables, or public safety technology is a plus.

• Six Sigma Green Belt certification a plus.

Travel required:

Up to 15%, for manufacturing and supplier site visits, outside test labs, and program reviews.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, dental, and vision plans

• Fitness programs

• Emotional and mental wellness support

• Learning and development programs

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

jobs.title: GTM Enablement - Sales Execution & North America Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring a Sales Execution & NA Enablement Lead to raise how our enterprise sellers plan, pursue, and win complex, technical deals. This is not a traditional training role. You’ll set the standard for what great enterprise selling looks like, turn it into artifacts and operating rhythms, and make sure sellers and managers actually use it.

The role has two mandates: own key global sales execution programs, and act as the primary Enablement partner to North America sales leadership. You’ll work closely with the Global Head of Enablement, Sales Leadership, RevOps, Product Marketing, Product & Technical Enablement, and FDE.



What you’ll do

 - Own enterprise sales execution: Build and operationalize the critical artifacts that drive excellent sales execution.

 - Enable sellers to win technical enterprise deals: Coach reps to build business cases with champions, read 10-Ks, and connect ElevenLabs capabilities to measurable outcomes for technical and economic buyers.

 - Partner with NA leadership on enablement: Diagnose field gaps and adapt global programs to NA needs, including competitive positioning, developer-led motions, and vertical playbooks.

 - Facilitate globally: Lead highly engaging, practical sales execution sessions, not just build the programs behind them.

 - Manage the coaching and operating rhythm: Embed selling standards and artifacts into how managers inspect deals and coach sellers.

 - Build the foundation for a vertical selling motion: Lay the groundwork for vertical selling, which is becoming a global priority, not just an NA need.

 - Execute in an AI-native way: Use AI to scale coaching, practice, and reinforcement, going beyond general AI fluency.



Requirements

 - 10+ years experience in enterprise sales leadership and enablement experience, ideally in an AI-native or developer-focused company

 - Excellence building and operationalizing value-selling artifacts across sales org with measurable results

 - Experience with MEDDICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, or similar methodologies, and the judgment to adapt them

 - Experience enabling frontline sales managers and building strong coaching methodologies

 - AI fluency, and comfort building in a fast-growing environment where the operating model is still taking shape

 - Enough technical depth to credibly support sellers selling to developers and technical buyers

 - Proven cross-functional influence across Sales, RevOps, PMM, Product, and FDE teams

 - Bonus: Experience working in voice AI



Location

This is a remote-first role. Candidates must be based in North America.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, New Verticals - Fulfillment Strategy & Operations
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington, DC; Chicago, IL; Tempe, AZ
jobs.description:
About the Team

New Verticals is an exciting team at DoorDash that is building and scaling new ways to delight our customers beyond restaurant delivery. New Verticals owns delivery businesses across Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol, Retail, Pharmacy and DashMart. Our Fulfillment Strategy & Operations team has three mandates: onboard merchants well, fulfill every order with speed and accuracy, and keep improving our logistics network. We do it by finding efficiencies, shipping product tooling and launching operational processes at scale.

About the Role

We are scaling our New Verticals Fulfillment Strategy & Operations team. Strategy & Operations combines strategic thinking, strong analytical problem solving, and operational execution to identify opportunities, develop solutions, and drive measurable business impact for our New Verticals businesses while working cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Operations to bring these solutions to life.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager to lead a team of three focused on two critical areas of New Verticals fulfillment - merchant experience and occasion quality.

For merchants who pick and pack their own DoorDash orders, you’ll set the strategy for improving the tools and workflows they use every day. You’ll work with Product and Engineering to build features that help merchants fulfill orders accurately and efficiently, while unlocking growth for their businesses.

You’ll also lead our approach to fulfillment quality during occasions—our highest-volume days, when getting the customer experience right is especially important. You’ll identify risks, develop plans with cross-functional partners and help ensure orders are delivered with high quality at scale.

This role combines strategy, analytics, product development and hands-on operations. You’ll partner with teams across regions, including Product Managers in EMEA, to identify shared opportunities and build solutions that work for local markets.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Lead: You'll spearhead cross-functional projects, collaborating with Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to develop and implement tech solutions that increase selection across our New Vertical offerings.

• Strategize: You will own and deliver on improving key quality and cost metrics. You’ll create and execute quarterly and annual strategic plans aligned with product capabilities to elevate order quality.

• Build: You will build strategic initiatives and drive innovation across our offerings; this can vary from AI-powered predictions to improving the overall shopping experience. This means everything from high-level strategy to operational details.

• Analyze. You love working with data to drive business decision-making and are familiar with SQL.

We’re excited about you because…

• You are an operator. You don’t hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you’re also able to think long-term. You are excited to experience our operation firsthand to inform your strategy.

• You solve problems from first principles. You’re excited to think innovatively, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.

• You’re analytical. You possess a sharp analytical mind, and can extract and communicate meaningful insights from data to drive strategic decisions. You are comfortable with SQL and data visualization tools.

• You’re AI native. You root cause problems with a systems first approach and can identify how to automate repeatable tasks using AI tools like Claude, Cursor, Gemini or Copilot.

• You have 8-12+ years of experience. You’ve succeeded in high-performing cultures (tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, startups or a related experience). Prior experience in e-commerce fulfillment or marketplace operations is a plus!

• You have prior people management experience. You have hired & developed a team.

• You have a completed Bachelor’s Degree ideally in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field. An MBA is highly preferred!

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$170,000—$250,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools: To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview.

How it works: Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support - rather than replace - human decision-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI-enabled tool  in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Emerging Talent Programs
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is experiencing hyper-growth, and the demand for exceptional engineering, software, and hardware talent is critical to our success. This strategic role is paramount to building and sustaining & retaining a world-class pipeline of early career professionals who are passionate about our mission. As the leader of our Emerging Talent Program Managers, you will be instrumental in defining, architecting, and executing Anduril's emerging talent strategy, positioning us as the employer of choice for the brightest minds ready to tackle the toughest challenges in defense technology. Your ability to empower your team will directly ensure that our Intern, New Grad, and Veteran programs consistently deliver high-quality, impactful experiences that convert and retain top talent.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Lead & Develop a High-Performing Team: Provide exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentorship to a team of Program Managers overseeing Anduril’s Intern, New Grad, Veteran, and Events initiatives. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and professional growth within the team.

• Drive Strategic Program Execution: Translate high-level emerging talent strategy into consistent, high-quality, and scalable execution across all programs. Set clear priorities, establish robust operating rhythms, and define delivery standards to ensure programs consistently meet and exceed objectives.

• Oversee Program Management Excellence: Ensure the seamless planning, design, and delivery of all emerging talent programs, from university engagement and event strategy to candidate experience, onboarding, and development. Maintain program integrity, consistency, and alignment with Anduril’s values and mission.

• Establish & Monitor Performance Metrics: Own accountability for key program outcomes, including year-over-year improvements in candidate conversion, program participant retention, and hiring manager satisfaction. Develop and implement robust reporting frameworks to track performance, identify trends, and drive data-informed decisions across all emerging talent initiatives.

• Cultivate Cross-Functional Partnerships: Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with critical internal stakeholders, including Recruiting, Engineering leadership, HR Business Partners, Finance, and Legal. Partner effectively to secure necessary resources, align program goals with business needs, and ensure widespread support and buy-in for emerging talent initiatives.

• Optimize Budget & Resource Allocation: Oversee program budgets, working closely with Program Managers and Finance to ensure responsible allocation of resources, maximize ROI, and identify opportunities for cost efficiency without compromising program quality.

• Champion Continuous Improvement: Utilize comprehensive program data (e.g., conversion rates, satisfaction scores, retention data, cost-per-hire) to conduct in-depth analysis. Identify program gaps, scale successful initiatives, eliminate ineffective practices, and continuously iterate to enhance program design and delivery.

• Elevate Program Impact & Reputation: Work with Program Managers to ensure that Intern, New Grad, and Veteran experiences are consistently high-quality, impactful, and reflective of Anduril's innovative culture. Drive strategies that build trust with hiring managers, fostering active participation and advocacy for the programs.

• Strategic Event Oversight: Provide strategic guidance and oversight to the Program Manager responsible for event strategy, ensuring that all emerging talent events effectively attract, engage, and convert top technical talent, aligning with the broader university relations and talent acquisition goals.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in talent acquisition, HR, or program management, with at least 4+ years directly managing high-performing teams responsible for early career or emerging talent programs (Intern, New Grad, Veteran programs).

• Demonstrated expertise in building, coaching, and developing Program Managers or senior individual contributors to achieve strategic objectives.

• Proven track record of designing, implementing, and scaling complex emerging talent programs in a fast-moving, technical, or defense/aerospace environment.

• Strong operational acumen with the ability to set priorities, define operating rhythms, and ensure high-quality execution at scale.

• Exceptional data analysis and interpretation skills, with experience using metrics (conversion, retention, satisfaction, cost, throughput) to drive strategic decisions and continuous improvement.

• Superior stakeholder management and influencing skills, capable of building trust and collaboration with senior leadership, engineering managers, and cross-functional partners.

• Experience managing program budgets and optimizing resource allocation to achieve maximum impact.

• A strategic mindset, capable of identifying gaps, proactively solving problems, and translating high-level vision into actionable plans for your team.

• Comfort operating in ambiguous environments, adapting to change, and leading through periods of hyper-growth.

• Deep passion for Anduril's mission and a commitment to attracting and developing world-class technical talent

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.

• Experience with talent acquisition technologies and HRIS systems relevant to program management.

• Prior experience working within or closely with the defense, aerospace, or national security sectors.

US Salary Range

$183,000—$243,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Manager / Associate Director of Client Services
jobs.description:
A Rare Opportunity to Shape the Future of Genomics

Join a team of brilliant, passionate innovators determined to transform healthcare. At BillionToOne, we've built a category-defining, publicly traded company on Nasdaq where transparency fuels trust, collaboration drives breakthroughs, and every contribution moves the needle on our mission to make life-changing diagnostics accessible to all. We don't just aim for incremental improvements; we build products that are 10x better than anything that exists today.

Our scientists, engineers, sales executives, and visionaries are united by an unwavering commitment to changing the standard of care in prenatal and cancer diagnostics. This is where cutting-edge science meets human compassion, and every innovation you contribute helps remove the fear of the unknown from some of life's most critical medical moments.

If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

We are looking for a Senior Manager / Associate Director, Client Services, Prenatal to lead client service teams in a diagnostic laboratory environment. This role is part of a broader Client Services organization. Final title and level will be determined based on the candidate's experience and interview performance.

This leader plays a critical role in delivering efficient, high-quality client and patient support for our Unity non-invasive prenatal screening test. The team handles inbound and outbound communications and tickets from patients, clients, and internal teams. You will maintain customer satisfaction and drive continuous improvement across the organization. This is a full-time onsite position and reports to the Director of Client Services and Inside Sales.

Working hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM PT.

Role Levels:

• Senior Manager: Leads a team of up to 12, including a Lead/Supervisor, and is heavily involved in day-to-day operations, including escalations, coaching, quality, and daily performance against KPIs.

• Associate Director: Owns a broader scope, managing established managers across functions that impact the patient experience and leading larger strategic initiatives for the Client Services organization.

Responsibilities:

• Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and motivate the Client Services team (Senior Manager: up to 12 team members, including a Lead/Supervisor; Associate Director: established managers and their teams). Set performance goals, conduct semi-annual performance evaluations, and coach team members to improve individual and team performance.

• Customer Support: Manage and resolve escalated inquiries, issues, and complaints related to our screening test or patient results. Respond to customers promptly and accurately by phone, email, or Slack, and maintain high customer satisfaction and a positive patient experience.

• Troubleshooting: Partner with technical teams and key stakeholders to resolve complex customer, operational, and technical issues in a timely manner. Equip the team with the knowledge and resources to diagnose and troubleshoot problems, and demonstrate proficiency with our proprietary digital tools to continuously improve the user experience.

• Process Improvement: Continuously review and improve customer service standard operating procedures (SOPs) and policies to increase efficiency and productivity. Analyze customer feedback and performance metrics to identify opportunities and implement improvements.

• Training and Development: Develop training programs and materials, and lead regular training sessions and workshops, so representatives have the product knowledge, technical skills, and customer service techniques they need.

• Reporting and Analysis: Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as response time, average speed to answer, first-call resolution, and customer satisfaction. Prepare regular reports and present findings and recommended actions to senior management.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with Sales, Marketing, and Product Development to relay customer feedback, address product issues, and contribute to product and service improvements. Build strong working relationships and promote a customer-centric culture across the organization.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, life sciences, healthcare administration, or a related field.

• Senior Manager: Minimum of 5 years of total experience, including at least 3 years in a people management role.

• Associate Director: Minimum of 8 years of total experience, including at least 5 years in people management and experience leading managers.

• Experience in a diagnostics laboratory, life sciences, or prenatal multi-customer-facing environment preferred.

• Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and motivate a high-performing team.

• Experience interviewing, hiring, and building out a strong customer service team.

• Experience holding 1:1s with team members and delivering performance appraisals.

• Ability to work in a very fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills; ability to effectively tailor messages to different audiences, both internally and externally.

• Passion for creating a delightful experience for internal and external customers.

• Forward-thinking, with an innate ability to break down and de-escalate complex situations with little or no guidance.

• Proven track record in a customer service management role; excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting capabilities.

• Proficiency in customer relationship management systems and tools, particularly Salesforce Lightning.

• Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to analyze and interpret KPI metrics.

Benefits And Perks:

• Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients

• Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings

• The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousands patients

• Multiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%

• Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)

• Supplemental fertility benefits coverage

• Retirement savings program including a 4% Company match

• Increase paid time off with increased tenure

• Latest and greatest hardware (laptop, lab equipment, facilities)

• Daily on-site lunches provided from top eateries

• A variety of perks on campus (state of the art gym, restaurant)

• Free on-site EV charging (compatible with all EVs, including Tesla)

At BillionToOne, we are proud to offer a combination of a (1) base pay range (actual amount offered is based on experience and salary/equity options split that the candidate chooses) (2) generous equity options offering, on top of (3) industry leading company benefits (free healthcare options, 401k match, very generous fully paid paternal leave etc.).

Senior Manager: The base salary range for this role is $174,068 to $184,947. This position is eligible for an annual bonus and receives a new hire equity grant of up to $90,000 at grant value, vesting over four years, plus annual equity refresh grants equal in value to the new hire grant. Together, the total four-year value of base, target bonus, and equity is up to approximately $1.1 million. We also offer competitive medical and dental coverage and a 401(k) with company match.

Associate Director: The base salary range for this role is $184,947 to $195,826. This position is eligible for an annual bonus and receives a new hire equity grant of up to $105,000 at grant value, vesting over four years, plus annual equity refresh grants equal in value to the new hire grant. Together, the total four-year value of base, target bonus, and equity is up to approximately $1.2 million. We also offer competitive medical and dental coverage and a 401(k) with company match.

BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.

BillionToOne is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to make powerful, accurate diagnostic tests accessible to everyone. Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.

Our Impact

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.
Unity Confirm™ enables non-invasive confirmation for high-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne’s Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.
Our Northstar® liquid biopsy test uniquely combines treatment selection with real-time monitoring, giving oncologists unprecedented precision in cancer care.

Our Growth

From $0 to $400M+ annualized revenue run-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.

Our Recognition

Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers for 2025 and we're Great Place to Work certified, with 100% of our people willing to go the extra mile, even as we've scaled to over 700 employees.

Our Future

Headquartered in Menlo Park with facilities in Union City, CA, and a new lab opening in Austin, TX in 2027, we're continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible in molecular diagnostics. We're just getting started.

Ready to help us change the world, one molecule at a time? Learn more at billiontoone.com

jobs.title: Art Director (Temp)
jobs.description:
Sphere Entertainment Co. is a leader in immersive experiences, technology and media. The Company includes Sphere, an experiential medium powered by advanced technologies. The first Sphere opened in Las Vegas, with a second venue planned for Abu Dhabi. In addition, the Company includes MSG Networks, which operates two regional sports and entertainment networks, MSG Network and MSG Sportsnet, as well as a direct-to-consumer and authenticated streaming product, MSG+, delivering a wide range of live sports content and other programming. More information is available at www.sphereentertainmentco.com.

*This is a temporary role with a full-time schedule (40 hours per week).

Who are we hiring?

The ideal candidate is a proven creative with exemplary aesthetics, design and storytelling skills that thrive on the challenge of creating dynamic content for new formats. What will you do?

• Demonstrated creative and design excellence with career progression in your portfolio

jobs.title: Senior Network Planner
jobs.location: New York, NY / Sunnyvale, CA / San Francisco, CA / Bellevue, WA
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

We are seeking an experienced, highly motivated Senior Network Planner to join our Infrastructure Capacity – Backbone Network & Connectivity team. You will independently own the strategic planning, procurement, and management of our core network connectivity, keeping it expanding, reliable, and efficient. You will play a lead role in growing our backbone network, including our international (EMEA/APAC) carrier and fiber footprint. You will also set the technical and commercial bar for other planners and mentor team members as we scale.

Key Responsibilities:

• Capacity Procurement: Own the end-to-end evaluation and procurement of new backbone network capacity (wavelength and dark fiber) between locations. This includes independently negotiating commercial terms with telecommunications vendors and carriers, in line with business requirements and network growth forecasts.

• Solution Review & Design: Independently review and approve proposed capacity solutions from vendors, setting the technical bar for fit, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to network design principles. Own circuit diversity standards across your sites or region to strengthen network resilience and minimize single points of failure.

• Capacity Management: Own capacity management across multiple sites or a full region. Monitor utilization proactively, spot bottlenecks early, and drive multi-quarter upgrade or reconfiguration plans instead of reacting to exhaustion as it happens.

• Network Planning & Forecasting: Own long-term capacity forecasts for the backbone and edge network, incorporating cross-regional trends and technological advances. Turn forecasts into actionable, multi-site expansion plans that Capacity, Supply Chain, and Construction can plan against.

• Vendor Relationship Management: Own strategic vendor and carrier relationships. Independently negotiate favorable commercial terms and set the technical and commercial evaluation standards other planners use to assess vendor proposals.

• Technical Documentation: Establish and maintain documentation standards for network designs, circuit inventory, capacity utilization, and planning activities across the broader planning team.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Represent Network Backbone & Connectivity in cross-functional planning forums, aligning Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Construction, and Product teams on expansion plans. Provide technical guidance that shapes how those teams carry out network expansions.

• Mentorship & Process Ownership: Mentor and guide other Network Planners, including region-focused planners. Continuously refine the team’s processes for carrier evaluation, forecasting, and documentation as the backbone team scales.

• Problem Solving: Independently resolve complex, often ambiguous technical and commercial issues related to network capacity, diversity, and performance. Escalate only the highest-stakes trade-offs, not routine decisions.

• Industry Trends: Track emerging network technologies, industry best practices, and vendor roadmaps. Turn them into forward-looking recommendations that shape the team’s backbone strategy, beyond your own planning work.

• International Carrier & Fiber Strategy: Apply deep, hands-on knowledge of international carrier markets (EMEA and/or APAC) and the fiber/subsea landscape to independently lead regional backbone expansion tied to CoreWeave’s global growth. Represent CoreWeave directly in carrier and vendor negotiations for these regions.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Proven experience (typically 7+ years) in backbone network planning for large-scale telecommunications, hyperscaler, data center colocation, or cloud/content networks, including senior-level ownership of complex, multi-site or multi-region initiatives.

• Extensive, hands-on experience with wavelength (DWDM/coherent optics) and dark fiber-based network solutions, including independently negotiating commercial terms with vendors and carriers.

• Demonstrated experience independently leading network capacity forecasting, management, and optimization across multiple sites or regions, not just a single site or project.

• Deep understanding of network architecture principles (redundancy, diversity, and resilience), with a track record of improving how a team evaluates and designs for them, not just applying existing standards.

• Direct experience with international carrier markets (EMEA and/or APAC) and the fiber/subsea landscape, including representing the company in carrier negotiations for these regions.

• Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to less-senior planners or engineers.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to navigate ambiguity and make high-stakes decisions with limited guidance.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to represent the team in cross-functional and leadership-level discussions.

• Ability to manage multiple concurrent, often cross-regional projects and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in network planning tools and software (e.g., GIS systems, FiberLocator, capacity management platforms).

• Experience with specific vendor equipment (e.g., Ciena, Nokia, Infinera, Cisco).

• Knowledge of IP routing and switching principles.

• Familiarity with network automation concepts.

• Experience formally mentoring or training junior planners or engineers.

• Experience presenting network planning or capacity topics in executive-facing forums (e.g., MBR/S&OP).

• Formal negotiation or vendor-management training or certification.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization’s growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $157,000 to $210,000. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

jobs.title: Sr. Financial Analyst
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States; South San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

• We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

• We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.

• We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.

• We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

The Sr. Financial Analyst is a highly analytical, detail-oriented role at the intersection of finance, financial systems, data, and business analytics. This individual will support and enhance our Financial Systems capabilities while developing the breadth of skills and business knowledge needed to contribute across Sales Operations and Business Analytics as organizational needs evolve. The ideal candidate understands not only how financial data moves through systems, but why the numbers make sense, how changes affect upstream and downstream processes, and how high-quality data enables better business decisions. This is a hybrid role with a strong preference for candidates located near either our South San Francisco or San Diego office and able to work in the office approximately 2–3 days per week, supporting close collaboration across Finance, Accounting, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, IT, and other stakeholders.

• Develop a deep understanding of Veracyte’s financial master data, including its structure, business purpose, dependencies, and upstream and downstream impacts across financial reporting and business processes.

• Support Financial Systems activities, including system administration, data maintenance, reporting, testing, issue resolution, enhancements, and ongoing process improvement.

• Perform detailed tie-outs and reconciliations across reports, systems, source data, and financial outputs, investigating differences through resolution rather than relying solely on system results.

• Understand the flow of financial information across ERP, planning, reporting, and analytical environments and assess how changes to data, business rules, hierarchies, or master data may affect dependent processes.

• Support month-end, quarter-end, forecasting, budgeting, and other financial reporting processes where Financial Systems expertise and data validation are required.

• Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, IT, and other stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into scalable data, reporting, and systems solutions.

• Participate in system implementations, enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and testing, with particular attention to data integrity and the downstream consequences of system or configuration changes.

• Use AI and emerging technologies thoughtfully to improve analysis, validation, documentation, and process efficiency while maintaining appropriate financial controls and human review.

• Thrive in a rapidly changing environment and navigate ambiguity with confidence, using sound judgment to establish priorities, identify the right stakeholders, assess potential impacts, and move work forward even when requirements or solutions are not fully defined. Remain flexible as business needs, systems, data, and technologies evolve.

• Develop knowledge of Sales Operations and Business Analytics data models, metrics, and reporting needs, creating flexibility for the role to support cross-functional analytical priorities as business needs evolve.

Who You Are:

You are someone who is equally comfortable asking, “Does this number tie?” and “Does this number make sense?” You enjoy getting into the details of financial data, tracing information through interconnected systems, and understanding the consequences of a change before it is made. You are eager to learn how the business operates and understand not only what the numbers are, but what they mean for the organization and its decisions. You are curious about emerging technology and see AI as a tool to complement sound financial judgment, strong controls, and thoughtful analysis. You may not have worked in every system or mastered every technology listed below, and that’s okay. We value people who learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions, care deeply about getting the details right, and are motivated to expand their capabilities across financial systems, analytics, and the broader business.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

• Relevant experience working with financial systems, financial reporting, financial data, business systems, analytics, or a closely related function.

• Strong understanding of financial data across accounting, reporting, master data, business processes, and enterprise systems, paired with attention to detail and broader business acumen.

• Demonstrated ability to reconcile, validate, and trace financial data across systems and processes while evaluating the upstream and downstream impacts of data, configuration, reporting, and process changes.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to recognize when results are mathematically correct but do not logically make sense from a financial or business perspective.

• AI-forward mindset with curiosity about how AI can responsibly improve financial analysis, systems processes, data quality, and business analytics.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial and technical concepts clearly to different audiences.

• Ability to independently investigate issues, identify root causes, evaluate impacts, and drive problems toward resolution.

• A continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to question existing approaches while maintaining disciplined financial controls and data integrity.

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior hands-on experience with one or more enterprise financial platforms such as Oracle ERP, SAP ERP, TM1, Cognos or comparable ERP, consolidation, planning, and financial reporting systems.

• Experience supporting enterprise financial master data and reporting systems, including hierarchies, mappings, chart of accounts, data governance, system administration, implementations, integrations, upgrades, testing, and process transformation.

• Exposure to Sales Operations, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or enterprise business analytics.

• Experience working with reporting and analytical tools, large interconnected datasets, and data querying, transformation, visualization, automation, or related technologies that complement financial systems experience.

• Practical experience using AI-enabled tools to accelerate analysis, research, documentation, validation, or process improvement, combined with an understanding that financial outputs require appropriate review and judgment.

• Experience operating in a life sciences, biotechnology, diagnostics, healthcare, or other highly regulated and data-intensive environment.

• Ability to work in a hybrid environment, with a preference for candidates able to be onsite in either South San Francisco or San Diego approximately 2–3 days per week.

#LI-Hybrid

For candidates based in our San Diego office, the range is $112,000 - $135,000.

For candidates based in our South San Francisco office, the range is $117,000 - $141,700.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range

$112,000—$141,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter).

jobs.title: Senior Treasury Analyst
jobs.description:
About Triumph

Triumph operates a digital platform for physical collectibles and an arcade-style mobile gaming business. Our flagship app ranks among the top in the gaming category on the App Store, with hundreds of thousands of monthly active users and hundreds of millions of games played. Money moves through the business at real scale: billions of dollars in volume each year, across multiple banks and payment processors.

Position Overview

We're hiring our first Senior Treasury Analyst to own Triumph's day-to-day cash operations. You'll know where every dollar sits across our banks and payment processors, run our weekly cash reporting, and help build the treasury controls a company of our size needs. You'll report to the VP, Accounting & Corporate Controller and work closely with Accounting, Strategic Finance, and our banking partners. As our first treasury hire, you'll be expected to make sound calls on your own when something breaks, and to know when to escalate. Money moves 7 days a week, so the role includes some weekend coverage.

Key Responsibilities

 - Daily cash positioning. Track balances and activity across our bank accounts and payment processors every day, and make sure each account is funded for payroll, vendor payments, inventory purchases, and player payouts.

 - Weekly cash reporting. Own the weekly cash flow report: classify inflows and outflows, explain week-over-week movements, and tie the reported position to the banks. Provide actuals to Strategic Finance for the rolling 13-week cash forecast.

 - Processor settlements and reserves. Track settlements, reserves, and holdbacks at each payment processor, resolve delays and discrepancies, and keep operating cash clearly separated from player balances.

 - Payments and bank operations. Prepare and coordinate wires and ACH payments within our approval workflow. Administer bank portals, user access, and signatories, and manage account openings, closings, and know-your-customer (KYC) requests from banks.

 - Treasury controls and policy. Help design and run controls over cash, including dual approval, callback verification of payment-detail changes, periodic access reviews, and fraud prevention. Optimize account structure for yield, liquidity, and risk.  Draft treasury and investment policies for approval, and document procedures so they hold up in an audit.

 - Investments and banking relationships. Support the investment of excess cash within policy, track yield and bank fees, help evaluate banking partners, and monitor compliance with any credit facility terms.

 - Foreign currency. Manage currency needs for international vendors and contractors.

 - Automation and systems. Automate data pulls and cash reconciliations, and help shape treasury requirements for our NetSuite implementation.

 - Audit and ad hoc support. Support external audit requests on cash and prepare treasury analysis for finance leadership.

Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

 - 4-7 years of experience in corporate treasury, cash management, or a closely related finance role, ideally at a fintech, payments, marketplace, or other high-transaction-volume company.

 - Hands-on experience with daily cash positioning across multiple bank accounts, and with wires, ACH, and bank portals.

 - Working knowledge of payment processor settlement flows, reserves, and reconciliations.

 - Working SQL skills for pulling payment and balance data, plus advanced Excel.

 - Sound judgment under pressure: you can resolve a cash issue on a weekend and explain the call on Monday.

 - A controls mindset: you understand why the person who moves money should not be the one who reconciles it.

 - Clear, confident communication with banks, vendors, and internal teams.

 - Experience with stablecoin or on-chain payment flows strongly preferred.

 - In office 5 days a week in San Franscisco HQ

Nice to Have

 - Python or similar for automating data work.

 - Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) designation, or progress toward it.

 - Experience with skill-based gaming, digital wallets, or consumer payments.

 - Experience with Ramp, NetSuite, or QuickBooks Online.

Why Triumph?

 - Build the treasury function at a profitable, fast-growing company, with direct visibility to finance leadership.

 - Broad exposure to banking, payments, and controls that would take years to get at a larger company.

 - A passionate team that is proud of our work.

 - Competitive salary and benefits (healthcare, vision, dental, 401(k), and more).

Triumph Labs, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on any basis protected by law. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in line with the California Fair Chance Act and applicable local ordinances.
