The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the role: 
We are seeking a talented AP Accountant with experience in high-growth environments to own the end-to-end accounts payable function. The ideal candidate will bring strong operational expertise in accounts payable, a process-improvement mindset, and a collaborative approach.

This role will work closely with the Finance and GL  teams, as well as cross-functionally with departments such as Hardware, Manufacturing, and Legal, to ensure that our AP processes are efficient, accurate, and scalable.

Location: This role will be based out of our San Mateo office and requires 3 days a week in office.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

Invoice and Expense Management

 - Accurately enter invoices into the accounting system (Coupa) after confirming proper authorization

 - Process invoices promptly and in accordance with vendor payment terms

 - Review the AP aging report weekly and resolve past-due invoices

 - Reconcile assigned vendor statements promptly to maintain account accuracy

 - Review and approve employee travel and expense (T&E) reports for payment

 - Investigate and resolve discrepancies by coordinating with internal departments and vendors to address missing documentation, invoice issues, or purchase order variances

Month-End Close

 - Review account reconciliations for AP-related close items

 - Prepare month-end accruals with appropriate supporting documentation

 - Complete monthly balance sheet reconciliations accurately and on schedule

 - Assist with monthly and quarterly vendor flux and other balance sheet income statement fluxes

Process Improvement and Special Projects

 - Identify and implement improvements that streamline workflows and increase the accuracy of accounts payable processes

 - Monitor ERP system activity to ensure accurate invoice postings between the GL and accounts payable subledger, including Coupa

 - Collaborate with the Business Systems team to troubleshoot and resolve system-related issues

What Makes You a Good Fit:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

 - At least two years of relevant accounts payable experience

 - Experience scaling processes at high-growth companies, preferably hardware startups

 - Proficiency with ERP systems and automated accounts payable workflow platforms, such as Coupa, NetSuite, and Ramp

 - Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with employees, vendors, and all levels of management

 - Demonstrated initiative and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision

 - A problem-solving mindset and a strong sense of ownership from start to finish

Why Join Us?

At Skydio, you’ll help shape the future of autonomous flight technology. You’ll work alongside world-class engineers and domain experts, and you’ll be given ownership and autonomy to grow into a leadership role. We offer competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and an opportunity to make a tangible impact in an industry poised for massive growth.

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $80,000 - $100,000. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinary Assistant - Brentwood, MO
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

VEG is a rapidly growing emergency company with hospital locations across the United States. Our mission is helping people and their pets when they need it most. We are revolutionizing emergency medicine with a “customer first” mentality and a true, employee-centric work environment.

TALENT + CULTURE AT VEG

At VEG, we want people and their pets to feel safe, secure, and valued; we want our employees to feel the same way. What we’re aiming to achieve on the customer side is equivalent in nature to what we want for our employees: to have the best experience possible. With the highest NPS score in our industry, we’re ready to ensure that VEG remains the place where the best and brightest in the emergency world not only want to work, but stay and grow. For our customers and their pets, we strive to find a way to say, “yes.” We do the same and more for our teams. In fact, VEG is one of this year’s nominees for INC Magazine’s Best Places to Work!

WHO WE NEED

You are passionate and motivated. You value learning and are a team player that is honest and respectful to your peers. You love what you do. You love working with animals and people. You are comfortable adapting to new scenarios, willing to learn new techniques, and think outside the box. You have excellent interpersonal capabilities across a diverse group. You’re happy to pitch in wherever and whenever you are needed, with a positive attitude. You demonstrate the ability to accomplish assigned tasks for all areas involved, knowing when to ask for assistance. You display excellent communication skills with your peers, customers, and team.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO DO

• Treat each patient and customer with the highest level of compassion and care.

• Perform basic to intermediate nursing care tasks, patient monitoring, and treatments.

• Use understanding of common diseases and conditions, physical assessment, and monitoring parameters to accurately triage incoming patients.

• Administer subcutaneous, intramuscular, and intravenous medications and understand potential adverse effects of medications.

• Set-up, monitor, and administer intravenous fluid therapy including constant rate infusions and blood transfusion therapy.

• Contribute as a team member to incoming outpatient care and ongoing inpatient care.

• Participate in giving and receiving patient rounds to ensure continuity of care.

• Be trained to properly perform all aspects of CPR as a RECOVER Certified Rescuer.

• Collect samples and perform diagnostic tests including in-house and point-of-care tests and diagnostic imaging.

• Assist in setting-up, performing, monitoring sedation and surgical anesthesia with LVT or DVM supervision.

• Perform nursing care tasks such as placing and maintaining urinary catheters and nasal oxygen tubes, and

• Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot oxygen cages and other oxygen administration techniques.

• Work alongside licensed veterinary technicians as a vital member of the nursing care team.

• Obtain additional training along guided growth pathways offering roles in addition to direct nursing care such as veterinary technician credentialing, trainer role, community outreach, and leadership.

Veterinary Assistants can additionally (where permitted by law):

• Administer, monitor, and maintain patients under general anesthesia with or without mechanical ventilation for patients with varied levels of risk.

• Perform advanced vascular access techniques including jugular catheter placement, sampling line placement, central line placement, intraosseous catheterization, and arterial catheterization.

• Perform advanced diagnostic techniques including ultrasonography and paracentesis,

• Participate in formulating treatment, anesthetic, and nursing care plans.

• Obtain additional training along guided growth pathways offering roles in addition to direct nursing care such as a trainer role, coordination of care, community outreach, and leadership.

WHY YOU SHOULD CHOOSE US

Because emergency is all we do, so we do it best! We also offer:

• Industry-leading‌ ‌compensation‌

• We build our hospitals from scratch. You’ll be using all of the latest equipment and technology.

• Generous employee pet discount

• Referral rewards - tell your friends why they should come work for VEG too!

• Health‌, Vision, and Dental ‌Insurance‌ ‌ ‌

• 401K‌ ‌w/‌ ‌company‌ ‌match‌ ‌ ‌

• Paid‌ ‌parental‌ ‌leave‌ ‌-‌ ‌up to 12 ‌weeks‌ ‌of‌ ‌paid‌ ‌leave‌ ‌at‌ ‌100%‌ ‌of‌ ‌regular‌ ‌salary‌ ‌

• Unlimited‌ ‌Continuing Education opportunities - we want to help you grow in your career!

• Flexible‌ ‌work‌ ‌schedules‌ ‌for‌ ‌a‌ ‌true‌ ‌work-life‌ ‌balance‌ ‌ ‌

• Growth‌ ‌potential‌ ‌ ‌

• Groceries‌ ‌sent‌ ‌to the hospitals weekly for the staff to enjoy,‌ ‌monthly‌ ‌and‌ ‌quarterly‌ ‌contests,‌ ‌quarterly‌ ‌hospital‌ ‌outings,‌ company-wide retreats,‌ ‌etc!‌ ‌

• Lastly, because while our work is serious, we believe that it should also be fun!

VEG celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. You've found the equal opportunity employer you are looking for. We can't wait to meet you!

jobs.title: Director of Customer Experience
jobs.description:
ABOUT RED OAK

Red Oak builds compliance software for financial services firms.

Our vision: We become the compliance layer every Financial Services firm runs on.

Today, we serve 19 of the top 20 global asset managers, including BlackRock, Vanguard, PIMCO, and Morgan Stanley, alongside 1,550+ regulated firms. Our customers report $95–101T in combined AUM.


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Customer Experience is why Red Oak wins. Our NPS of 64 isn't a nice-to-have metric — it's the reason clients choose us and keep choosing us, and it's the foundation of our retention and satisfaction numbers. This role exists to protect that.

You'll bring Implementation and Support together as one unified Customer Experience function — one strategy, one bar for quality, one clear escalation path. And you're doing it at a pivotal moment: as we bring two customer bases that have each been served differently onto one model, you'll need to preserve the high-touch experience that earned that NPS score while moving fast to build the structure that lets it scale across a much bigger, more complex customer base. We serve everyone from SMB to large Enterprise, and each needs its own model — without the experience ever slipping.

Why now: the hard part of the merger — stabilizing two teams, two systems, two ways of working — is behind us. We're moving into BAU, which means we're ready to stop just integrating and start building again. You're not walking into a rescue mission; you're walking into a blank page with real resources and real momentum behind it. It's a genuinely exciting time to join.

High ownership. High ambiguity. High impact.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Implementation and Support run as one function, not two — shared goals, one handoff, one accountable owner for anything that crosses the line.

 - Time-to-value drops, especially for Enterprise — tighter sequencing turns onboarding from a bottleneck into a differentiator.

 - SMB and Enterprise are served on models built for each — lighter-touch and self-serve at the low end, high-touch where it counts, without either feeling like an afterthought.

 - Support's scope is clear and escalations into Engineering fall, as customers self-serve more through the platform and knowledge base.

 - AI is doing real work, not window dressing — ticket triage, resolution, and onboarding scale through automation, and headcount stops being the default answer to growth.

 - NPS holds at 64+ as we scale — proof the merger strengthened the experience instead of diluting it.

 - Team leads are coached, growing, and running an org structure built for how the business actually works now.


THE ROLE

You'll own the post-sale client journey end to end, across a book that spans self-serve digital accounts up through complex Enterprise implementations. You'll spend your early days figuring out how your teams should be structured to serve that range well, then build toward a model that keeps our service quality high without requiring it to be entirely hands-on.

 - Own the end-to-end post-sale client experience across Implementation and Support, setting one strategy and one standard for both functions rather than letting them run as silos

 - Manage Implementation and Support leadership, setting priorities, coaching, and resourcing both teams as you determine the right organizational structure

 - Define and hold both functions accountable to shared metrics — implementation timelines and time-to-value, support response and resolution times, and client satisfaction

 - Build a single, clear escalation path for issues that cross the Implementation/Support boundary, so complex client problems have one accountable owner

 - Clarify the actual scope of support versus customer success — and re-align where necessary so each team is doing the work it's built for

 - Use AI to scale service without losing quality — extending ticket triage and resolution automation, and building toward self-serve onboarding for our digital customer base

 - Tighten onboarding sequencing to shorten time-to-value for Enterprise accounts, while scaling a lighter-touch model for the high-volume digital/self-serve base

 - Partner with Customer Success on handoff quality from Implementation into steady-state, and with Product and Engineering on structural issues surfaced through Support

 - Represent Customer Experience at the leadership level on retention risk and expansion readiness tied to onboarding and support quality


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 8+ years' experience in post-sale functions, including 5+ years leading Implementation, Support, or Customer Experience teams, with direct experience managing team leads or managers

 - Strong SaaS background — you understand what it takes to scale a service organization without breaking the experience that got you there

 - Experience navigating organizational change, ideally post-merger or post-acquisition — you know how to figure out where teams should sit and how to bring people along with the change

 - A track record improving time-to-value and reducing escalations through process

 - Hands-on experience deploying AI and automation in support or onboarding — you've architected ticket triage, resolution, or self-serve systems yourself. This is a builder mandate, not an adopter one.

 - Clear, direct communication — you can set a shared standard across two teams that haven't operated under one leader before

 - A bias toward figuring things out — this role starts with more open questions than answers, and you'll be expected to build the structure

 - Nice to have: experience serving Enterprise accounts alongside a high-volume digital/self-serve motion


BENEFITS

 - Equity units via EOP (Employee Ownership Plan): share in what we're building

 - Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision

 - 401(k) with a 3% company contribution

 - 20 days PTO annually, plus your birthday off and paid sick leave

 - Enhanced family leave

 - Life insurance


HOW WE WORK

We move fast and expect you to build structure where none exists yet. You'll get real autonomy and real ownership from day one, and we expect you to use AI as a first resort in how you build and scale your team's work.


WORK STRUCTURE

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

Location: Austin HQ — hybrid, in office Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday

Red Oak is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager, Commercial
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. The Senior Marketing Manager is responsible for driving brand awareness, demand, and building pipeline for Fivetran in the Commercial business segment. This role will support sales teams in North America through impactful, multi- touch marketing programs and execution. The ideal candidate is a results-driven professional with expertise in B2B lead generation within the small-to-medium business segment.

This is a full-time hybrid position based in our Denver, Austin, Philadelphia, Oakland or New York City office.

Technologies You’ll Use

DemandBase, Webflow, Marketo, Sendoso, SFDC, Chat GPT, Claude, and Looker.

What You’ll Do

• Develop and execute a comprehensive regional marketing strategy to drive brand awareness, demand, and pipeline.

• Work closely with teams across marketing to formulate and execute targeted, multi-channel demand generation programs, using a mix of inbound and outbound marketing tactics

• Manage program execution for influencer marketing, email marketing, events, sales plays and more.

• Partner with sales to prioritize top prospect accounts and develop targeted 1:few and 1:1 ABM campaigns that build awareness, increase engagement, create new opportunities, and accelerate pipeline progression.

• Plan and execute 1:few regional events, including executive dinners, networking events, and partner programs, tailored to deepen relationships with key decision-makers at prospect accounts.

• Work closely with sales to ensure a seamless handoff of qualified leads, enabling speed-to-lead and effective sales follow-up to drive conversion rates.

• Closely monitor KPIs and metrics to measure program effectiveness and progress to targets.

• Collaborate with product marketing to develop relevant messaging, positioning, and segment-specific content plans.

• Build and maintain relationships with cross-functional teams, vendors, agencies, and strategic partners to foster positive relationships and drive results.

Skills We’re Looking For

• 5+ years experience in B2B marketing with a focus on the commercial business market

• Proven track record of success in developing and executing lead generation programs within the commercial market.

• Event management experience.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across internal and external stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Data-driven approach with a knack for translating data insights into actionable marketing strategies.

Perks and Benefits

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

jobs.title: Manager, Design
jobs.description:
The Position

CallRail is looking for an experienced, hands-on Manager of Design to manage and execute brand design across all marketing touchpoints. In this role, you’ll be responsible for maintaining the visual identity of our brand, overseeing a team of talented designers, both in-house and freelance, and partnering closely with cross-functional teams to bring our brand to life in meaningful, consistent, and compelling ways.

This role requires a balance of hands-on design execution and team management. You’ll own design projects from concept through execution, manage team workloads and priorities, and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to ensure high-quality creative work.

This role will report directly to the Senior Manager of Content and Creative. This is a hybrid role based in Atlanta, GA, requiring in-office attendance 3 days per week.

What You'll Do

• Brand Design & Execution: Accountable for the visual brand identity, ensuring consistency, creativity, and clarity across all channels. Oversee brand design across campaigns, web landing pages, product launches, and marketing initiatives. Review, contribute to, and approve visual assets to maintain brand excellence.

• Team Management: Manage and mentor a single in-house brand designer while coordinating work across a network of freelance creatives. Foster a collaborative, inclusive design culture across internal and external partners, ensuring alignment and quality across all work.

• Hands-On Design: Own and execute design projects from campaign creative to brand system updates, maintaining an active design workload alongside team management responsibilities.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing partners to align brand expression with business goals. Manage stakeholder feedback while bringing a perspective and point of view.

• Brand Governance: Own and maintain brand guidelines, ensuring the system is scalable, flexible, and well-documented for internal and external partners.

• Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external creative partners, including freelance designers, animators, illustrators, and others as needed.

• Design Operations: Oversee project scoping, prioritization, and resourcing to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget.

• AI & Design Innovation: Explore and leverage AI-powered design tools to improve creative workflows, increase efficiency, and support high-quality design execution.

What You'll Need

• 5+ years of experience in brand design, with at least 2+ years in a management role

• A strong portfolio showcasing a range of brand work—from brand systems to large-scale campaigns

• Experience building and maintaining design systems and brand guidelines

• Proven ability to manage designers and provide constructive feedback

• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to balance hands-on design responsibilities, team management, and competing priorities

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills

• Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite & Figma

• Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, preferably in a SaaS organization

• Experience designing responsive web and landing page designs in Figma within established UX layouts, with a strong understanding of web design best practices

If you do not meet all the requirements listed, we still encourage you to apply! No job description is perfect, and we may also have another opportunity that aligns with your skills and experience.

Additional Perks

• Healthcare (one option covered at 100% for employees), Dental & Vision Coverage

• Competitive HSA with company matching

• Paid parental leave

• Flexible vacation policy

• 401K options with company dollar-for-dollar match

• Employee stock options available from day one

• $2,000 annual educational allowance

• Catered lunch every Tuesday * an in-office perk

• MARTA transportation or office parking expenses covered

• Employee charitable donation company match, up to $500 annually

• Regular company outings and events

• Hybrid work options with $500 office stipend to set up your home office

• Designated bike storage

Learn more: https://www.callrail.com/about/

You Are Welcome Here

CallRail understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company's core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, radicalized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions. In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example - she/her/hers, he/him/his, they/them/theirs, etc).

Continuous adoption of AI technologies is essential to this role. You will be expected to leverage AI platforms to streamline operations, solve complex problems, and stay ahead of industry benchmarks.

*** This position is based out of our Atlanta office. Through December 2026, employees are expected to work in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Beginning in January 2027, CallRail will transition to a 3 day hybrid work model. Employees will work in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays.

jobs.title: Medical Assistant - Mason, OH
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Medical Assistant plays a pivotal role in supporting dermatology physicians by delivering high-quality patient care. Responsibilities include patient rooming, updating medical histories, documenting visit details, and assisting with various dermatological procedures such as biopsies, surgeries, and skin treatments.

Essential Functions:

To perform effectively in this role, the candidate must fulfill the following duties with or without reasonable accommodations:

• Collaborate with a team to manage an average patient volume of up to 40 patients daily.

• Document patient histories, including history of present illness (HPI), medical, surgical, and family history, medications, and allergies.

• Prepare and assist with dermatological and cosmetic procedures, including ED&Cs, biopsies (shave and punch), ILK, I&D, Botox, laser treatments, excisions, and other surgical interventions.

• Administer local anesthesia and remove sutures as directed.

• Ensure strict adherence to sterile techniques and infection control practices.

• Perform scribing responsibilities, including inputting templates and chart notes as directed by physicians.

• Process prescription refills and manage prior authorizations.

• Log pathology samples and coordinate with appropriate laboratories.

• Operate specialized equipment such as Narrowband UVB and photodynamic therapy units.

• Maintain and replenish liquid nitrogen containers.

• Clean and stock examination rooms and supply areas.

• Ensure adherence to organizational infection control protocols.

• Maintain reliable and consistent attendance.

• Perform other duties as assigned by the supervising physician or department lead.

Knowledge, Skills, & Responsibilities:

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• 3 years of medical assistant experience, preferably in dermatology.

• Medical Assistant Credentials/Certification Required.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate patient records.

• Effective communication and teamwork skills.

• Position requires travel to all other locations to support operational needs.

This role requires a proactive, dependable, and detail-oriented individual with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a dynamic healthcare environment. The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong commitment to patient care and operational excellence.

Physical and Mental Demands:

The physical and mental demands described below are representative of those required to perform this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities:

• Physical Requirements:

• Occasionally required to stand, walk, and sit for extended periods.

• Use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms.

• Occasionally required to climb stairs, balance, stoop, kneel, bend, crouch, or crawl.

• Occasionally lift, push, pull, or move up to 20 pounds.

• Vision Requirements:

• Close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Note:
This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the role. Additional responsibilities may be assigned, or duties modified by the department supervisor based on operational needs.

jobs.title: Director, Site Operations
jobs.description:
The Role

The Director, Site Operations leads all aspects of our plant operations ranging from the cultivation of cannabis through distribution and everything in between.  As the Director, Site Operations, you’ll direct all the daily processes and long-term targets for the facility. You’ll grind away at the details of managing internal resources to maximize safety, compliance, efficiency, productivity and culture. You’ll also blaze the path toward creating and developing the multilevel professional team, and you’ll work closely with your management team to keep every detail of the facility up to standards.

Essential Functions

• Oversee all strategic planning and vision for facility plant operations for cultivation, processing, packaging, maintenance, quality and logistics/fulfillment

• Manager all facility activities working closely with departmental managers ensuring wholesale objectives are accomplished on time and budget

• Own the facility budget; Analyze facility data, including efficiency metrics, labor variance analysis, defect rates, cost drivers, volume and capacity planning, etc. to make recommendations on optimal quality and efficiency improvements and capital expenditures

• Develop and produce reporting to clearly illustrate the trends of the business

• Manage and maintain a company culture consistent with the culture established at Green Thumb corporate of accountability, transparency and enjoyment

• Participate in developing and implementing rules, regulations, policies, and procedures to advance Green Thumb’s mission, vision, goals and objectives

• Continuously improve the skills, knowledge and morale of all employees; create an environment where the entire team does the same

• Implement and maintain wholesale facility and equipment preventative maintenance program; replace, or make adjustments to plant facilities and equipment when necessary

• Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal billing or licensing requirements

• Will be required to be on-call and to respond to emergency situations at any time. This may include scheduling issues, potentially covering a vacant shift, facility issues and/or human resources requirements

• Other duties as assigned

Safety & Compliance

• Be aware of hazards in the workspace.

• Retain and understand department specific training.

• Be compliant with area safety requirements, state regulations and PPE requirements while at GTI sites.

• Follow GMP, biosecurity, sanitation or other quality and compliance requirements.

• Perform record keeping accurately and completely as directed by a lead or supervisor.

• Report and escalate safety & quality concerns.

Working Conditions

• While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to perform reaching, grasping, bending, stooping, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, changing, and challenging environment

• Work involves daily exposure to allergens (such as cannabis, tree nuts, and coconut oil).

• Travel up to 10% may be required

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Business required; MBA or similar preferred

• 10+ years of management experience in manufacturing environment; direct management of 100+ individuals in a manufacturing setting required

• Consumer Packaged Good experience required

• In-depth knowledge & understanding of Lean, Six Sigma, certifications a plus

• Exposure to horticulture and/or plant science and/or lab processing, a plus

• Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience managing a P&L required

• Can-do attitude and ability to adapt quickly; business is experiencing tremendous growth so previous operational experience in growth environment is substantially preferred

• Highly motivated, self-directed, innovative and able to work independently or among teams with keen judgement, common sense and resourcefulness

• Adapts and thrives in a demanding, fast-paced environment

• Possesses a high level of critical thinking

• Operates with a high level of professionalism and integrity, including dealing with confidential information

• Must understand and comply with the rules, regulations, policies, and procedures of Green Thumb

• Must have a solid understanding of the Cannabis laws, rules and regulations and passion to further their understanding and knowledge of the industry and the laws.

Additional Requirements

• Must be at a minimum of 21 years of age.

• Must possess valid state ID.

• Must be able to obtain, and maintain, state badging requirements to work in the cannabis industry (requires background check and state review)

The pay range is competitive and based on experience, qualifications, and/or location of the role. Positions may be eligible for a discretionary annual incentive program driven by organization and individual performance.

Green Thumb Pay Range

$160,000—$190,000 USD

jobs.title: Battery Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Battery Mechanical Engineer, you will conduct the mechanical design, thermal management, and structural analysis of high-voltage and low-voltage battery packs and energy storage modules. The right person for this role has a strong command of mechanical design, thermal runaway mitigation, and structural design principles, as well as a solid handle on structural/thermal FEA tools. If you are someone who is hardware-focused, detail-oriented, and eager to own critical battery hardware from concept through deployment, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Perform CAD design of battery modules, enclosures, structural support frames, and thermal management components.

• Perform finite element analysis (FEA) and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) to evaluate structural and thermal systems, including thermal runaway propagation mitigation.

• Generate, review, and release high-quality engineering drawings and product definitions.

• Collaborate extensively with electrical engineering, battery management systems (BMS) software, and manufacturing teams to integrate cell-level hardware into system-level architectures.

• Support prototyping, environmental testing (vibration, shock, thermal cycling, and penetration testing), and manufacturing operations onsite.

• Own the development of critical battery subsystems from cradle to grave.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience performing mechanical design and analysis of complex hardware, ideally involving battery modules or power systems.

• A bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or similar.

• Prior experience operating advanced CAD software (such as NX or SolidWorks) and FEA/CFD software

• A solid understanding of hardware manufacturability, material selection, and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)

• Strong communication and collaborative skills

• Ability to travel to other Anduril sites, customer sites, or supplier sites as business demand dictates (anticipated 10-25% travel).

• Ability to obtain and hold a U.S. Secret Security Clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Exhibits strong initiative and ownership of complex engineering tasks.

• Experience with NX CAD software and/or Abaqus FEA softwae.

• Direct experience designing lithium-ion battery enclosures, cell-to-pack packaging, busbars, and high-voltage safety systems.

• Familiarity with environmental testing standards for high-reliability applications (such as MIL-STD-810, UN 38.3, or DO-160).

• Expertise in engineering tool development in Microsoft Excel, MATLAB, and/or Python

US Salary Range

$142,000—$188,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: EH&S Specialist II, Second Shift
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team

The EHS team carries a profound responsibility to keep people and the environments where we operate safe while we build the future. We're not here to slow things down; we're here to enable safe speed. At this stage in Relativity’s trajectory, you'll have the rare opportunity to shape how EHS is embedded in every process and decision, from the factory floor to the launch pad. We have a voice at every level, and we use it to build a culture where EHS isn’t just about compliance, but rather a shared responsibility amongst all employees.

About the Role

This is a second shift position from 2:00pm - 10:30pm

EHS Specialists are the initiators and leaders for tasks and objectives related to larger projects and EHS strategy at Relativity’s locations. They are strategic project managers, safety culture drivers, and EHS subject matter experts.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Providing expert-level collaborative EHS support to departments across the site, including engineers, specialists, and technicians, by forming a deep understanding of their processes and how EHS can enhance and improve upon them

• Driving incident investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective action management

• Developing and driving initiatives that foster a positive safety culture

• Preparing and providing support for EHS-related activities and documentation

• Monitor waste disposal, spill prevention and assessing risks while driving mitigation controls to lower risks

• Develop and review risk assessments, such as JHAs (Job Hazard Analyses)

• Implement EHS training across various work centers

About You

• Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety and/or Environmental Sciences (EPA) with a minimum of 3+ years of experience working in the EHS field

• Project management of various safety programs in a dynamic manufacturing environment, including, but not limited to: Confined Space, Crane and Rigging, Control of Hazardous Energy, and Industrial Ergonomics

• Demonstrate innovative, technical approach to complex incident investigations, root cause analysis, risk mitigation, Job Hazard Assessments and EHS policies and procedures

• Strategic and collaborative mindset, with the ability to work across varying departments and levels to provide subject matter expert (SME) EHS support

• General knowledge and experience with CalOSHA, SCAQMD, DTSC, RCRA and hazardous waste regulations

• Advance skill in Excel, Word, and other Microsoft Office tools.

Nice to Have

• OSHA 30-Hour

• HAZWOPER 40-Hour

• Associate Safety Professional (ASP) / Certified Safety Professional (CSP)

• RCRA / DOT Hazardous Waste Certification

• EMT certification and experience

At Relativity Space, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation practices. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors.

Compensation is only one part of our total rewards package. Relativity Space offers competitive salary and equity, a generous PTO and sick leave policy, parental leave, an annual learning and development stipend, and more! To see some of the benefits & perks we offer, please visit here.

Hiring Range:

$74,000—$112,000 USD

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you need a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at accommodations@relativityspace.com.

Please note: Relativity Space does not accept unsolicited resumes, candidate profiles, or referrals from recruitment agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited submission - via email, our website, social media, or directly to an employee - will be deemed the property of Relativity Space, and no fee will be owed absent a current, fully executed agreement with Talent Acquisition that specifically authorizes submissions for the applicable role.

jobs.title: Staff Compensation Analyst
jobs.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com http://OpenGov.com.




JOB SUMMARY

As the Senior Compensation Manager, you will lead the evolution and scale of OpenGov's compensation programs in alignment with our business objectives, combining hands-on program ownership with strategic analytics and AI-enabled operations. You'll serve as a trusted compensation advisor to HRBPs, People Managers, Talent Acquisition, and cross functional partners across the business — helping them navigate compensation decisions with clarity and confidence. You'll own the full compensation toolkit — program design, cycle execution, equity planning, and manager enablement — while building the data-driven infrastructure and automated workflows that let compensation scale ahead of the business, not behind it. This is a player-coach role: you'll do the work yourself building models, running benchmarks, owning cycles, while also setting direction and raising the bar for other professionals on the team.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Compensation Advisory & Program Management

 - Administer and evolve OpenGov's compensation programs - comp cycles, promotions, and variable pay - serving as project lead across each program

 - Maintain the integrity of compensation data and systems, including internal job architecture, career paths, salary scales, and comp ranges aligned with our compensation philosophy

 - Serve as a strategic advisor to HRBPs, People Managers, and FP&A, providing business-relevant compensation guidance and recommendations for new and existing employees to ensure internal equity, external competitiveness, and budget alignment

 - Build trusted, consultative relationships with cross-functional partners, helping them apply compensation philosophy confidently to real business decisions

Equity Planning

 - Own equity planning and administration, including new-hire and refresh grant guidelines, vesting structures, and equity budget modeling

 - Partner with Finance and Legal on equity program design, plan changes, and compliance requirements

 - Advise HRBPs and business leaders on equity-related questions for offers, promotions, and retention scenarios

Strategic Analytics

 - Design and build compensation metrics, reports, and tools that inform program decisions and forecast/analyze compensation outcomes

 - Lead competitive intelligence on market trends and talent movement, particularly for premium and fast-moving job families (e.g., AI/ML, engineering, data science)

 - Analyze compensation data to surface trends, outliers, and risk areas, translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations for HR and business leaders

Enablement

 - Create and deploy compensation content and training for HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, Managers, and Employees, spanning foundational and complex compensation topics

 - Promote understanding of OpenGov's compensation philosophy and practices across the organization, building relationships that result in trusted partnership

AI-Enabled Compensation Operations

 - Design and build AI-powered workflows and tools that automate recurring compensation work — benchmarking, offer modeling, job description generation, and comp cycle reporting — operationalizing and automating so compensation scales with our growth

 - Integrate AI tools directly into daily compensation work to increase speed and consistency of deliverables, including market analysis, manager communications, and data summarization

 - Evaluate where AI can responsibly replace manual steps, with clear judgment on where human review must stay in the loop, and bring recommendations forward proactively to the broader People Team

 


REQUIREMENTS AND PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - 10+ years of experience in compensation, consulting, or a related field in a high-growth, fast-paced environment 

 - Experience building compensation programs, managing projects, and scaling processes with company growth

 - Experience with equity program design and administration, including grant guidelines, vesting structures, and equity budget modeling preferred

 - Advanced proficiency with Workday Advanced Compensation strongly preferred

 - Strong analytical and Excel/Google Sheets skills required to analyze data and build meaningful, understandable models and reports; ability to see beyond the numbers to drive sound decision-making

 - Demonstrated, hands-on experience building AI-powered tools or workflows in a compensation/HR context (e.g., automating benchmarking, modeling, or reporting tasks) 

 - Knowledge of federal, state, and local laws impacting people operations and compensation

 - Experience working with base pay and incentive plans required

 - Experience with global compensation strongly preferred

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience required; a strong background in data/quantitative analysis such as Finance, Statistics, or Economics preferred

 - Ability to present and distill complex topics in a concise and meaningful manner to diverse stakeholders

 - Strong consultative and advisory skills, with a track record of building trusted partnerships with cross-functional stakeholders

 - Must be able to independently problem-solve and work under pressure in a deadline-driven, rapidly changing organization

 - Ability to exercise judgment and discretion in maintaining confidential and sensitive information

 - Ability to gain alignment and represent a common point of view across multiple stakeholders



Compensation:

Boston, MA: $160,000 - $180,000

On target ranges above include base plus a portion of variable compensation that is earned based on company and individual performance.

 

The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.




WHY OPENGOV?



A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust.  Some people say this is boring.  We think it’s the core of our democracy.



Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.



A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.



A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.



Benefits That Work for You

Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:

 - Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families

 - Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

 - 401(k) with company match

 - Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions

 - Professional development and growth opportunities

 - A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Change Enablement
jobs.description:
Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. They work with the world’s leading insurance companies to help them execute comprehensive, transformational solutions for legacy Life & Annuity and P&C lines. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry.   Click here for more information about Fortitude Re.

The AVP, Change Enablement supports the successful delivery and adoption of Fortitude Re's strategic initiatives by applying Fortitude Re's Change Enablement Framework to cross-functional changes that impact people, processes, technology, and ways of working. Reporting to the VP, Change Management, this role leads change enablement activities for assigned initiatives, partnering with project teams and business stakeholders to assess change impacts, build readiness, support leaders through transitions, and drive sustainable user adoption. The role also contributes to building Fortitude Re's change enablement capability by coordinating the Change Enablers Community of Practice, developing practical tools, and helping colleagues build change enablement skills.

What You Will Do:

• Lead change enablement activities for assigned initiatives, applying Fortitude Re's Change Enablement Framework to support implementation and adoption of cross-functional changes.

• Partner with project and program managers, business stakeholders, and initiative sponsors to assess change impacts and readiness, and to develop and support the implementation of change plans covering stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and adoption and reinforcement activities.

• Work with Project Managers to Integrate change enablement activities into project plans, milestones, and delivery timelines, coordinating with Communications, People & Culture, and Technology to ensure consistent messaging and support.

• Support initiative sponsors and change leads in utilizing Fortitude’s change framework to lead successful change, including effectively building buy-in, communicating with teams, and reinforcing new ways of working.

• Track and report on change readiness and adoption, gather stakeholder feedback, and recommend practical actions to address barriers and improve outcomes.

• Coordinate and facilitate the Change Enablers Community of Practice, and develop and deliver workshops, templates, playbooks, and tools that help others apply the framework, capturing lessons learned to improve our approach.

What You Will Have:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Organizational Development, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in change enablement or organizational transformation, including supporting and leading change activities for complex, cross-functional initiatives.

• Demonstrated expertise in developing and executing change enablement plans using structured methodologies such as Prosci, including impact assessments, stakeholder analysis, readiness planning, and adoption measurement.

• Prior experience leading large-scale transformation or change initiatives required.

• Experience developing and coordinating communications, training, and reinforcement activities that support successful adoption.

• Strong interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders across functions and organizational levels in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong facilitation, presentation, and coaching skills, with experience building practical tools, templates, or training materials, and a good understanding of project and program delivery.

• Experience within financial services, insurance, reinsurance, or another regulated industry preferred.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Wrike, or similar collaboration and tracking tools required.

• Prosci Change Management Certification, CCMP, or equivalent credentials preferred.

The base salary range for this role is listed below and will be commensurate with candidate experience. Pay ranges for candidates may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. In addition to base salary, all employees are eligible for an annual bonus based on company and individual performance as well as a generous benefits package.

Base Salary Range

$150,000—$160,000 USD

jobs.title: Manager, Precision Activation
jobs.location: HYBRID - Atlanta, GA; Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; Denver, CO; Kansas City, MO; New York City, NY; Raleigh, NC; St. Louis, MO/REMOTE - U.S. Based
jobs.description:
At MERGE, we are Built Different. We are a marketing and technology agency purpose-built for the intersection of health and wellness—where human impact matters most. By weaving storytelling through technology, we move beyond traditional engagement to Whole Human Marketing. This approach recognizes that humans are multidimensional and complex, and uses AI to ensure every brand interaction feels natural, contextual, and relevant.

This commitment to human-first innovation is what brings us together and propels us forward. We are united by our North Star: to unite people and brands to empower healthier, happier lives.

Emerge to the Top of Your Career

At MERGE, we strive to create a superior work experience where talented and ambitious people grow. An experience that encourages people to think higher and feel deeper. An experience where people engage their minds and hearts to do the best work of their careers.

As our Paid Social Manager, you will...

Lead end-to-end campaign execution, technical configuration, ongoing optimization, and performance reporting for pharmaceutical and life sciences clients. Working directly with the Associate Director of Precision Activation, this role translates strategic client goals into comprehensive, full-funnel media programs designed to engage patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals using accurate, privacy-compliant targeting strategies.

Serving as the team's dedicated subject matter expert, you will manage hands-on operations across key platforms including Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit, Pinterest, Snap, and X. You will maintain strict compliance with MLR guidelines, FDA regulations, and platform-specific healthcare advertising policies without compromising campaign effectiveness.

What you'll do

Strategic Planning & Audience Strategy

• Translate overarching brand and business objectives into full-funnel paid social strategies targeting patient, caregiver, and HCP audiences, partnering closely with the Associate Director.

• Develop data-driven audience segments utilizing CRM/first-party data, NPI-matched HCP lists, contextual signals, and platform targeting while adhering to privacy standards and health-category regulations.

• Formulate recommendations for platform selection, budget distribution, and flighting schedules, authoring the paid social components of comprehensive media plans and POVs.

• Facilitate collaborative brainstorming sessions with creative, strategy, and analytics partners to tailor ad formats and creative messaging to specific channels and target groups.

Campaign Activation, Optimization & Management

• Oversee campaign technical setup and architecture, including account structure, taxonomy, tracking infrastructure (pixels, conversion APIs, UTMs), and pre-launch quality assurance.

• Maintain active oversight of campaign pacing against allocated budgets and key metrics, continuously updating pacing documentation and reallocating spend to maximize results.

• Execute structured testing frameworks covering creative assets, target audiences, bidding strategies, and ad placements, transforming actionable insights into campaign enhancements.

• Manage ongoing budget forecasting, monthly financial reconciliations, and vendor invoice processing.

• Ensure rigorous campaign quality control, brand safety management, and community moderation, strictly adhering to adverse event reporting and escalation workflows.

Regulatory Compliance & Policy Adherence

• Guarantee that all campaigns, targeting tactics, and creative assets comply fully with MLR-approved guidelines, FDA requirements (including ISI and fair balance), data privacy laws, and platform-specific healthcare advertising policies.

• Assemble paid social specifications and documentation for MLR submission, establishing realistic deployment schedules aligned with review cycles.

• Monitor evolving platform regulations regarding privacy, targeting parameters, and health categories, proactively communicating potential risks and mitigation strategies to internal leadership and client stakeholders.

Performance Measurement & Analytics

• Extract platform analytics to generate weekly, monthly, and post-campaign performance reports containing detailed analysis and strategic recommendations.

• Collaborate with analytics teams to establish key performance indicators and measurement frameworks, including brand lift, conversion lift, and third-party attribution models.

• Deliver performance presentations to clients, addressing complex campaign inquiries and providing strategic context.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Client Engagement

• Act as the principal day-to-day paid social subject matter expert for assigned client accounts.

• Work in tandem with integrated cross-functional teams—including media planning, analytics, strategy, creative, and account management—to deliver cohesive marketing programs.

• Advise creative partners on social-first creative development, technical specs, and channel best practices.

• Nurture vendor and social platform representative relationships to secure beta testing opportunities, novel ad formats, and dedicated platform support.

• Provide paid social strategy, healthcare category perspectives, and input for new business opportunities and pitches.

Team Leadership & Operational Excellence

• Partner with team leadership to mentor junior team members, guiding their professional development and skill acquisition.

• Drive operational efficiency across the discipline by creating standardized playbooks, QA protocols, and shared knowledge resources.

What you'll bring

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, advertising or a related field, or equivalent work experience

• 3–5 years of hands-on paid social campaign management, ideally in an agency environment

• Experience running paid social for pharmaceutical or life sciences brands (required)

• Working knowledge of MLR review and the regulatory and compliance requirements of paid media in health

• Deep, hands-on platform expertise in Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, Reddit, Pinterest, Snap and X

• Experience building full-funnel campaigns for patient and/or HCP audiences

• Strong analytical skills: intermediate Excel (XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, pivot tables, charts) and the ability to turn data into clear recommendations

• Experience managing pacing, budgets, forecasts and invoicing across multiple campaigns

• Understanding of how paid, owned and earned social work together

• Clear writing and presenting skills, with the confidence to walk clients through performance and strategy

• Strong organization and time management across multiple brands and deadlines

• Integrity, attention to detail and respect for agency processes

Optional

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Numenor (Reactor)
jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

The Numenor team is building Valar’s next reactor, the flagship program that will define how we deliver nuclear power at scale. This dedicated team owns the entire plant, from the reactor core and helium systems to cooling, plant modules, and the Citadel, uniting mechanical, systems, safety, IC&E, quality, and supply chain under one mission. The work starts with bringing the first unit to life and ends with a production line that delivers reactors faster with every build. What this team builds will power the critical infrastructure of the future.

The Role

Valar Atomics seeks an Engineering Manager for the reactor program. This role will build and lead a team of Responsible Engineers and designers for a group of mechanical systems, either the reactor side (reactor core and graphite, control rod drives, helium pressure boundary, heat transport, cavity cooling, and helium services) or the plant side (power conversion, heat rejection, the reactor complex and Citadel, service modules, and plant services). The role will lead the team from the first unit through scaled production, delivering reactors at an increasing rate.

The role demands someone who leads engineers hands-on with a hardware-first mentality, owning people, schedule, and delivery, while the Responsible Engineers keep technical signature and ensure the design basis is met. We are looking for someone who obsessively removes blockers for the team every day, so the Responsible Engineers can focus on engineering and delivering functional systems.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership

• Hire, onboard, and mentor the Responsible Engineers, engineers, and designers for your group of systems.

• Set workload and priorities for the team, and remove blockers so it can move as fast as possible.

• Manage scope, schedule, and budget for your systems within the reactor program.

• Run performance, growth, and staffing for the team as the program scales.

Delivery

• Own schedule and delivery for each system, from design through IFC, build, and test.

• Track RE deliverables against each system’s baseline and raise slips early to the Director and program controls.

• Coordinate each system’s readiness for design reviews, design freeze, and IFC.

Integration

• Drive interface closure between systems with systems engineering and the plant model.

• Work closely with procurement and supply chain so parts and vendors arrive on time.

• Work with licensing, quality, safety, IC&E, and manufacturing so the design builds right the first time, and faster with each unit.

Basic Qualifications

• 5+ years of mechanical engineering on complex hardware, such as pressure systems, heat transfer equipment, mechanisms, or large structures.

• 3+ years managing engineers with direct reports.

• Delivered hardware from design through build and test against a schedule.

• Led mechanical systems on first-of-a-kind hardware from concept through build, test, and commissioning.

• Strong base in mechanical design, drawings, analysis, and design reviews.

• Experience managing vendors and key suppliers through design and fabrication.

• Comfortable working hands-on with the team on the shop floor and with vendors.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience with high-temperature, high-pressure systems, such as pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and piping.

• Hardware delivery: first-of-a-kind hardware taken from design through build and test, in aerospace, power generation, oil and gas, or defense.

• Helium or other gas systems, precision mechanisms, or rotating equipment.

• Power conversion, heat rejection, or balance of plant, including skids and modular systems built in a factory and installed on site.

• Working knowledge of ASME pressure vessel and piping codes (Section VIII, B31.1, B31.3).

• Design for manufacture and scaling from prototype to series production.

• Nuclear industry experience: commercial, defense, or national laboratory. A plus, not a prerequisite.

• PE license (Mechanical): a plus.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.
