jobs.title: Compounding Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
About Us

At The Pharmacy Hub, we collaborate with pharmaceutical brands, manufacturers, health brands, telemedicine providers, and healthcare companies to deliver essential products directly to patients. Our expertise allows us to seamlessly distribute pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and other healthcare products to consumers, ensuring greater accessibility and convenience.

Position Summary

The Compounding Maintenance Technician will perform preventive and corrective maintenance on non-sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment and support the daily cleaning, inspection, preparation, and operational readiness of machines and production tools. This person will also respond to facility repairs, installations, and general maintenance needs across our Miami Gardens and Davie locations. They will work with the Production and QC teams and with qualified external vendors. Success in this role means minimal equipment downtime, prevention of unexpected failures, and safe, reliable production operations in accordance with approved SOPs, GMP, and applicable safety requirements.

Core Responsibilities

Daily Equipment Cleaning and Preparation (30%)

• Clean, inspect, and prepare assigned manufacturing machinery daily using approved cleaning procedures and materials, including powder and debris removal, accessible component cleaning, and authorized disassembly/reassembly.

• Verify cleanliness, assembly, and readiness before production; support machine setup and product changeovers to minimize downtime between batches.

• Maintain segregation of clean and dirty tools, and coordinate with Production and QC for required release.

Preventive Maintenance (25%)

• Execute scheduled preventive maintenance on tablet presses, capsule fillers, mixers, blenders, dedusters, sieves, troche equipment, packaging equipment, and associated utilities.

• Inspect, lubricate, adjust, and replace components according to manufacturer instructions and approved procedures.

• Identify wear, abnormal noise, vibration, or other early signs of failure before breakdowns occur.

Corrective Maintenance and Equipment Repairs (20%)

• Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and operational problems within training and authorization, responding promptly to production breakdowns and verifying proper operation.

• Coordinate specialized repairs with qualified external vendors and communicate repair status and expected downtime.

• Coordinate required post-maintenance inspections and approvals before equipment returns to service.

Facility Maintenance and Repairs (15%)

• Perform routine facility inspections and minor repairs involving doors, locks, fixtures, shelving, lighting, and basic plumbing within qualifications.

• Report and support resolution of HVAC, temperature, humidity, ventilation, and utility issues.

• Assist with equipment installation, relocation, assembly, and facility improvement projects, and respond to assigned work orders.

Maintenance Documentation and Coordination (10%)

• Complete maintenance and cleaning records, maintain preventive maintenance schedules and service records, and monitor spare parts.

• Coordinate maintenance priorities with the Production team and maintain organized work areas.

Qualifications

Required

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Minimum 3 years in a similar role, with hands-on experience in manufacturing equipment maintenance, mechanical repair, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.

• Strong mechanical aptitude, with basic electrical and pneumatic knowledge and safe use of hand and power tools.

• Ability to read technical manuals and follow SOPs, with accurate recordkeeping and strong attention to detail.

• Proactive troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with good time management and a team-oriented approach.

• Basic Microsoft Office skills.

• Ability to stand, bend, kneel, perform repetitive maintenance tasks, handle components within established safe lifting limits, and wear required PPE.

Preferred

• Pharmaceutical or GMP-regulated manufacturing experience, including compounding pharmacy operations.

• Familiarity with tablet presses, capsule equipment, and facility maintenance.

• Technical training or certification in industrial maintenance, mechanics, electrical systems, or mechatronics.

• Experience in nutraceutical and dietary supplement, food and beverage, cosmetics and personal care, medical device, or industrial manufacturing and packaging environments.

Work Schedule

100% Onsite - Working out of our Miami Gardens location, with a planned future move to our Davie location.

Monday - Friday, 3PM to 11PM

Pay Range

$18—$20 USD

The Pharmacy Hub Cares:

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

• 7 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

• Commitment matters at The Pharmacy Hub! Increased PTO every year

Core Values

The Pharmacy Hub is dedicated to breaking barriers in healthcare by championing access, intervention and affordability.

• Customer-first mindset - we develop strong partnerships with telehealth platforms and healthcare companies to enhance access and understand their specific needs

• Innovation for intervention in care - we develop advanced compounding solutions and products to better support patient health outcomes

• Continuous improvement - we continuously improve our processes and offerings through intelligent, honest and transparent practices to deliver cost-effective solutions that truly benefit our clients and their patients.

You will play a pivotal role in maintaining these values and contributing to the company’s mission of redefining healthcare delivery through superior pharmacy services

At The Pharmacy Hub, we don’t just offer jobs—we offer opportunities for career growth and development. We take pride in our fast-paced, team-driven culture and are committed to supporting our employees in achieving success.

If you’re ready to join a company that values hard work, dedication, and teamwork, apply today! We look forward to welcoming you to The Pharmacy Hub and working together to deliver top-tier pharmacy fulfillment solutions.

The Pharmacy Hub is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation to participate in the hiring process are encouraged to indicate this in their application.

The Pharmacy Hub participates in E-Verify. A post-offer background check is required for all positions. Additional pre-employment screenings may apply depending on the role.

jobs.title: Phlebotomist / Administrative Assistant (Float, Monday - Friday)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Phlebotomist/Administrative Assistant at one of our offices, you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you’ll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions, both clinical and administrative, and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• Provide best in class venipuncture services on a population ranging from pediatrics to geriatrics, depending on the office location

• Perform and assist with extended scope duties such as, but not limited to non-blood specimen collection, EKGs/ECGs, vitals, ear lavages, vaccines, PPD tests, and swabs

• Maintain high standards of in-office care through proper specimen labeling, handling and processing, inventory upkeep, and tool sterilization

• Continue to care for our members beyond the lab room by answering patient messages, following up on lab cases and assisting our providers and virtual medical team with clerical duties such as, but not limited to biometric screening forms, medical record and consult review, billing inquiries, and DOH reporting

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

• Master our technology suite including, but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, Circulation, RingCentral, and our Electronic Medical Record System, in order to interact with team members and complete daily work

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification.  They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification.  Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 6 months of relevant experience as a Medical Assistant or Phlebotomist outside of a training/externship environment

• An active phlebotomy certification to practice in CA

• Strong customer service skills, including ability to establish and maintain effective customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• A High School Diploma or equivalent

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse, multi-disciplinary teams (additional experience with remote teams a plus)

• A proven ability to display confidence and instill trust during the collection process while delivering individualized, human-centered, customer-focused care

• A proven track record of persisting through change, consistently stepping up to take action on challenges, and learning quickly and effectively when faced with new situations or tasks

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices

The range for this role is $28.00 to $30.00 per hour based on a standard full-time schedule. jobs.title: Data Analyst, Product Analytics
jobs.description:
DATA ANALYST, PRODUCT ANALYTICS

Current is a leading consumer fintech platform transforming financial access for everyday Americans with over 6 million members. We provide access to financial solutions that seamlessly work together to solve the needs of our members and enable all Americans to build better financial futures. Based in NYC, our results-driven environment drives us to build better products, grow faster and empower everyone on our team to have an impact on our business and mission to improve financial outcomes.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Analyst, Product Analytics, you will be at the forefront of understanding how our members use and experience Current's products. You will be embedded with product and business teams across areas such as banking, user journey and experience, liquidity, and value-added services, translating business questions into rigorous analyses and clear recommendations. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, business leads and analytics leaders to measure what matters, run experiments, and uncover the insights that shape our roadmap. You enjoy digging into data to understand not just what happened, but why.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Analyze large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and opportunities across customer behavior, product performance, and the user journey.

• Conduct deep-dive and root-cause analyses to explain changes in key metrics and turn ambiguous data into clear recommendations.

• Design, run, and interpret A/B tests and other experiments, including success metrics, sample sizing, significance testing, and readouts.

• Partner with product managers and engineers to define success metrics and measure the impact of new features and initiatives.

• Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track KPIs and deliver clear, actionable insights to stakeholders.

• Support business cases and prioritization by sizing opportunities and quantifying expected impact.

• Communicate findings and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.

• Use AI tools to speed up analysis, insight generation, and reporting while keeping accuracy and rigor.

• Work with analytics engineers and data engineers to ensure accessible, accurate, and high-quality data.

• Uphold data integrity, accuracy, and governance across your analyses and reporting.

ABOUT YOU

• Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience as a data analyst, ideally in product analytics within B2C, financial services, or technology.

• Strong proficiency in SQL for analyses and data development

• Working experience with Python for data analysis.

• Experience with A/B testing, experimental design, and statistical inference.

• Experience building dashboards and reports in Looker, Tableau, or similar BI tools.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail, and the ability to find the needle in the haystack.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to translate business questions into analysis plans.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear narratives and actionable insights.

NICE TO HAVE

• Familiarity with the fintech industry and banking products.

• Experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift).

• Experience with product analytics tools and event data (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel, Segment).

• Exposure to dimensional modeling concepts and dbt.

• Experience using AI tools to improve analytics efficiency.

• Familiarity with machine learning techniques and predictive analytics.

This role has a base salary range of $130,000 - $175,000. Compensation is determined based on experience, skill level, and qualifications, which are assessed during the interview process. Current offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

BENEFITS

• Competitive salary

• Meaningful equity in the form of stock options

• 401(k) plan

• Discretionary performance bonus program

• Biannual performance reviews

• Medical, Dental and Vision premiums covered at 100% for you and your dependents

• Flexible time off and paid holidays

• Generous parental leave policy

• Commuter benefits

• Fitness benefits

• Healthcare and Dependent care FSA benefit

• Employee Assistance Programs focused on mental health

• Healthcare advocacy program for all employees

• Access to mental health apps

• Team building activities

• Our modern NYC based office with open floor plan, stocked kitchen, and catered lunches

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Client Liaison, Science & Natural History
jobs.description:
ABOUT SOTHEBY'S

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly motivated, proactive and productive Executive Assistant & Client Liaison with impeccable organizational skills to provide mature, discrete, professional assistance. As the Executive Assistant & Client Liaison, you will be responsible for providing full business and administrative support, and assistance managing an important client list in a one-to-one working relationship.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Having diary ownership of busy schedule, anticipating needs around business getting and sales; scheduling meetings/ events/ travel/dinners appropriately, reminding the executive of upcoming meetings and events, ensuring they remain on time, monitoring and resolving any conflicts pro-actively.

• Acting as the “eyes and ears” for the executive and ensuring they are informed of key events including art, science, and book fairs, conferences, internal events and dinners, updates and initiatives, upcoming sales and sale results.

• 2+ years of professional experience in an Executive Assistant role, or role with similar responsibilities. Previous experience as a pre-sale, post-sale, or shipping coordinator helpful

• Strong multi-tasking and prioritization skills; ability to pivot when priorities shift

• A fastidious attention to detail, accuracy and organization.

• Adept at handling sensitive and confidential information in a professional manner, maintaining discretion at all times.

• Able to maintain composure under pressure.

• Skillful ability to interact in a professional, mature and collaborative style with key constituents across multiple departments and locations (US, UK, Europe, Middle East, Hong Kong)

• Ability to show good judgment and represent the Sotheby’s brand and core competencies.

• Excellent interpersonal skills and an enthusiastic client service attitude.

• Excellent written communication and analytical skills with experience in drafting reports and presentations and responding to correspondence in a timely fashion.

• Strong experience in Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

• Flexibility to work some evenings and weekends when necessary.

The proposed base salary for this position ranges from $60,000-$65,000. In addition to base salary successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus, as well as a competitive benefits package. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered.

jobs.title: IT Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

About the Job

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean's harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

We're looking for an IT Business Operations Manager to run the business side of technology at Panthalassa. You'll own how we buy, track, and pay for the software and hardware our teams depend on. That means vendor relationships, contracts and renewals, license allocation, the IT budget, and forecasts that stay ahead of a growing company.

This role is for someone who can read a contract, build a forecast model, and sit down with an engineer to figure out whether they actually need the enterprise tier. You'll partner closely with Finance, Legal, and our IT engineers. Our Business Systems Engineer administers the platforms, and you own the commercial relationship and the spend behind them.

This is the first dedicated role for this function at Panthalassa. You'll build the processes, reporting, and operating rhythm from the ground up.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company's direction on a regular basis.

Responsibilities

Vendor and Contract Management

• Own relationships with IT software and hardware vendors, including account reviews, escalations, and vendor performance

• Lead renewal and new purchase negotiations with Finance and Legal, including pricing, terms, and multi-year commitments

• Maintain a contract repository and renewal calendar so nothing renews without a decision

• Run new vendor intake with Information Security, including risk review before purchase

Software Licensing and SaaS Inventory

• Own the SaaS application inventory, including business owner, license counts, cost, and renewal dates

• Track license utilization, then reclaim, reassign, or right-size unused seats

• Partner with our IAM and Business Systems Engineers so license assignment follows automated provisioning rather than manual requests

• Prepare for and manage vendor true-ups and license audits

Budget and Forecasting

• Build and manage the annual IT operating and capital budget with Finance

• Forecast spend against headcount growth, new facilities, and planned projects

• Track actuals against budget monthly, explain variances, and flag risks early

• Code and reconcile IT invoices and purchases with Finance

• Report IT spend to IT leadership and department heads in terms they can act on

Hardware Asset Lifecycle

• Own hardware purchasing and vendor relationships for laptops, phones, peripherals, and office technology

• Maintain an accurate asset inventory from purchase through assignment, repair, and disposal

• Plan and budget refresh cycles with our Endpoint Engineer, who owns hardware technical standards

• Coordinate certified disposal and keep records that support audit

Process and Reporting

• Build the operating rhythm for the function: renewal calendar, budget reviews, and vendor scorecards

• Own the purchase request and approval workflow for technology, working with our Business Systems Engineer to automate it

• Support the asset and vendor management controls in our compliance framework (NIST or equivalent), including evidence

• Document processes in Confluence so the next person can pick them up

Required Qualifications

• Strong attention to detail: you catch the renewal date, the duplicate invoice, and the seat count that doesn't add up

• Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to keep many workstreams moving at once

• A track record of project or asset management in a software tool, keeping status accurate and responsibilities clearly assigned

• General familiarity with financials and budgeting

• Exceptional external communication: you're comfortable as the primary point of contact for vendors, from routine check-ins to tough conversations

• Skillful written communication, from vendor emails to internal documentation

• A history of strong partnerships with stakeholders across an organization

Desired Qualifications

• Familiarity with SaaS business models, including pricing tiers, seat-based licensing, and renewal terms

• Familiarity with information security concepts as they apply to vendors, such as security reviews and data handling

• Familiarity with procurement processes, including purchase approvals, quotes, and purchase orders

• Familiarity with SCIM provisioning and how it ties to license assignment

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

Additional Requirements

• Intermittently able to work longer hours around budget cycles and major renewals (flexible PTO and working hours offered)

• If remote, quarterly visits to our HQ office in Portland, OR.

Compensation and Benefits

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

• Cash compensation of $130,000 - $150,000.

• Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.

• A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: Flexible paid time off Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled) Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA

• Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

Location

This is ideally an on-site position, based at our offices, lab, and shop in Portland, Oregon. We will consider exceptional remote candidates who can commit to being on-site in Portland, Oregon at least one week per quarter.

jobs.title: Games UX Designer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

WHAT WE NEED

We’re looking for a Gameplay UX Designer with a deep interest in problem solving, excellent communication skills, and a player-first mindset to join our Experience Design team. You thrive in collaborative, highly iterative environments where you balance player needs with design constraints and production realities. Working side-by-side with UI artists, technical designers, engineers, and game designers, you act as the bridge between creative vision and technical execution.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Help Drive the UX Vision: Guide conversations with cross-functional partners and take ownership of feature design against product specifications.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Shepherd UX design efforts through leadership approvals, iteration cycles, and final implementation with support from Production and Leadership.

• Build Comprehensive Documentation: Communicate the UX vision clearly by developing competitive analyses, persona designs, user journeys, wireframes, flow diagrams, and interactive prototypes.

• Advocate for the Player: Ensure all designs are rigorously tested and validated, prioritizing usability, accessibility, and an exceptional player experience.

• Bridge Design and Execution: Work seamlessly alongside engineering and UI art to ensure technical feasibility and flawless execution of the user experience.

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU A GREAT FIT

• Effective Communicator: Exceptional ability to present complex design ideas and rationale clearly through both written and verbal channels to varied stakeholders.

• Design Expertise: Deep understanding of interaction and layout design.

• Design Systems: Proven background in creating, maintaining, and extending robust design systems.

• Tool Proficiency: High proficiency in industry standard UX tools (e.g., Figma, ProtoPie, etc.).

BENEFICIAL QUALIFICATIONS / NICE TO HAVES

• Proficiency in motion graphics, animation, or visual effects as they relate to UI/UX feedback loops.

• Technical Familiarity: Experience working directly in game engines (e.g., Unreal Engine, Unity, or proprietary engines), utilizing design toolsets, visual scripting, and production pipelines.

The pay range for this position in California at the start of employment is expected to be between $81,600 and $120,780 per Year.

However, base pay offered is based on market location, and may vary further depending on individualized factors for job candidates, such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other objective business considerations.

Details of participation in compensation and benefit plans (if applicable) will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an "at-will position" and the company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

jobs.title: Magruder-Tabb Animal Clinic- Veterinary Assistant
jobs.description:
Who is VetEvolve?

VetEvolve is a network of veterinary practices built to support the people delivering care and the practices they lead. We combine clinical insight with operational strength to give our teams the support, tools, and structure they need to thrive, without losing what makes each practice unique. We are intentionally focused on growth, not as an end in itself, but as a way to strengthen our practices, expand access to care, and create more opportunities for our teams.

Guided by our values: Care First. Better Together. Grow Forward. Own It. We create an environment where veterinary professionals can do their best work, build meaningful careers, and deliver exceptional care. Growth with intention. Care without compromise.

Veterinary Assistant

Compensation: $XX–$XX/hour, commensurate with licensure and experience

Position Summary:

The Veterinary Assistant provides essential support to the veterinarian during outpatient exams and throughout the diagnosis and treatment of patients. They care for all patients, assist with medical procedures, and help ensure each patient receives high-quality, compassionate care. In this role, the Veterinary Assistant also serves as a key connection between the veterinarian and clients. Through exceptional service and communication, the Veterinary Assistant helps build trust and foster lasting relationships with clients and their pets.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Provides compassionate, professional care to patients and clients at all times.

• Communicates clearly and respectfully with clients, doctors, and team members, including answering phones and routing inquiries as needed.

• Handles sensitive client situations with empathy and discretion, escalating medical questions appropriately.

• Assists the veterinarian during exams, diagnostics, treatments, and surgical procedures.

• Safely restrains animals of varying sizes and temperaments using low-stress handling techniques.

• Administers medications, draws up vaccines, collects lab samples, and performs basic lab tests as directed.

• Creates, reviews, and enters treatment plans accurately in the medical record system.

• Educates clients on common vaccinations, medications, and treatment protocols to ensure understanding of care plans and follow-up recommendations.

• Accurately records patient information and maintains organized, up-to-date medical records.

• Enters charges accurately and assists with the client check-out process, including processing payments when needed.

• Ensures exam rooms, treatment areas, and hospital spaces are clean, stocked, and well maintained.

• Demonstrates consistent reliability, punctuality, and commitment to supporting patients, clients, and hospital operations.

• Performs all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• Basic computer proficiency, including the ability to use practice management software and Microsoft Office applications.

• Previous experience working with animals preferred; veterinary or animal care background strongly valued.

• Able to work safely around cleaning chemicals, anesthetic gases, radiation, zoonotic diseases, and animal bodily fluids.

• Maintains composure and professionalism in emotionally challenging or high-stress situations.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and safely handle animals up to 130 pounds.

• Comfortable sitting, standing, walking, bending, and kneeling for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Professional, neat appearance consistent with hospital standards.

Hours:

• Must be able to work a flexible schedule and be available for scheduling during all hours the practice is open to support hospital operations.

Compensation and Benefits:

• We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage. In addition, employees are eligible to participate in our 401(k) retirement plan. Other benefits include paid time off, paid holidays and access to employee assistance program.

Ready to Learn More?

We look forward to learning about your unique priorities and goals and working together with our local hospital teams to support you.

jobs.title: Summer 2027: Category Finance Intern (May through August)
jobs.description:
About Us

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

Job Name: Summer 2027: Category Finance Internship (May through August)

Location: Needham, Massachusetts, USA

Work Period: May through August

Location & Schedule: This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week position with 5 DAYS per week onsite in Needham, MA. There is no relocation or housing assistance for this position.

Compensation Range: Ranges from $28/hr - $34/hr. Specific compensation is set according to a standardized scale aligned with your educational level at the time of hire.

Join the SharkNinja Early Edge Experience: Built for early talent. Geared toward impact. Driven by speed. Whether you're in a co-op or internship, our early talent program is designed to provide valuable exposure to the industry and a fast-paced professional environment. You’ll dive into meaningful projects and tasks that sharpen your skills and deepen your knowledge. Along the way, you’ll benefit from professional development opportunities, community events, and connections that make your experience well-rounded and enriching. Your time with us will culminate in an opportunity to showcase your contributions and learnings to SharkNinja leaders because this is a program for those ready to shape what’s next — fast.

This role: Category Finance Internship

Are you energized by numbers, strategy, and seeing how financial decisions shape real-world innovation? Do you thrive in fast-paced environments where analysis meets action? Are you excited to gain hands-on experience supporting the launch of next-generation

consumer products? If so, we invite you to learn more about the Category Finance Internship role at SharkNinja.

As a key member of the Category Finance team, you’ll play a hands-on role in supporting the Product Development, Finance, Marketing, and Strategic Sales teams through cross-functional reporting. You’ll gain exposure to the financial processes behind product creation—from early-stage development to market launch. You’ll learn how finance drives decision-making across the business while building critical analytical and communication skills.

If you’re curious, detail-driven, and excited to be at the center of where innovation and financial strategy connect, we want to hear from you!

Here are some of the EXCITING things you’ll get to do:

Category P&L Management

· Prepare and maintain Category P&Ls across assigned Shark & Ninja categories.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Domestic Order Management
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon is searching for a Senior Director of Order Management to lead our Domestic Order Management function, including our Order Processing and Order Validation teams. This key operational leader will have a direct impact on customer experience, order accuracy, compliance, and downstream fulfillment and billing execution.

This position reports to the Vice President of Commercial Operations and works closely with Sales, Legal, Finance, IT, and operational teams across Axon. The Senior Director will own several key company internal controls and will lead a global team of Order Processing and Order Validation professionals responsible for building and maintaining a best-in-class order management function.

A critical component of this role will be leading the continued transformation of Axon’s order management processes. The Senior Director will assume ownership of automation and AI-enabled initiatives currently underway, including intelligent document scanning and data extraction, automated order validation, and workflow automation designed to reduce manual processing and enable orders to move from submission through validation and closure more efficiently. This leader will be accountable for advancing these initiatives from development through implementation, adoption, and measurable business impact.

As Axon continues to mature its Order-to-Cash operating model, the scope of this role may evolve over time. The Senior Director will be expected to bring an enterprise mindset to the broader Order-to-Cash process and help evaluate opportunities to improve organizational design, process ownership, and end-to-end accountability. This may include assuming additional operational responsibilities in adjacent areas, including Billing Operations. While the initial scope is focused on Order Management, the successful candidate should be comfortable operating in an evolving environment and taking on broader responsibilities as the business scales.

What You’ll Do

Location: On-site 4x a week (Tuesday-Friday) at an Axon Hub location.  Hub Locations: Seattle, San Francisco (Presidio), Scottsdale, Boston, NYC, Sterling, Atlanta

Reports to: Vice President Commercial Operations

• Own all aspects of Domestic Order Management, including Order Processing and Order Validation, ensuring orders are complete, accurate, compliant, and processed in a timely manner.

• Manage the implementation, governance, and ongoing compliance with Axon’s booking policies, including review and approval of designated transactions and policy exceptions within established approval thresholds.

• Lead a team of Order Processing and Order Validation professionals, establishing clear performance expectations, service levels, controls, and development plans.

• Own the Order Management process improvement and technology roadmap, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate manual work, strengthen controls, and improve order cycle time and accuracy.

• Assume ownership of AI, automation, and intelligent document-processing initiatives currently in development and drive them through successful implementation and adoption.

• Lead initiatives utilizing technologies such as AI-enabled document review, document scanning, optical character recognition (OCR), intelligent data extraction, automated validation, and workflow automation to streamline order intake and processing.

• Partner with IT, Systems, Finance, Sales, and other stakeholders to design and implement automated workflows that identify missing information, validate order requirements, route exceptions, and enable qualifying orders to progress through the order lifecycle with reduced manual intervention.

• Establish measurable success criteria for automation initiatives, including improvements in processing time, order accuracy, exception rates, manual touchpoints, control effectiveness, and overall productivity.

• Maintain appropriate human review, exception management, monitoring, and internal controls as AI and automation are incorporated into Order Management processes.

• Own operating review controls over adequate order documentation and work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to support accurate and timely fulfillment and billing.

• Assist with the identification and review of sales opportunities, contracts, and non-standard transactions to ensure downstream operational requirements are understood and addressed.

• Review and approve sales orders and ensure orders are transmitted to Axon’s ERP, revenue, and downstream operational systems accurately, completely, and consistently with company policies.

• Ensure billing requirements are appropriately established based on customer contracts. Partner closely with Billing and other cross-functional teams to resolve complex contractual and billing requirements.

• Partner closely with Billing leadership to improve the handoff between Order Management and Billing, reduce downstream exceptions, improve invoice readiness, and increase first-time invoice accuracy.

• Develop a strong understanding of downstream Billing Operations, including invoice readiness, billing requirements, exception management, customer-specific invoicing requirements, and the root causes of billing delays or corrections.

• Evaluate opportunities to improve Order-to-Cash processes, including clarifying ownership, reducing handoffs, consolidating activities where appropriate, and creating greater end-to-end accountability.

• Support the assessment and potential implementation of future operating model changes across Order Management as Axon continues to scale.

• Build scalable processes, leadership capabilities, and operating rhythms that can support broader responsibility across adjacent Order-to-Cash functions over time.

• Own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Order Management policies, process documentation, operating procedures, decision frameworks, and checklists.

• Ensure high-quality training, documentation, and communication are provided to Order Management teams and internal stakeholders as processes, policies, and systems evolve.

• Lead ongoing development and improvement of Axon’s systems and operational processes across the end-to-end Order-to-Cash cycle.

• Perform self-audits and operate internal control procedures to support Sarbanes-Oxley compliance and ensure continued effectiveness as processes become increasingly automated.

• Support the integration of acquisitions into Axon’s Order-to-Cash processes, systems, policies, and controls.

• Support internal and external audits of Axon’s Order-to-Cash cycle, including preparation and review of audit documentation and deliverables.

• Ensure adherence to established booking SLAs, proactively monitor performance and exceptions, and drive corrective actions to improve timely and accurate transaction processing.

• Lead cross-functional transformation initiatives that improve the accuracy, scalability, control environment, customer experience, and velocity of Axon’s Order-to-Cash processes.

What You Bring

• 10+ years of experience in Order Management,Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, or related Order-to-Cash functions. Billing Operations experience is strongly preferred.

• 5+ years of people management experience, including leadership of globally distributed teams.

• Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing operational teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Experience serving as a process owner for Order Management, sales orders, or broader Order-to-Cash processes.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex process transformation initiatives, including process redesign, automation, standardization, and implementation of new operating models.

• Experience applying AI, intelligent document processing, OCR, workflow automation, or similar technologies to improve transaction processing, accuracy, productivity, or controls.

• Strong understanding of Sarbanes-Oxley requirements and experience owning or operating key internal controls within the Order-to-Cash cycle.

• Experience implementing and governing commercial or booking policies, including review and approval of policy exceptions and non-standard transactions.

• Advanced experience with Salesforce, ERP platforms, and integrated financial and operational systems.

• Experience with Billing Operations, including invoice readiness, billing accuracy, exception management, or customer-specific billing requirements, is strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience reviewing complex customer contracts, including State and Local and/or Federal government transactions.

• Experience working in Hardware, Software, and Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) business models; knowledge of ASC 606 revenue recognition preferred.

• Strong analytical, project management, and organizational skills, with demonstrated ability to use data and metrics to drive operational improvements and measure performance.

• Outstanding cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to translate complex operational, system, policy, and control issues into clear recommendations for Sales, Finance, IT, and senior leadership.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Operations, or a related field.

Work Location

This role is based in a hub location and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs

• Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs

• Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.

$193,725—$309,960 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician – Electrical & Controls
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

The Maintenance Technician (Electrical & Controls) keeps the electrical, controls, and instrumentation systems at Lithium One, our East Texas refinery in Joaquin, TX, running safely and reliably. You’ll install, test, and maintain motors, switchgear, transformers, and motor control centers, and when something goes down, you’ll be the one troubleshooting the PLCs, VFDs, relays, and instrumentation to get production back up. Because we’re a startup, you’ll also have a real hand in building our maintenance program from the ground up, from PM planning and CMMS to finding ways to simplify or automate repetitive work. 

Responsibilities

 - Install, maintain, repair, and test electrical and controls equipment, including medium and low voltage motors, 480V three-phase and single-phase circuits, transformers, switchgear, breakers, generators, load centers, and motor control centers

 - Troubleshoot and diagnose issues with PLCs, VFDs, HMIs, relay systems, instrumentation, and industrial networks during both planned maintenance and unplanned breakdowns, find the root cause, and make timely repairs

 - Maintain, program, and upgrade control systems, including Allen Bradley PLCs, and own controls projects from start to finish

 - Perform and document preventive maintenance, inspections, and calibration on electrical, controls, and instrumentation equipment, and recommend equipment for inclusion in PM programs

 - Read one-line diagrams, blueprints, and schematics, calculate circuit load requirements, and log work, parts used, and asset history accurately in our in-house CMMS

 - Work closely with operations, engineering, mechanics, and the maintenance crew; support pump, motor, valve, and piping repairs; flag potential hazards; and suggest improvements to planning, scheduling, PM, and storeroom processes

 - Follow all OSHA and company safety procedures (including lockout/tagout, confined space, and traffic rules) and local, state, and national electrical codes; participate in safety meetings and report hazards, near misses, or equipment damage right away

Qualifications & Experience

 - 3+ years of industrial or manufacturing maintenance experience with a focus on electrical and controls

 - Associate’s degree in electrical, electronics, or instrumentation preferred, or equivalent experience

 - Hands-on experience with 480V three-phase and single-phase AC circuits, motors, transformers, switchgear, breakers, MCCs, relay systems, and instrumentation, plus solid knowledge of electrical power and distribution systems

 - Ability to read one-line diagrams, blueprints, schematics, and manufacturer specs, and to calculate circuit load requirements

 - Well-rounded mechanical aptitude, including hydraulics, pneumatics, pumps, valves, and piping

 - Skilled with hand and power tools and electrical test and measurement equipment

 - Able to walk through how you approach planned vs. unplanned maintenance, including how you troubleshoot when equipment fails unexpectedly

 - Experience in oil & gas, water treatment, chemical processing, or a similar industrial setting; hydrometallurgy, mining, or battery materials experience is a plus

 - Strong communication across shifts and good computer skills; CMMS experience preferred

 - Valid driver’s license

Schedule

 - 12-hour shifts, 6 AM–6 PM

 - Sunday–Tuesday plus every other Wednesday, or Thursday–Saturday plus every other Wednesday

 - A night shift option will be added in Spring 2027

Working Environment & Physical Requirements

 - Work in the processing plant and shop in all weather conditions, including extreme temperatures, with exposure to chemicals and other hazardous materials

 - Ability to lift a minimum of 50 pounds and to stand, walk, and work in confined or elevated spaces for extended periods

 - Ability to climb ladders and structures, with the manual dexterity to use hand and power tools

 - Must wear and use all required PPE


OUR CULTURE IS BUILT ON FOUR PRINCIPLES:



Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people.

Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.



Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

Company Overview

Asset Living is a third-party management firm with a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.

Vice President, Business Development

Our Vice President, Business Development is a senior individual contributor responsible for originating new third-party management business within an assigned region or product line (market rate, affordable, or student housing). The VP owns each client relationship they originate for the life of that relationship and is accountable for growing Asset Living's share of each client's portfolio over time. They partner closely with the Division Presidents who lead operations in their territory and direct the business development support resources aligned to their pursuits to convert opportunities into signed management agreements and successful takeovers.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Originate new management assignments from property owners, developers, investors, and capital partners within an assigned region or product line, with a primary focus on new client relationships

• Build and sustain a self-generated pipeline through direct prospecting, broker and lender relationships, industry events, and market intelligence, rather than relying on inbound RFPs

• Own each originated client relationship for its full lifecycle, growing share of wallet through acquisitions, new developments, lease-ups, and assets the client owns that are managed by other operators

• Qualify opportunities rigorously against Asset Living's assignment standards, pursuing business that fits the platform and walking away from business that does not

• Lead pursuit strategy and owner-facing presentations, proposals, and RFP responses, directing business development support resources on underwriting, management proposals, market research, and pursuit materials

• Hold credible owner-level conversations on operating performance, NOI, budgets, fee structures, and asset strategy using T-12s, rent rolls, and market data

• Negotiate management fees and key property management agreement terms within established pricing standards, escalating exceptions through the appropriate approval path

• Partner with Division Presidents and operations leadership on service fit, staffing, and takeover readiness so that what is sold can be delivered

• Coordinate the transition from award through management agreement execution and takeover with Legal, Client Services, and Operations

• Introduce Asset Living's programs, services, and elective offerings to clients where they add value to the asset

• Stay engaged with clients after takeover, partnering with Operations on relationship health and raising risk early so performance concerns are addressed before they affect the relationship

• Maintain accurate and timely contact, activity, opportunity, and pipeline records in the CRM, and produce reliable forecasts

• Achieve annual origination targets and activity standards set in partnership with sales leadership

• Represent Asset Living at industry conferences, association events, and client meetings to build brand presence and market knowledge within the territory

• This position entails travel, estimated at 40-50% of work time annually. Travel may be required for client meetings, property tours, conferences, and other business-related activities.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Real Estate, Finance, or related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Five or more years of experience in business development, sales, asset management, acquisitions, or operations leadership within multifamily or commercial real estate

• Demonstrated record of originating new business and building a book of clients from zero or near-zero, not solely managing inherited accounts

• Working knowledge of property management operations, owner economics (NOI, budgets, capital plans, and hold strategy), and third-party management agreements

• Exceptional relationship-building, presentation, and negotiation skills with owners, principals, and asset managers

• Self-directed, coachable, and persistent through long pursuit cycles and competitive losses

• Motivated by a production-weighted compensation structure with meaningful variable earnings

Preferred Qualifications by Product Line

jobs.title: Senior PCB Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Radar Reinvented.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Senior PCB Design Engineer to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

High-performance printed circuit boards are critical to Echodyne’s advanced radar products. Echodyne is seeking a Senior PCB Design Engineer to join our PCB Design team and own complex board designs for our radar products and related hardware.

In this role, you will work closely with Analog/Mixed-Signal (AMS), RF, Mechanical, and Manufacturing Engineering, as well as external suppliers, to translate schematics, performance requirements, and physical constraints into high-performance, reliable, and manufacturable designs. You will play a key role throughout the product lifecycle, from layout planning and design release through new product introduction (NPI), production, and sustaining. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on PCB design expertise, with sound technical judgment, and effective cross-functional collaboration.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Independently plan and drive assigned PCB designs from schematic review through production release, including estimates, priorities, dependencies, technical risks, and status.

• Translate schematics, electrical requirements, and mechanical constraints into complex multilayer PCBAs for analog, RF, and mixed-signal applications. Collaborate with Engineering and PCB fabricators to establish board outlines, stackups, materials, placement, routing, controlled impedance, via structures, and other physical design requirements.

• Apply signal integrity, power integrity, electromagnetic compatibility, thermal, reliability, and design for manufacturability, assembly, and test (DFM/DFA/DFT) best practices.

• Work with Electrical Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, and external vendors to optimize designs for cost, quality, and manufacturability.

• Support new product introduction (NPI), product revisions, and sustaining changes by working with cross-functional teams and suppliers to resolve fabrication, assembly, build, yield, and production issues.

• Create, review, and maintain component symbols, footprints, 3D models, in the company wide component library.

• Provide technical guidance to less experienced PCB designers and improve PCB design methods, standards, tool flows, and review and release practices.

• Work with RF Engineering and Analog/Mixed Signal design teams to learn requirements and key features, understand how these features match with vendor capabilities, and implement best practices in Schematic and Layout

REQUIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

• Proficiency with Altium Designer or similar PCB design software and the ability to interpret complex schematics

• Knowledge of PCB layout practices for RF, millimeter-wave, high-speed digital, mixed-signal, analog, and power applications

• Knowledge of PCB stackups, materials, controlled impedance, via structures, finishes, fabrication processes, and assembly methods

• Practical application of design for manufacturability, assembly, and test principles

• Knowledge of applicable IPC standards and controlled PCB fabrication, assembly, and release documentation requirements

• Ability to prioritize multiple assignments from broad direction and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams, fabricators, and contract manufacturers

DESIRED SKILLS / EXPERIENCE
(Looking for one or more as a complement to the core skills)

• Experience developing PCB designs for radar, aerospace, defense, RF, or other high-reliability electronic products

• Experience with high-density interconnect (HDI), high layer count, rigid-flex, flex circuit, or other advanced PCB technologies

• Experience with Arena or a similar product lifecycle management (PLM) system

• IPC CID, CID+, or other relevant PCB design certification

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering Technology, a related technical field, or equivalent experience and 10 or more years of relevant PCB design experience, or an equivalent combination of education and industry experience

• Eligibility to handle export-controlled technical data, including ITAR and EAR-controlled information

Echodyne’s technology is export controlled by the U.S. Government and we must evaluate an applicant’s eligibility to handle export-controlled information or obtain required Government authorizations.  Therefore, we will ask you as part of the application process to identify whether you are a U.S. Citizen or green card holder, or have asylum/refugee status in the U.S.

WHAT WE OFFER

This is an exempt role.

The expected annual salary range for this role is

$124,733—$187,048 USD

If your skills generally align but not perfectly, please apply anyway. There may be another role that’s a great fit for you!

We offer competitive compensation and benefits to our full-time, US-based employees, including:

• RSU (Restricted Stock Units)

• Generous Benefits:

• Fully-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you

• Choice of PPO or HDHP/HSA

• Virtual Care – 98Point6

• Employee Assistance Program

• Mental Health coverage through Springhealth & Talkspace (Premera)

• Travel Assistance Insurance

• Company Paid Life Insurance

• Company Paid Short & Long Term Disability

• Flexible PTO (exempt) / 15 days per year (non-exempt)

• 401(k) match

• Pet Insurance

• Prepaid Legal Program

• Commuter Benefits

• Paid Company Holidays

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Forward Deployed Engineer - Resilient Edge & Tactical Networking
jobs.description:
About Us:

At webAI we firmly believe that the future of AI lies in distributed processing at the edge, bringing computation closer to the source of data generation. Our mission is to build a future where local and private is the default, servers and data centers are optional. Where valuable data and intellectual property remain entirely private, enabling the deployment of large-scale AI models directly on standard consumer hardware without compromising the information embedded within those models. We are developing an end-to-end platform that is secure, scalable, and fully under the control of our users, empowering enterprises with AI that understands their unique business.



About the Role

We are looking for Senior Engineers to drive webAI Public Sector initiatives focused on secure, resilient, and distributed data systems operating at the tactical edge.



In our world, network connectivity isn't guaranteed. Systems must thrive in Denied, Degraded, Intermittent, and Limited (DDIL) bandwidth environments. We are less concerned with formal peer-to-peer or blockchain dogmas and far more focused on practical, robust edge synchronization: building systems that can discover local nodes, store-and-forward critical data across ad-hoc transports (such as Wi-Fi and Bluetooth), and reconcile state once connectivity is restored.



This is real-world edge work built for dynamic field settings, rather than sterile cloud data centers or closed SCIF environments. You will architect software running across a hybrid footprint of edge nodes, mobile endpoints, and cloud sync services.



Responsibilities

 - Architect Resilient Transport & Sync Layers: Design and implement store-and-forward transport and data-synchronization protocols tailored for low-bandwidth, high-latency, and DDIL field conditions.

 - Ad-Hoc Networking & Discovery: Implement local peer discovery and async I/O transports operating over heterogeneous physical links, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and ad-hoc mesh networks.

 - Field Ready Systems Engineering: Apply delay tolerant networking (DTN) principles and local conflict-free data synchronization (e.g., CRDTs and content-addressable storage) to ensure mission-critical applications function offline indefinitely.

 - Hybrid Edge & Mobile Integration: Develop and maintain software components spanning hybrid architectures bridging field edge devices, mobile environments, and upstream cloud services.

 - Performance & Resource Optimization: Lead tuning, memory management, and debugging for resource-constrained hardware operating in rugged, disconnected field deployments.

 - Security & Cryptographic Primitives: Understand and implement various authorization and authentication security patterns, suitable for DDIL and contested environments.

 - Cross Functional Collaboration: Partner with hardware, mobile, and backend teams to validate end-to-end functionality under simulated and live field constraints.



Qualifications

Core Requirements:

 - 5-7+ years of software engineering experience building robust systems software or distributed networking services.

 - Core Languages: Strong proficiency in Rust or other systems level languages (Go, C, or C++).

 - Resilient Networking Expertise: Demonstrated experience with store-and-forward architectures, delay-tolerant networks (DTN), async I/O, or local device-to-device transport layers (e.g., BLE, TCP/IP, socket-level async networking).

 - Edge & Offline First Mindset: Practical experience solving synchronization challenges under intermittent, contested, or low-throughput network constraints (DDIL).

Nice-to-Haves / Pluses:

 - Experience with Android development (NDK, Kotlin, KMP, CMP, background sync services, or Bluetooth/Wi-Fi Direct stacks).

 - Familiarity with hybrid mobile/cloud application architecture and state reconciliation.

 - Hands-on experience testing and evaluating wireless networking hardware and software in physical field or operational testing environments (outside of traditional lab/SCIF environments).

 - Background in content-addressable data structures, Merkle DAGs, or CRDTs.

 - Expertise in embedded hardware or robotics orchestration.



Why webAI?

At webAI we do our best to live out our core values we have put in place as the foundation on which we operate as a team. We are looking for people who are interested in personifying the same:

 - Truth - that which is true or in accordance with fact or reality; it’s not always easy, it’s not always pleasant, but we try to live by what reality is so we can accomplish something really cool

 - Ownership - the act, state or right of possessing something; we want you to fully own your responsibilities in this company, and continue to help define what fits in that purview and how we can help you be your best

 - Tenacity - persistent determination; we are really fired up about what we are trying to do here, and would love to have those who are fired up about what they do, to join us. If you really dig our mission, we certainly don’t mind that cherry on top

 - Humility - the quality of having a modest view of one’s value or importance; do we hope webAI can change the world? Certainly, but we know the only way to accomplish that is to not worry so much about the company’s accomplishments or status, but instead put all of that importance on building a world class team and treating them as such. We believe that’s the ultimate formula for success



Benefits:

We strive to provide competitive benefits to all employees. The benefits listed in this posting generally apply to U.S.-based employees. For employees hired outside the United States, benefits may vary based on local law, country-specific requirements, and the employment platform or entity through which the employee is hired.

 - Competitive salary and performance-based incentives

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits package
   
   - Including a high-deductible HSA option with $200/month company contribution

 - 401k match (US-based only)

 - Equity options

 - Flexible PTO Policy

 - Parental leave for eligible employees

 - Continuing education support

 - Basic, company-paid life insurance

 - Supplemental life insurance

 - Company-paid short and long term disability

 - Free parking for in-office employees
