jobs.title: New Media & Social Lead
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.




AI-FIRST BY DEFAULT

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. If you’re energized by experimenting, adapting, and learning constantly, you’ll thrive here. Expect your day-to-day to evolve as fast as the technology does.




NEW MEDIA & SOCIAL LEAD

Building Deepgram’s social, creator, and new media program from scratch · Reports to the Head of Brand & Awareness


THE ROLE

Deepgram is a voice company, and the internet is where voice is demoed, debated, memed, and decided. We’re hiring a Brand Social Lead to build our new media, social, and creator program from the ground up, and to make Deepgram a brand people want showing up in their feed. You’re a new media strategist. Brand-first, social-first, and very online. You know that a Substack post, a creator collab, a 30-second demo clip, a sharp X thread, and a founder’s LinkedIn post are different instruments, and you know which one to play and when. You’re plugged into the creators and communities shaping AI and developer culture, and you show up with ideas nobody has tried yet.


This is a lead role with no playbook to inherit: you’ll write it. You’ll set the strategy, make creative bets, and build the systems that drive social forward, partnering closely with creative teams, communications, DevRel, product marketing, and company leadership. We’re mid-rebrand, with a new verbal and visual identity landing now, so you’ll be defining how the new Deepgram brand shows up. You’ll report to our Senior Director, Brand Marketing.


WHAT YOU’LL DO


BUILD THE PROGRAM FROM ZERO

 - Define Deepgram’s social and new media strategy: which channels we own, where we show up, how we should show up there, and what we stop doing. A strategy that easily guides when to say yes, and when to say no.

 - Set the baseline, the goals, and the measurement. Define what good looks like channel by channel, benchmark against competitors, and use the data to make decisions.

 - Stand up the operating system: a visible calendar, intake, review, publishing, and reporting the whole company can see and trust.

 - Partner with product marketing, communications, executives, and cross-company leadership to set the social calendar — understanding what to prioritize from a company perspective as well as what works best on social.


OWN EVERY CHANNEL, NATIVELY

 - Lead Deepgram’s presence across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouTube and wherever the conversation moves next, each with its own voice and formats.

 - Bring a social-first point of view to Deepgram’s social content, cadence, and channels. Understanding what is moving the needles, adjusting based on data, and growing our social community.

 - Drive employee advocacy, building a sustainable program that encourages everyone at Deepgram to easily share what we’re up to. Understand how to get social into each employee’s hands, make it their own, and measure the effectiveness. Equip everyone with AI-native tools to stay on brand and social-first.

 - Support executive social, helping our founders and leaders show up with their distinct points of view in the ways that will resonate most across channels.


CREATE CONTENT THAT LIVES OUT LOUD

 - Lead short-form and social video strategy: demos, clips, explainers, behind-the-scenes, and reactive moments. Our product talks; our feed should too.

 - Bring fresh formats: collabs, series, live moments, AI-native experiments, and stunts only a voice AI company could pull off.

 - Partner with design, video producers, and AI tools to build a repeatable video engine that ships weekly, not quarterly.

 - Turn launches, events, podcasts, livestreams, and campaigns into a steady stream of native social content.


BUILD THE CREATOR AND COMMUNITY NETWORK

 - Build out an always-on creator program. Identify, recruit, and manage creators across developer, AI, and tech culture, from YouTubers and streamers to newsletter writers and niche builders.

 - Partner with DevRel to amplify hackathons, builds, and community across Deepgram’s corporate channels.


LEAD WITH BRAND AND TASTE

 - Make every post unmistakably Deepgram. Apply the new brand in social-native ways, and know when to break the template.

 - Spot cultural moments early and move fast, with the judgment to know which ones are ours.

 - Use and build AI tools to scale the work: social listening, research, drafting, clipping, and reporting.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 7+ years in social, content, and new media, including time leading strategy for a brand people love to follow, ideally in tech, developer tools, AI, or consumer internet.

 - Proof you’ve built something: a program, channel, or creator network you grew from little or nothing, with the numbers to show for it.

 - Fluency across platforms, including Substack and the newsletter ecosystem, and a point of view on where attention is going next.

 - Video instincts. You know what makes someone stop scrolling, and you can brief, direct, and edit short-form.

 - Real relationships with creators, and an eye for talent before it’s obvious.

 - Credibility with developers. You understand how technical audiences talk, what they respect, and what makes them roll their eyes.

 - Brand-first thinking. You make the brand more interesting without making it less clear.

 - Data fluency. You set baselines, read the numbers honestly, and use them to decide what to do next.

 - Lead-level drive. You set direction, make calls, bring fresh ideas, and get things shipped without waiting for permission.


BONUS POINTS

 - You’ve built an audience of your own: a newsletter, channel, podcast, or community.

 - Experience in developer marketing, DevRel, or AI.

 - Hands-on video editing or production skills.

 - Experience with creator contracting, usage rights, and disclosure requirements.

 - Experience at a high-growth company during a rebrand.

Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com http://deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Compute Transformation
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Transformation team at OpenAI partners with Finance, Infrastructure, Data, and Engineering to design and scale the business processes and systems that support our growth. Our work combines process design, systems thinking, and operational change to turn fragmented workflows into reliable, repeatable, and well-controlled operations.

We work as embedded partners to Finance, Accounting, and Operations, shaping priorities and delivering improvements across core business processes. For compute, our focus is an accurate, connected view of contractual obligations, delivered capacity, usage, and cost that supports sound decisions and repeatable financial operations.

About the Role

As Program Manager, Compute Transformation, you will lead cross-functional initiatives that connect purchasing, operations, billing, accounting, and financial planning across our compute commitments and our data center initiatives. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of problem definition, process design, integrated planning, and end-to-end delivery.

You will work across Compute Finance, Infrastructure Accounting, Capacity Planning, Fleet, Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Data, and Engineering. You will turn ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, drive decisions and dependencies, and deliver reliable processes and systems that make compute and infra spend easier to understand, forecast, reconcile, and control.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with a hybrid work model of 3 days per week in the office.

In this role, you will:

 - Own an integrated compute and infra transformation plan: workstreams, milestones, critical dependencies, resources, decision logs, and acceptance criteria. Drive execution from problem definition through production adoption.

 - Map current workflows and design scalable processes from demand planning, contracting, delivery & acceptance, receiving & operations, invoicing, payment, and month-end close. Clarify ownership, handoffs, evidence, and exception paths.

 - Enable source of truth systems that cover both operational needs and accounting / finance needs for data center construction, operations, and maintenance.

 - Drive consistent tracking of contracts, tranches, delivery events, and capacity acceptance. Connect committed spend to provisioned, accepted, allocated, and used capacity to support forecasting and financial review.

 - Coordinate reliable ingestion and normalization of cloud service provider usage, billing, invoice, and delivery data. Establish data owners, completeness checks, and traceability to financial outputs.

 - Improve compute billing, accrual, and allocation processes through consistent pricing rules, SKU mappings, telemetry and organizational tags, reconciliations, and controlled handling of manual adjustments.

 - Partner with application, AI, and data engineers to translate requirements into integrations and automation across contract, procurement, compute data, and finance platforms, with monitoring and governed change controls.

 - Align Infrastructure, Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Legal, and Engineering on decisions and dependencies. Manage scope, risks, vendor dependencies, and change requests; escalate with clear options and business impact.

 - Lead end-to-end testing, UAT, rollout, training, and handoff to operational owners. Define success measures for traceability, data quality, manual effort, exception resolution, close readiness, and adoption.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 8+ years of experience in project or program management, finance transformation, infrastructure operations, or enterprise systems delivery in complex, scaled environments.

 - Understanding of compute or infrastructure economics and related finance processes, including commitments, usage-based billing, procurement, accruals, cost allocation, and forecasting.

 - Experience partnering with software and data engineers to define requirements, resolve tradeoffs, test solutions, and deliver changes into production without direct authority.

 - A strong process mindset and the ability to connect contractual terms, operational events, financial data, and control requirements into a practical future-state design.

 - Fluency in data dependencies, system integrations, reconciliation, and data quality. Comfort working with analytical teams and tools such as SQL, Databricks, and BI platforms.

 - Experience improving workflows through automation or AI, with appropriate human review, controls, exception handling, and operational ownership.

 - Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive updates that explain decisions, risks, business impact, and specific actions needed.

 - Experience driving complex initiatives through ambiguity and organizational change, with clear evidence of hands-on delivery and adoption. Cloud FinOps, infrastructure finance, or capacity-planning experience is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Infrastructure Security
jobs.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



We're hiring a Senior Manager, Infrastructure Security to lead the team responsible for securing 1Password's cloud-native platform. Reporting into Platform Security, you'll set the direction for Infrastructure Security, establish priorities, and drive execution aligned with our broader security strategy.

We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong judgment and people leadership. You'll help your team tackle complex security challenges, prioritize work that meaningfully reduces risk, and build strong partnerships with engineering teams to make security an integral part of how our platform evolves.

Your team is responsible for security across cloud infrastructure, identity and access management, privileged access, networks, containers, and emerging AI and automated systems. You'll lead and develop a team of security engineers while partnering closely with Platform Security, Threat Operations, and infrastructure engineering leaders to strengthen our security posture.

As AI and agentic technologies become increasingly integrated into production environments, you'll also help define how we secure these systems, including their identities, access to infrastructure and data, and the controls that limit potential risk.

In this role, you'll help ensure 1Password's infrastructure remains secure, resilient, and scalable while enabling engineering teams to move quickly and confidently.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

We're looking for someone who brings strong technical depth, direct people leadership experience, and the ability to turn a security strategy into shipped work.

 - 8+ years of experience in security engineering, including at least 3 years directly managing a team, with demonstrated accountability for team delivery, individual performance, engagement, and professional growth.

 - Deep production experience securing a major cloud platform, including identity and trust boundaries, workload isolation, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code.

 - Experience building or improving privileged access programs, including how people and workloads access the systems and resources they need.

 - Experience implementing network segmentation, WAF, and zero-trust approaches at scale.

 - Hands-on experience securing AI and agentic systems in production, including workload identities, access to infrastructure and data, and security boundaries designed to limit the impact of a compromised agent.

 - Demonstrated ability to review technical work, identify gaps, and raise the quality of engineering outcomes through effective technical oversight and coaching.

 - Ability to navigate ambiguous, complex problems, establish priorities within an area of ownership, and define technical direction without relying on prescribed solutions.

 - Proven ability to influence engineering teams through technical credibility, a track record of delivering results, and the development of high-performing engineers.

 - Experience using AI to improve individual and team effectiveness, modeling responsible adoption, and ensuring AI-assisted work is reviewed for accuracy, sound judgment, and impact.
   
   

What you can expect:

 - Set the strategic direction and priorities for Infrastructure Security, and own delivery end to end, aligned with the Platform Security strategy

 - Define clear goals and metrics so progress is measurable and trade-offs can be argued with evidence

 - Lead delivery across concurrent workstreams in cloud security, identity and access management, and container security

 - Build, coach, and grow a team of security engineers: set clear expectations for what good looks like, and address both strong performance and off-track performance early rather than waiting for issues to surface

 - Work closely with platform and infrastructure engineering teams so security is designed into systems from the start

 - Help define how we secure AI and automated systems, including the identities they run as, how their access is scoped, and where the boundaries around them sit

 - Partner with the other Platform Security teams and with Threat Operations so findings reach the right owner and get remediated inside an agreed SLA

 - Make the calls Infrastructure Security needs, and bring in your peers and manager on decisions that reach beyond the team

 - Make sure security keeps up with company growth without slowing teams down







USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $230,000 USD and $334,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $202,000 CAD and $293,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone https://blog.1password.com/inside-the-culture-powering-1passwords-next-chapter/. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. 

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.



This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work 
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer: 

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy 

 Growth and future 
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community 
🤝 Paid volunteer days 
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.



You belong here.



1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.



Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.



Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.



Successful applicants will be required to complete a background check that may consist of prior employment verification, reference checks, education confirmation, criminal background, publicly available social media, credit history, or other information, as permitted by local law.



1Password uses artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) technologies, including natural language processing and predictive analytics, to assist in the initial screening of employment applications and improve our recruitment process. jobs.title: Territory Manager - Cleveland, OH
jobs.description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone.  Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor.  Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Territory Manager

Position Summary

The Territory Manager will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned territory. This individual will be responsible for educating healthcare providers (HCPs) on Mineralys’ product, building trusted customer relationships, driving product adoption, and achieving territory sales performance goals.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong selling skills, customer engagement capabilities, and a passion for improving outcomes for patients with uncontrolled hypertension. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial biotech environment and is energized by the opportunity to launch a breakthrough new class of medicine.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Management / Business Execution

• Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the disease state, clinical data, and relevant treatment guidelines.

• Build and execute a comprehensive territory business plan aligned with brand strategy, launch priorities, and sales objectives.

• Drive product adoption and compliant utilization among targeted healthcare providers.

• Analyze territory trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify opportunities and course correct as needed.

• Consistently deliver against sales goals, call activity expectations, and launch milestones.

• Maintain accurate territory reporting, and CRM documentation

Customer Engagement / Selling Excellence

• Execute strategic call plans by translating data and insights into impactful, customer-focused actions.

• Demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and openness to new ideas, embracing innovative approaches to customer engagement.

• Apply strong business acumen to assess market dynamics and leverage insights for effective territory planning.

• Build and sustain trusted relationships with healthcare providers, office staff, and key decision-makers

• Clearly and compliantly communicate clinical data, product value, access information, and appropriate patient identification.

• Deliver engaging, high-quality product presentations and address customers questions with confidence and credibility.

• Partner with customers to address barriers to patient access and support product pull-through

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders to understand customers needs and elevate the overall customer and patient experience in a compliant manner.

• Collaborate closely with adjacent field partners including Field Reimbursement Managers, Territory Managers, and Regional Business Directors to support customer needs and territory objectives

• Share insights, learnings, and best practices with field leadership and internal team (e.g., Marketing, Training, Field Operations and Analytics)

• Provide timely market intelligence, customer insights, and competitive updates

• Support regional meetings, launch initiatives, and company-sponsored programs

Compliance / Culture

• Operate with the highest standards of integrity and in full compliance with all company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements

• Demonstrate professionalism, accountability and ethical conduct in all customer interactions

• Consistently embody Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required

• 3+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience preferred with other relevant sales experience considered

• Specialty sales experience (cardiometabolic) preferred

• Prior launch experience preferred

• Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales goals strong customer relationships

• Strong clinical acumen and ability to communicate complex scientific information

• Excellent territory planning, organizational, and communication skills

• Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, launch environment

• Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel within territory

Success Profile

• Customer-focused centric and relationship-driven

• Highly accountable with strong execution focus

• Adaptable and resilient in a launch environment

• Collaborative, team-oriented, and eager to contribute to shared success.

• Passionate about making a meaningful impact for patients

Travel

• This position requires up to 60% travel.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, drive unit and actuators
jobs.description:
About ALSO.

We’re ALSO, an electric mobility company originally conceived as a part of Rivian. We’re a passionate team of builders, dreamers, doers and innovators, focused on creating entirely new (not to mention, innovative and delightful) vertically integrated, small EVs designed to meet the global mobility challenges of today and tomorrow. Our mission is to inspire everyone to ride ALSO—replacing many local car, truck and SUV miles with ones on vehicles that are more affordable, more enjoyable and 10-50x more efficient.



In this role, you will be a member of Also’s Technical Program Management team, responsible for driving the drive unit and actuator modules end to end from concept/proto development phase through mass production. You will partner with product, mechanical, electrical, firmware, test, supply chain, industrial design, and other cross-functional teams to drive product development in consumer-facing products.



What You Will Do 

 - As a Technical Program Manager, you’ll use your product development expertise to lead multi-disciplinary hardware projects from start to finish: managing drive unit programs from architecture and prototyping through validation, industrialization and production ramp.

 - You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify and manage risks early leading to rapid reaction plans to keep the program on track, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.

 - Drive the planning and implementation of customer features with the cross-functional teams to hit roadmap goals, tracking progress, while communicating status, blockers, and risks to leadership.

 - Develop and manage comprehensive program schedules via Gantt charts, technical issues, design release management, certification, manufacturing, and resource needs with engineering, supply chain, and cross-functional teams.

 - Identify and solve the top program blockers and adapt lean processes to the organization.



What You Will Bring 

 - Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, or a related engineering field

 - 7+ years of experience in program management, engineering or similar cross-functional role

 - Demonstrated success in shipping drive unit and actuator products from initial concept through mass production.

 - Familiarity with New Product Introduction (NPI) processes, including tooling qualification, PPAP, DVT/PVT, and first-article inspections.

 - Experience managing programs involving electromechanical systems with multiple interdependent subsystems (motors, PCBAs, sensors, structural assemblies).

 - Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and global suppliers on industrialization and production readiness.

 - Ability to understand technical discussions (driven by curiosity to understand how the entire system works) and provide decision framework to make technical decisions and accelerate development.

 - Clear communicator - able to hold conversations with engineering and supply chain while distilling status and decisions for executive leadership.

 - Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed (estimated ~10-15%)



The salary for this position ranges from $200,000 - $250,000 per year, depending on experience, qualifications, and location.


Perks and Benefits

 - Robust health coverage. Excellent health, dental and vision insurance covered up to 100% by Also. with FSA & HSA options.

 - One Medical membership and dedicated insurance advocates.

 - Rich fertility and family building benefits with Progyny.

 - Flexible time off. 

 - 401(k) match.



Why ALSO.

We’re passionate about helping the world find a better way to get there—wherever it is you’re headed.

We’re located in the heart of Silicon Valley and have brought together a world-class team from some of the biggest brands in the technology, automotive, cycling, outdoor recreation and retail spaces. 

Together we’re working hands-on to imagine, design and build an entirely new solution to a global set of transportation challenges.

jobs.title: Director, Central Resources
jobs.description:
At RES, we’re looking for purpose-driven individuals who are passionate about restoration and sustainability, and who want their work to make a lasting environmental impact. Our team members go above and beyond, bringing initiative, integrity, and a strong work ethic to every project. Collaboration is key—we thrive on teamwork, open communication, and diverse perspectives. In a field that constantly changes, we value those who are resilient, adaptable, and resourceful in the face of challenges. If you're intellectually curious, eager to learn, and ready to help restore ecosystems and protect natural resources, you’ll find your place here.

RES is seeking a Director, Bank Development to lead and support the successful development and delivery of mitigation bank projects across an assigned territory.

In this role, you will serve as a portfolio-level leader for complex, multi-year projects, partnering closely with Project Managers, General Managers, Client Solutions, Operations, FP&A, and other cross-functional teams. You will help guide projects from early feasibility and development strategy through planning, execution, financial oversight, reporting, and delivery.

This is a highly collaborative leadership role for someone who enjoys building structure, coaching project teams, solving complex delivery challenges, and connecting market opportunity with strong project execution. The role draws directly from the responsibilities and competencies in the uploaded job draft, including portfolio project leadership, financial oversight, PM coaching, bank development strategy, and cross-functional coordination.

Why You’d Love This Job

You will love this job if you enjoy leading complex projects that require both strategic thinking and disciplined execution.

This role gives you the opportunity to influence the full lifecycle of mitigation bank development, from evaluating new opportunities and supporting feasibility work to helping PMs build strong project plans and deliver projects successfully. You will play a key role in strengthening project management practices across your territory, creating consistency, improving tools, and helping teams make better decisions around scope, schedule, budget, risk, and resources.

You will also have the chance to coach and mentor Project Managers, helping them grow their capabilities while supporting projects that create meaningful ecological outcomes.

What Your Day-to-Day Might Look Like

As Director, Bank Development, you will serve as a portfolio-level leader for complex, multi-year mitigation bank projects across your assigned territory. You will partner with sales teams and opportunity Project Managers to support technical proposals, assess project feasibility, and define budgets, schedules, staffing plans, resource needs, and key milestones. You will help PMs build strong project models and management plans, including work breakdown structures, communication plans, scope management plans, quality plans, risk management plans, procurement plans, reporting requirements, contracts, and sales assumptions.

In the course of the project lifecycle, you will meet regularly with PMs to review project status, manage critical issues, reinforce reporting expectations, and provide guidance on change control. You will coordinate closely with FP&A, General Managers, Client Solutions Managers, Operations Managers, PMs, and other support functions to keep projects moving and drive successful implementation. You will also help lead bank development strategy work, including market evaluation, opportunity conversion, bookings strategy, and project delivery optimization.

A significant part of your role will involve reviewing project financial performance, including budgets, percent complete, revenue, margin, cash, forecasts, and budget adjustments. You will evaluate projects through regulatory, technical, financial, and operational lenses to support sound go/no-go decisions. You will also introduce new practices, tools, training, and programs that strengthen PM capability, promote consistent project management discipline across the territory, and support PMs as a mentor, coach, and internal partner.

We’d Love to Talk to You If You Have Many of the Following

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in applied sciences, engineering, construction, environmental restoration, or a related field.

• 7+ years of progressive experience in an applied-sciences, engineering, construction, restoration, mitigation banking, or related project environment.

• 5+ years of project management experience and/or team leadership experience.

• Experience leading complex projects from conception through completion.

• Experience managing, mentoring, coaching, or providing oversight to Project Managers or multidisciplinary project teams.

• Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, execution, reporting, and delivery.

• Ability to evaluate projects based on regulatory, technical, financial, and operational requirements.

• Experience estimating project work and evaluating subcontractor bids.

• Familiarity with project management software, project tracking systems, proposal development, or structured reporting tools.

What Will Make You Stand Out

• Experience with mitigation banking, ecological restoration, environmental consulting, construction, or other long-cycle development projects.

• Strong financial fluency, including the ability to connect project decisions to revenue, margin, cash flow, forecasts, and budget performance.

• Experience developing bank development strategies using market data, demand assumptions, pricing, customer insights, and delivery constraints.

• A track record of helping teams convert opportunities into bookings and projects into successful outcomes.

• Experience building or improving project management tools, templates, training resources, or best-practice systems.

You Will Thrive in This Position If You

• Lead through influence and build trust across cross-functional teams.

• Enjoy coaching, mentoring, and developing Project Managers.

• Communicate clearly with technical, financial, operational, and executive audiences.

• Can navigate ambiguity while keeping teams focused on the next right action.

Please note that the “Day in the Life” section is not intended to be an exhaustive list of job duties, but rather a representative snapshot of typical responsibilities and work experiences at RES.

RES is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a VEVRAA Federal Contractor. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Building Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

CP Group, a vertically integrated commercial real estate and management firm, has been a leading owner-operator and developer of commercial real estate throughout the Sunbelt since 1986. Today, CP Group is the largest office landlord in Florida, Atlanta’s largest private commercial property owner, and in the top 25 of largest office landlords in the United States.

CP Group brings an extensive track record and unparalleled market insight to advance investors’ opportunities in the region’s most dynamic markets. Headquartered in Boca Raton, Florida, the company has a corporate office in Atlanta and regional offices in Dallas, Denver, Jacksonville, Miami, and Washington DC.

Building Engineers are responsible to ensure the efficient operation and maintenance of HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, water treatment and life safety equipment and systems for the assigned property(s).

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to) maintaining a clean and safe working environment, performing rounds, conducting routine assessments, performance of day-to-day preventive and corrective maintenance, construction, painting, fire protection, and housekeeping assignments for assigned property(s).

The Building Engineer must have the technical aptitude for building maintenance and repair as well as a can-do attitude and positive communication style that offers tenants high levels of customer service and a strong sense of confidence for timely resolution.

Essential Responsibilities:

• Customer service (internal and exterior clients)

• Perform all plumbing, electrical, or HVAC requirements of the building(s)

• Operate and maintain the central chilled-water plant and air-side systems, including chillers, cooling towers, pumps, air handling units (AHUs), VAV systems, and fan-powered boxes with electric reheat, as well as DX units, fan coil units, heating equipment, and air distribution systems

• Participate in the required on-call rotation as assigned and respond to after-hours emergencies, equipment failures, and building operational issues in accordance with established procedures

• Monitor and adjust all mechanical/pneumatic equipment, VFDs, steam stations, control gauges, distributor panels, valves, thermostats, diffusers, and other equipment necessary to provide a comfortable environment for the buildings

• Use the Building Automation System (BAS), including DDC and pneumatic controls, to monitor equipment performance, respond to alarms, adjust schedules and setpoints, and troubleshoot HVAC and controls issues

• Verify field conditions and perform any necessary repairs or adjustments

• Repair doors, ceilings, hand railings, and floors and other general repairs, adjustments and installations about the property

• Perform repairs to plumbing fixtures (water closets, urinals, flush valve assemblies, lavatories)

• Perform preventive maintenance duties in accordance with OEM standards, building protocol, manufacturer recommendations and industry best practices; Including changing filters, cleaning coils, flushing condensers, punching tubes, greasing fan, pump and motor bearings as required, inspecting and adjusting belts, replacing motor bearings, aligning pulleys and shafts, monitor condenser, chilled, heating and secondary water chemical treatment and its associated feed equipment, clean and maintain cooling towers, and perform annual inspections and other scheduled routines as directed.

• Complete and document preventive and corrective maintenance work orders in a timely manner, including follow-up on outstanding repairs and equipment deficiencies.

• Inspect engine room equipment, fan room equipment, cooling tower, all motors, house pumps, electric rooms, back-up generator, fire pump(s), sump pump(s), and ejector pumps.

• Trouble shoot and repair base building systems

• Conduct ongoing quality control

• Develop routine cleaning schedules: clean sidewalks, streets, parking lots, warehouse fronts, riser rooms, telephone rooms, roof drains, etc.

• Assist with irrigation inspections, oversee irrigation repairs, monitor and clean irrigation pumping stations,

• Reinstall or replace signage, verify rooms are clean and clear of obstructions and debris

• Change out bad ceiling tiles

• Do drywall, door, locks, cabinets, wall-covering, baseboard and other repairs

• Identify, report, and coordinate repairs involving building components, roof or glass leaks, and water intrusion, including responding to tenant concerns.

• Monitor and manage card access

• Respond to punch list items for tenant build

• Check for operating emergency exit signs and lights and ensure free and clear access to emergency stairs and exits. Perform additional fire and life safety inspections as per NFPA and local jurisdiction, OEM standards, building protocol and as directed by supervisors.

• Document and report activities to supervisor, and promptly communicate equipment issues, deficiencies, and recommended repairs.

• Respond immediately to emergency situations (fire, evacuation, equipment failure, ) and tenant concerns.

• Comply with all applicable codes, regulations, governmental agency, and company directives as relates to building operations and practice safe work habits

• Complete all required Safety Training as scheduled

• Comply with Uniform Dress Code while working and maintain a neat and clean appearance while on the property at times other than working hours

• Inspect Buildings during inclement weather

• Additional duties as assigned

Qualifications:

• Can do initiative, solutions-oriented attitude, good communicator

• Technical mechanical knowledge and proficiency

• Ability to ascertain what repairs are most urgent in nature and prioritize

• Minimum high school diploma or GED Equivalent

• 3-5 years related work experience in operating mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems in a commercial property setting

• EPA Section 608 Universal Certification

• City and County of Denver Refrigeration Operator Certificate, or ability to obtain it within one year of employment

• Additional trade licenses or certifications relevant to commercial building operations are preferred but not required unless otherwise specified.

• Experience in operation, maintenance and basic repair of HVAC, boilers, heaters, pumps, refrigerant systems, compressors, water systems, etc.

• Knowledgeable in energy management systems, energy reduction techniques and

• Working knowledge of Building Automation Systems (BAS), including DDC and pneumatic controls, equipment monitoring, and basic troubleshooting.

• General working knowledge of commercial building systems, including their operation, maintenance, and basic troubleshooting.

• Basic Computing Skills in Outlook, Excel & Word

• Must successfully complete background screening

Physical Demands:

• Must have ability to stoop, stand, climb, frequently lift a minimum of 50 of equipment (pumps, tools, ladders) and safely install rigging/lifting devices

• Regularly required to crouch and reach to install/move equipment by bending forward at the waist or by bending legs and spine

• Must be able to safely access mechanical rooms, rooftops, ladders, and elevated or restricted equipment areas as required to perform assigned duties.

• Must be able to perform duties in varying environmental conditions, including exposure to heat, cold, noise, and outdoor weather conditions.

Base Salary Range:

$70,000 - $75,000 per year.

Other Compensation:

This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus.

CP Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Benefits:

We offer a competitive benefits package, including:

• Unlimited vacation, summer Fridays, and 9 company holidays

• Company-paid life and disability insurance

• Company-subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Voluntary insurance including supplemental life insurance, pet insurance, critical illness, accident, hospital, legal, and cancer insurance.

• 401(k) with company match

jobs.title: Senior Talent Development Leader, Talent Acceleration Products
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

Gusto is looking for a Senior Talent Development Leader to treat our highest-stakes talent systems as evolving products. This role requires a product-management lens, balancing long-term product strategy with rigorous product operations. On one side, you will own the product roadmap and lifecycle for Gusto's high-potential talent acceleration and executive development offerings, ensuring these products deliver a distinct and additive value proposition for our most promising leaders. On the other, you will own the end-to-end product health and user experience of our Quarterly Performance Review cycle. This means managing the strategic operating plan, the technical partnerships, and the cross-functional coordination required to ensure the performance process is a seamless, impactful experience for every Gustie and People Empowerer.

These two focus areas form a cohesive talent ecosystem: talent acceleration products rely on the high-fidelity signals surfaced by a trustworthy performance evaluation product. Conversely, a well-run review cycle serves as the primary discovery engine for future leadership potential. In this role, you will hold ownership over a robust portfolio of critical offerings, driving continuous definition and improvement on each to ensure they complement one another within a unified talent ecosystem. AI is integrated into your product management approach, not as an add-on, but as a core lever for automating mechanics and surfacing readiness signals with greater precision. You will determine where AI leads the experience and where human intervention remains critical, evolving these products as the tools and the business change.

About the Team:

The Talent Development team acts as a strategic partner to the business, diagnosing capability needs and architecting systems that empower employees to build their best careers. We move beyond traditional programs to design the organizational conditions that create clarity, connection, and commitment. By partnering with HR and business leaders, we align learning directly to organizational strategy, using AI and design to embed development into the flow of work.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• High-Potential Talent Product Strategy: Define and own the end-to-end product lifecycle for our high-potential talent acceleration offering. Define the product roadmap, user value proposition, and inclusion criteria in partnership with Gusto executive leaders, People Partners, and business unit leaders, ensuring the product is positioned as an acceleration engine rather than remediation.

• Product Delivery & Facilitation: Lead the end-to-end delivery of these offerings. Partner with executive leaders to design, launch, and execute the high-potential talent strategy. You are responsible for ensuring the "user experience" of these programs is seamless and delivers measurable acceleration outcomes.

• Executive Development Product: Act as the product owner for our executive development portfolio, including third-party coaching partnerships. Manage the roadmap, utilization, and impact of these offerings, collaborating with executive stakeholders to ensure our executive coaching products remain high-impact and scalable.

• Performance Review Product Strategy: Treat the quarterly performance review process as a high-stakes internal product, defining the roadmap for process evolution, user experience goals, and efficiency metrics. Ensure the cycle consistently delivers meaningful development and assessment outcomes across the organization.

• Product Operations & Lifecycle Management: Manage the end-to-end delivery of the performance cycle—from planning and readiness tracking to final calibration. Own the operational calendar and product milestones, ensuring each launch, progression, and close is seamless and predictable for all users (People Empowerers and Gusties).

• Product Experience & Communications: Act as the product owner for the user experience of the performance cycle. Lead the communication strategy and stakeholder engagement, ensuring clear messaging, alignment with People Partners, and effective escalation pathways. Design the experience to minimize friction and maximize clarity.

• Feedback Loops & Product Iteration: Own the product health and continuous improvement loop. Synthesize qualitative and quantitative feedback to drive iterative improvements. Partner with People Tech to define tooling requirements, prioritizing design and tooling fixes over manual process work to create a more scalable, automated, and impactful performance product.

Here’s what we're looking for:

• You've run a high stakes talent process for a whole company and you know the difference between a process that merely completes and one people trust.

• You can design a program from a blank page (high-potential talent criteria, cohort structure, a coaching partnership) and you can also execute a recurring operational plan with zero dropped threads. Most people are better at one of these. We need both.

• You're the go-to expert PEs, People Partners, and executives trust on high-stakes talent process questions, and you resolve root causes by shaping the standards and systems others follow.

• You already think about where AI can take manual work off a process like this, not as a future idea but as something you'd start doing in your first quarter.

• You build relationships with People Partners and business leaders easily, because most of this role's real work happens through them, not around them.

• Typically 12+ years of relevant experience (or 8+ with an advanced degree) in talent development, talent management, or HR programs, including designing and running enterprise-wide talent processes

Our cash compensation amount for this role is $150,640/yr to $1185,789/yr in Denver & most major metro locations, and $177,020/yr to $218,325/yr for San Francisco & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

Submit your interest to join our Franchise Sales team!

Franchise is one of Gusto’s newest and fastest-growing channels, and it represents a massive, largely untapped market. Our team works the market from two sides. We partner with franchisors, the brands, so Gusto is easy for them to approve and recommend. We also sell directly to franchise owners and multi-unit operators, so franchisees have a clear reason to choose us.

Account Executives run an outbound motion into the franchisees in those networks, closing new business that can scale across locations.

jobs.title: Specialist, Launch Management Engineer - Paint Shop
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

As a Specialist, Launch Management – Paint at Scout Motors, you will coordinate assigned paint-shop launch activities from pre-series builds through production ramp-up. You will apply specialized knowledge of paint manufacturing and launch processes to evaluate readiness, resolve issues, maintain accurate launch information, and recommend corrective actions.

This is an individual contributor role. You will exercise judgment within established launch objectives, standards, and approved plans, adapting proven approaches to address varied technicus and coordination challenges. Your manager will establish priorities and review work at critical milestones. Decisions involving staffing, budget approval, launch commitments, or changes outside your assigned authority will be escalated to the responsible leader.

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Paint-Shop Launch Readiness

• Coordinate assigned paint-shop launch deliverables, including equipment and process readiness, pre-series build preparation, open issues, and production ramp-up activities.

• Evaluate readiness against established milestones and acceptance criteria; identify gaps and recommend actions to the responsible owners.

• Represent assigned paint-shop launch topics in cross-functional meetings and communicate requirements, dependencies, and risks.

Issue Resolution and Continuous Improvement

• Analyze launch and production data to identify defects, process variation, readiness gaps, and recurring issues.

• Apply structured problem-solving methods, relevant precedent, and specialized paint-process knowledge to determine appropriate corrective actions.

• Coordinate implementation with accountable technical and operational owners, track progress, and verify documented results.

• Escalate unresolved issues or proposed changes that exceed established authority or could affect safety, quality, cost, or launch timing.

Schedule and Action Tracking

• Maintain detailed schedules, milestone trackers, and action logs for assigned paint-shop launch activities.

• Confirm action owners, deadlines, dependencies, and closure evidence with cross-functional partners.

• Identify missed commitments and schedule risks early; recommend recovery actions and escalate decisions requiring leadership support.

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Partner with Paint Production, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Logistics, Finance, and other relevant teams to resolve launch dependencies.

• Facilitate working sessions on assigned topics, document decisions, and follow up on agreed actions.

• Explain technical issues and recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences, including senior stakeholders.

Launch Reporting and Documentation

• Collect, validate, and maintain technical information, readiness evidence, build findings, and change records.

• Prepare concise status reports and presentations covering milestones, open issues, risks, corrective actions, and decisions needed.

• Maintain traceable documentation in approved project, reporting, and change-management systems.

Cost Monitoring

• Track cost information and budget variances for assigned launch activities in collaboration with Finance and the responsible budget owner.

• Identify potential cost impacts and provide supporting analysis and recommendations.

• Support forecasts and reporting without independent authority to approve budgets, spending, or financial commitments.

Start-Up and Ramp-Up Support

• Coordinate assigned activities within the approved paint-shop start-up organization and launch plan.

• Maintain communication routines, responsibility trackers, and handoffs between participating teams.

• Identify resource constraints and recommend support needs to management; staffing selection and resource allocation remain leadership responsibilities.

Knowledge Transfer

• Document lessons learned and share relevant paint-process and launch-management knowledge with colleagues.

• Develop work aids and contribute technical content to training materials in partnership with process owners and training teams.

• Track assigned training-readiness actions against launch milestones and escalate gaps.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Blythewood, South Carolina.

• This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Production Management, Business, or a related field. An equivalent combination of relevant education and work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

• Experience: At least four years of relevant experience in automotive manufacturing, paint-shop operations, manufacturing engineering, or technical launch coordination, including practical experience with paint-shop processes.

• Paint-process knowledge: Working knowledge of automotive surface preparation, coating application, curing, finish inspection, and paint-defect identification, with a demonstrated understanding of how process performance affects vehicle quality and launch readiness.

• Launch capability: Experience supporting pre-series builds, readiness reviews, production ramp-up, milestone tracking, and technical change coordination.

• Specialized problem-solving: Ability to evaluate identifiable technical and operational factors, assess unusual circumstances, adapt established methods, and resolve a broad range of issues within the assigned specialty.

• Analytical skills: Ability to validate data, identify trends, assess readiness and schedule impacts, and translate findings into practical recommendations.

• Coordination and communication: Ability to build productive cross-functional relationships, communicate difficult technical matters clearly, and influence action without direct supervisory authority.

• Project discipline: Ability to manage assigned deliverables, maintain accurate records, prioritize competing demands, and escalate risks with clear facts and recommended next steps.

• Systems proficiency: Proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, along with experience using project-management, issue-tracking, reporting, or technical change-management systems.

• Continuous improvement: Experience applying structured problem-solving and continuous-improvement methods in a manufacturing environment.

Role Scope and Decision-Making

• Accountable for the quality, accuracy, and timely completion of assigned paint-shop launch deliverables.

• Determines appropriate actions within established standards, approved plans, and delegated authority.

• Provides specialized analysis and recommendations; work is reviewed by the manager at critical milestones and decision points.

• Coordinates cross-functional activities without direct reports or formal supervisory responsibility.

• Does not independently establish department strategy, select personnel, approve budgets, or authorize production release.

• Escalates significant technical risks, competing priorities, resource needs, and changes affecting approved launch commitments.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial Base Salary Range: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00

Internal Leveling Code: IC9

Notice to applicants:

• To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older.

• Residing in San Francisco: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

• Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

• Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Territory Manager - Olympia, WA
jobs.description:
“Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone.  Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor.  Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com. Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Territory Manager

Position Summary

The Territory Manager will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned territory. This individual will be responsible for educating healthcare providers (HCPs) on Mineralys’ product, building trusted customer relationships, driving product adoption, and achieving territory sales performance goals.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong selling skills, customer engagement capabilities, and a passion for improving outcomes for patients with uncontrolled hypertension. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial biotech environment and is energized by the opportunity to launch a breakthrough new class of medicine.

Key Responsibilities

Territory Management / Business Execution

• Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the disease state, clinical data, and relevant treatment guidelines.

• Build and execute a comprehensive territory business plan aligned with brand strategy, launch priorities, and sales objectives.

• Drive product adoption and compliant utilization among targeted healthcare providers.

• Analyze territory trends, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify opportunities and course correct as needed.

• Consistently deliver against sales goals, call activity expectations, and launch milestones.

• Maintain accurate territory reporting, and CRM documentation

Customer Engagement / Selling Excellence

• Execute strategic call plans by translating data and insights into impactful, customer-focused actions.

• Demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and openness to new ideas, embracing innovative approaches to customer engagement.

• Apply strong business acumen to assess market dynamics and leverage insights for effective territory planning.

• Build and sustain trusted relationships with healthcare providers, office staff, and key decision-makers

• Clearly and compliantly communicate clinical data, product value, access information, and appropriate patient identification.

• Deliver engaging, high-quality product presentations and address customers questions with confidence and credibility.

• Partner with customers to address barriers to patient access and support product pull-through

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders to understand customers needs and elevate the overall customer and patient experience in a compliant manner.

• Collaborate closely with adjacent field partners including Field Reimbursement Managers, Territory Managers, and Regional Business Directors to support customer needs and territory objectives

• Share insights, learnings, and best practices with field leadership and internal team (e.g., Marketing, Training, Field Operations and Analytics)

• Provide timely market intelligence, customer insights, and competitive updates

• Support regional meetings, launch initiatives, and company-sponsored programs

Compliance / Culture

• Operate with the highest standards of integrity and in full compliance with all company policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements

• Demonstrate professionalism, accountability and ethical conduct in all customer interactions

• Consistently embody Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required

• 3+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience preferred with other relevant sales experience considered

• Specialty sales experience (cardiometabolic) preferred

• Prior launch experience preferred

• Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales goals strong customer relationships

• Strong clinical acumen and ability to communicate complex scientific information

• Excellent territory planning, organizational, and communication skills

• Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, launch environment

• Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel within territory

Success Profile

• Customer-focused centric and relationship-driven

• Highly accountable with strong execution focus

• Adaptable and resilient in a launch environment

• Collaborative, team-oriented, and eager to contribute to shared success.

• Passionate about making a meaningful impact for patients

Travel

• This position requires up to 60% travel.

These positions are eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Actual compensation may vary from posted hiring range based on geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level.

US Salary Range:  $130,000 - $165,000
