jobs.title: Associate Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.

About the Role

Our Data Engineering team is looking for an Associate Data Engineer. In this role, you will partner with clients, implementation teams, and internal stakeholders to help deliver high-quality data extracts and distribution solutions from Abacus’s core data management platform, which is built on scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.

This is an early-career opportunity designed for recent graduates who are excited to build a foundation in data engineering, healthcare data, and client-facing delivery. As a trusted partner to the team, you will support client adoption of Abacus’s data management offerings while developing hands-on experience in data analysis, mapping, SQL, data quality, and cloud-based data services.

This opportunity is designed for recent graduates. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire, including US citizens, green card holders, and those on F-1 Optional Practical Training (OPT).

Your day to day

• Partner with clients, implementation teams, and internal stakeholders to understand data distribution requirements.

• Perform data analysis, data profiling, and data mapping to support accurate client outputs.

• Build and maintain data distribution extracts, SQL queries, and scripts with guidance from senior team members.

• Support optimization of data extract scripts for performance, scalability, and reliability.

• Validate outputs, investigate data issues, and contribute to root cause analysis when discrepancies arise.

• Document requirements, workflows, data mappings, and technical decisions to support repeatable delivery.

• Participate in client meetings, project discussions, and internal working sessions to learn requirements and communicate progress.

• Collaborate with teammates to solve data challenges and contribute to a high-performing, inclusive, and supportive team culture.

• Bring curiosity and ideas for process improvements, automation, and more efficient ways of working.

What you bring to the team

• Recent graduate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or equivalent academic, project, internship, or professional experience relevant to data engineering, analytics, computer science, information systems, or a related technical field.

• Strong SQL programming skills, with the ability to write queries, analyze data, and troubleshoot results.

• Exposure to data analysis, data profiling, reporting, data mapping, or data validation through coursework, internships, projects, research, or prior work experience.

• Interest in healthcare data and systems, including domains such as membership, claims, provider, or related healthcare data sets.

• Ability to work with large or complex data sets and apply analytical thinking to solve business and technical problems.

• Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to perform root cause analysis on data, processes, and outputs.

• Clear communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage work in a fast-moving environment.

• Curiosity, humility, and a willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and healthcare data concepts.

• Desire to contribute individually while also collaborating closely with others.

What we would like to see, but not required

• Experience or coursework involving AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark, or other cloud-based data platforms.

• Experience or exposure to Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouse technologies.

• Academic, internship, or project experience involving performance tuning, query optimization, ETL, or data pipeline development.

Compensation

Compensation for this role is $30/hour or $62,400 per annum.

What you'll get in return

• Unlimited paid time off: recharge when you need it.

• Work from anywhere: flexibility to fit your life.

• Comprehensive health coverage: multiple plan options to choose from.

• Equity for every employee: share in our success.

• Growth-focused environment: your development matters here.

• Home office setup allowance: one-time support to get you started.

• Monthly cell phone allowance: stay connected with ease.

Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer

As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.

AI Use in Recruitment

We use AI-powered tools throughout our recruitment process. This includes Greenhouse's Real Talent Matching Technology, which helps prioritize applications based on job-related criteria, as well as additional AI tools used to support sourcing, interview preparation, and other recruiting tasks. We do not remove the human element—our recruiters and hiring teams review all applications and make all decisions related to candidate progression and hiring, regardless of which tools are used to support that process.

Identity and Location Verification

To protect the integrity of our hiring process, all interviews are conducted by live video with your camera on. Virtual or blurred backgrounds and headsets are not permitted absent an approved accommodation, and you should be in a well-lit, private space where your face and surroundings are clearly visible. Candidates who advance may also be asked to complete identity and location verification, which may include verifying your identity, work history, and confirming that you are located where your application states. Applications containing knowingly false or materially misrepresented information, including identity, location, or credentials, may be disqualified, and any offer may be rescinded if a material misrepresentation is discovered at any point in the process.

If you need an accommodation for any part of the interview process, please let your recruiter know in advance.

By applying, you acknowledge that we will collect and process your personal information for recruiting purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including for the verification steps described above. Please review our Applicant Privacy Notice for more information, including your rights.

jobs.title: Onsite Specialist
jobs.description:
Who You Are

Swoogo seeks a hands-on, customer-focused Onsite Specialist to deliver our onsite services from first scope to final tear down. You will scope and quote custom engagements, order the hardware and consumables, and manage each project from start to finish. You will also lead our network of contract onsite technicians, who deliver most of our onsite work, and travel to events as the onsite technician yourself when an engagement calls for it. This role combines technical skill, project discipline, and the composure to run live check-in for a client's event. You report to the Senior Director, Onsite and work closely with Professional Services, Support, and our hardware partners.

Responsibilities

Scope and quote custom engagements

• Run discovery with clients to understand event format, attendance, venue, check-in flow, badge and printing needs, and staffing requirements

• Build scopes of work and quotes covering hardware, consumables, staffing, travel, and shipping

• Price each engagement accurately and flag margin or scope risk before a quote goes out

• Recommend the right mix of hardware and onsite staffing for each event

• Track quotes through approval and hand off signed engagements with a complete scope

Order hardware and consumables

• Place hardware and consumable orders (printers, scanners, tablets, badge stock, cables) with Swoogo's fulfillment partners and vendors

• Confirm delivery dates, tracking, and return logistics so equipment arrives onsite and comes back on time

• Keep an accurate record of orders, inventory, and cost per engagement

• Stage, configure, and test equipment before it ships or travels with you

Manage engagements from start to finish

• Own each engagement from signed quote through post-event wrap-up, and act as the client's point of contact

• Gather venue details early, including network, power, load-in, and floor plan, and confirm them before travel

• Build and maintain the project timeline, task list, and status for every engagement

• Communicate progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to clients and internal stakeholders

• Manage multiple engagements at once across different dates and locations

• Close out each engagement with a wrap-up of equipment used, issues, and the inputs needed for accurate billing

Lead the contractor network

• Onboard new contract technicians and enroll them in Swoogo Onsite Certification

• Coordinate contractor availability and assign the right technician to each engagement

• Prepare project briefs for handover, covering scope, venue details, equipment, schedule, and client contacts

• Provide remote support to contractors during live events, and step in directly when an issue needs escalation

• Generate post-event reconciliation reports covering hours, equipment, expenses, and billing inputs

• Collect feedback from contractors and clients after every event, and report trends to the Senior Director, Onsite

• Maintain contractor records, certification status, and performance history

Deliver onsite

• Travel to events as the onsite technician on engagements you deliver yourself, representing Swoogo to the client

• Set up, configure, and test check-in stations, badge printers, and related hardware and networking

• Train client and event staff on check-in, badge printing, and equipment use

• Troubleshoot hardware, printing, connectivity, and software issues in real time during live events, and escalate to Support or Product when needed

• Tear down, pack, and return all equipment, and document its condition

• Bring field feedback and recurring issues back to Product so our offerings improve

• Follow Onsite Services processes, standards, and billing practices

Education, Experience, and Skills Required

• At least 2 years of experience in a customer-facing, project-based role, such as event technology, event production, AV, or field services

• Hands-on experience working at live events, ideally with check-in, badge printing, or event hardware such as printers, scanners, and tablets

• Working knowledge of networking basics, including Wi-Fi and connectivity troubleshooting

• Experience scoping, pricing, or quoting services, and coordinating contractors, vendors, or freelance technicians

• Excellent project management skills, with strong attention to process, detail, and deadlines; experience with project management tools is a plus

• Confident, client-facing, and an excellent communicator, comfortable training groups of adults

• Calm, resourceful problem solver who stays steady when something breaks during a live event

• Bachelor's degree in a related business or technical field, or equivalent experience

• Experience with Zebra ZD621, ZC10L, Epson ColorWorks and similar label printers is a plus

• Experience with event registration or check-in platforms is a plus

Travel and Physical Requirements

• Travel to client events throughout the year, including evenings and weekends when events require about 75%

• Lift, carry, and set up equipment cases up to 50 lbs

• Occasional travel for company offsites; the role is otherwise remote

Swoogo & How We Work

Learn more about Swoogo and how we work.

Swoogo is committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, sexual harassment, and all forms of abusive conduct. We do not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind—whether committed by managers, peers, clients, or vendors. We strictly comply with all applicable employment laws, including Title VII of the Civil Rights Act, the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), and the Age Discrimination in Employment Act (ADEA).

jobs.title: Tax Controversy Senior (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Who we are:

LMC was founded in 2010 on the principle of delivering out-of-the-box, trusted, expert guidance. Great clients is one aspect, but it is our even greater staff that sets us apart.

For us, it’s about creating a positive work environment that offers flexibility and growth.

LMC is searching for an experienced and motivated Tax Controversy Senior Associate to join our team at a leading full-service public accounting and advisory firm.

This is an exciting opportunity for a tax professional looking to expand their technical expertise, take ownership of client engagements, work directly with firm leadership, and play an important role in the continued growth of our Tax Controversy practice.

The ideal candidate will have a strong tax background, excellent analytical and research abilities, and exceptional writing skills. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex tax problems, developing creative resolution strategies, and advocating on behalf of clients before federal, state, and local taxing authorities.

What You’ll Do:

Key Responsibilities

• Represent individuals, businesses, partnerships, and other entities before the IRS and state and local taxing authorities.

• Manage tax controversy matters from initial notice review through resolution, including examinations, audits, appeals, assessments, and collection matters.

• Research complex federal, state, and local tax issues and prepare detailed technical memoranda, written analyses, and client correspondence.

• Draft persuasive penalty abatement requests, reasonable cause statements, protest letters, appeals, audit responses, and other substantive submissions.

• Apply the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury Regulations, IRS guidance, Internal Revenue Manual procedures, case law, and state and local tax authority guidance to client matters.

• Handle penalty abatement requests, installment agreements, Offers in Compromise, collection alternatives, and other tax resolution matters.

• Review tax returns, transcripts, and supporting documentation to identify discrepancies and develop effective resolution strategies.

• Communicate directly with clients, taxing authorities, and internal engagement teams.

• Manage multiple engagements, deadlines, and client relationships while maintaining a high standard of work product.

• Assist in developing internal procedures, training materials, and best practices for the growing practice.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• Approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience in public accounting, tax controversy, tax compliance, or a related field.

• CPA, EA, JD, or LL.M. in Taxation is required (or on track to receive licensing).

• Prior experience dealing directly with the IRS and/or state and local taxing authorities.

• Strong understanding of federal, state, and local tax laws and administrative procedures.

• Excellent technical research and writing skills, with the ability to analyze complex tax issues and translate findings into clear, concise, and persuasive written submissions.

• Experience drafting technical memoranda, penalty abatement requests, protest letters, and substantive client correspondence.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership of assignments, and collaborate effectively with partners, managers, and other professionals.

Career Growth & Opportunity

This is more than just an opportunity to work on tax notices and controversy matters. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the practice.

The successful candidate will have meaningful exposure to firm leadership, opportunities to manage increasingly complex engagements, develop client relationships, mentor junior professionals, and take on greater responsibility as the practice expands.

There is a clear opportunity for professional growth and advancement into a Tax Controversy Manager role and beyond.

Why Join Us?

• Work within a full-service, mid-sized accounting and advisory firm.

• Gain exposure to a diverse range of complex federal, state, and local tax matters.

• Work directly with experienced tax professionals and firm leadership.

• Be part of a collaborative team with opportunities to make a meaningful impact.

• Build and develop a career in a growing and specialized area of tax practice.

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of essential functions, responsibilities, or requirements.

Working at LMC provides unlimited growth potential along with a competitive compensation and benefits package. We also offer flexible hours & hybrid options to accommodate a work-life balance.

The annual base salary range for this role is $90,000-120,000. This range includes the anticipated low and high end of LMC’s salary range for this position. Actual compensation may vary based on various factors, including experience, education and/or skill level.

LMC is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. LMC makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

jobs.description:
More than 130 years ago, we started with core values that never go out of style: listen, learn and help businesses and individuals reach their goals. Our financial strength and stability are key reasons Forbes names us one of the Best 100 Banks in America the past eight consecutive years and Newsweek names Banner one of the Most Trustworthy Companies the past four years.

With more than $15 billion in assets and over 150 locations throughout Washington, Oregon, Idaho, and California, we understand our role in the economy and take that responsibility seriously. In addition to offering a source of capital to personal banking clients and businesses of all sizes, we place a high importance on employee volunteerism and donate millions of dollars each year to community organizations.

Join our team as a Client Engagement Center Service Rep, where you’ll be the trusted voice clients rely on for support, guidance, and solutions. jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

Job Summary:

PsiQuantum's Photonics & Technologies group turns the company's core platforms into commercial products. The Cryogenic Interconnect business line brings our data-center-grade cryogenics to AI rack-scale interconnect.

Turns PsiQuantum's cryogenic capabilities into customer programs — and delivers them. PsiQuantum is the only company bringing data-center-grade cryogenics to AI infrastructure. This role works directly with customers to find where cryogenic operation solves their problems in interconnect reach, cooling density and next-generation architecture; shapes those opportunities into programs; and then manages those programs from first hardware through qualification into production.

Responsibilities:

• Identify and develop opportunities where PsiQuantum's cryogenic capabilities — data-center-grade cryostats, thermal containment, warm-to-cold interfaces — solve AI data center problems, across interconnect, cooling and future rack architectures.

• Convert opportunities into programs: scope, phase structure, statements of work, acceptance criteria and pricing.

• Manage those programs end to end with customer and internal teams.

• Coordinate joint demonstrations and qualification gates across internal engineering, customer deliverables and external suppliers.

Experience/Qualifications:

• 10+ years spanning business development and program management for datacenter, networking or complex hardware systems, with 3+ years running customer-funded co-development or NPI programs through qualification into production.

• Commercial fluency in co-development structures: SOWs, phased POs, acceptance gates, production frameworks, take-or-pay and capacity reservation terms.

• Technically credible: can hold a room on thermal budgets, qualification criteria and schedule risk without an interpreter.

• Experience coordinating across a customer, contract fabricators and long-lead suppliers simultaneously.

• Comfort developing programs for a product that is still being defined, where the specification and the schedule move together.

jobs.title: Transmission Interconnection Manager
Subject Matter Expert, Legal
jobs.description:
About the Team

We are building AI systems that help people tackle complex, consequential work in the legal industry. Law demands careful reasoning, precise language, and sound judgment: understanding the facts, identifying the right questions, weighing competing interpretations, and helping clients decide what to do next. We see an opportunity for AI to help legal professionals work with greater rigor and focus more of their time on the problems that matter most.

Our team works across Research, Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market to build AI capabilities and products for legal work. Our customers include the top law firms in the world as well as in-house legal departments of some of the largest businesses in the world. We translate the realities of practice into evaluations, training signals, and useful tools, with the ambition of making AI a trusted part of how lawyers research, analyze, draft, and advise.



About the Role

We are looking for a Subject Matter Expert in Law who brings the judgment and practical experience developed in a law firm to shaping the next generation of AI. You will help define what excellent legal work looks like, test where our models meet that standard, and turn your findings into better model behavior and product experiences.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of legal practice and AI development. You will work directly with legal materials, model outputs, evaluation rubrics, and product prototypes. Your expertise will help us tackle some of the hardest questions in legal AI, including how to assess reasoning when there is no single correct answer.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.



In This Role, You Will:

 - Define the quality bar for what top-notch legal work looks like, drawing on real matters and the standards lawyers apply to research, analysis, drafting, document review, and client advice.

 - Design challenging, realistic AI model evaluations with representative facts, source materials, constraints, and deliverables, including cases that test ambiguity, competing arguments, and professional judgment.

 - Create and review reference work such as research memoranda, contract analyses, redlines, diligence findings, and draft legal documents that demonstrate strong reasoning and practical usefulness.

 - Develop rubrics that assess legal accuracy, issue spotting, factual grounding, citation validity, jurisdictional context, and the appropriate treatment of uncertainty.

 - Evaluate model outputs and complete legal workflows, identify recurring failures, and give researchers and engineers specific, actionable feedback supported by examples and corrected work.

 - Partner with Research on datasets, grading methods, and training tasks or environments that strengthen legal reasoning. Test whether model changes address the underlying problems and improve performance on new cases.

 - Work with Product and Engineering to identify valuable use cases, prototype workflows, and translate lessons from evaluations into experiences that fit how lawyers actually work.

 - Collaborate with legal professionals and design partners to refine our standards and test usefulness in practice, applying sound judgment around confidentiality, privilege, data permissions, and professional responsibility.



You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

 - Have practiced law at a law firm, with substantial experience producing and reviewing work for real client matters. We care more about demonstrated judgment and quality of work matter over title or firm pedigree.

 - Bring deep expertise in one or more practice areas, such as commercial transactions, corporate law, litigation, or regulatory work, and curiosity about workflows beyond your specialty.

 - Are an excellent legal researcher and writer who can assess authorities, distinguish strong arguments from plausible ones, and explain how facts and context affect a conclusion.

 - Can make expert judgment explicit: explain why an answer is incomplete, a clause creates risk, or an analysis misses the central issue, and describe what better work would look like.

 - Enjoy working directly with AI tools, exploring their limits, and testing ideas systematically. You can collaborate closely with technical teams and communicate clearly across disciplines.

 - Take ownership in ambiguous settings and are willing to build the first version of an evaluation, reference document, rubric, or workflow, then improve it through feedback.

 - Care deeply about the quality and consequences of legal work, and are motivated by the opportunity to help shape how AI supports the profession.



Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have:

 - Experience designing evaluations, benchmarks, datasets, or review frameworks for legal work or frontier AI systems.

 - A track record of improving legal workflows through technology, knowledge management, automation, or new ways of working.

 - Experience training or supervising lawyers, developing practice guidance, or translating complex legal concepts for different audiences.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Sales Executive, Diversified
jobs.description:
About Definitive Healthcare:

At Definitive Healthcare, our mission is simple: to connect with the real people who make healthcare happen. With real data on real people, our customers get the Definitive picture of the Healthcare market to move their businesses and organizations forward.

We’re committed to delivering the industry’s most reliable, actionable, and differentiated insights and empowering the innovators and organizations transforming healthcare. Because when our customers succeed, healthcare improves—for everyone.

Since our founding in 2011, we’ve grown into a global company headquartered just outside Boston, Massachusetts, supporting more than 2,100 customers around the world. Along the way, we’ve built a culture centered on purposeful work, collaboration, curiosity, and meaningful impact.

We’re passionate about the work we do and the people we do it with. Through programs like Definitive Cares and our employee-led affinity groups, we create opportunities for our teams to connect and give back to the communities where we live and work.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Sales Executive to own new-business sales for a defined Diversified territory. You'll run the entire new-business sales cycle from prospecting through close against a proven quota, complemented by inbound leads and Sales Development support.

What You’ll Do

You'll run the entire new business sales cycle within the Strategic market selling into Diversified organizations. Unlike many hunting roles, you won't be prospecting alone your outbound effort is complemented by inbound leads and dedicated Sales Development support as you research prospective customers, develop outreach strategies, identify prospects, demo decision makers, and close business. You'll be coached value selling by a hands-on manager. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced, driven sales professional ready to own a full-cycle new-business territory within a high-growth healthcare commercial intelligence company!

• Prospect and cold call into target accounts across pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and related Diversified segments via phone, email, and LinkedIn to build and manage your own pipeline.

• Develop a deep understanding of how Diversified commercial, market access, and business development teams use healthcare commercial intelligence to inform go-to-market strategy.

• Build and nurture relationships with prospects and stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Commercial Operations, and the C-suite.

• Diagnose each prospect’s business problem and strategic priorities, then lead value engineering and ROI conversations that show how Definitive Healthcare solves it.

• Build and execute your own go-to-market strategy for a defined Diversified territory, including account prioritization and a multi-channel outreach cadence.

• You independently lead deals from first call to close, making judgment calls on pricing and contract terms without needing manager sign-off, and you're a go-to resource for less experienced reps.

• Manage complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders including Sales, Sales Ops, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and IT and data-driven buying decisions.

• Track and hit weekly and monthly activity targets calls, meetings booked, and pipeline generated in addition to closing new business at or above quota.

• Accurately forecast opportunities and maintain pipeline hygiene in Salesforce.

• Use AI tools to enhance prospecting, research, and deal preparation.

• Flag expansion potential within newly closed accounts to the Account Executive team for future growth.

• Stay current on Diversified industry trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory considerations relevant to buying decisions.

What You'll Bring

• BA or BS degree

• 8+ years of experience selling into Strategic or Enterprise accounts, with experience in data or consultative selling; healthcare data experience a plus.

• Experience selling data, analytics, or a product with a significant data component required.

• Experience selling into Diversified, pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare strongly preferred.

• Documented evidence of consistent quota attainment / top-producer track record.

• You're a seasoned hunter — cold calling, objection handling, and relentless follow-up don't wear you down after years in the field, they still motivate you.

• Strong negotiation and closing skills; experience running multi-stakeholder deal cycles.

• Willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time, including industry events and onsite prospect meetings.

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this position is $88,000–$132,000 per year, which represents the base pay the company reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role. Target on-target earnings (OTE), including uncapped commission, is $176,000–$264,000 per year. Actual pay within this range will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

Depending on the position, employees may also be eligible to participate in a company bonus or commission plan. All employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, and participation in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer contribution.

Why we love Definitive Healthcare, and why you will too!

At Definitive Healthcare, our values shape how we work, how we treat one another, and how we deliver for our customers.

• We’re obsessed with data. Great companies are built on data customers can rely on. As responsible stewards, we validate rigorously, question assumptions, and use data to make better decisions.

• We’re accountable. We take ownership of results, not just tasks. When something needs doing, we step up. When things break, we fix them. We follow things through until the job is done.

• We care deeply. About our teammates, our customers, and the impact of what we build. We assume good intent, communicate openly, and support each other through challenges. We always bring maximum energy to everything we do.

We're also committed to creating an environment where our people feel supported in their work, their wellbeing, and their financial future.

• We invest in our people. We offer a competitive benefits package, including comprehensive healthcare benefits and a 401(k) match.

• We make room for connection and impact. Definitive Cares is our 100% employee-driven program that creates opportunities to connect with colleagues through affinity groups and make a positive impact on our communities.

• We’re a great place to work. In 2024 and 2025, we earned multiple workplace honors, including Built In’s 100 Best Places to Work in Boston (both years), a Stevie Bronze Award for Great Employers, and recognition as a Great Place to Work in India.

What our Employees are saying about us on Glassdoor:

“Great Work atmosphere, great work life balance, excellent company to work for, amazing top notch product, incredible customer service, lots of tools to help you succeed.”

-Business Development Manager

“Great team. Amazing growth. Employees are treated very well.”

-Research Analyst

“I have waited 36 years to work at a dream job for a dream company, and I am so happy to have finally got there.”

-Profile Analyst

If you don’t fit all of these qualifications, but believe you’re still a great fit, feel free to apply and tell us why in your cover letter.

If you are a California, Colorado, New York City or Washington resident and this role is a remote role, you can receive additional information about the compensation and benefits for this role, which we will provide upon request.

Definitive Hiring Philosophy

Definitive Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other status. If you’re interested in working in a fast growing, exciting working environment – we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Principal Subcontracts Administrator
jobs.description:
STR is seeking a highly motivated Principal Subcontracts Administrator to join our growing Contracts & Supply Chain team. The Principal, Subcontracts professional will lead and manage the full lifecycle of subcontracts across a diverse portfolio of government contracts. Responsibilities will include subcontracting strategy, solicitation, proposal evaluation, negotiation, award, post-award administration, compliance, performance management, modification, and closeout.

The successful candidate will serve as a subject-matter expert and trusted business partner to Program Management, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Contracts, Legal, and other internal stakeholders. The role requires sound judgment, strong negotiation and communication skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced federal contracting environment.

This position offers the opportunity to lead complex subcontracting activities, advise internal stakeholders, support purchasing-system compliance, contribute to process improvements, and help scale STR’s subcontract management practices as the company grows.

What you will do:

• Lead full lifecycle administration of a portfolio of subcontracts, including pre-award, award, post-award administration, modification, closeout, and records retention

• Partner with Contracts, Legal, Security, Quality, Finance, IT, and Program teams to develop and execute subcontracting strategies aligned with program requirements, prime contract obligations, company policies, and applicable acquisition regulations

• Oversee subcontractor due diligence, onboarding, risk classification, screening, periodic reviews, and compliance monitoring

• Prepare and issue requests for proposals and other solicitations to subcontractors

• Evaluate subcontractor proposals for price, cost, technical, schedule, contractual, and compliance considerations, as applicable

• Lead proposal analysis, including review of labor rates, indirect rates, assumptions, exceptions, terms and conditions, and cost or pricing information, as appropriate

• Draft, negotiate, and execute subcontracts, subcontract modifications, nondisclosure agreements, teaming-related agreements, and other special agreements

• Interpret and apply applicable Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), prime contract requirements, and subcontract flowdown requirements

• Manage subcontract modifications, changes, deliverables, invoices, funding actions, approvals, and other post-award requirements

• Monitor subcontractor performance, including cost, schedule, technical performance, deliverables, compliance, and overall risk

• Partner with Program Management, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, Contracts, Legal, and other stakeholders to resolve subcontract-related issues and support successful program execution

• Support purchasing-system compliance activities, including communications with the Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA), preparation for Contractor Purchasing System Reviews (CPSRs), audit responses, and remediation activities

• Identify subcontracting risks and recommend mitigation strategies related to pricing, terms and conditions, intellectual property, data rights, cybersecurity, export controls, security requirements, organizational conflicts of interest, and other applicable compliance areas

• Develop and improve subcontracting procedures, templates, tools, and training to increase efficiency, consistency, and scalability

• Maintain appropriate records and evidence to support audits, customer reviews, certifications, and regulatory inquiries

• Serve as a trusted advisor and subject-matter expert on subcontracting matters across the organization

• Utilize purchasing and ERP systems

• Experience using AI‑enabled tools and a strong willingness to learn and apply AI to drive efficiency and improve quality and effectiveness in Contracts and Supply Chain processes

Who you are:

• This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a US government security clearance, if required for assigned programs, for which US citizenship is needed by the US Government.

• Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, contracts, finance, or a related field, plus at least 7 years of relevant experience; equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered

• Significant experience administering subcontracts in a U.S. government contracting environment

• Experience supporting DoD and/or Intelligence Community customers

• Working knowledge of the FAR, DFARS, federal acquisition principles, and applicable subcontract flowdown requirements

• Experience with multiple contract types, such as firm-fixed-price (FFP), cost-plus-fixed-fee (CPFF), time-and-materials (T&M), labor-hour, and other cost-reimbursement arrangements

• Experience drafting, negotiating, administering, and managing subcontracts and related agreements

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate subcontractor proposals and perform or support price and cost analysis

• Experience supporting purchasing-system compliance, audits, CPSR preparation, or related government reviews

• Strong written, verbal, analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills

• Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and manage competing priorities

• Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills

• Ability to collaborate, communicate, and coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders

Nice to have:

• Professional certification, such as NCMA’s Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), or a related credential.

• Experience supporting DoW, classified programs or Intelligence Community customers.

• Experience working with DCMA, the Defense Contract Audit Agency (DCAA), CPSRs, or other government audits and reviews.

• Experience with subcontract closeout, claims, disputes, equitable adjustments, or termination activities.

• Familiarity with export control, cybersecurity, intellectual property, data rights, and government property requirements.

• Experience implementing or improving subcontract management systems, processes, and internal controls.

• Experience mentoring or providing functional leadership to other contracts, procurement, or subcontract professionals.

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $140,000.00 - $175,000.00

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at www.str.us for more info.

STR is an equal opportunity employer. We are fully dedicated to hiring the most qualified candidate regardless of race, color, religion, sex (including gender identity, sexual orientation and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any portion of the employment process, email us at appassist@str.us and provide your contact info.

Pursuant to applicable federal law and regulations, positions at STR require employees to obtain national security clearances and satisfy the requirements for compliance with export control and other applicable laws.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Education - NYC (Bronx, Manhattan, Staten Island)
jobs.description:
At Yondr, we believe in the power of presence. Our mission is to create phone-free spaces that deepen human connection and elevate shared experiences. We partner with artists, educators, and visionaries to design environments that put people, not devices, at the center.



Yondr’s business segments span numerous industries, primarily across education and live events. Yondr supports schools through cell phone-free programs. Our education programs facilitate the successful implementation of phone-free school environments by providing administrators and teachers with education, training, and development resources, along with all necessary equipment. In addition, Yondr supports top artists in music and comedy by creating phone-free shows, allowing performers and audience members to enjoy live performances without the distraction of phones.



POSITION SUMMARY

The Account Executive, Education is responsible for driving new business growth by developing partnerships with K–12 schools and school districts throughout an assigned territory. This role is responsible for generating new sales opportunities, managing the full sales cycle, and building trusted relationships with education leaders to advance Yondr's mission of creating phone-free learning environments.

Reporting to the Education Sales leadership team, the Account Executive serves as a consultative partner to prospective customers, identifying their needs and delivering tailored solutions that improve student engagement and learning outcomes. The ideal candidate is a proactive, relationship-driven sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building meaningful connections, and is passionate about helping schools create distraction-free spaces where students can thrive.

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Development & Sales

 - Develop and execute a territory sales strategy to generate new business opportunities with K–12 schools and school districts.

 - Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold calling, referrals, networking, and lead generation activities.

 - Conduct in-person meetings, virtual presentations, phone calls, and email outreach to establish relationships with school administrators and district decision-makers.

 - Meet or exceed established sales goals through effective pipeline management and disciplined sales execution.

 - Identify and respond to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and other competitive bid opportunities.

 - Negotiate pricing, contracts, and partnership agreements with prospective customers.

Relationship Management

 - Develop trusted relationships with school leaders, administrators, and district stakeholders throughout the sales process.

 - Deliver compelling presentations and product demonstrations that clearly communicate the value and impact of Yondr's solutions.

 - Collaborate with existing customers to identify referral opportunities and expand regional market presence.

 - Represent Yondr with professionalism while serving as a trusted advisor to prospective education partners.

Sales Operations & Collaboration

 - Maintain accurate customer records, pipeline activity, forecasts, and sales documentation within the company's CRM platform.

 - Partner closely with Implementation, Customer Success, and Account Management teams to ensure seamless customer onboarding and successful handoffs following contract execution.

 - Participate in ongoing sales training, professional development, and product education to strengthen sales effectiveness and industry knowledge.

 - Represent Yondr at regional and national education conferences, trade shows, and industry events to generate awareness and new business opportunities.

 - Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned in support of departmental and organizational objectives.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications

 - Five (5) or more years of professional sales experience with demonstrated success meeting or exceeding sales goals.

 - Experience in outbound prospecting, cold calling, lead generation, and pipeline development.

 - Ability to travel up to 60% to support customer meetings, conferences, and business development activities.

 - Valid U.S. driver's license and ability to travel throughout assigned territory.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

 - Consultative, relationship-focused approach to selling with a strong customer-first mindset.

 - Excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

 - Ability to build trust and credibility with school administrators and executive-level decision-makers.

 - Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.

 - Self-motivated and highly autonomous with excellent follow-through and accountability.

 - Comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced, and rapidly evolving environment.

 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt solutions to customer needs.

 - Proficiency with CRM systems and standard business productivity applications.

 - Passion for Yondr's mission of creating distraction-free environments that promote meaningful human connection.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience selling into the K–12 education market.

 - Experience presenting to school boards, district leadership teams, or educational organizations.

 - Familiarity with public sector purchasing processes and RFP responses.

 - Previous experience representing an organization at conferences, trade shows, or industry events.

 - Experience in solution-based or consultative B2B sales.

 - Physical Requirements

 - Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.

 - Ability to communicate effectively in person, virtually, and by telephone.

 - Ability to travel up to 60% of the time, including occasional evenings and weekends for conferences and customer events.

 - Ability to transport sales materials, displays, and equipment weighing up to 25 pounds.

JOB LOCATION

 - Remote position

 - Although this position is remote, the candidate must be located within one of the three areas listed - Bronx/Manhattan/Staten Island.

COMPENSATION

 - Expected OTE = $155,000 - $165,000 w/a base range of $90k - $100k

YONDR BENEFITS

 - 100% paid medical coverage plan option for employees and access to 15+ plan types, including PPO, HMO and HDHP

 - Dental and vision and ancillary benefits such as short-term disability, long-term disability and life insurance

 - Generous PTO for rest and recharge throughout the year

 - 12 weeks of paid parental leave

 - 1 week paid holiday break at the end of December, for a company-wide closure + 11 additional nationally recognized holidays

 - 401(k) offering

 - Tech tool preference, including choice of PC or Mac.

 - Hybrid employees receive catered lunch twice a week.

Recruitment Fraud Notice: Yondr will never request payment during recruitment or onboarding. All recruiting emails from our team come from an @overyondr.com http://overyondr.com address. Please report any suspicious recruiting activity to support@overyondr.com.

Yondr is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in its hiring of employees based on race, religion, gender, or sexual orientation.

SmartAsset is seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands-on Vice President, Legal & Chief Compliance Officer to lead our legal and regulatory compliance functions. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description:
Role Description

Security Engineers at Dropbox safeguard our digital ecosystem alongside a diverse team of professionals dedicated to protecting our products and users. Trusted by millions, our mission is to integrate security seamlessly into Dropbox, empowering confident collaboration.

In this role, you’ll help shape how Dropbox secures AI systems and agentic workflows, building and operating the controls that protect the infrastructure, tools, and data they rely on. You’ll tackle challenges such as prompt injection, secure agent access, and MCP integrations, turning emerging risks into practical, reusable safeguards. Partnering across engineering and security, you’ll lead hands-on work that enables teams to adopt AI safely while protecting customer data.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

• Design, deploy and operate infrastructure-level security controls for Dropbox's AI and agentic infrastructure, including cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes and data stores.

• Design and implement secure authentication, authorization and networking patterns for AI agents and other non-human actors

• Lead security implementation for secure usage of AI tools and governance.

• Maintain a high and continuously improving bar for the security of Dropbox infrastructure in order to protect customer data.

• Review the current and upcoming infrastructure stack from a security perspective and provide hardening mechanisms and recommendations.

• Deploy, build, and/or operate security infrastructure solutions to help scale and raise the security bar for Dropbox’s on-prem and cloud infrastructure.

• Collaborate with cross functional teams and lead security initiatives to influence product decisions and enhance security posture.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

• 8+ years of Security Experience, demonstrating impactful contributions to security strategies.

• Experience in securing agentic AI systems with hands-on implementation of security controls targeting AI-specific vulnerabilities like prompt injection, data or model poisoning, and AI supply-chain risk.

• Experience in designing and implementing identity and authorization for non-human workloads and agents using modern frameworks such as SPIFFE/SPIRE, OAuth 2.1, OIDC, or cloud provider equivalents.

• Experience implementing policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, and security automation for cloud and AI platforms.

• Experience with agentic frameworks and MCP tool integration.

• Experience with cloud security technologies for providers like Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Microsoft Azure.

• Proficiency using one or more scripting or high-level languages to automate tasks, manipulate data, or build small systems e.g. Bash, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, NodeJS, C/C++, Java

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field, or equivalent experience, with coding proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience securing MCP-based systems or similar AI agent and tool protocols.

• Experience with multi-agent security controls such as trust boundaries, signed inter-agent messaging, and circuit breakers.

• Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, NIST SP 800-218A, OWASP LLM and agentic security guidance.

• Experience in Kubernetes and container security.

• Experience with security tools such as Teleport, CrowdStrike, Proofpoint, IPS/IDS, SIEM or SOAR.

• Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent.

• Involvement in security community activities, conferences, or publications.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

• Awareness: Understand yourself and others.

• Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.

• Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.

• Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

US Zone 1

This role is not available in Zone 1

US Zone 2

$214,200—$289,800 USD

US Zone 3

$190,400—$257,600 USD

jobs.title: Auto Body Team Lead
jobs.description:
About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
Line Lead is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

What you’ll be doing:

• Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.

• Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.

• Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.

• Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.

• Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

• Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.

• Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.

• Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.

• Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.

• Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.

• Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.

• Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.

• Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.

• Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

What the job requires:
To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• High School Diploma or GED equivalent

• Experience using computers

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• Demonstrated functional expertise in one or more areas pertaining to Carvana’s reconditioning process

• Demonstrated understanding of our current reconditioning processes and lean principles

• Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years).

• Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels

• Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to effectively delegate tasks to team members.

• Ability to communicate and interact with others effectively in a professional, courteous manner.

• Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.

• Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.

• Ability to work overtime and on weekends.

• Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Position with a competitive salary

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally

• Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Legal stuff
Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Vice President, Public Sector
jobs.description:
Bitwarden promotes better internet security and safety with an open source password management solution for individuals, teams, and business organizations.

Bitwarden seeks a Vice President of Public Sector Sales to build and lead our public sector business. You will own strategy and execution across federal, state, local, and education (SLED) markets, build a team of public sector sellers, and establish the partner, channel, and contract vehicle relationships that government buyers rely on. You bring deep relationships in the public sector community, a strong understanding of government procurement, and the leadership to turn Bitwarden’s trusted open source platform into a go-to choice for agencies and institutions.

This is an all-remote role with a requirement for overlap with US East Coast hours. Proximity to the Washington, DC metro area is a plus.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy and leadership

• Own the public sector go-to-market strategy across federal civilian, defense, and SLED segments, with accountability for pipeline, bookings, and forecast accuracy

• Build, lead, and develop a team of public sector account executives and supporting roles

• Partner with Bitwarden leadership on segment priorities, territory design, and long-term public sector investment

• Establish an operating cadence for forecasting, pipeline reviews, and reporting to company leadership

• Work closely with Security, Compliance, Product, and Engineering on FedRAMP and other government compliance requirements, and bring customer requirements back to the roadmap

Partners, channel, and procurement

• Build relationships with federal integrators, resellers, and distributors to expand reach into agencies and institutions

• Establish and grow access to key contract vehicles and procurement pathways

• Navigate government buying cycles, including RFPs, RFIs, and fiscal year timing

• Partner with the Channel and Strategic Partnerships team to align public sector and partner strategy

Executive engagement

• Serve as executive sponsor on strategic public sector opportunities and lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals to close

• Build relationships with agency CIOs, CISOs, and IT leaders

• Represent Bitwarden at public sector industry events and forums

• Gather competitive and market intelligence across the public sector landscape

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

• 12+ years of B2B technology sales experience, including 7+ years selling into the public sector

• 5+ years leading public sector sales teams, ideally including building a team or a new public sector business

• Established relationships across federal agencies, integrators, and the reseller and distributor ecosystem

• Hands-on experience with government procurement, contract vehicles, and long sales cycles

• Experience selling security, identity, or infrastructure software to government buyers

• Working knowledge of FedRAMP and government compliance frameworks

• Familiarity with open source software in government environments is a plus

• High emotional intelligence and a collaborative leadership style that builds trust across a fully distributed company (100% remote)

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including with executive and agency audiences

• A growth mindset and a desire to learn from others

• Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security

• Ultimate focus on customer adoption and success

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

• Interview with Chief Sales Officer

• Interview with Sales leadership and team members

• Interview with cross-functional leaders (Security/Compliance, Engineering, Channel)

• Reference calls

• Interview with the CEO

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.

Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.

We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team.

We recognize and understand that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications for the position, you should still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. Please let us know if you require accommodations during the interview process.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Edmentum is a dynamic educator and student-focused company dedicated to tech-enabled learning solutions. Our goal is to ensure that all students have access to flexible learning environments and educators have the tools they need to support their students. We are on a mission to create innovative, proven learning technology, partnering with educators to ignite student potential. We are a Remote First organization with a strong commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

As a Partnership Manager, you'll own a dynamic territory across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Maryland, balancing the growth of existing district partnerships with the pursuit of new business opportunities. This role combines strategic account management, customer relationship development, and proactive prospecting, with approximately half of your focus dedicated to renewals and account expansion and half dedicated to identifying and winning new district partners. You'll thrive in a highly visible, field-based role where building trusted relationships, understanding customer needs, and driving meaningful educational outcomes go hand in hand.

Where you'll work: This is a field-based role supporting school and district partners throughout the Greater Philadelphia region, including Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and portions of Maryland. The ideal candidate will be based in or near Philadelphia, PA, Wilmington, DE, Trenton, NJ, or the surrounding area and will spend approximately three days per week traveling within their assigned territory, typically within a two hour driving radius, with the remainder of the time working remotely from a home office.

What You’ll Do

• Drive revenue growth across your territory, developing strategic account plans and executing to exceed targets.

• Build trusted relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders—becoming a go-to partner in their success.

• Deliver tailored presentations and demos that align to customer priorities and drive complex buying decisions.

• Own the full sales cycle, making strategic account decisions in alignment with company goals.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams to enhance customer experiences.

• Analyze market trends and customer insights to inform territory strategy and identify new opportunities.

• Champion continuous improvement, contributing to the evolution of our sales processes and team best practices.

• Embrace new challenges and contribute to additional initiatives as needed to drive team and company success.

Who You Are

• You bring 4-6 years of experience in sales or customer-facing roles, bonus if it’s in EdTech or Education.

• Deep understanding of modern real-time rendering techniques and GPU hardware

• Deep understanding of Unreal Engine 5 and underlying technologies

• Ability to write, debug, and analyze shaders and pipelines using platform GPU performance and debugging tools

• A shipped rendering optimization or approximation of your own design that you can walk us through in detail

• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Relevant Experience:

• Experience with PS5, PS5 Pro, and Xbox Series X|S development tools and platform requirements

• Unreal Engine 5 optimization

• Experience defining content budgets and standards with technical artists, such as LOD, asset validation, mesh and texture streaming, etc.
