jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Creative Director of Content
jobs.description:
Senior Vice President, Creative Director, Content

The Creative Director, Content is an integral part of Highwire’s leadership team, elevating our content marketing strategies and storytelling quality, fostering integration across departments, and maximizing the client value of content across all marketing channels. We are looking for a special leader that is equal parts right brain and left brain—a strategic thinker and marketer that can inspire unforgettable writing and pixel-perfect visuals.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of highwire’s content marketing team, drive integration and make a significant impact on our business growth in categories such as Enterprise Technology, Cybersecurity, Healthcare, Energy and Sustainability and Financial Services. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, a strong leader, and a skilled collaborator who can navigate complex organizational and interpersonal dynamics while delivering exceptional results for our clients.

You will lead a highly-skilled team of content strategists, designers, writers and editors, partnering with our discipline leads across Social Media, Creative, Insights and Analytics to continually find ways to multiply our impact. We will look to you to establish new benchmarks for branded content, developing reach, relevance and engaging both new and existing audiences with high-quality deliverables that meet client needs, demonstrating value and ROI.

Key Responsibilities:

• Content Marketing Leadership:

• Oversee the team responsible for the development and execution of innovative content marketing and editorial strategies that drive growth, engagement and thought leadership for our clients and their executives

• Lead new business and organic growth, with a responsibility and ownership of a new business pipeline, built in partnership with practice leads and in response to standalone content marketing growth opportunities

• Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices to keep our content marketing efforts cutting-edge. These include the impact of AI on content generation, dissemination and consumption.

• Evaluate and build upon existing programs through strategic direction, strategy, and content development. Establish yourself as senior counsel to our most important clients, helping them navigate new challenges and apply content marketing or editorial solutions

• Serve as the ultimate guardian of content quality, ensuring all our deliverables meet the highest standards in both writing and strategy

• Team Management and Development:

• Lead and manage the Editorial and Content Marketing teams (including Writers and Editors), Designers,Producers and Motion Graphics.

• Hold regular one-on-one meetings and execute performance evaluations for direct reports, leveraging individual OKRs and quarterly targets

• Set departmental OKRs in conjunction with the team and agency leadership

• Mentor, coach, and provide feedback for career path development of team members

• Foster a positive, collaborative culture that contributes to job satisfaction for all teams

• In partnership with our Delivery and Operations (project management) teams, ensure effective work distribution, optimized staffing and timely delivery

• Establish and monitor freelance and contractor budgets, ensuring additional capacity is deployed where necessary, and justified against the above

• Client Strategy and Relationship Management:

• Actively consult on cross-channel client storytelling strategies

• Maintain a strong understanding of key clients' businesses, verticals, voice, preferences, and operational nuance

• Oversee high-profile client relationships, ensuring satisfaction and retention

• Identify client growth opportunities and prepare proactive proposals to continually enhance the programs we deliver

• Identify clients at risk of churn and create tailored retention strategies

• Work closely with Account Managers on key client relationship development, satisfaction and retention beyond editorial and content marketing

• Process Improvement and Operational Efficiency:

• In collaboration with our Delivery and Operations teams, design, document, and implement processes that improve internal efficiency, ensure quality and elevate the client experience

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency or reduce costs via process enhancements, technology or staffing optimization

• Develop and deliver team training (both in person and via on-demand materials), ensuring standardization of approach and scalability of delivery

• Ensure that every account is properly resourced for client satisfaction. If this requires additional resource, be prepared to make the business case leveraging your familiarity with standardized metrics: Revenue, capacity and utilization

• Business Development:

• Support business development by contributing to the development of new business pitches, reviewing proposals, and approving new scopes of work (designed in collaboration with our Delivery and Operations teams)

• Establish yourself as a thought leader, and continually contribute to Highwire marketing materials

• Collaborate with business development teams to expand our client base through networking, speaking engagements and acting as an ambassador for the agency

• Cross-Functional Integration:

• Spearhead the integration between Content Marketing, Editorial and the wider agency

• Work particularly closely with our Insights and Analytics teams, leveraging analyst input for more sophisticated, cross-channel content marketing strategies and approaches

• Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams to create more sophisticated understanding and application of our integrated abilities

• Work closely with CRMs, account and practice leads to ensure clients are consistently presented with content solutions which anticipate need, enhance their competitive advantage and deliver tangible, measurable value

Success Factors:

• 15+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial, or related field, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role

• Proven track record of developing and executing successful and highly creative campaigns

• Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into actionable plans

• Strong understanding of the digital marketing landscape, including paid, earned and social media. A background or experience in PR is beneficial.

• Experience managing and mentoring teams of designers, writers, editors, and content marketing strategists

• Strong understanding of technology industry, players, and trends, especially in the B2B or healthcare spaces

• Experience in change management and organizational development

• Expert knowledge of search engine optimization (SEO) and inbound marketing concepts.

Personal Attributes:

• Visionary and personable leader with the ability to inspire and motivate teams and clients alike

• Adaptable and resilient, able to thrive in a fast-paced, changing environment and structure which at times may seem ambiguous, even if our ambitions and aspirations are not

• Collaborative mindset with strong interpersonal skills

• Results-oriented with a focus on driving growth and innovation

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities

• Capable and confident in performing phone or video calls on behalf of the company and at short notice

The salary range for this position is $195,000 to $249,000, with the final offer based on a combination of factors, including education, relevant experience, skills, prior training, internal equity, and local geographic market data. This role also includes a competitive benefits package with medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401(k) matching, generous paid time off, and additional perks designed to support your overall well-being and growth. #LI-Hybrid

About Highwire

Highwire is a strategic marketing communications agency at the intersection of innovation and industry. We partner with ambitious companies and established brands to navigate complexity, lead markets, and grow with purpose. With integrated expertise in strategic marketing and communications, corporate reputation, creative, and insights, we cut through the noise to deliver bold ideas and measurable impact across B2B technology, healthcare, cybersecurity, energy, professional and financial services, and more.

At Highwire, we believe that storytelling fuels transformation. We know that the most impactful stories represent all voices and perspectives. As a values-driven agency, we foster an inclusive environment where everyone—regardless of age, race/ethnicity, size, shape, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion and different abilities–can feel safe, celebrated and worthy.

We ensure that every Highwire Walker has the requisite support to soar in their careers. Our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging is foundational and embedded in our business and culture. We aspire to change our industry and build a better future for all.

Our people-first culture is driven by four core values:

• Team Empowerment

• Growth Mindset

• Inclusion Always

• Fierce Distinction

We’re looking for individuals with big ideas, strong opinions, and the energy to bring them to life. If you thrive in an environment that values personal accountability, high standards, and boundless motivation, this is the opportunity for you. Be part of our award-winning culture and contribute to an exciting and growing business where you can make a real impact.

Highwire. Above all.

Our people-first culture is reflected in the meaningful benefits, flexibility, and support we offer:

• Competitive salary with merit-based opportunities for growth

• Flexible hybrid work model tailored to your schedule and lifestyle

• Generous vacation policy, including extended summer and winter breaks

• Early log-off on Fridays through our Empower Hours program

• 401(k) plan with employer matching

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus FSA options

• Paid parental leave benefits

• Commuter benefits

• Annual Growth Mindset stipend for books, events, or learning experiences

• Monthly technology reimbursement

• Wellness benefit program for mental and physical health

• 501c3 donation matching program

• Mentorship and ongoing professional development opportunities

• Monthly recognition and team celebrations

• Employee referral and new business referral bonuses

• Quarterly Highwire events and team gatherings

• Dog-friendly office environment

• A supportive, inclusive, and collaborative workplace where you can grow and do your best work

Location & Work Environment

Highwire offers both remote and hybrid work options, depending on where you live.

Hybrid: Candidates located within commuting distance of our New York, NY or San Francisco, CA offices follow a hybrid schedule, with three in-office days per week.

Remote: We hire for fully remote roles in the following states: California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Washington, D.C..

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Instacart Business - Growth
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart Business is hiring a Senior Product Manager to drive growth on Instacart Business. You'll own how we acquire, activate, retain, and expand business customers across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise.

About the Role

You'll own the growth roadmap end to end. That means setting the goals, sizing the opportunities, running the experiments, and deciding what to scale and what to kill. We're focused on durable growth: compounding levers that keep businesses ordering and grow their accounts over time.

Instacart Business's features are one of your biggest levers. Team accounts, spending controls, invoicing, tax-exempt purchasing, and integrations are what we lead with when we acquire customers, what we activate them into, and what makes Instacart Business part of how they run. Driving adoption of those features is a dedicated growth initiative. You'll also spot where new or expanded features can open up more growth.

The role suits a PM who knows funnel metrics and experimentation well, and who has the product craft to turn what they learn into better experiences. You'll bring your own point of view on where growth comes from, and you'll align Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Design, Engineering, and Data Science behind it.

About the Team

Instacart Business brings Instacart's same-day delivery to companies of every size, from small offices and restaurants to large enterprises. Our customers use it for office snacks and supplies, team events, restaurant restocking, and everything in between. We build for how businesses buy. That means shared accounts with team management, spending controls and approvals, tax-exempt purchasing, invoicing and net terms, and integrations with the expense and procurement tools businesses already use. These features are available in the Instacart app and on the e-commerce sites Instacart powers for retailers.

Many businesses already shop on Instacart outside of Instacart Business. You'll convert them into Instacart Business customers and grow the accounts we already have.

Growth sits within the product team. You'll work alongside the PMs building payments, invoicing, and integrations. We're a small team with a high bar for craft and a bias toward shipping, measuring, and learning fast.

What You'll Do

• Own the business customer funnel. This covers acquisition, activation, habit formation, retention, and winback across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise. You'll set the goals and metrics, then build the experiment roadmap against them.

• Grow existing accounts. You'll turn single-buyer accounts into team accounts and single-location customers into multi-location ones, and increase order frequency and spend over time.

• Drive adoption of business features. You'll run feature adoption as a dedicated growth program, making sure customers find, set up, and keep using the features built for how businesses buy. That includes how we position those features during acquisition and onboarding.

• Build growth into the product. You'll own onboarding, in-product education, and lifecycle experiences. You'll partner with Marketing, which owns CRM and outbound channels.

• Grow business on retailer sites. You'll own business customer growth on retailer sites powered by Instacart.

• Grow through partners. You'll work with Partnerships on co-marketing and integrations that bring Instacart Business to where business buyers already are, and measure their impact.

• Build and expand features that drive growth. You'll find opportunities to build new features and expand existing ones, then scope and ship the work with the biggest growth impact.

• Use AI in the product and in how you work. In the product, that means personalization, targeting, and churn prediction. In your own workflow, it means doing more research and analysis with a small team.

• Work across the company. Your partners are Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Finance.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of a growth area with measurable, durable results in acquisition, activation, retention, or lifecycle.

• You're strong at experimentation and analysis. You design A/B tests, work in the data yourself, and make clear calls on ambiguous results.

• You weigh tradeoffs between growth and profitability and between short-term wins and compounding levers.

• You've shipped product features end to end.

• You write and communicate clearly, and you can align senior partners around a decision.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with B2B, SMB, marketplace, or SaaS growth.

• Experience growing customers across segments, from SMB through enterprise, or driving account expansion.

• Experience partnering with Growth or Performance Marketing on attribution, channels, and budget.

• Experience with growth partnerships, co-marketing, or product integrations with external partners.

• Experience applying AI/ML to growth problems.

• Familiarity with grocery, retail, or CPG.

#LI-Remote

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

jobs.title: AI Security Engineer, Detection and Response
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

Our mission at Ōura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Ōura Ring and its connected app. We’ve helped over a million people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lives.Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work - both in and out of the office.We are looking for an AI Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response team. You will focus on building AI agents and automations for security incident lifecycle, threat hunting, and detection engineering. Ōura is building an AI-native detection and response program, where agents investigate and resolve routine alerts and people focus on the hard calls. You will be hands-on in our environment, turning that plan into working solutions that protect our systems, data, and the members we serve.

What You Will Do:

• Design, build, and deploy AI agents and automations that investigate and triage alerts, write and tune detections as code, enrich incidents, and take approved response actions to automate routine security operations.

• Run AI-driven threat hunting, and turn gaps in visibility into new detection capabilities.

• Conduct security incident response from detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review, coordinating with engineering, IT, our managed SOC partners, and leadership.

• Conduct investigations and digital forensics across endpoint, cloud, identity, and SaaS environments.

This is a remote role based in the US with a strong preference for candidates based on the East coast.

We have offices in San Francisco, San Diego and Los Angeles for those who prefer hybrid or office settings. Ōura employees in other major cities (like Boston and New York) occasionally gather informally at local co-working locations.

What you'll bring:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, with a primary focus on security operations, detection engineering and incident response.

• Proven experience leading incident investigations and digital forensics.

• Hands-on experience writing and tuning detections in security detection solutions.

• Hands-on experience building or integrating end-to-end AI agents and LLM-based solutions for security operations, such as alert triage, investigation, or automated response.

• Scripting and automation skills in Python, and experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure as code.

• You are organized, prioritize effectively, and stay calm under pressure, handling incidents alongside long-term build work.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills with the ability to synthesize highly technical concepts into clear and concise language

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

• Competitive salary and equity packages

• Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources

jobs.title: Principal Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

Job Summary:

The mission of PsiQuantum's Principal Hardware Design Engineer role is to support the Electronics team for our photonic switching products. This engineer will collaborate in cross-functional teams of thermal, mechanical, firmware, and optical engineers. The designs will meet the requirements of the overall system architecture and product requirements.

Responsibilities:

• Architect a PCB hardware design from an functional requirements document.

• Design, create schematics, and oversee PCB layout of analog and digital circuitry consisting of but not limited to DAC’s, ADC’s , high-speed transceivers, FPGA's, microcontrollers, clock distribution, power supply filters, inrush current limiters and power distribution.

• Ensure robust signal integrity and EMI suppression in all designs.

• Design and create test set-ups for testing of electro-optic modules.

• Characterize, optimize, and debug analog, digital, and electro-optic circuitry using equipment such as mixed signal & sampling oscilloscopes, vector network analyzers, signal generators, multimeters, DC power supplies.

• Develop bench software to drive measurements.

• Analyze data and extract key performance parameters.

• Maintain detailed documentation of hardware designs, test results, and design changes.

• SI simulation using Cadence and Ansys tools

Experience/Qualifications:

• Master's or Ph.D. Degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Physics or equivalent.

• 10 years of relevant experience in product development and release to volume manufacturing leading to multiple successful commercial products.

jobs.title: Facilities Technician II
jobs.description:
At Relativity Space, we’re building rockets to serve today’s needs and tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Our Terran R vehicle will deliver customer payloads to orbit, meeting the growing demand for launch capacity. But that’s just the start. Achieving commercial success with Terran R will unlock new opportunities to advance science, exploration, and innovation, pioneering progress that reaches beyond the known.

Joining Relativity means becoming part of something where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level. Here, you're not just executing tasks; you're solving problems that haven’t been solved before, helping develop a rocket, a factory, and a business from the ground up. Whether you’re in propulsion, manufacturing, software, avionics, or a corporate function, you’ll collaborate across teams, shape decisions, and see your work come to life in record time. Relativity is a place where creativity and technical rigor go hand in hand, and your voice will help define the stories we’re writing together. Now is a unique moment in time where it’s early enough to leave your mark on the product, the process, and the culture, but far enough along that Terran R is tangible and picking up momentum. The most meaningful work of your career is waiting. Join us.

About the Team:

The Launch team operates at the intersection of every major aspect of Terran R, from stages and payloads to ground systems, launch, landing, and refurbishment. The Cape is the only place where you see it all come together, offering a level of exposure and responsibility unmatched elsewhere in the program. This is where first flights happen, where history is built on top of history, and where the scale of what's underway is unlike anything in modern aerospace. The mission stays the same, but the work evolves with every milestone: from first launch to reuse, high-cadence operations, and beyond. If you're looking to define what's next in space launch and write a new playbook, not just repeat what’s already been done, this is where it happens.

About the Role:

The Facilities Technician II supports the daily operations, maintenance, and repair of company facilities. This role is responsible for assisting with preventive maintenance, troubleshooting building systems, and ensuring a safe, clean, and functional work environment. The Facilities Technician II works under direct supervision and receives hands-on training to develop technical skills across multiple trades, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and general building maintenance.

• Perform routine preventive maintenance on building systems, equipment, and infrastructure.

• Respond to work orders and service requests in a timely and professional manner.

• Conduct routine inspections of facilities to identify maintenance needs and safety hazards.

• Operate basic tools and equipment safely in compliance with OSHA and company standards.

• Maintain accurate records of work performed in the CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System).

• Provide excellent customer service to employees and stakeholders regarding facilities requests.

About You:

• 5+ year of general maintenance, facilities, or related experience preferred (internships or apprenticeships acceptable).

• Basic knowledge of one or more trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, carpentry).

• Ability to read and follow instructions, manuals, and simple schematics.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

• Basic computer skills; experience with CMMS a plus.

• Ability to lift 50 lbs, climb ladders, and perform physical work in various environments.

• Willingness to be on-call for occasional after-hours emergencies.

• Proactive mindset — spotting issues before they become bigger problems.

• Team-player attitude, but also capable of working independently.

• OSHA 10 certification.

• Forklift or aerial lift operator certification.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

● Create technical content: Produce videos, podcasts, presentations, white papers, guides, and documentation that showcase Menlo's value to technical audiences across the customer lifecycle, using AI writing and media tools to accelerate first drafts while owning technical accuracy and brand voice.

● Shape product positioning: Connect customer needs and technology trends to Menlo's products to build technical positioning and messaging for key use cases.

● Enable the field: Train Sales and Sales Engineering on technical features, functionality, and the competitive landscape, and keep enablement materials current with each release.

● Build and run the lab: Own a lab environment for competitive analysis, demo development, integration validation, and evaluating new technologies.

● Track the competitive landscape: Use AI-assisted research tools to monitor and synthesize competitor launches, analyst reports, and threat-landscape developments into concise battlecards and briefings for the field.

● Support sales opportunities: Build technical customer-facing documentation, contribute to technical RFP responses (using AI tools to draft from an approved content library, with expert review), and answer technical customer inquiries.




OUTCOMES & METRICS

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

● A field organization that is confident and well-equipped to demonstrate, position, and defend Menlo's products against competitors in technical conversations.

● A steady stream of credible technical content that builds thought leadership and accelerates opportunities through the sales funnel.

Success Metrics

● Technical content published on a regular cadence covering new features, capabilities, and use cases.

● Influenced pipeline: growth in qualified leads and opportunities attributed to technical content and campaigns.

● Increase in lead-to-sales-qualified conversion rate for campaigns supported by technical content.

● Field enablement coverage and effectiveness: customer-facing staff trained on each major release, plus post-training confidence/assessment scores.

● Engagement on technical content (views, shares, comments, downloads) relative to baseline.


FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES

Required:

● 5+ years of experience in technical product marketing, product management, sales engineering, or a similar security-focused role.

● Strong working knowledge of the modern threat landscape, including browser-based threats, phishing, malware and vulnerabilities.

● Hands-on technical familiarity with networking, web security, cloud deployments, and common enterprise security controls (e.g., SSO, SIEM, proxies, firewalls).

● Proven ability to understand customer needs and translate complex technical concepts into clear, engaging content for different audiences.

● Clear, persuasive communication skills, both written and spoken, with internal teams and external audiences.

● Skilled in using AI tools (e.g. Gemini, Claude ) in your daily workflow for research, content drafting, and analysis, with the judgment to validate outputs for technical accuracy.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

● Bachelor's degree in a technical or related field.

● Experience with SSE, proxy chaining, and advanced APT or mobile security topics.

● Familiarity with public cloud primitives, virtualization, data center, storage, and database technologies.

● Experience building and maintaining demo or lab environments.

● Experience producing video or podcast content.

● Experience using AI to scale content production or competitive intelligence (e.g., prompt libraries, AI-assisted RFP tools, automated research digests).


MENLO MINDSETS

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

● Proactive Leadership — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.

● Straight Talk — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.

● United Impact — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.

○ What it looks like in this role: You sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales, aligning each team on a single, accurate technical story and making sure field feedback flows back into the product.

● Elevated Talent — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.

○ What it looks like in this role: Through hands-on training and enablement, you raise the technical bar of the entire field organization so every customer conversation is more confident and credible.

● Customer-Compelled — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.

○ What it looks like in this role: You start from real customer problems and use cases, building content, demos, and documentation that help customers quickly see and realize the value of Menlo.

Follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/menlo-security/!

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

jobs.title: Technician Team Lead
jobs.description:
About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
Line Lead is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

What you’ll be doing:

• Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.

• Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.

• Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.

• Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.

• Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

• Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.

• Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.

• Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.

• Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.

• Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.

• Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.

• Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.

• Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.

• Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

What the job requires:
To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• High School Diploma or GED equivalent

• Experience using computers

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• Demonstrated functional expertise in one or more areas pertaining to Carvana’s reconditioning process

• Demonstrated understanding of our current reconditioning processes and lean principles

• Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years).

• Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels

• Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to effectively delegate tasks to team members.

• Ability to communicate and interact with others effectively in a professional, courteous manner.

• Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.

• Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.

• Ability to work overtime and on weekends.

• Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Position with a competitive salary

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally

• Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Legal stuff

jobs.title: Director, Innovation & Commercialization Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At the heart of AG1 lies a commitment to our mission to empower people to take ownership of their health. Since 2010, we've dedicated ourselves to bringing Foundational Nutrition to people around the world.

Our ethos is deeply rooted in science, with an unwavering dedication to continuous improvement. We leverage and contribute to the latest research to deliver a powerful, straightforward solution for optimal health to our customers. We harness the finest ingredients so that every scoop of AG1 gives you the nutrients you need with the simplicity you want in a daily routine.

Likewise, our organization puts the same energy into creating an environment that is a reflection of the cultural values that define who we are and how we work together. These seven values— One Spectacular Life, Customer Obsessed, Radical Ownership, High Performance, Courage, Amazing Humans and Continuous Pursuit of Excellence —are a representation of the high standards we set, and hold ourselves accountable to, when it comes to building our global team.

THE ROLE

AG1 is expanding its innovation portfolio across products, formats, and channels. We are seeking an experienced leader to operate, and continuously strengthen our enterprise Stage Gate governance and commercialization process. This role will combine governance design and decision discipline with hands-on cross-functional execution, helping AG1 move products from concept through development, manufacturing readiness, and launch with greater clarity, speed, and accountability.

Reporting to the Chief Legal & Administrative Officer, the Director will have meaningful delegated ownership of the governance model, including recommending and implementing gate standards, decision protocols, performance measures, and improvements. The Director will partner closely with Product Development leadership and functional stakeholders while maintaining an enterprise-wide perspective.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Stage Gate Governance & Decision Discipline

• Design, operation, and evolution of the Stage Gate governance framework with the executive owner, including gate criteria, required evidence, decision rights, and escalation pathways.

• Lead high-quality gate reviews focused on decisions and readiness, not routine status updates; document approvals, conditions, owners, and formal closure.

• Maintain a concise gate decision record covering evidence, approvals, conditions, decisions locked or left open, exceptions, and accountable owners; follow conditional approvals through closure.

• Develop and maintain practical standards for decisions that become locked at each gate, including clear controls for material changes after approval.

• Apply proportionate gate requirements for product variants, new flavors, pack sizes, and claims changes, based on risk and complexity rather than a one-size-fits-all process.

• Identify decisions requiring executive intervention, frame options and trade-offs, and recommend an appropriate path forward.

Cross-functional Planning & Execution

• Integrate NPD plans across Product Development, Packaging, Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Marketing, Retail, DTC, and International.

• Establish critical-path plans, realistic functional lead times, dependencies, and clean handoffs; ensure early functional engagement before downstream commitments are made.

• Maintain integrated launch baselines and forecasts; when upstream milestones slip, make the impacts on timing, scope, resources, and risk explicit for the accountable decision-maker.

• Provide visibility into project status, timing, risks, competing resource demands, and launch-readiness decisions.

• Partner with accountable product and functional owners to resolve gaps without displacing their technical or commercial decision authority.

Commercialization Readiness

• Coordinate upstream-to-downstream requirements across formula and claims decisions, packaging specifications and qualification, artwork and labels, sourcing, master data, production, and channel launch activities.

• Define clear readiness expectations for manufacturing, inventory, retailer execution, and DTC launch; ensure deviations are explicitly evaluated and approved.

• Surface the timing, cost, and execution impacts of proposed late changes.

Process Excellence & Adoption

• Build on AG1’s recent Stage Gate redesign work, including streamlined tasks, improved sequencing and redesigned gate meetings, and operationalize changes across active launches.

• Simplify or eliminate duplicative and legacy requirements while protecting critical controls and decision quality.

• Review briefs, approval points, and handoff artifacts to ensure each has a clear purpose, owner, and downstream user; retire redundant documentation.

• Create a reliable system of record for current decisions, approved versions, deliverables, owners, milestones, and changes.

• Establish a practical framework for handling retailer-specific requests and other exceptions, including their incremental cost, capacity, and schedule implications.

• Define useful measures of process effectiveness, such as on-time gate closure, changes to locked decisions, rework, and launch readiness; train teams and drive adoption.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years in CPG new product development, innovation operations, commercialization, or related cross-functional leadership, ideally including food, beverages, or nutritional products.

• Demonstrated experience owning or materially redesigning a formal Stage Gate or comparable NPD governance framework, not merely participating in gate meetings.

• Experience launching physical consumer products and understanding formulation, regulatory/quality, packaging, supply chain, manufacturing, and commercial interdependencies.

• Strong judgment in setting governance standards while avoiding unnecessary bureaucracy; experience leading decision forums and navigating cross-functional trade-offs.

• Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, implement change, and turn complex workflows into practical operating routines.

• Excellent integrated planning, risk management, facilitation, and executive communication skills.

• Experience facilitating executive gate decisions, setting and tracking conditions of approval, and leading pragmatic change control.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience spanning mature CPG processes and high-growth, entrepreneurial environments.

• Experience with beverage or supplement categories and retail, DTC, Amazon, or international launches.

• PMP certification or equivalent formal training in project or program management methodologies.

• Familiarity with PLM, NPD portfolio tools, and process excellence methodologies.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

• Competitive compensation and performance-based incentive plans.

• A 100% remote working environment (excluding Laboratory positions), which has been implemented from day one.

• A strong company culture that is enforced through the hiring process to ensure values alignment and a highly collaborative team.

• A mission-driven approach to everything that we do, with an overall goal to significantly improve our customers’ health and wellness.

• A high-growth, dynamic environment with opportunities for your direct impact to be felt.

• Paid holidays, company-wide reset and reflect days, and unlimited PTO (based on your country of residence).

• In-person team meetups for optimal collaboration, team building and accelerating productivity.

• A work environment and culture that is based on high performance, productivity and continuous improvement.

• The opportunity to work with passionate, high-growth, business-minded colleagues who bring their all to our mission each and every day.

• Access to AG1 products and branded swag.

• Monthly telecom stipend to offset some of the costs of home internet/wifi for eligible team members.

• All other benefits and insurances as required by law, based on your specific country of residence.

AG1 is dedicated to providing equitable and competitive compensation & benefits packages. For this particular role, the base salary range is $145,000 - $180,000 and will ultimately be decided at the offer stage, based on an individual candidate’s level of skills and experience aligned with the needs of this role. Base salary is one component of total compensation for this position. We provide a competitive mix of base salary, performance bonus, and stock option allocation for eligible roles.

jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

jobs.description:
About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
Line Lead is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

What you’ll be doing:

• Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.

• Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.

• Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.

• Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.

• Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

• Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.

• Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.

• Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.

• Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.

• Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.

• Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.

• Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.

• Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.

• Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

• High School Diploma or GED equivalent

• Experience using computers

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

• Ability to effectively delegate tasks to team members.

• Ability to communicate and interact with others effectively in a professional, courteous manner.

• Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.

• Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.

• Ability to work overtime and on weekends.

• Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be. 

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.



 - Housing: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $350 million https://eliseai.com/blog/intelligence-is-getting-cheaper-life-should-too funding round at a $4 billion valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Bessemer Venture Partners to accelerate this mission.



The Future Platforms Team - Executing on EliseAI’s Future Products

The Future Platforms team is responsible for executing on the next generation of AI products and business lines. This team will blend go-to-market, product, operations, and strategy with a mandate to push the frontier of AI and own everything required to take them from idea to market leadership.



Our goal is to take Elise from agentic AI to truly end-to-end autonomous operations, fundamentally transforming how housing operators run their businesses and how residents experience their homes.

 - High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering accurate work.

 - Clear communication skills and experience working directly with clients.

Growth and impact. It’s not often that you can get in on the ground floor of a funded (unicorn https://www.eliseai.com/blog/eliseai-raises-250m-series-e!) startup that’s scaling so fast. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Waymo’s Product Management Team is a mission-driven team responsible for writing and enacting first-of-their-kind playbooks to bring fully autonomous driving technology to market. Our team develops simple solutions for complex problems by orchestrating cross-functional efforts to safely drive Waymo’s technology and the products it enables forward. We do this by understanding the customer, the business, and the technology. We are humble about the scope of our work, collaborative in our approach to problem-solving, and ambitious about our vision for the future.

You will:

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for how Waymo's autonomous fleet stays safe and keeps running through large-scale, fleet-wide disruptions

• Define product requirements for onboard behaviors and for the fleet-level automation that detect, contain, and recover from these events

• Turn real-world event data into a clear, prioritized view and make principled trade-offs

• Lead a large, cross-functional, cross-org effort and drive alignment up to senior leadership

• Define success metrics and evaluation strategies for end-to-end, fleet-level performance during rare events, and decide when mitigations can be relaxed as performance improves

• Scale fleet resilience to new markets, platforms and international cities as Waymo expands

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

Job Summary

The Supervisor, manages day to day operations across multiple shifts supporting the manufacture and assembly of solid rocket motor (SRM) hardware at Voyager’s Reno, NV facility. This role carries full accountability for shop floor operations — technician scheduling and workload across shifts, training and qualification, shop safety and 5S compliance, shop supply/tooling budget and vendor management, and equipment uptime — while partnering cross-functionally with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Production Control, and Program Management to keep the build shop meeting program commitments. About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: Washington, D.C Metro, Boston, MA or Remote, US - Eastern, Central U.S. timezones
Travel: Up to 25%, domestic or international
Job ID: 1956

The Role:

We are seeking a Sr. PBP Director, GTM to lead People Business Partner support for IonQ's global Go-To-Market organization.

This leader will serve as the primary People partner to the global GTM organization, including the Chief Business Officer and their leadership team, working closely across sales, marketing, customer success, field engineering, revenue operations, and other commercial functions to translate business priorities into people and organizational strategies that drive growth and performance.

This is a highly visible, hands-on role at a pivotal moment for IonQ's commercial growth. You'll play a central role in scaling a high-performing sales and GTM culture, elevating the talent and organizational foundations this fast-growing, geographically distributed team needs, and proving out a PBP model that can expand as the org does.

The ideal candidate combines strong business and sales HR acumen and executive presence with a pragmatic, roll-up-your-sleeves approach.   They will enjoy operating the fast moving and “bias to action” culture of GTM, and be a true business partner. They’re a highly collaborative driver with a firm and flexible point of view on how to accelerate the business via strategic and operationally excellent people solutions.

Responsibilities:

Partner with the Business

• Serve as the senior People advisor to GTM leadership, building trusted relationships and providing counsel on organizational effectiveness, talent, workforce planning, leadership, and culture.

• Translate GTM's commercial strategy and revenue priorities into practical people strategies that support pipeline growth, sales productivity, and go-to-market execution.

• Build a deep understanding of IonQ's commercial motion — sales segments, quota structures, territory design, and buyer landscape — to proactively identify organizational opportunities and risks.

• Coach senior leaders through complex organizational, talent, performance, and leadership decisions.

Build the PBP Function for GTM

• Design a PBP model and coverage plan appropriate to a fast-growing, quota-carrying commercial organization, with a clear point of view on when and how to add headcount as the org grows.

• Partner with Sales Compensation and Total Rewards so GTM's comp and rewards programs - plan design, quota-setting support, leveling and offer governance - are fit for purpose in a fast-growing commercial organization.

• Act as the voice of the business with Talent Acquisition on GTM hiring: translate the growth plan into a workforce plan and role requirements, hold hiring managers to a consistent bar and a disciplined process, and feed quality-of-hire and ramp signals back into the profiles we recruit against.

• Partner with managers and enable onboarding and ramp, with a point of view on what's driving time to full productivity and what needs to change.

• Serve as execution partner for enterprise-wide People practices across GTM - performance management cycle, annual compensation review, and engagement survey cycle.

• As the team expands, hire, develop, and set clear priorities and performance expectations for the PBPs who join.

Lead Organization Design & Change

• Lead organizational design initiatives across GTM, including territory and coverage models, team structures, leadership accountabilities, and workforce planning.

• Guide leaders and the organization through growth, restructuring, and evolving go-to-market priorities.

• Balance enterprise-wide consistency with the unique needs of a commercial, revenue-driven organization.

Drive Talent & Organizational Performance

• Own talent outcomes across GTM, with particular focus on seller retention, ramp-time, succession, leadership effectiveness, and performance.

• Build robust talent and succession plans, identify capability gaps across the sales leadership bench, and partner with leaders to strengthen it.

• Coach leaders on performance management, feedback, seller development, and difficult people decisions, including performance-based exits common in a quota-driven environment.

• Use people and sales performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and translate them into action.

• Strengthen employee engagement, organizational health, and a high-performance culture aligned with IonQ's values.

Requirements:

• 12+ years of progressive HR/People experience, including significant senior HR Business Partner leadership experience.

• Demonstrated experience partnering directly with senior sales, marketing, or commercial leadership teams.

• Hands-on involvement in annual comp planning alongside Finance and Sales Ops, including quota setting and plan changes.

• Experience supporting quota-carrying, revenue-focused, or commercial/GTM organizations.

• Experience supporting a business through significant commercial scaling, market expansion, or transformation, including acquisition integration.

• Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to connect people strategy directly to revenue and commercial outcomes.

• Proven expertise in organizational design, talent management, succession planning, leadership coaching, and change management.

• Experience operating as a function of one or close to it, including a clear point of view on prioritization and what you deliberately chose not to do.

• Strong executive presence, judgment, and the ability to influence and challenge senior leaders constructively.

• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving, ambiguous, high-growth environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience building a PBP or HRBP function from the ground up, including a track record of scaling from individual contributor to team leader.

• Experience supporting global or internationally distributed sales organizations (EMEA, public sector/federal, or emerging markets).

• Experience with sales compensation design, territory planning, or quota methodology.

• Experience working within a high-growth technology or deep-tech company.

What Success Looks Like:

Within the first 6–12 months, this leader will have:

• Established themselves as a trusted, high-impact partner to GTM leadership.

• Proven the value of dedicated PBP support for GTM, building the case (and the plan) for additional PBP headcount as the org scales.

• Created greater clarity around GTM's organizational structure, leadership accountabilities, and critical talent.

• Strengthened succession and talent plans across the sales and GTM leadership bench.

• Delivered measurable progress on seller retention, ramp-time, engagement, and leadership effectiveness.

• Partnered effectively with Sales Compensation and Total Rewards to ensure GTM's comp and incentive programs support desired seller behavior.

• Accelerated cultural alignment and adoption of IonQ's values and ways of working across a fast-scaling commercial team.

The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

jobs.title: Roboticist (Embodied AI, Machine Learning, Computer Vision)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Welcome to TELUS Digital https://www.telusdigital.com/ — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS https://www.telus.com/en/, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.




LOCATION & FLEXIBILITY 

This is a remote US-based role requiring travel for client meetings and hands-on site support (e.g., teleoperation data collection locations). You’ll coordinate on-site setup, equipment readiness, and field execution across project locations as needed.




THE OPPORTUNITY 

We’re hiring a Roboticist (Senior Robotics Applied AI Engineer) to serve as a trusted advisor to our global robotics and embodied-AI clients — and the engineer who ships the solution. This is a solutions-lead role that codes, not consultation alone. Our Roboticist will apply the same consultative, outcome-driven approach across accounts and geographies as our robotics practice grows.

Expect to flex across concurrent client engagements, each with its own goals, constraints, and regional considerations. Bringing deep expertise in robotics and embodied AI, you’ll guide clients through large-scale data collection, field deployments, and program design — and build the perception systems, data pipelines, and model integrations that deliver them.

Internally, you’ll act as the vital bridge between client vision and execution—partnering with Commercial, Solutions, Operations, and Quality to translate ambitious goals into well-run programs across multiple accounts worldwide. As the senior robotics presence in-region, you’ll be the first point of contact and engineering expertise for robotics solution and project requests originating in the US and EU, coordinating with our India/APAC team to move solutions from blueprint to production across time zones.

Strong experience in machine learning, computer vision, technical solutions engineering is required. 




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Clients will see our Sr. Robotics Applied AI Engineer as a genuine and trusted advisor, not a vendor resource — someone whose input shapes program design before problems occur. Internally, Commercial, Solutions, Operations, and Quality all treat this role as the technical anchor point for robotics engagements, and client programs consistently meet the outcomes they were scoped to deliver. Beyond the advisory anchor, this person also ships working perception and robotics systems: US/EU requests route through them early, feasibility is assessed before commitment, and cross-region handoffs to India/APAC stay clean under load.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Strategic Client Advisory & Co-Design: Act as the primary robotics subject-matter advisor in client conversations — assessing what a client is trying to achieve and recommending the approach, equipment, and program design most likely to get them there, rather than defaulting to a standard offering (co-design & iterate).

 - Hands-on Solution Build: Design and build the CV and perception systems — detection, segmentation, pose estimation — on the 3D geometry underneath (SE(3), camera models, projection, coordinate frames), and own sensor calibration and fusion (intrinsic/extrinsic, hand-eye, LiDAR–camera) and LiDAR processing.

 - Data Pipelines & Models: Design egocentric data-collection pipelines (head/wrist cameras, depth, IMU) for robot learning; evaluate, integrate, and fine-tune VLA models under data and compute constraints; and build supporting services (REST/gRPC, PostgreSQL) to expose model inference and robotics services.

 - Outcome-Based Scoping: Partner with clients to define success up front, then shape program scope, staffing models, and equipment needs around that outcome — pushing back where a client's initial ask won't get them the result they want.

 - Robotics Domain Leadership: Bring deep knowledge of the robotics and Embodied-AI landscape (hardware, data collection, simulation, and emerging models) to turn technical trends into actionable client solutions.

 - Technical Bridge & Scoping Alignment: Serve as the connective layer between client technical requirements and our internal delivery teams — ensuring what's scoped with the client is translated into specifications Operations, Solutions, and Quality can actually execute, and that internal technical constraints or trade-offs are surfaced back to the client accurately and early.

 - Commercial Support & Development: Identify and help shape new robotics-related opportunities within existing and prospective client accounts, acting as technical credibility in front of clients alongside Commercial.

 - Field Execution & Technical feedback loop: Own real-time technical feedback on equipment, calibration, and field performance during pilots and live programs, escalating issues before they affect client-facing quality, timelines, or SLA standards.

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Background in robotics, mechatronics, robotics engineering, or a closely related technical field.

 - Experience in robotics machine learning, computer vision, or technical solutions engineering, with a track record of shipping to production.

 - Demonstrated client-facing or presales experience on robotics, automation, or embodied-AI programs, combined with strong hands-on build/deploy experience — this role both advises and ships.

 - Strong computer vision and perception (detection, segmentation, pose estimation, optical flow) and 3D geometry (SE(3), camera models, projection, coordinate frames).

 - Sensor calibration and fusion, including LiDAR–camera, plus LiDAR processing; and sim-to-real experience (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, or Unity Robotics Hub).

 - Conceptual grasp of VLA architectures and the current SOTA landscape; strong Python (PyTorch), able to read and implement research papers.

 - Strong working knowledge of current robotics and embodied-AI industry trends, data collection methods, and deployment models.

 - Proven ability to translate technical detail into business-relevant recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

 - Comfortable operating cross-functionally across Commercial, Solutions, Operations, and Quality teams.

 - Experience supporting global or multi-region client engagements preferred.

 - Hands-on experience with multi-camera systems, including calibration, synchronization, and tracking.

 - Solid grounding in computer vision fundamentals — object detection, pose estimation, segmentation, sensor fusion — and their application to robotic perception.

 - Ability to read and critically interpret state-of-the-art technical reports published by frontier labs developing general-purpose humanoid and non-humanoid robots.

 - Willingness and ability to travel to data collection sites (globally) as needed to support engagements.




TECHNICAL STACK

Python (PyTorch) · OpenCV, Open3D, PCL · Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo, Unity Robotics Hub · ROS/ROS2 · VLA models (RT-2, OpenVLA, π₀, Octo), ViTs, multimodal · REST/gRPC, Docker, PostgreSQL; TensorRT/ONNX for edge.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.
