jobs.title: Sr. Scientist, Reagent Development
jobs.location: South San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

• We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

• We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.

• We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.

• We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Scientist to provide scientific and technical leadership within the Reagent Development team. This individual will independently lead complex reagent and analytical method development supporting NGS-based clinical laboratory products, from early feasibility and technical strategy through characterization, qualification, transfer, and lifecycle support. The Senior Scientist will define experimental approaches, integrate biochemical, physicochemical, statistical, quality, and operational considerations, and exercise sound judgment to turn incomplete or conflicting data into clear technical decisions.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on scientific expertise with the maturity to establish direction, anticipate risk, resolve ambiguous and cross-disciplinary problems, and guide the work of other individual contributors. Success in this role means delivering robust reagent formulations, meaningful analytical and QC strategies, data-supported specifications, transferable methods, and complete, review-ready design-control documentation while elevating scientific rigor across the team.

Responsibilities:

Technical and Project Leadership:

• Independently lead complex reagent-development projects from concept through implementation, with ownership of technical strategy, objectives, study design, execution, analysis, risk management, documentation, and delivery against program milestones.

• Translate product, assay, manufacturing, quality, and business needs into practical reagent-development plans, technical requirements, decision criteria, and stage-appropriate deliverables.

• Independently analyze and interpret complex datasets.

• Identify critical path activities, dependencies, resource needs, and emerging risks; adjust plans proactively and escalate issues with clear options and recommended actions.

• Provide technical direction to scientists and associates contributing to project work. Define expectations, review experimental plans and data, monitor progress, and help resolve roadblocks without requiring formal people-management responsibility.

Formulation, Characterization, and Analytical Strategy

• Lead the development, optimization, and characterization of buffers, enzyme formulations, bead-based reagents, and other multicomponent solutions used in NGS and nucleic acid sample-preparation workflows.

• Develop a mechanistic understanding of how raw-material attributes, formulation composition, processing conditions, packaging, storage, and shipping affect reagent stability, manufacturability, and downstream assay performance.

• Define critical quality attributes and build fit-for-purpose analytical strategies for raw materials, intermediates, bulk formulations, and finished reagents.

• Conceive and evaluate innovative analytical or formulation approaches to improve reagent performance, robustness, scalability, stability, and operational readiness.

• Integrate orthogonal physicochemical, biochemical, and functional data to establish meaningful relationships between reagent attributes and NGS performance.

QC Assay Development and Lifecycle Support

• Lead the development, qualification, and transfer of analytical and functional QC methods for incoming materials, in-process samples, bulk formulations, and finished reagents.

• Define controls, reference materials, sampling strategies, measurement requirements, and statistically justified acceptance criteria appropriate to intended use and development stage.

• Identify analytical measurements and surrogate functional assays that are sufficiently sensitive, precise, and practical to predict performance and support in-process control or release decisions.

• Lead investigations of out-of-specification, out-of-trend, stability, lot-to-lot, and performance issues; determine root cause, assess impact, and recommend scientifically justified corrective or preventive actions.

• Establish approaches for trending reagent, method, and process performance and use the resulting data to identify risk and continuous-improvement opportunities.

Statistics, Quality, and Design Control

• Apply DOE, measurement-system analysis, risk-based experimentation, process capability, SPC, stability modeling, and other statistical tools to optimize formulations and methods, quantify uncertainty, and reduce variability.

• Lead or make substantial technical contributions to design inputs and outputs, requirements, FMEA and other risk assessments, verification and validation strategies, protocols, reports, and design reviews within the quality management system.

• Author and critically review SOPs, test methods, specifications, protocols, technical reports, and investigation records for scientific rigor, traceability, and readiness for cross-functional or quality review.

• Ensure development work is performed and documented in accordance with applicable design-control, ISO 13485, GMP, and internal quality-system expectations.

Technology Transfer and Cross-Functional Leadership

• Lead transfer of formulations, analytical methods, and QC assays into Manufacturing and Quality Control, including transfer planning, readiness assessment, training, comparability studies, and resolution of transfer-related issues.

• Provide scientific leadership for raw-material qualification, supplier evaluation, technical assessment of supplier documentation, and changes to materials, processes, methods, or specifications.

• Partner effectively with Molecular Biology, Product Development, Automation, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Clinical Laboratory teams to align technical decisions with product and operational needs.

• Communicate complex data, uncertainty, risk, and recommendations clearly to technical contributors, cross-functional partners, and leadership.

• Mentor and develop junior scientists and associates through experimental guidance, technical review, constructive feedback, and modeling of high standards for scientific reasoning and documentation.

Who You Are:

• A hands-on technical leader who can move comfortably between bench-level detail and program-level strategy.

• An independent problem solver who can bring structure to ambiguity and make sound decisions with incomplete or evolving information.

• A practical product developer who can balance scientific rigor with program priorities, timelines, manufacturability, quality requirements, and operational constraints.

• A trusted scientific partner who influences through expertise, judgment, preparation, and clear communication rather than authority alone.

• A collaborative mentor who raises the quality of work performed by others and creates clarity without taking ownership away from individual contributors.

• Flexible and resilient when priorities, resources, or technical assumptions change, while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

Required Qualifications:

• PhD. in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Molecular Biology, Chemical Engineering, or a related field with 6+ years of relevant industry experience, or an M.S. with 7+ years of relevant industry experience.

• Proven ability to independently lead complex technical projects, including defining strategy, planning and executing studies, and driving decisions through implementation.

• Demonstrated experience guiding the technical work of scientists, research associates, or other individual contributors through project leadership, mentoring, or matrixed team leadership.

• Experience developing and characterizing chemical or biochemical reagents and developing analytical methods or QC assays, with hands-on experience in NGS, nucleic acid sample preparation, or related molecular diagnostic workflows.

• Demonstrated success troubleshooting complex, multivariable technical problems and identifying root cause using hypothesis-driven, data-based approaches.

• Experience working under design controls and within an ISO 13485 and/or GMP-regulated environment, including authorship or review of controlled technical documentation.

• Proficiency with relevant physicochemical and biochemical methods, which may include pH, conductivity, osmolality, density, refractive index, viscosity, UV-Vis and fluorescence spectroscopy, Karl Fischer, HPLC/UHPLC, CE-SDS, and DLS/zeta potential.

• Strong working knowledge of statistics and quality science, including DOE, Gage R&R or measurement-system analysis, process capability, SPC, lot-to-lot trending, stability modeling, and specification setting; proficiency with JMP, Minitab, Python, or R.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex data, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to varied audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with bead-based reagents, enzymes, surfactants, polymers, or viscous, high-salt, or otherwise challenging formulations.

• Working knowledge of additional characterization techniques such as FTIR/Raman, GPC/SEC, ion chromatography, ICP-OES/MS, GC, DSF/nanoDSF, LC-MS, cIEF, or rheometry.

• Experience with raw-material qualification, supplier technical management, formulation scale-up, stability-study design, method transfer, and manufacturing investigations.

• Experience developing workflows for automation or high-throughput clinical laboratory operations, including consideration of liquid handling, throughput, QC, and operational robustness.

• Familiarity with CLIA/CAP laboratory environments and development of reagents or assays for clinical, diagnostic, or other regulated applications.

#LI-Onsite

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range

$150,000—$170,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. jobs.title: Lead Data Center Technician
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

LEAD DATA CENTER TECHNICIAN

Join SpaceX’s IT Infrastructure team as a Lead Data Center Technician, where you’ll play a critical role in building and maintaining multiple data centers. As a key member of our team, you’ll deploy and maintain the infrastructure that powers our mission critical systems, including servers, networks, HVAC and power systems. The ideal candidate has experience working with various types of hardware architecture and understands the strength of each.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Monitor and resolve networking, compute and rack power distribution infrastructure incidents in multiple data centers

• Manage complete lifecycle for data center hardware including selection, deployment, operation, maintenance and decommission

• Physically rack and cable data center equipment

• Track and logically organize the physical storage of incoming data center equipment

• Perform quality assurance testing and resolve recurring issues

• Establish, schedule and track preventative maintenance procedures

• Update documentation, including interconnect drawings, rack layouts and operation procedures

• Monitor the environmental conditions and power/cooling systems of a data center to ensure they are optimized for servers, switches, storage arrays, and other devices

• Maintain in depth quantitative performance and utilization data for detailed reporting and analytics to drive continuous improvement opportunities

• Work with the supply chain team and vendors to evaluate, procure and manage inventory of data center equipment

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• Professional experience working in a data center environment or with enterprise grade IT hardware

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Certifications related to IT infrastructure such as CompTIA Servier+, CompTIA Network+, CCNA, and CDCMP

• Experience with data center infrastructure management (DCIM) including tools to monitor, measure, manage, and/or control data center utilization

• In-depth knowledge of data center environments, servers, and network equipment

• Extensive experience installing, monitoring, and maintaining data center equipment

• Strong Linux skills including:

• Navigating the system’s directories and filing system Manipulating files in the Linux shell User permission configuration Package installation and software management Ability to identify and apply different filesystem types Using Linux commands for process management Basic troubleshooting and debugging Bash or other scripting

• Power and data center cooling capacity planning experience

• Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills

• Experience working with multiple vendor hardware architectures

• Experience working with server management tools such as HPE iLO, Cisco CIMC and Dell iDRAC

• Willingness and ability to respond to incidents after hours

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to work overtime hours and weekends as needed

• Willing to participate in after-hours on-call rotation

• Willing to travel to other sites for surge support and systems familiarization

• Ability to lift up to 50lbs

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

jobs.title: (787) HR Analyst
jobs.description:
Company Summary

Arlo Solutions (Arlo) is an information technology consulting services company that specializes in delivering technology solutions. Our reputation reflects the high quality of the talented Arlo Solutions team and the consultants working in partnership with our customers. Our mission is to understand and meet the needs of both our customers and consultants by delivering quality, value-added solutions. Our solutions are designed and managed to not only reduce costs, but to improve business processes, accelerate response time, improve services to end-users, and give our customers a competitive edge, now and into the future.

Position Overview

The HR Analyst plays a critical role in supporting end-to-end HR service delivery, including providing analytical, operational, and coordination support across Personnel Administration, Benefits, Payroll coordination, as well as Onboarding and Offboarding activities. This role is responsible for running and analyzing HR reports, tracking HR KPIs, supporting coordination between HR and Talent Acquisition for seamless handoffs, facilitating day-to-day HR operations, and ensuring data accuracy and process consistency across HR systems.

The HR Analyst partners closely with HR leadership, Recruitment, Payroll, and Program stakeholders to support day-to-day HR operations while enabling data-driven decision-making across the employee lifecycle.

Work Location: Washington, D.C. area (remote)

Clearance: N/A

Job Responsibilities and/or Success Factors

HR Operations & Service Delivery

• Support end-to-end HR service delivery across personnel actions, employee lifecycle changes, and HR transactions.

• Coordinate closely with Payroll to ensure accurate processing of hires, terminations, changes, and audits.

• Assist with benefits administration coordination, including eligibility tracking, enrollments, and employee inquiries.

• Support general HR inquiries and conduct research of policies and procedures, as needed.

• Maintain accurate employee data across HR systems and ensure compliance with internal policies and applicable regulations.

• Support onboarding, offboarding, and employee documentation processes in partnership with HR leadership.

• Partner with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to ensure hiring processes are followed and timelines are met.

HR Reporting, Analytics & KPIs

• Run standard and ad-hoc HR reports related to headcount, turnover, hiring activity, benefits, and workforce trends.

• Track and maintain HR and Talent Acquisition KPIs (e.g., time-to-fill, pipeline metrics, hiring volume, retention, turnover, and other workforce data).

• Support HR dashboards and reporting for leadership, ensuring data integrity and consistency.

• Assist with audits, data validation, and reconciliation across HR, ATS, and payroll systems.

Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Support

• Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, workflows, and reporting efficiency.

• Support documentation of HR procedures, SOPs, and job aids.

• Serve as a liaison between HR, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, I.T., PMO and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth service delivery.

• Provide responsive, professional support to employees and managers on HR-related inquiries.

Education and Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Management, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field.

• 2–4 years of experience in HR operations, HR analytics, or a related HR role.

• Experience running reports and working with HR data across HRIS and ATS platforms.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and HR systems.

• Excellent communication, organizational, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with HR KPIs, workforce metrics, and reporting dashboards.

• Experience working in a government contracting or professional services environment.

• Knowledge of payroll coordination and benefits administration processes.

• HR certification (PHR, SHRM-CP) or progress toward certification.

AAP Statement

We are proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and as such, we evaluate qualified candidates in full consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, and any other protected status.

jobs.title: Head of Advisor Success
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE:

Savvy is looking for a Director of Advisor Implementation to own and scale how wealth management practices move their businesses onto Savvy. When an advisor joins us, they're moving everything: their team, their clients, their systems, and the way they've run their practice for years. This leader makes that move fast, predictable, and something advisors feel great about.

Advisor Implementation owns the advisor's journey from signature until they’ve established their practice at Savvy. The Director leads the team that runs this end to end: managing every workstream of the move, keeping the advisor confident and bought in, and enabling them and their team to work the Savvy way. For enterprise teams, the work looks a lot like a consulting deployment: learn how the business ran before, then map it onto Savvy.

This role reports to the Head of Advisor Success and partners closely with Growth, Product, Operations, Compliance,Client Experience, and IT. It's ideal for a senior operator who has run implementation or deployment through hypergrowth, brings a consultative and commercial mindset, and has a strong executive presence with demanding customers.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own and lead the Advisor Implementation function, including hiring, training, performance management, and org design for a rapidly scaling team.

 - Build and run distinct implementation motions for enterprise teams and emerging advisors, with clear segmentation, staffing models, and playbooks for each.

 - Build an enterprise deployment playbook: discovery of how each team runs today, mapping their workflows and roles onto Savvy, and a tailored plan to get them live.

 - Own advisor enablement so advisors and their teams are confident in Savvy's tools and ways of working by the time they hand off to Client Experience.

 - Act as program lead across every workstream of a transition, coordinating Client Transition Specialists, Operations, Compliance, and IT to hit one plan and one date.

 - Own implementation KPIs and OKRs, including time to start date, time to assets transitioned, implementation CSAT, signed-not-started rate, and enablement completion.

 - Build a capacity model tied to the Growth forecast so the team is staffed ahead of volume.

 - Partner with Growth on late-stage enterprise deals: join recruiting meetings, scope deployment complexity before signing, and set expectations the team can deliver.

 - Design and own the handoffs from Growth into implementation and from implementation into Client Experience.

 - Own the team’s AI and automation stack: build the workflows, agents, and tools that cut manual work from implementation.

 - Serve as the senior escalation point for high-stakes implementations and fix the underlying process behind each one.




MUST HAVE:

 - 8 to 12+ years in implementation, onboarding deployment, consulting, or business operations, with 4+ years leading teams in a high-growth environment.

 - Proven experience building and scaling an implementation or deployment program through rapid growth (2x+ volume), including managing managers.

 - Experience moving customers' whole operations onto a new platform: learning how their business runs, redesigning their workflows, and driving adoption.

 - Experience running both enterprise (high-touch, complex) and mid-market (repeatable, volume) motions.

 - Strong program management across many parallel workstreams and teams you don't directly manage.

 - Sales acumen: has partnered with Sales on late-stage deals and is comfortable presenting to and managing senior, demanding customers.

 - Track record designing enablement and change management for experienced professionals.

 - Tech-forward operator with a track record of using automation and AI to improve speed and quality.

 - Excellent communication, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Wealth management experience, especially advisor transitions (RIA, broker-dealer, wirehouse).

 - Experience at a recruiting-driven platform (wealth, real estate brokerage, healthcare practice platforms, PE-backed rollups).

 - Management consulting or implementation consulting background.

 - Experience leading or partnering on AI-enabled implementation or service transformations.




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Savvy Wealth is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive work environment that values diversity and individual contributions.


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - We offer a generous relocation package to help top talent make the move to our NYC office

 - Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

 - Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans 

 - NYC office in Union Square

 - Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

 - Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

 - Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

 - Benefits are available to full-time employees

jobs.title: Designated Technical Support Engineer - West
jobs.description:
About Glean:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

Glean is looking for a talented Designated Technical Support Engineer to join our rapidly expanding, venture-backed startup.  We are building a modern knowledge assistant personalized to every employee in your organization, making all information within your company accessible, contextual, and fresh. Our team works hard and plays hard. We are professional, creative, passionate, and most importantly - customer-obsessed.

As a trusted technical resource to the customer, you will provide both proactive and reactive support to our growing customer base. By providing the highest level of service to our customers, you will ensure our customer experience is the best in the industry.

You will:

• Own the proactive and reactive support for Glean customers by prioritizing issues for your designated customer(s)

• Meet with your assigned customers regularly to review issues and develop resolution plans and drive continuous improvement in how you and your Glean teammates provide support to them

• Be available to your assigned customers via collaborative communication channels consistently to ensure you are providing timely responses and updates on issues

• Create and maintain customer-specific runbooks and knowledge articles

• Provide first response, technical troubleshooting, resolution, and follow-through of customer issues and inquiries

• Assist customers in the configuration, set-up, and verification of new content sources and product features to enable them to realize additional value for their users

• Educate customers on the use of Glean product features

• Identify system and user health issues, then create and execute remediation plans while coordinating and updating the customer accordingly

• Handle customer-impacting alerts which require coordination with customer admin and system resources through resolution

• Work closely with teams across Glean to drive product, process, and service improvements

• Drive key improvement projects that will improve the scale and efficiency of support, while providing upgrades to the customers’ support experience

• Coordinate all support activities with your assigned customer(s), which may include more stringent access and security processes, ensuring you move with high urgency for their issues.

• Represent the unique needs of your assigned customer(s) with respect to product and security improvements that will improve the customer support experience

• Please note that this role will be dedicated to select customers and requires additional background screenings/clearances/training/certification, carry & use of customer-provided equipment, and extended on-call shift timing based on customer contractual obligations.

About you:

• Technically curious: you have a never-ending desire to add technical knowledge and skills to your personal toolkit and share those learnings with your peers

• Fearless: you have an intense need to tackle the toughest customer issues and technically complex issues with the goal of driving customer satisfaction

• Strong communicator: you are a professional presenter with superior interaction skills with both customers and internal teams

• Detail-oriented: you are highly organized and methodical, ensuring all issues are managed to completion

• Data-driven: you utilize metrics and objective measurements to assess success and improvement opportunities for yourself and for the customer experience

• Key knowledge and skills required: Must-haves: Problem solving: technical problem-solving skills including the ability to troubleshoot and isolate issues to their root cause Ability to debug issues including searching & reading application logs, analyzing stack traces and browser trace files Experience in at least one of the following disciplines: Customer Solutions Engineering, Support Engineering, Professional Services Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: Search technologies, Knowledge technologies, SaaS-based system integrations Experience with Cloud technologies in at least one of the following: Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure Must have experience in troubleshooting REST API issues Working experience on SSO, SAML, and OAuth along with network troubleshooting Able to fully document issues you manage and contribute to the support knowledge base Good-to-haves: Knowledge of SQL/database, Basic Kubernetes, Intermediate/Advanced Linux Experience in using Github, Jira & Confluence Basic knowledge of LLM’s and how GPT works

Location:

• This role is remote but may require flexible working hours.

Compensation & Benefits:

The standard base salary range for this position is $143,000 - $170,000 USD annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#LI-REMOTE

AI-First Mindset at Glean:

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our Applicant Arbitration Agreement.

By clicking “Submit Application,” I confirm that I have read the Global Data Privacy Notice and the Applicant Arbitration Agreement, and I agree to the terms.

jobs.title: Sr. Associate, Environmental Health & Safety
jobs.description:
The Sr. Associate, Regional Environmental Health & Safety is responsible for supporting and executing environmental health and safety programs across corporate, divisional, and individual site operations, including corporate offices, home installation field operations, warehouses, distribution centers, and manufacturing facilities across multiple states. 

This role partners closely with corporate, divisional, and site leadership to ensure regulatory compliance, mitigate operational risk, prevent workplace injuries, and foster a consistent safety culture throughout the organization.



What You'll Do:

 - Regional EHS Oversight: Implement corporate safety programs and standards across divisional and individual site levels, conduct site visits and risk assessments, and partner with operational leaders to improve safety performance.

 - Field & Contractor Safety: Conduct field inspections of active jobsites, identify hazards, reinforce safe work practices, and support compliance among field personnel, field managers, and contractors.

 - Facility Safety: Conduct safety inspections of office spaces, warehouses, distribution centers, and manufacturing facilities. Identify hazards related to building and fire safety, electrical systems, chemical storage and handling, housekeeping, powered industrial trucks, vehicles and trailers, tools and equipment, material handling and storage, ergonomics, first aid and emergency preparedness, and personal protective equipment (PPE).

 - Incident Management: Investigate injuries, near misses, and property damage; determine root causes; and implement corrective and preventive actions.

 - Regulatory Compliance: Support compliance with applicable federal, state, and local EHS regulations, including OSHA requirements and relevant environmental standards.

 - Training & Safety Culture: Deliver safety training, coach operational leaders, and promote hazard reporting, employee engagement, and accountability.

 - Performance & Continuous Improvement: Track safety metrics, analyze incident trends, report findings to leadership, and implement initiatives to reduce risk and improve compliance.



What You'll Bring:

 - Bachelor’s degree in EHS, Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience considered.

 - Five or more years of EHS experience preferred, particularly in multi-site operations, construction, home improvement, field services, warehousing, or distribution.

 - Working knowledge of OSHA regulations, safety audits, risk assessments, and incident investigations.

 - Strong analytical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

 - Ability to influence operational leaders, manage competing priorities, and drive corrective actions across multiple locations.

 - Proficiency in Microsoft Office and EHS reporting systems.

 - Ability to travel regularly across assigned state divisions.

Preferred Certifications

 - OSHA 30-Hour Construction and/or General Industry training.

 - Associate Safety Professional (ASP) or Certified Safety Professional (CSP).

 - First Aid/CPR/AED certification.

 - Additional training in incident investigation, fall protection, ergonomics, or powered industrial truck safety.

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Axion Ray’s mission is to improve the quality and safety of innovative, engineered products - airplanes, electric vehicles, medical devices, home appliances, consumer electronics - by creating the world’s best proactive management platform, powered by the latest advances in artificial intelligence. Axion leverages bleeding-edge tech & AI stack to solve real-world problems. With investment from top Enterprise SaaS VCs like Bessemer, and key strategic partners such as Boeing and Raytheon, we are uniquely positioned to solve the hardest problems in manufacturing today. jobs.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
jobs.description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our AI Tooling team and help shape how developers and agents build with Supabase. You'll build and own our AI tooling, including agents, the MCP server, agent skills and the dashboard assistant, and as the space moves you'll build the tooling for new technologies too. You'll build it all eval-first: every tool ships with evals and metrics, so we know, with evidence, that it makes agents better rather than worse.

You'll work closely with the Docs, CLI, Frontend and SDK teams, and with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers who run these services in production. Other teams contribute to AI Tooling to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities, and you'll help them do that while keeping the quality bar high.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Build and improve the AI tooling we run today, including the MCP server, agent skills, agents and the Assistant.

 - Make new Supabase products usable by agents from day one: tools, skills and evals for new product surfaces. Also build tooling for new AI technologies as they emerge: prototype quickly, evaluate honestly, and decide with the team what is worth taking to production.

 - Drive an eval-first approach: build and improve evals, instrumentation and feedback loops, measure tools against a no-tool baseline, and help define the quality KPIs and gates that stop regressions shipping.

 - Understand how customers and agents actually use what we ship, and turn that into improvements to our tooling, interfaces and documentation.

 - Design how documentation and product knowledge are exposed to agents, and measure whether it works.

 - Build patterns and tools that help customers add AI to their own apps, such as MCP on Edge Functions, vector embeddings and agents running on Edge Functions.

 - Enable teams to improve Supabase's agentic capabilities through contributions to AI Tooling: clear contribution paths, templates, documentation and review practice.

 - Centralise shared AI logic so teams reuse it rather than duplicate it.

 - Ship tools that are battle-tested, with strong tests, benchmarking and stress testing where it counts.

 - Work with the AI Tooling Infrastructure engineers on reliability, auth and hosting.

 - Work across Docs, CLI, Frontend, SDK and other teams to deliver one coherent developer experience, and stay close to the fast-moving AI ecosystem.
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU



MUST HAVE:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering experience.

 - Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well: npm, ES modules, bundlers, compatibility.

 - Are deeply familiar with the AI ecosystem: current tools, agent patterns and practical trade-offs. You can tell a durable pattern from hype.

 - Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers.

 - Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success, and understand baselines, variance and cost.

 - Have strong judgement about where AI improves workflows and how to avoid fragile or gimmicky experiences.

 - Write tests and validate reliability in real-world conditions.

 - Know Postgres and relational database practice.

 - Communicate clearly in writing, work across product, engineering and docs, and thrive in async, globally distributed teams.

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with vector databases and embeddings, ideally pgvector.

 - Examples of customer-facing AI features or agents you've shipped.

 - Examples of documentation or structured knowledge designed for developers or agents.

 - Experience with Braintrust or a similar eval and tracing platform, or setting up CI quality gates.

 - Open-source contributions or developer tooling you've maintained.

 - Experience across several product surfaces or teams.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.title: Sr. Oracle Cloud Engineer I
jobs.description:
As Sr. Oracle Cloud Engineer I, you’ll play a key role in operating, modernizing, and automating the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environment supporting a mission-critical federal program in downtown Washington, DC. You will design, deploy, and manage secure cloud infrastructure, including compute instances, virtual cloud networks (VCNs), storage, identity and access management (IAM), and database services. You will develop and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, build and optimize GitLab CI/CD pipelines, and automate cloud provisioning, configuration, and operational processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability. Working as part of a small, experienced technical team, you will collaborate directly with federal stakeholders to troubleshoot technical challenges, strengthen cloud security, optimize platform performance, and implement solutions aligned with federal security and compliance requirements, including NIST, RMF, and FedRAMP. This position requires working onsite at the customer's location in Washington, DC, four days per week, providing opportunities for direct customer engagement and collaboration. This is a hands-on role where your technical expertise, initiative, and ability to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable Oracle Cloud solutions will directly contribute to mission success.

We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!

What you’ll do:

• You will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and modernization of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) supporting a mission-critical federal program.

• You will design, deploy, configure, and manage OCI resources, including compute instances, Virtual Cloud Networks (VCNs), storage, load balancers, identity and access management (IAM), and database services, while developing and maintaining Terraform infrastructure as code and GitLab CI/CD pipelines to automate provisioning, configuration, and deployments.

• Your daily responsibilities will include managing cloud networking and connectivity, troubleshooting infrastructure and performance issues, monitoring system health using OCI Monitoring, Logging, and Alarms, and implementing automation through PowerShell, Bash, and Python scripting.

• You will also support cloud security and compliance by managing access controls, encryption, secrets, and security configurations in accordance with NIST, RMF, FedRAMP, and agency-specific requirements.

• Working directly with engineering, cybersecurity, and program stakeholders, you will maintain platform availability, optimize cloud resource utilization, strengthen operational reliability, and identify opportunities to modernize infrastructure and streamline service delivery.

What you’ll need to succeed:

• Active Secret clearance with the ability to obtain an Interim Top Secret clearance.

• 3+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or systems engineering, with substantial hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments.

• Demonstrated expertise with core OCI services and architecture, including Compute, Virtual Cloud Networks (VCNs), Block and Object Storage, Load Balancers, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and database services.

• Strong hands-on experience with Terraform is a critical requirement, including developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting reusable infrastructure modules, managing state files, and automating cloud infrastructure deployments.

• Solid PowerShell Bash, and/or Python scripting to automate cloud provisioning, system configuration, maintenance, and operational processes.

• Working experience building, maintaining, and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines using GitLab to support automated infrastructure deployments and application delivery.

jobs.description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. About the Role

The Director, Organic Search (SEO/AEO/GEO)  provides thought leadership and shares their passion for the discipline of organic search and emerging LLM, AEO, and GEO opportunities for our clients’ businesses.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience creating and executing organic search strategies,   leading client and internal teams through strategy, process, analytics, and cross-discipline collaboration, with a clear history of exceeding client goals and KPIs.

They understand that strong SEO fundamentals are the foundation for AI search visibility, and they know how to extend that foundation into answer-engine and generative-engine strategies that earn brand mentions and citations inside AI-generated answers. This individual will partner with the VP, Integrated Search to help build new product offerings in this fast moving space.

Organic Search Strategy & Innovation (SEO, AEO, and GEO)

• Lead Unified Search Strategy: Own the integrated organic search strategy for each client, treating classic SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as one connected program rather than separate silos.

• Maintain Technical & Content Foundations: Build and maintain strong technical and content SEO foundations (crawlability, indexation, rendering, site architecture, page experience, structured data, and helpful, people-first content) as the baseline for classic results and AI search features.

• Drive AEO & Direct Answers: Develop AEO strategies that position client content for direct extraction across featured snippets, People Also Ask, knowledge panels, and voice assistants.

• Execute GEO & AI Retrieval: Develop GEO strategies that increase how often and how accurately client brands are mentioned, cited, and recommended inside AI-generated answers across Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, and Claude.

• Modernize Content Architecture & Keyword Research: Shift keyword research toward conversational, question-based, and prompt-based inquiries across the funnel. Guide content structure for answer extraction via clear question-based headings, answer-first summaries, comparison tables, original data, and expert attribution.

• Entity & Knowledge Graph Authority: Strengthen entity clarity and brand consistency across owned properties, structured data, knowledge graph sources, and business listings so AI systems accurately represent clients and products.

• Testing, Innovation & Compliance: Design and run tests measuring what moves AI visibility; turn findings into repeatable agency playbooks, workflows, and new product offerings. Ensure all initiatives strictly follow search engine quality and spam policies.

Measurement, Analytics & Insights

• Lead Organic Data Strategy: Analyze performance data to draw key insights that shape the strategic vision, providing QA, reporting, and strategic direction across search and cross-channel opportunities.

• Build Next-Gen Measurement Frameworks: Integrate traditional SEO metrics with AI visibility tracking, reporting on brand mention and citation frequency, AI share of voice against competitors, sentiment/accuracy of AI answers, and AI referral traffic.

• Platform & Dashboard Management: Select, implement, and manage LLM visibility tracking platforms (e.g., Screaming Frog, PromptWatch, Profound, Conductor, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity), connecting AI visibility signals to business outcomes via Search Console, GA4, and client CRM data.

• Client Education & Expectation Setting: Help clients understand how zero-click and AI-answer behavior is changing user traffic patterns, resetting success metrics and expectations accordingly.

Account Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Client Strategic Guidance: Develop a deep understanding of each client’s business, competitors, and marketing goals. Translate complex concepts (such as how AI search systems crawl, index, and cite content) into clear, actionable narratives for senior stakeholders.

• Partner on Growth & Scoping: Work closely with Planning teams to align programs with client goals, partner with the VP on project plans and scope definition, and actively participate in new business pitches.

• Cross-Discipline Alignment: Partner directly with developers on technical execution (bot management, rendering, schema), and collaborate with content, creative, PR, social, and paid media teams so owned, earned, and paid efforts work together to build brand authority.

Team Leadership & Enablement

• Team Growth & Mentorship: Direct, coach, and support team members across disciplines, demonstrating how to think strategically about organic and AI search within the broader media mix.

• Upskilling & Playbooks: Upskill the practice on AEO and GEO practices, tools, and measurement, building shared playbooks and training modules.

• Performance & Culture: Constructively evaluate team performance, provide support and recognition, and cultivate an environment that encourages testing, intelligent risk-taking, and innovation.

About You

The essentials:

• 6+ years of progressive organic search experience, with a track record of leading strategy, managing teams, and delivering client growth (agency experience preferred).

• Integrated SEO/AEO/GEO Expertise: Proven hands-on experience developing integrated strategies across traditional search, answer engines, and generative platforms.

• AI & Technical Understanding: Working knowledge of how AI search engines retrieve, synthesize, and cite information, paired with strong technical SEO proficiency (site architecture, crawl budget, bot management, rendering, structured data).

• Search & Measurement Stack: Deep experience with Google/Microsoft Search Console, enterprise SEO tools (Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Conductor), and emerging LLM tracking platforms (PromptWatch, Profound, Scrunch).

• Strategic Communication: Strong ability to interact with clients and cross-functional teams at all levels, translating technical search concepts into high-impact business context.

• People Leadership: Prior experience managing, mentoring, and developing junior to mid-level team members.

Core Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Organic Search Growth: Organic traffic, target achievement, engagement, and conversion metrics across organic channels.

• Rankings & Direct Answer Visibility: Topic visibility for priority terms alongside answer feature wins (featured snippets, PAA, knowledge panels, and local pack performance).

• AI Search Visibility: Brand citation frequency, mention accuracy/sentiment, AI share of voice across tracked prompts, and AI referral traffic/conversions.

• Technical Health: Crawlability, indexation health, Core Web Vitals, and structured data implementation.

• Client & Delivery Excellence: Client retention, satisfaction, and on-time milestone delivery.

• Thought Leadership & Market Presence: Regular delivery of high-impact POVs on algorithm shifts and AI search updates, published whitepapers/case studies, industry speaking or panel contributions, and active contribution to new agency service offerings.

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Control
jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

Job Summary:

The OS Core Team at PsiQuantum works closely alongside engineers and scientists in the electronics, system architecture, and validation teams and is responsible for building the scalable, distributed, fault-tolerant control plane and operating system for utility scale photonic quantum computers. Our team is responsible for orchestration, scheduling, kernel architecture, co-design, calibration, validation, providing abstractions, systems, and operating software for the immense heterogenous fabric of co-processors, networks, and photonics that are critical to the success of our company’s goal of building the world’s first useful quantum computer. As a Senior Software Engineer, Calibration & Control you will design and implement algorithms, controls, and software that keep our quantum processors in spec 24×7x365.

Responsibilities:

• Develop and implement software for control of photonic quantum computers in Rust.

• Design and architecture of system software.

• Participate in design and code reviews.

• Collaborate across software, hardware, and research teams at PsiQuantum.

• Testing and maintenance of control software.

• Champion and serve as an exemplar of good software development practices at PsiQuantum.

Experience/Qualifications:

Required skills and experience:

• 15+ years experience with Rust or C++ in a system software context.

• Architecture and implementation of system software for HPC, robotics, AI, quantum computing, semiconductor fabrication, or control systems.

• Proven track record of developing and shipping reliable, performant software in a high scale or mission critical context.

• Bachelors degree in a technical discipline preferred, or equivalent experience.

Ways to stand out:

• Experience in high performance computing.

• Experience in computer architecture.

• Experience in high performance networking.

• Experience building operating systems, compilers, or kernels.

• Experience interfacing with ASICs and/or FPGAs in complex/high-performance systems or an edge-computing context.

• Experience with Nix.

• Experience with highly scalable distributed systems in a reliability and up-time critical environment.

• Familiarity with quantum control.

• PhD in a related technical discipline is a plus, but not required.

PsiQuantum provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. PsiQuantum does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable laws.

jobs.title: Director of Advisor Onboarding
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE:

Savvy is looking for a Director of Advisor Onboarding to own and scale how wealth management practices move their businesses onto Savvy. When an advisor joins us, they're moving everything: their team, their clients, their systems, and the way they've run their practice for years. This leader makes that move fast, predictable, and something advisors feel great about.

Advisor Onboarding owns the advisor's journey from signature until they’ve established their practice at Savvy. The Director leads the team that runs this end to end: managing every workstream of the move, keeping the advisor confident and bought in, and enabling them and their team to work the Savvy way. For enterprise teams, the work looks a lot like a consulting deployment: learn how the business ran before, then map it onto Savvy.

This role reports to the Head of Advisor Success and partners closely with Growth, Product, Operations, Compliance,Client Experience, and IT. It's ideal for a senior operator who has run onboarding or deployment through hypergrowth, brings a consultative and commercial mindset, and has a strong executive presence with demanding customers.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Own and lead the Advisor Onboarding function, including hiring, training, performance management, and org design for a rapidly scaling team.

 - Build and run distinct onboarding motions for enterprise teams and emerging advisors, with clear segmentation, staffing models, and playbooks for each.

 - Build an enterprise deployment playbook: discovery of how each team runs today, mapping their workflows and roles onto Savvy, and a tailored plan to get them live.

 - Own advisor enablement so advisors and their teams are confident in Savvy's tools and ways of working by the time they hand off to Client Experience.

 - Act as program lead across every workstream of a transition, coordinating Client Transition Specialists, Operations, Compliance, and IT to hit one plan and one date.

 - Own onboarding KPIs and OKRs, including time to start date, time to assets transitioned, onboarding CSAT, signed-not-started rate, and enablement completion.

 - Build a capacity model tied to the Growth forecast so the team is staffed ahead of volume.

 - Partner with Growth on late-stage enterprise deals: join recruiting meetings, scope deployment complexity before signing, and set expectations the team can deliver.

 - Design and own the handoffs from Growth into Onboarding and from Onboarding into Client Experience.

 - Own the team’s AI and automation stack: build the workflows, agents, and tools that cut manual work from onboarding.

 - Serve as the senior escalation point for high-stakes onboardings and fix the underlying process behind each one.
   


MUST HAVE:

 - 8 to 12+ years in onboarding, implementation, deployment, consulting, or business operations, with 4+ years leading teams in a high-growth environment.

 - Proven experience building and scaling an onboarding or deployment program through rapid growth (2x+ volume), including managing managers.

 - Experience moving customers' whole operations onto a new platform: learning how their business runs, redesigning their workflows, and driving adoption.

 - Experience running both enterprise (high-touch, complex) and mid-market (repeatable, volume) motions.

 - Strong program management across many parallel workstreams and teams you don't directly manage.

 - Sales acumen: has partnered with Sales on late-stage deals and is comfortable presenting to and managing senior, demanding customers.

 - Track record designing enablement and change management for experienced professionals.

 - Tech-forward operator with a track record of using automation and AI to improve speed and quality.

 - Excellent communication, executive presence, and cross-functional influence.


NICE TO HAVE:
