jobs.title: Maintenance Mechanic III
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

Consistently leads an assigned team to inspect, maintain, repair and install mechanical, electromechanical, pneumatic and/or hydraulic equipment at plant and/or pump stations.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• In conjunction with supervisor, or in his/her absence, reviews daily team requirements. Oversees work assignments to ensure that schedules are met. May recommend changes to schedule to optimize production and/or reduce costs. Ensures that labor reporting is accurate and balances with labor tracking system. Provides feedback to Supervisor on labor, material and equipment demands needed to achieve schedule.
• Monitors work assignments and ensure that team members are meeting or exceeding production and quality standards. Coaches and trains team members to increase skill level and to improve productivity, safety, quality and processes in a cost-effective manner. Trains team members to troubleshoot and resolve problems.
• Provides technical guidance, troubleshoots, resolves or coordinates resolution of technical issues/problems on a proactive basis. Models and teaches finding cost effective solutions to tasks.
• Prepares work orders either manually or from a Computer Maintenance Management System as required and prepares work related reports, procurement requisitions, charts, graphs and data submittal requirements in an accurate and timely manner.
• Models safe work practices and provides leadership in achieving safety goals. May assist with safety training. Ensures that safety awareness is ongoing, that good housekeeping is practiced and that environmental and safety regulatory requirements are met. Reports potential problems to supervisor on a timely basis.
• Performs duties of Maintenance Tech III as required.
• May assist with maintaining parts, spares and maintenance procurement and inventory.
• May assist in other areas of plant as directed.

Work Environment:

• Spends 100% of the time in operations environment.
• Typically spends 25 – 35% of time exposed to outdoor and sometimes inclement weather.
• Company service vehicles are used as required.
• Travels 1 – 2 times per year for company provided training.
• May serve rotational 24 hour emergency on-call.
• Possible Work Hazards: May be exposed to possible operations hazards including fumes, dust, toxic and caustic chemicals, noise, rotating machinery, high pressure and hot and cold temperatures, slippery surfaces, water and electrical hazards.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma or GED with the ability to read, write and comprehend English (operational, process, safety and quality instructions) and be able to carry out verbal and written instructions.
• Over five years of* experience in a related position in a similar environment with ability to comprehend complex specifications, blueprints and manuals.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations. Vocational training and mechanical aptitude required, with the ability to read, interpret and record data from meters, gauges, scales, panels, computer consoles and other equipment.
• Demonstrates ability to mentor, coach and train others to identify cost effective solutions.
• Must demonstrate ability to use computer programs for preparing work orders, work related reports, charts, graphs and data submittal requirements.
• Must demonstrate proficiency in and model the care and use of all site specific, facility required PPE (Personal Protection Equipment).
• Must consistently demonstrate the ability to perform all assigned tasks in an organized, accurate and timely manner and the ability to efficiently maintain, install and repair any equipment used in the facility. Fabrication and welding experience may be required if necessary at site.
• Must have the ability to diagnose problems regardless of complexity, troubleshoot mechanical, electro-mechanical, hydraulic or pneumatic equipment and take corrective action within policy and procedure limitations.
• Good verbal and written communication skills are necessary.
• Must demonstrate ability to work in a team environment and willingness to assume additional or new responsibilities readily.
• Must be able to serve rotational 24 hour emergency on-call if required by site.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Must possess a valid driver’s license.
• Employee Orientation, Departmental Operating Procedures, Safety, OSHA and Quality Training.
• Note: Will not perform duties unless properly
• Forklift Certification if required by site.
• May perform more advanced functions as part of training and development.

Physical Requirements:

• Amount of time spent – Standing 25%, Walking 75% for as many as five miles per shift.
• Requires close visual and hearing observation to detect non-conformance and machine malfunction.
• Constantly uses hands to finger, handle or feel and frequently reaches with hands and arms.
• Works in various positions; works on ladders, catwalks, and supports at heights of 50 feet above the ground; and works with hands extended above and below head and body up to 40 minutes using hand tools weighing up to 15 pounds.
• Must be able to lift and carry 50 pounds (occasionally 60 pounds) distances of 10 feet.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
With over 30,000 customers, including a third of Fortune 500 companies, Tempo is trusted by organizations across the globe to make their workflows work better.

We create a suite of integrated solutions for time management, resource planning, budget management, roadmapping, program management, reporting and more. We create the tech that enables the modern team to deliver – for every step from first vision to value.

Since our beginning in 2007 as a project to make a time-tracking tool to help a client – Tempo has expanded to become the #1 time management add-on for Jira, and we have developed and acquired a multitude of tools to become one of the most trusted names in the Atlassian ecosystem.

We want everyone to work better – but we also want to be a tech company with a heart. Join us as we continuously innovate our award-winning products, create new solutions, and help the world work smarter, not harder.



About the role

Tempo is entering its most exciting chapter yet, moving from an Atlassian-native marketplace vendor to a Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) provider for enterprises, led by the launch of a new AI-native flagship platform. We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help bring this platform and the full Tempo product suite to market with messaging that lands, programs that drive pipeline, and enablement that helps our sellers win.

Reporting to the Director of Enterprise Product Marketing, you'll own persona- and vertical-specific storytelling for audiences that range from hands-on practitioners to the C-suite. You'll translate product capability into value that buyers recognize, then build the programs and tools that carry that value into the market. This is a high-impact role for a solutions marketer who is equally comfortable shaping a category narrative and rolling up their sleeves to build a sales deck.



What you'll do

 - Develop persona-specific messaging and positioning for buyers and influencers across organizational levels, including C-suite executives, strategy and PMO leaders, product leaders, IT leaders, and digital and AI transformation leaders — connecting each audience to the outcomes they care about.

 - Build narratives across multiple industry verticals that promote the full Tempo product suite, not just a single product.

 - Design and run integrated go-to-market programs and launches, from defining the audience and the story through asset creation, cross-functional alignment, and post-launch measurement.

 - Partner with Product Management and Finance on pricing and packaging strategy, translating market and buyer willingness-to-pay signals into positioning that supports the model.

 - Create high-impact sales enablement, including pitch decks, solution briefs, competitive battlecards, discovery frameworks, ROI and business case tools, and seller training that supports complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

 - Partner with the Partner Marketing team to build better-together narratives and co-marketing programs that help ecosystem and channel partners lead with Tempo.

 - Partner with the Growth Marketing team to translate messaging into campaigns that fill and move the funnel, and to test and refine what resonates across segments.

 - Serve as a voice of the market by running customer interviews, gathering sales feedback, tracking the competitive landscape, and validating positioning before it goes wide.

 - Guide how Tempo engages design partners and customer advisors, and ensure what's learned from those conversations — call transcripts, program results, recurring feedback — makes it back into the messaging framework, sales enablement materials, and customer advocacy content.

 - Build and mature launch tiering framework — the criteria that classify a launch's scope and investment level, and the playbooks and cross-functional process that let any future launch run consistently, whether it's a flagship platform release or a minor feature update.

 - Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate research, competitive analysis, and content production, without sacrificing quality. Automate repetitive tasks, streamline workflows across the GTM and launch lifecycle, and surface data insights faster — freeing up time for strategic, high-impact work.

 - Influence the product roadmap by bringing market and buyer insight back to Product Management.



Who you are

 - 5-8 years of product marketing experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, with a strong solutions marketing background.

 - A proven track record developing persona- and vertical-specific messaging for audiences ranging from practitioners to the C-suite.

 - Experience building and running go-to-market programs and product launches that drove measurable pipeline or revenue.

 - Experience creating sales enablement assets and training for teams selling into complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals.

 - A collaborative approach, with a history of working closely across Product, Sales, Partner Marketing, and Growth Marketing teams.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex products easy to understand.

 - Experience designing repeatable, scalable marketing processes — launch frameworks, playbooks, or operating models — not just executing one-off programs.

 - Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow — for research, competitive analysis, and content production — with the judgment to know when they're helping and when they're not.
   
   

Why Join Tempo?

 - Impact: Work on meaningful products that empower enterprise users and improve productivity.

 - Innovation: Be part of a culture that values creativity and innovation, with opportunities to make a real impact.

 - Collaboration: Join a supportive, collaborative team that values openness, communication, and a continuous learning environment.

 - Growth: Opportunities for professional development, including conferences, courses, and mentorship.



What's In It For You (Org-wide)

 - Remote First work environment

 - Unlimited vacation in most of our locations!!

 - Great benefits including health, dental, vision and savings plan.

 - Perks such as training reimbursement, WFH reimbursement, and more.

 - Diverse and dynamic teams with challenging and exciting work.

 - An opportunity to have a real impact on our business.

 - A great range of social activities (both in person and virtual).

 - Optional in person meet-ups and the ability to travel to our international offices

 - Employee referral program

 - And so much more!

Note: As our hiring teams are global, please submit your resume in English only

Apply today to join the Tempo team and help shape the future of enterprise productivity software.

Join us at Tempo Software, where we proudly foster an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to creating an inclusive culture where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

About Commvault

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

As the first line of communication with these top strategic accounts and C level executives within these accounts, ideal BDRs have a strong understanding of the sales process, excelling at researching leads, starting new relationships, and setting our sales closers up for success. You should be a quick learner with strong communication skills, and have the ability to showcase our offerings in a compelling way. Every potential customer is an opportunity for you to boost top-line revenue growth, customer acquisition levels, and profitability.

**This role is located in Ft. Lauderdale, FL, Monday-Thursday in office and work from home on Friday**

jobs.title: Internal Ballistician
jobs.description:
Long Wall Company was created in 2024 to accelerate missile defense technology for the U.S. and our allies. We specialize in ballistic missile defense and are developing Cyclops, a low-cost, mass-producible interceptor. We also produce containerized launchers and offer low-cost targets for threat replication. The future of global security depends on defensive technology that redefines cost, magazine depth, and distribution to deter and defend against evolving threats. Join us.
 
WHAT WE LOOK FOR
Mission-Driven Problem Solvers– The problems in missile defense demand ingenuity. We want engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals who approach challenges with curiosity, embrace failure as a learning opportunity, and stay focused on delivering the best solution for the mission.
Total Ownership– We seek those who take full responsibility for delivering flight-ready work while recognizing that no one succeeds alone. The best engineers, technicians, and corporate professionals make their teammates better, knowing that complementary skills create force multiplication and drive mission success.


Internal Ballistician 
DESCRIPTION 
Long Wall is seeking an experienced Ballistician to support the design, development, testing, and production of solid rocket motors (SRMs) for our interceptor system. This role is responsible for ensuring that SRM ballistic performance meets demanding missile-interception requirements while remaining manufacturable at scale.  The Ballistician serves as the technical authority for SRM internal ballistics and overall booster performance.  Responsibilities include developing and optimizing propellant grain designs; performing SRM performance analysis (including sensitivity to off-nominal conditions); reviewing and interpreting static-fire and flight-test data; providing technical oversight and direction to propulsion suppliers; and defining ballistic requirements and verifying compliance throughout development and production.   
 The successful candidate will establish rigorous analytical methods while driving efficient program execution. They will work closely with propulsion, structures, aerodynamics, guidance and control, manufacturing, and systems engineering teams to ensure ballistic decisions remain aligned with system-level performance, technical baselines, and program objectives

jobs.title: AI Training Infrastructure - Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description:
AI TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE 


- MEMBER OF TECHNICAL STAFF

Location: Hybrid | Bellevue, WA (downtown)
Multiple levels and roles available




BUILD THE TRAINING INFRASTRUCTURE POWERING NEXT-GENERATION AI MODELS



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

A well-funded, rapidly growing AI infrastructure company is building a next-generation cloud platform designed to power the full lifecycle of artificial intelligence. The organization is developing a comprehensive AI infrastructure, platform, and services portfolio that supports the full spectrum of AI workloads—including large-scale compute, model training, fine-tuning, inference, and emerging agentic AI applications.



Backed by significant long-term investment, the company combines the speed, ownership, and innovation of a startup with the stability and resources of an established parent organization. Engineering teams are intentionally lean, highly collaborative, and AI-native, leveraging modern tooling and automation to build infrastructure capable of supporting the industry's most demanding AI workloads.



We're seeking AI Training Infrastructure Engineers to build and scale the distributed systems that power large-scale AI model training. This team focuses on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence across GPU clusters, enabling researchers and engineers to train and deploy advanced AI models at scale.

 
 


THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a foundational engineering role focused on building the infrastructure layer behind large-scale AI training workloads. You'll work on distributed training systems, GPU clusters, model pipelines, and the tooling required to make AI development more reliable, efficient, and scalable.



You'll collaborate closely with infrastructure, orchestration, performance, and machine learning teams to solve complex challenges around distributed computing, fault tolerance, training efficiency, and production readiness.



This opportunity is ideal for engineers who enjoy building highly scalable systems and working at the intersection of AI research, infrastructure engineering, and distributed computing.

 
 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and scale distributed training infrastructure supporting large AI models across large GPU clusters.

 - Design and improve systems that increase training reliability, efficiency, and resource utilization.

 - Develop solutions for fault tolerance, checkpointing, recovery, and large-scale training operations.

 - Integrate AI models into production training pipelines in partnership with platform, orchestration, and performance engineering teams.

 - Diagnose and resolve issues impacting training throughput, stability, reliability, and cost efficiency.

 - Build tools and automation that improve the developer experience for AI researchers and engineers.

 - Establish best practices for training infrastructure, operational processes, and platform reliability.

 - Contribute to the evolution of the AI infrastructure platform as an early member of the engineering team.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on experience building and operating distributed training systems or large-scale machine learning infrastructure.

 - Experience supporting large AI models, foundation models, post-training workflows, or similar ML systems.

 - Strong understanding of the reliability, scalability, and efficiency challenges associated with multi-node GPU training.

 - Experience integrating training systems with production machine learning pipelines.

 - Strong programming skills and experience working with complex distributed systems.

 - Ability to independently own technically challenging projects in a fast-moving engineering environment.

 - Comfortable operating with high ownership and limited process overhead.

 
 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with distributed training frameworks such as PyTorch Distributed, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, Ray, or similar technologies.

 - Experience with supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), or other post-training workflows.

 - Background operating AI training infrastructure at scale within a hyperscaler, AI research organization, cloud provider, or GPU cloud environment.

 - Experience optimizing GPU utilization, training performance, or distributed system reliability.

 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, containerized AI workloads, and large-scale infrastructure platforms.

 


COMPENSATION

 - Competitive base pay for Bellevue market

 - Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, annual bonus, and long term incentives. These awards are allocated based on individual performance  

 - U.S. based employees have access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan and company match, employees also receive per calendar year, paid holidays

 


LOCATION

 - Hybrid role based in downtown Bellevue, WA.

 - Approximately three days per week in the office.

 - Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. who are open to relocation are encouraged to apply.

 - U.S. work authorization is required. Visa sponsorship is not currently available.

 


WHY JOIN?

 - Build the infrastructure powering the next generation of AI models and applications.

 - Work directly on distributed training systems, GPU clusters, and large-scale AI platforms.

 - Solve some of the industry's most challenging problems around AI scalability, reliability, and efficiency.

 - Join early enough to influence architecture, tooling, and engineering practices.

 - Collaborate with a highly experienced team building critical AI infrastructure from the ground up.

 - Enjoy the ownership and technical impact of a startup environment backed by significant long-term investment.

jobs.title: Power Electronic Testing Engineering – Power Semiconductor Reliability
jobs.description:
Renesas is seeking a Power Electronic Testing Engineering to support the development, qualification, and reliability assessment of advanced power semiconductor products. This position requires a strong background in semiconductor reliability, device physics, accelerated life testing, and failure mechanisms.

The successful candidate will develop and execute reliability characterization strategies, establish acceleration models, translate accelerated test results to application mission profiles, and support qualification of products for industrial and automotive applications. Experience with power semiconductor devices and wide-bandgap technologies is highly desirable, with GaN experience strongly preferred.

The position will also serve as a technical representative for Renesas through industry standards activities, technical publications, peer-reviewed articles, and presentations at reliability-related conferences.

• Develop reliability characterization strategies and accelerated life test methodologies for semiconductor devices, including switching accelerated lifetime (SALT), and partner with Test Engineering to translate reliability requirements into test systems and execute testing.

• Design experiments to identify and characterize semiconductor failure modes and degradation mechanisms.

• Develop and assess Early Life Failure Rate (ELFR) and related early-life reliability testing methodologies.

• Translate accelerated reliability test results into use-condition lifetime predictions and mission-profile-based reliability assessments.

• Investigate reliability failures and work with failure analysis, design, process, product, and manufacturing engineering teams to understand root cause and reliability risk.

• Provide technical guidance on the reliability implications of new device structures, materials, processes, and product applications.

• Prepare and publish technical white papers and articles for peer review covering semiconductor reliability, accelerated testing, failure mechanisms, and related areas.

• Present technical work at reliability conferences, workshops, and other industry forums.

• Participate in industry standards organizations and technical committees, including JEDEC and AEC, and contribute to the development and improvement of semiconductor reliability and qualification standards.

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Reliability Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Master’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.

jobs.title: Contracts Manager
jobs.description:
Do you like working with different project teams in a fast-paced environment? Are you interested in joining an organization focused on making a positive impact? If so, we’d like to talk with you about growing with us.

We are currently seeking a Contracts Manager to work full-time, onsite in our Memphis, TN office.  This is an excellent opportunity to join and grow EnSafe, getting involved in a variety of projects for a diverse range of clients across the globe.

As the Contracts Manager, you will serve as the primary point of contact for non-federal contractual matters and corporate compliance activities, including contract negotiations and the management of complex administrative and compliance processes across multiple business functions.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES
In this role, you will:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for all non-federal client contracts, proposals, and projects.

• Manage the full contract lifecycle, including proposal support, contract review, negotiation, execution, and administration.

• Monitor the contracts portal, assign incoming work, and report on workflow status and priorities.

• Review RFPs and contract documents to identify risks and support development of compliant responses.

• Negotiate contract terms and conditions while aligning with company objectives and risk tolerance.

• Draft subcontractor flow-downs and negotiate subcontract terms and conditions.

• Maintain and update contract templates, standards, and related documentation.

• Oversee supplier portal registrations, compliance requirements, and access management.

• Manage corporate registrations, filings, business licenses, and related compliance activities.

• Prepare required, non-federal small business reporting and support compliance across multiple entities and jurisdictions.

• Manage corporate insurance renewals, claims tracking, and audit coordination.

• Maintain subcontractor and vendor insurance certificates and compliance documentation.

• Draft and process corporate agreements, including NDAs, employment agreements, teaming agreements, and joint venture agreements.

• Maintain litigation tracking records and assist with conflict-of-interest reviews.

• Administer office leases and reconcile annual CAM expenses.

• Provide day-to-day direction and workload coordination for the Part-Time Contracts Coordinator.

• Partner with Contracts, Risk Management, Health & Safety, Finance, and operational teams to support company objectives.

• Provide back-up support for contract workflows and leadership as needed.

SKILLS/EXPERIENCE
Minimum Skills and Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Legal Studies, Business Administration, Paralegal Studies, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.

• 10+ years of experience in contract management, legal support, corporate compliance, risk management, or a related field.

• Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management, contract negotiation, and RFP/RFQ processes.

• Experience reviewing and negotiating commercial contract terms and conditions.

• Experience managing regulatory compliance activities, registrations, filings, and business licensing requirements.

• Experience administering compliance activities across multiple entities, clients, jurisdictions, or business functions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify contractual and business risks.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

• Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

• High attention to detail and a proactive, ownership-driven approach to work.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a cross-functional environment.

• Experience providing guidance, coordination, or oversight to support staff or junior team members.

Preferred Skills:

• Juris Doctor (JD) degree, MBA, and/or equivalent legal/contracting experience.

• Experience drafting and negotiating subcontract agreements and flow-down provisions.

• Knowledge of certificates of insurance, and risk mitigation practices.

• Experience with supplier management systems, contractor compliance platforms, or contract management software.

• Experience supporting professional services, consulting, engineering, construction, or environmental services organizations.

Why Join EnSafe?

• Employee-Owned Advantage EnSafe is 100% employee-owned, with an ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) since 1997. That means when EnSafe succeeds, you succeed too, turning company growth directly into shared rewards.

• Commitment to Growth and Wellness The company supports personalized career development, mentorship, and employee wellness initiatives such as health tracking tools.

• Purpose‑Driven Work EnSafe’s mission focuses on impactful environmental, health, and safety consulting—making a real difference in communities and is backed by its long-standing technical credibility.

• Safety as a Value, Not Just a Service Safety is deeply embedded in our culture, prioritizing employee well-being in addition to helping clients maintain compliance. We stress that “safety is part of everything we do.”

• A Culture of Freedom & Ownership At EnSafe, our career philosophy is built on freedom. The freedom to take initiative, achieve your goals, and shape your own career path Employees are encouraged to pursue growth in a flexible, entrepreneurial environment.

• Challenging, Creative Work Workdays at EnSafe are anything but ordinary, fast-paced, dynamic, and filled with opportunities to tackle projects in environmental consulting, health & safety, engineering, and technology. Every day calls for creativity, innovation, and agile problem-solving.

#LI-Onsite

About EnSafe

EnSafe began as a two-person firm in 1980, navigating complex regulatory compliance issues on behalf of our clients.  We nurture our people with growth and development opportunities.  We build enduring, trustful relationships with each of our clients, with a focus on high ethical and safety standards.  We build this reputation by attracting high-quality people and retaining them for the long term.

jobs.title: Fleet Support Administrator (JFK Airport)

WHAT WE OFFER

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

jobs.title: Director, Engineering Services
jobs.description:
ICON builds robotic systems that construct multi-story buildings. The company launched Titan commercially in March 2026, has raised over $550M, and holds more than $360M in government contracts across the Army, Air Force, DARPA, and NASA. That growth means more printers in the field, more sites running concurrently, and a larger installed base that has to stay productive.

This role owns Engineering Services: the team that keeps ICON’s printer fleet and site equipment reliable, supportable, and current. That includes sustaining engineering, engineering change management, reliability and root-cause analysis, and the technical content field and operations teams run on. New product design stays with Hardware Engineering; Engineering Services owns everything after release.

You will report to the VP, Operations Technology and work daily with Hardware Engineering, Construction Operations, Field Service, Supply Chain, and Quality. You are accountable for fleet uptime, change velocity, and building the service engineering function to match a growing installed base.

Responsibilities

Fleet Reliability & Sustaining Engineering

• Own reliability performance across deployed Vulcan, Phoenix, and Titan systems; set uptime and MTBF targets with Operations and report against them.

• Run root-cause analysis on recurring field failures and drive corrective designs through to release and fleet retrofit.

• Prioritize and manage the sustaining backlog against site schedules, parts availability, and cost.

Engineering Change & Configuration Management

• Own the ECO process end to end, including impact assessment, approval, documentation, and rollout to units in the field.

• Maintain as-built configuration control across the fleet so Operations, Supply Chain, and Service know exactly what is deployed where.

Service Readiness & Technical Enablement

• Deliver the service manuals, procedures, training content, and diagnostic tools that technicians and site crews depend on.

• Define spares strategy and serviceability requirements with Supply Chain and feed them back into new product programs.

Team Leadership

• Lead and grow a team of engineers and managers; set priorities, develop people, and manage the department budget.

• Represent Engineering Services in cross-functional planning with Hardware, Operations, and Prime program leadership.

Required Qualifications

• 10+ years in mechanical, electromechanical, or systems engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams.

• Experience owning sustaining engineering, reliability, or service engineering for complex deployed hardware (heavy equipment, robotics, industrial machinery, or similar).

• Hands-on experience running engineering change and configuration management processes.

• Track record of leading root-cause investigations and driving corrective actions to closure.

• Based in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX; this role is on site.

Preferred Qualifications

• Fleet or field operations experience with equipment running at multiple remote sites.

• Experience standing up or scaling a service engineering function.

• Familiarity with construction, robotics, or large-format automation.

• Experience supporting government or defense programs.

jobs.title: Mobile Phlebotomist (Albany, NY)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Sprinter Health, our mission is to reimagine how people access care by bringing high quality care directly into the home.

Using the same technology that powers leading marketplace platforms, we deliver care where people are, especially those who need it most.

We’ve supported millions of patients across 22 states and consistently maintained a 90+ NPS, reflecting the quality and experience we strive to deliver every day.

Our clinical teams are at the center of making healthcare more accessible, connected, and personal.



Where patient experience isn’t a metric. It’s a standard.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Sprinter, you’ll bring healthcare directly to patients in the comfort of their homes. You’ll spend your day on the road providing a variety of preventative and diagnostic services, including blood draws, vitals, height and weight assessments, urine collection, support with Annual Wellness Visits, and more.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys independence, connecting with patients, and a workday that looks different from a traditional clinic setting.

What We Offer

 - Guaranteed daily hours

 - National Mileage reimbursement, currently $0.76/mile reimbursement starting at mile 31

 - Company paid healthcare premiums

 - 100% 401(k) contribution of 3%

 - Company provided equipment including iPhone, iPad, scrubs, and supplies


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Life as a Sprinter starts before the first patient visit. Your car becomes both your office and your lab on the go, so preparation and organization are everything.

 - Prepare for your day by reviewing your schedule and ensuring you have the proper supplies and PPE.

 - Travel to patients’ homes throughout your assigned service area.

 - Provide scheduled services including blood draws, vitals, height and weight measurements, urine collection, support with Annual Wellness Visits, and other preventative and diagnostic services.

 - Use your expert phlebotomy skills to make blood draws as comfortable as possible for each patient.

 - Create a warm, welcoming, and professional experience in every patient’s home.

 - Accurately document each patient visit using Sprinter technology.

 - Properly label, handle, and transport specimens for lab drop off or shipment.

 - Manage your time, supplies, and schedule independently as you move from patient to patient throughout the day.


SOUND LIKE YOU?


MASTER OF YOUR CRAFT

 - Do you have exceptional blood draw skills?

 - Have you been the “go to” for hard sticks?

 - Are you confident in drawing blood from a wide range of patients?

 - Are you comfortable learning and performing additional clinical services?


ROAD WARRIOR

 - Do you enjoy a change of scenery during your workday?

 - Are you comfortable spending a significant portion of your day on the road?

 - Are you willing to travel an hour or more to visit patients?

 - Can you comfortably drive before 7:00 a.m. when your first patient is scheduled at 7:00 a.m.?


PATIENT FOCUSED

 - Are you passionate about helping others?

 - Are you kind, empathetic, and an effective communicator?

 - Do you enjoy meeting new people and creating a great patient experience?


SEEN IT ALL BEFORE

 - Are you comfortable providing care in a variety of home environments, recognizing that each patient’s living conditions and standards may be different from your own?

 - Can you remain calm, adaptable, and professional when faced with challenging or unexpected situations?


COMMITTED TO EXCELLENCE

 - Do you pride yourself on being reliable, dependable, and trustworthy?

 - Are you solution oriented and able to think critically when challenges arise?

 - Is your mode of transportation as reliable as you are?


TECH PROFICIENT

 - Are you proficient using Apple iPhones and iPads beyond calling and texting?

 - Are you comfortable navigating apps, electronic health records, telehealth platforms, and other digital tools?

 - Can you confidently learn and navigate new technology independently?

If you’re nodding yes, you’re off to a great start. Here are a few more things you’ll need to be successful as a Sprinter.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Strong phlebotomy skills, including experience with challenging sticks

 - Patient facing healthcare experience as a Phlebotomist, Medical Assistant (MA), Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN), or Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) in home preferred

 - Current BLS certification

 - Valid driver’s license, current auto insurance, and personal, reliable vehicle

 - Availability Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.

 - Ability to drive before 7:00 a.m. to arrive at your first scheduled patient on time

 - Proficiency using Apple iPhones and iPads

 - Ability to meet applicable state specific certification or licensing requirements


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs.

 - Ability to spend prolonged periods driving between patient appointments

 - Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and carry medical supplies and equipment

 - Ability to safely navigate a variety of patient home environments, including locations with stairs

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive, Home Care
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

A Place for Mom (APFM) is seeking a strategic, results-driven Enterprise Account Executive to drive growth within the home care segment by developing and expanding partnerships with large home care franchise systems, multi-location operators, and corporate organizations that own or manage multiple home care agencies. In this enterprise sales “hunter” role, the Account Executive builds the APFM value story to win the corporate order top-down. This role is responsible for engaging executive-level stakeholders to secure corporate partnerships and large-scale orders while increasing agency participation, referral volume, and network capacity across affiliated locations.

The Account Executive will take a consultative, enterprise-focused approach to selling, navigating complex organizational structures, and influencing stakeholders across corporate leadership, franchise business coaches, and individual franchise agencies. Success in this role is defined by establishing APFM’s value with strategic franchise accounts and landing corporate orders, which in turn grow APFM’s network capacity, participating agency penetration, and referral volume. To support the corporate sale, this individual will also work closely with Home Care Acquisition Managers (HCAMs), who drive grassroots adoption and agency-level sales, and Customer Success Managers (CSMs), who lead agency-level onboarding, enablement, and retention, to accelerate selling velocity, align corporate and local strategies, and expand APFM’s penetration across franchise and corporate networks.

The ideal candidate is a proven enterprise seller who combines a demonstrated history of consultative sales success with strong executive presence, analytical rigor, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams toward shared commercial objectives.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the full enterprise sales cycle with franchise organizations and other multi-location operators, from prospecting and securing executive access through negotiation and close, to land corporate orders that bring locations into APFM’s network at scale.

 - Build a compelling, tailored APFM value story for each strategic account, grounded in its business model, growth priorities, and location-level performance data, that makes the case for a corporate-level commitment.

 - Develop and execute strategic enterprise account plans for home care franchise systems, large corporate operators, and organizations with multiple home care agencies to win corporate orders, drive revenue growth, and achieve corporate sales objectives.

 - Build relationships with C-suite executives, corporate leadership, franchise business coaches, and other senior decision-makers to establish APFM as a strategic partner and secure large-scale corporate orders.

 - Identify opportunities to expand existing relationships, recognizing that some agencies may already participate in APFM’s programs through independently established agency relationships, and translate that existing engagement into corporate orders.

 - Drive enterprise-wide adoption and increase the penetration of APFM’s programs across eligible franchise locations, affiliated agencies, and corporate-owned networks.

 - Grow referral volume and network capacity by developing strategies that increase the number of participating agencies and expand engagement within existing accounts.

 - Partner closely with HCAMs to accelerate agency-level selling, align grassroots sales efforts with corporate priorities, and increase the velocity of local adoption and program utilization, building the location-level momentum that helps win each corporate order.

 - Guide Customer Success Managers (CSMs) on agency-level enablement, including the HCAM-to-CSM handoff at go-live, so local execution reflects each corporate partner’s priorities, and use the adoption results and upsell triggers CSMs surface as proof points to win and expand corporate orders.

 - Develop executive-level presentations and business reviews that communicate APFM program performance, highlight growth opportunities, and establish clear plans for expanding participation and referral volume.

 - Monitor strategic account performance, agency participation, network capacity, referral trends, and sales pipeline progression to assess progress against growth objectives and adjust strategies accordingly.

 - Establish measurable account-level goals and hold cross-functional partners, including HCAMs and CSMs, accountable for execution, ensuring that corporate agreements translate into agency participation, sustained retention, and incremental business.

 - Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, pipeline reporting, and performance metrics within APFM’s CRM and reporting systems.

 - Represent APFM in executive meetings, industry events, and strategic partnership discussions to strengthen relationships and identify new opportunities for growth.
   
   


SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, or a related field required.

 - Minimum of 7 years of B2B sales experience, with a proven track record of achieving and exceeding revenue targets.

 - Demonstrated success in consultative selling, closing enterprise deals, strategic business development, and navigating complex sales cycles.

 - Experience selling through franchise or multi-location/channel structures, winning corporate-level commitments that drive adoption across individually owned locations.

 - Strong executive presence, with the ability to build credibility and influence senior executives, corporate decision-makers, franchise leadership, and other key stakeholders.

 - Experience managing cross-functional teams, including sales and customer success partners, and driving results through influence and collaboration without direct authority.

 - Proven ability to turn data into clear, compelling insights that uncover growth opportunities, influence decisions, and build the case for investment.

 - Strong analytical, financial, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.

 - Experience in home care, senior care, or a related healthcare services industry preferred.

 - Highly organized and self-directed, with the ability to manage multiple strategic accounts, prioritize opportunities, and execute against ambitious growth objectives.

 - Willingness to travel as needed to support executive engagement, strategic account development, and field execution. Estimated 25% travel.
   
   


COMPENSATION

Base Salary: $122,500

Bonus: $82,075

Benefits:

 - 401(k) plus match

 - Dental insurance

 - Health insurance

 - Vision Insurance

 - Paid Time Off

About A Place for Mom

A Place for Mom is the leading platform guiding families through every stage of the aging journey. Together, we simplify the senior care search with free, personalized support — connecting caregivers and their loved ones to vetted providers from our network of 15,000+ senior living communities and home care agencies.

Since 2000, our teams have helped millions of families find care that fits their needs. Behind every referral and resource is a shared goal: to help families focus on what matters most — their love for each other.

We’re proud to be a mission-driven company where every role contributes to improving lives. Caring isn’t just a core value — it’s who we are. Whether you’re supporting families directly or driving innovation behind the scenes, your work at A Place for Mom makes a real difference.

Our employees live the company values every day:

 - Mission Over Me: We find purpose in helping caregivers and their senior loved ones while approaching our work with empathy.

 - Do Hard Things: We are energized by solving challenging problems and see it as an opportunity to grow.

 - Drive Outcomes as a Team: We each own the outcome but can only achieve it as a team.

 - Win The Right Way: We see organizational integrity as the foundation for how we operate.

 - Embrace Change: We innovate and constantly evolve.

Additional Information:

A Place for Mom has recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. APFM will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments, or access to financial accounts; and/or extend an offer without conducting an interview.

If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

A Place for Mom uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit www.dhs.gov/E-Verify http://www.dhs.gov/E-Verify.

jobs.title: Autism Evaluator - LCSW, LPC, LMFT - Contract/1099
jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, New Jersey & Maryland—and we’re growing into new markets in 2027.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

As an Autism Evaluator at Blackbird Health, you will play a central role in giving families clarity and long-term support by combining neurodevelopmental diagnostic evaluations (specifically autism spectrum assessments) with ongoing, evidence-based psychotherapy.

Working alongside an interdisciplinary care team, you will help kids, adolescents, young adults and families gain diagnostic clarity and transition seamlessly into effective, whole-child care. This role offers flexible customization to align your direct care hours between testing and therapy based on clinician strengths, business needs, and patient demand.

What Makes You, You

• Clinically Skilled Evaluator: Skilled (or eager to grow) in neurodevelopmental diagnostic tools (ADOS-2, ASRS, CARS-2) with an aptitude for synthesizing complex data into clear, actionable formulations.

• Therapeutically Grounded: Passionate about delivering high-quality, evidence-based psychotherapy to children, adolescents, and young adults.

• Developmentally & Neurodiverse-Informed: Skilled at meeting individuals where they are across developmental stages and neurodiverse profiles.

• Interdisciplinary Collaborator: Thrives in a team-based model, working alongside psychiatric nurse practitioners, executive function coaches, and speech/language therapists.

• Organized & Agile: Comfortable managing a dynamic schedule that balances autism evaluations, report writing, feedback appointments, and ongoing therapy sessions.

• Family-Centered Communicator: Able to convey diagnostic findings and complex clinical feedback to families with deep empathy, clarity, and care.

How You’ll Make an Impact

Autism Evaluations & Diagnostics

• Conduct Assessments: Perform neurodevelopmental diagnostic evaluations, focusing on autism spectrum evaluations (ADOS-2, ASRS, CARS-2).

• Synthesize & Formulate: Analyze, interpret, and synthesize assessment data into clear, clinically sound diagnostic conclusions.

• Deliver Family Feedback: Provide clear, compassionate feedback to clients and families following evaluations, outlining recommendations and care pathways.

• Manage Evaluation Timelines: Complete progress notes within 24 hours of service and oversee report-writing, feedback appointments, and schedule adjustments.

• Care Team Alignment: Communicate evaluation findings directly to the broader interdisciplinary team and participate in weekly clinical consultations.

Psychotherapy & Clinical Care

• Deliver Evidence-Based Care: Provide direct psychotherapy to a tailored caseload of pediatric and young adult clients.

• Conduct Diagnostic Intakes: Perform biopsychosocial assessments for incoming therapy clients to establish individualized treatment plans.

• Drive Integrated Outcomes: Partner with multidisciplinary providers to establish and maintain comprehensive, integrated treatment plans.

• Maintain High Documentation Standards: Track patient progress continuously and complete accurate, timely clinical documentation.

Schedule & Work Model

• Onsite Commitment: Minimum of 2 days per week onsite at the assigned clinic location (primarily dedicated to direct patient care and evaluation appointments). Remaining responsibilities may be completed remotely.

• After-School Coverage: To support school-aged children and families, a schedule that includes weekday hours after 3 PM or weekends is preferred.

• Role Customization: Productivity and split between autism evaluations and therapy sessions are customized per clinician and documented upon hire.

The Basics You’ll Need

• Active, independent LCSW license in Pennsylvania.

• Minimum 2+ years of experience delivering clinical care to children, adolescents, and families.

• Exceptional clinical writing and diagnostic documentation skills.

• Proven ability to collaborate within a multidisciplinary healthcare team.

Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience conducting autism spectrum or neurodevelopmental diagnostic evaluations.

• Familiarity or formal training in standardized diagnostic tools (ADOS-2, ASRS, CARS).

• Background in integrated or collaborative pediatric mental health settings.

Why Blackbird is Unique

• Hybrid Variety: Enjoy a balanced mix of testing and ongoing therapy without the burnout of mono-focused caseloads.

• Integrated Support: Work within a full ecosystem of PMHNPs, therapists, and specialty coaches.

• Administrative & Credentialing Support: We handle billing, credentialing, and scheduling logistics so you can focus on clinical care.

• Paid Consultation & Training: Dedicated time for multidisciplinary team consults and ongoing diagnostic skill development.

Benefits

• Medical, Dental & Vision coverage

• 401(k) with company match

• Employer-paid life insurance & professional liability coverage

• Generous paid time off

• Clear pathways for clinical career growth

Salary Range

$80—$95 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at recruiting@blackbirdhealth.com so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
The Talent Acquisition Enablement Manager makes hiring at Domino's simpler, more consistent and measurably better. The role is the accountable owner of the end-to-end recruiting process, from talent demand through onboarding handoff, and the connection point among people, process, technology, data and partner teams.

You are the process engineer and operating backbone for Talent Acquisition. You set common standards, redesign workflows, get more value from recruiting tools, apply automation and responsible AI to remove administrative work, and turn recruiting data into decisions leaders act on. You also keep the system governed, compliant, audit-ready and trusted.

This is not a traditional recruiting-operations or systems-administration role. You work as part of the TA Leadership team to decide where work should be eliminated, simplified, standardized, automated or delivered at scale, and you work across HR Technology, Legal, Analytics, Finance, operations, vendors and scalable delivery partners to make it stick.

This is an in-person role at Domino's World Resource Center based in Ann Arbor, MI.

What You'll Do

Talent Acquisition Operations

• Support the consistent execution of enterprise recruiting operations across corporate, supply chain, international, and store hiring.
• Maintain core recruiting workflows, templates, documentation, tools, service standards and operating procedures and ensure they are organized and easy to locate and use.
• Partner with recruiters, coordinators and TA leaders to identify operational barriers, clarify roles and improve handoffs across the hiring lifecycle.
• Monitor process adoption and data discipline, identify recurring issues and coordinate corrective actions.
• Support vendor, contract, access, system and operational administration activities as assigned.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

• Map the current-state internal, external, and contract recruiting processes from talent demand through onboarding handoff and find friction, duplication, unnecessary handoffs and administrative work.
• Redesign workflows to eliminate, simplify, standardize or automate work and to improve speed, quality, consistency and stakeholder experience.
• Partner with TA leadership to define roles, decision rights, handoffs, controls and service levels across TA and partner teams.
• Develop or enhance SOPs, playbooks, checklists, job aids and change materials that make improved processes sustainable.
• Measure the impact of process changes and recommend refinements based on feedback, operational data and business outcomes.
• Identify opportunities to improve the quality of recruiter and hiring-manager interactions.
• Keep a prioritized improvement roadmap ranked by business impact, recruiter capacity, candidate experience and process performance.

Enable Technology, Automation, & Responsible AI

• Own the business processes behind the TA technology ecosystem (applicant tracking, CRM, sourcing, interview and onboarding tools) and partner with technology teams to connect systems, workflows and data into one coherent experience.
• Drive adoption and optimization of the tools we already own; find existing functionality that can replace manual work, disconnected tools or unnecessary third-party solutions.
• Turn recruiter, candidate and hiring-manager needs into clear business, system and reporting requirements, and partner with HR Technology on enhancements, integrations, user acceptance testing and release readiness.
• Build and maintain the TA automation and AI roadmap, prioritized by business value, feasibility, risk and user experience.
• Partner with Legal to set standards and controls for responsible AI in hiring, keep human accountability for hiring, offer and adverse decisions, and monitor for adverse impact.
• Pilot new capabilities, measure results, scale what improves productivity, quality or experience, and retire what does not.

Compliance, Governance & Quality Assurance

• Own TA process standards, SOPs, playbooks, requisition taxonomy and process documentation, and keep them current and easy to find.
• Run governance for changes to process, technology, automation and AI, including process ownership, decision rights, definitions, change logs and control documentation.
• Define service expectations, quality standards, controls and escalation paths across TA and scalable delivery partners.
• Review requisition, candidate, disposition, offer and hiring data on a routine basis; document findings and drive remediation.
• Ensure the process meets EEO, OFCCP, pay transparency, background check, I-9 and data privacy requirements, plus local rules, with recordkeeping and audit readiness maintained.
• Embed structured, bias-aware practices such as standardized questions, scorecards and calibration, and escalate material data, process or compliance risks with practical recommendations.

Deliver Analytics, Scorecards, & Insights

• Design and own the recruiter scorecard and a focused set of KPIs, with clear definitions, targets and owners, covering speed, quality, experience, efficiency and process compliance (for example time to fill, offer acceptance, quality of hire, requisition load, candidate and hiring-manager satisfaction).
• Publish results on a regular cadence, review performance with TA leadership, and escalate sustained gaps.
• Own the recurring production, quality review and retirement of TA reports and dashboards.
• Maintain common metric definitions, calculation logic and data dictionaries for recruiting and internal mobility, and reconcile sources so the numbers can be trusted.
• Analyze funnel performance, cycle time, conversion, source effectiveness, offer outcomes, recruiter workload, quality of hire, hiring manager experience, and candidate experience.
• Run a recurring operating review that surfaces trends, bottlenecks, root causes and recommended actions, not just charts.
• Quantify the capacity, cost, quality or experience impact of each improvement, and show whether changes are removing work from recruiters and hiring leaders.
• Partner with TA leaders and HR Technology to define and refine reporting needs and prioritize enhancements.

Internal Mobility Insights & Talent Intelligence

• Partner with recruiters and TA leaders to frame research questions, scope talent-mapping projects and keep reusable talent maps, research libraries and market insight current.
• Maintain reporting on internal applicants, internal fills, movement patterns and opportunity flow, with consistent definitions and governance.
• Analyze barriers and patterns in internal movement and recommend fact-based improvements to workflows, role clarity, communications and measurement.
• Connect internal talent insight with external market intelligence to inform build, buy, borrow and develop discussions and workforce planning.

Stakeholder Partnership, Change Leadership, & Capability Building

• Be the connection point among TA, HR Technology, Legal, Analytics, Finance, operations, vendors and scalable delivery partners, and resolve gaps where work or decisions fall between teams.
• Lead cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through design, implementation, adoption and measurement, with clear status, risks, dependencies and decisions.
• Translate between business needs and technical requirements so solutions address the underlying problem.
• Build feedback loops with recruiters, hiring managers, field operators and candidates, and use them to improve candidate and hiring-manager experience.
• Develop communications, training and adoption plans, and train and certify recruiters, coordinators, hiring managers and operators on standard work and tools.
• Hold vendors and delivery partners to agreed service levels and measure the value they deliver.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
• 5+ years in Talent Acquisition operations, recruiting transformation, HR process improvement, HR technology, recruiting analytics or a related field, including 2+ years owning or redesigning an end-to-end process.
• Experience implementing or optimizing recruiting technology (applicant tracking, CRM, sourcing or interview tools), digital workflows or automation.
• Strong analytical skills: validate data, find patterns, diagnose root causes and turn findings into recommendations. Advanced Excel, and experience building metrics, dashboards and data documentation in a tool such as Power BI.
• Working knowledge of recruiting compliance, data privacy, recordkeeping and quality assurance.

jobs.title: Marketing Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Title: Marketing Automation Engineer (Braze)

Build the infrastructure powering the future of restaurant payments

At inKind, we’re building a new way to drive customers to restaurants. We power the relationship between millions of users and thousands of restaurants.

We are looking for a Marketing Automation Engineer at inKind who can optimize the consumer relationship with a mix of marketing best-practices, strong understanding of data flow, and the ability to translate it to genuine personalization while technically executing on them at scale. You’ll collaborate closely with business and marketing teams to build systems that directly impact the restaurants and users who rely on inKind.

As a Marketing Automation Engineer at inKind, you will be responsible for implementing marketing campaigns. You will receive creative briefs and project plans, and be responsible for drafting technical implementation docs and building them. Much of this building will be done dashboard-side in Braze Canvases. Optimizing platform usage, data-based triggering, and understanding user journeys are all key aspects of this role.

Our team has a builder-first mindset, leveraging modern Consumer Engagement Platform (CEP) tools such as Braze and data warehouses like Snowflake, to power rich datasets of user information to use for personalization and customer lifecycle management. We are looking for  someone who can turn that data into dynamic, well-timed, high-relevance communication across email, SMS, and push — at scale. This role would have the opportunity to create genuine personalization engines using best-in-class tooling and data models.

What You’ll Work On

Platform Execution

• Architect and build complex journey flows - multi-branch, behavior-triggered, time-delayed - that respond dynamically to what users do in the app

• Create sophisticated email, SMS, and push templates using dynamic templating (in Liquid): conditional content blocks, personalized variables, abort conditions, and live data pulls

• Manage subscription and compliance workflows for SMS opt-in/opt-out, email unsubscribe, and push permission states and follow TCR regulations

• QA (Verify) every campaign before launch and own responsibility post-launch: audience spot-checks, template rendering validation, link tracking, SMS encoding, and cross-client email rendering

• Translate high-level marketing briefs into well-defined audience definitions, validating logic against actual user data before launch

• Understand CEP best practices to inform cadence of messaging, frequency capping, and prioritizing of marketing communications across lifecycle and ad-hoc campaigns

Technical Rigor

• Write, understand, and document Liquid code to build dynamic content blocks

• Query our data warehouse (Snowflake) using SQL or review API payloads to validate that events and attributes match expected values, QA before launch, as well as triage potential issues.

• Use platform-native diagnostic tools (message logs, user lookup, event streams) to diagnose issues without needing an engineer to triage alongside you

• Understand technical limitations of campaigns and recommend well-scoped solutions

Segmentation & Personalization

• Build precise, multi-condition audience segments using a full range of segmentation capabilities

• Maintain a clean, documented segment library — consolidating redundant definitions and flagging when underlying data changes affect targeting

• Partner with the cross-functional teams to define and action on lifecycle stages (active, lapsing, high-value, etc.) and build reusable and trackable segments that reflect those definitions reliably

• Build and maintain a reusable component library: shared content blocks, brand-compliant modules, and snippet logic the team can use without rebuilding from scratch

Minimum Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience with a major CEP/CRM or marketing automation platform (Braze, Shopify, Iterable, Klaviyo, or equivalent)

• 2+ years of experience with Braze

• Deep expertise in journey/canvas building — multi-step, behavior-triggered flows with branching logic, delays, and channel mixing

• Dynamic templating skills: conditional blocks, variable logic, and live data integrations

• Experience with audience segmentation using behavioral data, custom attributes, and event properties

• Solid understanding of contact data models — user profiles, identified vs. anonymous users, subscription and consent management

• Ability to read API responses and event payloads to self-diagnose data issues without engineering support

• Liquid code proficiency

• Deep understanding of email deliverability fundamentals: list hygiene, bounce handling, unsubscribe management, and sender reputation

• Understanding of email domains/behavior and record management

• SMS compliance knowledge: opt-in/opt-out mechanics, quiet hours, carrier filtering, and message encoding

• Familiarity with TCR rules and regulations

Preferred Qualifications

• SQL proficiency and experience working with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery) for CRM analytics or audience building

• Background in consumer apps, marketplaces, or loyalty/rewards programs where lifecycle marketing directly drives repeat behavior

• Familiarity with how CRM data flows from a backend application via REST API or event streaming

• Experience with in-app messaging, content cards, or push notification strategy beyond transactional sends

Some of Our Benefits

• Generous PTO and company holiday policy + company-paid Short Term Disability

• 100% employer-covered health and dental insurance; higher-tier and dependent coverage options available

• Vision plan available at employee cost

• Child care benefits and generous parental leave

• Dog-friendly Austin office with great views of downtown

• Daily lunches and snacks for in-office team members

Who we are:

inKind connects passionate diners with exceptional restaurants across the country. inKind partners with thousands of restaurants and has millions of users who want to discover great places, dine confidently, and earn meaningful rewards.

Through the inKind app, guests earn 20% back every time they dine, turning everyday meals into something more rewarding. From celebrated restaurant groups like José Andres and Michael Mina to beloved neighborhood favorites, inKind helps diners explore the best restaurants in town while supporting the restaurants and chefs who shape how their cities eat.

Rooted in hospitality and built on a win-win philosophy, inKind exists to help great restaurants thrive while inspiring guests to dine out more often. Every meal creates value on both sides of the table, empowering diners to savor more while strengthening the restaurant community.

inKind is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that diversity is vital to inKind's ability to provide our clients with the best recommendations and are committed to fostering a varied and inclusive work environment. Your race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected category have no bearing on our hiring decisions.

By submitting this application, you acknowledge that inKind Cards, Inc. may share the information you provide with trusted third-party service providers, including fraud detection and application processing partners, to evaluate your application and ensure the integrity of our hiring process. Your information will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For California residents and others with applicable rights, please review our privacy notice for information about your rights regarding your personal data.

jobs.title: M&A Supplier Quality Development Leader (Onsite)
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As the Global M&A Supplier Quality Development Leader, you will drive supplier quality excellence and performance across key international and domestic regions to enable Axon's strategic growth. In this pivotal role, you will lead high-impact supplier qualification, new product introduction (NPI) readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives across complex hardware and sensor product lines. This role provides an exciting opportunity to scale global supply chain resilience, shape quality architecture, and mentor cross-functional partners in an innovative environment.

What You’ll Do

Location: Onsite at our Scottsdale, AZ office with 30-40% travel to Germany, Virginia, and Ohio
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Supplier Quality
Direct Reports: None

• Own supplier quality performance across multiple product lines (hardware, sensors, AI-enabled systems, and accessories) by driving performance metrics (PPM, yield, delivery, COPQ) and establishing clear accountability and continuous improvement roadmaps.

• Lead supplier qualification, onboarding, process validation (PPAP), FIRST Article Inspection (FAIR) execution, and capability assessments for new and existing suppliers.

• Serve as the supplier quality lead for New Product Introduction (NPI) programs from concept through production ramp, providing critical feedback on capabilities, tolerances, and design for manufacturability (DFx).

• Enhance and audit supplier quality systems (including IQC, IPQC, OQC, SPC, and risk management control plans) while promoting advanced quality methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, and digital quality tools.

• Lead complex root cause investigations and corrective actions (SCARs, 8D, NCMRs), acting as the primary escalation point to mitigate supplier risks to production and customer experience.

• Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program Management to align sourcing decisions, global manufacturing transitions, dual sourcing strategies, and long-term capacity planning.

• Contribute to global supplier segmentation, strategic development, and supply chain resiliency initiatives supporting product transfers and regional expansions.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or a related field).

• 5+ years of experience in Supplier Quality, manufacturing processes, NPI ramps, and product development lifecycles across global regions (U.S., Europe, Asia).

• Strong technical proficiency with PPAP, APQP, DFx, SPC, GD&T, audit methodologies, and electromechanical/electronics system products.

• Proven ability to operate independently, lead cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority, drive strategic long-term outcomes, and solve complex ambiguous problems.

• Relevant certifications such as Six Sigma Black Belt or Lead Auditor are preferred.

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Medical, Dental, Vision plans

• Fitness Programs and Emotional & Mental Wellness support

• Learning & Development programs and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• And yes, we have snacks in our offices

*Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.*

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.

Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at axongreenhousesupport@axon.com or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

Axon’s mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon’s impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.

We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We’re committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email recruitingops@axon.com.  Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.

Phishing alert:  Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process.  All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers.  If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not @axon.com, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.
