jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering, New Programs
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




FORWARD DEPLOYED AT HADRIAN

We embed Forward Deployed teams on Hadrian’s largest and most critical programs with the U.S. Government, the Armed Forces, and major defense primes. The Forward Deployed team works alongside program and engineering teams, from scoping to execution.

 

Forward Deployed adapts our product to fulfill customer needs. Sometimes that involves extending Opus, Hadrian’s AI-driven manufacturing autonomy platform; other times, it involves taking a new product from 0 to 1 to make a program successful. Everything the Forward Deployed team learns working on the front lines with our customers is fed back to our engineering teams to improve Hadrian’s product for all customers.

 

Recent projects have included establishing Factories-as-a-Service (FaaS) for the Armed Forces and several major primes, expanding Opus into new manufacturing sectors such as energetics, and growing a product line originally developed for a single program into a programs valued at over $1b.

 

The Role

As Director, you lead the Forward Deployed team across one or more programs and are responsible for their technical outcomes. You will oversee the technical aspects of a program larger than most startups ever experience, working directly with government representatives, customers, and Hadrian’s leadership teams.

The team is in its early stages, and the scope is rapidly expanding with Hadrian. Directors will play a key role in scaling the Forward Deployed team and leading multi-billion-dollar programs.

 - Own the technical roadmap and delivery. Take the program from the first ambiguous conversation to running in production; decide what Opus covers, what gets built, and what we say no to; and hold the team to a very high execution bar. The program hits rate, quality, schedule, and cost, in part because the software and systems behind it work; you own that part.

 - Bring program learnings to platform teams. Share program learnings at Hadrian to improve the product for all customers and decide which Forward Deployed products should become part of Opus.

 - Own the executive relationship on the technical side. Be the primary technical contact for customer program leadership, government stakeholders, and prime partners. Run technical reviews, have the hard conversations about scope and schedule yourself, and make the call when scope, schedule, and platform leverage pull against each other and the commercial stakes are real.

 - Build and lead the team. Hire and grow the engineers, product managers, and designers on your program. You set the standard for how they work, and they bring you their hardest scoping calls.

 - Stay hands-on. Early in a program, that can mean building the v0 yourself. Later, it means reviewing what your team ships closely enough to ensure it meets Hadrian’s quality bar.



What We're Looking For

 - Highly commercial technical leaders with excellent product judgment.

 - You have a demonstrated history leading engineering and product teams and scaling a product from zero to one.

 - You are strong with external and internal executives. You have owned senior customer relationships and made commitments on behalf of a company that you then had to deliver on.

 - You have product taste. You know what’s worth building and what good looks like for the user, and you’ve shipped end-to-end enough times to back that up.

 - You are hands-on technical. You are just as comfortable supporting your team with architecture and review as you are taking your own idea from design to delivery.

 - You are AI-native and relentless about it. You use AI to compress everything from discovery to execution, you can show us concretely how it already makes you multiples faster, and you’ve rebuilt how your whole team works around it.

 - You have hired builders into ambiguous roles and got them productive fast.

 - You are driven by the mission and the tempo. Rebuilding the industrial base matters to you, and you want to deliver at the pace our customers need.

 

What Will Set You Apart

 - Founder or founding-team experience, especially if you managed customer relationships and business decisions while still building.

 - Background in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or anywhere hardware, software, and operations intersect.

 - Forward-deployed or solutions leadership at a product company.


BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Hadrian does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, marital status, mental status, physical disability or any other legally protected status. When necessary, the Company also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled candidates and employees, including for candidates or employees who are disabled by pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions.

This role works closely with G&A leaders to set a people strategy that supports how the business runs and scales and translates it into action across talent, engagement, development, and retention. What You’ll Do

The Andrologist reflects the mission, vision, and values of Northwestern Memorial HealthCare, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Andrologist is primarily responsible for performing andrology tests and procedures, assuring quality assurance, coordinating patient appointments, documenting and interpreting as appropriate test results, reporting results in a timely fashion, ordering supplies and maintaining cryopreservation tank. This position may also be called upon to assist with other responsibilities, as needed.

Responsibilities:

• Perform andrology laboratory tests and procedures including semen analyses, strict morphology, antisperm antibody assay and semen cultures. Perform semen, epididymal fluid and testicular tissue processing, including cryopreservation. Perform quality assurance procedures.
• Coordinates the scheduling of patient appointments for the above tests and procedures. Answer patient queries for appointment in timely manner.
• Document test results with interpretation as appropriate and deliver results to the ordering physician and laboratory director in a timely fashion. Maintain accurate records with duplicate records in a safe, secure place. Maintain strict confidentiality regarding patient information.
• Assist with the intraoperative evaluation of reproductive tissue (i.e., epididymal fluid, testicular tissue), subsequent processing and cryopreservation of this tissue in a timely fashion.
• Order supplies and equipment necessary for performing duties. This includes ensuring that liquid nitrogen tanks supplying the cryopreservation tanks are adequately filled and in good working order.
• Maintain cryopreservation tanks, ensure that they remain appropriately filled and in good working order. Trouble-shoot any potential problems affecting these units. Address alarm status/problem conditions in a timely fashion and take prompt measures to address mechanical, security or other issues potentially impacting the specimens. Maintain neat and orderly records regarding storage of above specimens.
• Notify the laboratory director of patient or physician inquiries for laboratory services in a timely fashion. Many of these inquiries involve oncology patients in acute need of cryopreservation services. Providing this service to these patients in a high priority due to acute need for these procedures.
• Assist departmental staff in the development and execution of research projects (clinical and basic science) that pertain to this field.

Required

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience
• Zero (0) to two (2) years’ experience in a relevant role.
• Previous experience in lab work

The right fit looks like this

You're comfortable navigating complexity and don't wait for perfect information to move forward. You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and expect the same in return.

• Support neighborhood planning, public involvement and outreach efforts, and project development initiatives aimed at improving air quality and reducing congestion, pollution, and the impact of vehicles in urban areas.
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop strategic project proposals, engage stakeholders, and present findings to advisory boards and elected officials, contributing to the growth of planning services and client trust.
• Provide technical leadership and oversight for outreach efforts, project development initiatives, and strategic planning aimed at improving air quality, reducing congestion, and mitigating environmental impacts, with responsibility for interpreting, organizing, and executing complex assignments.
• Advise on proposal strategies, engage stakeholders, and present findings to senior leaders and advisory boards, contributing to the growth of planning services and client trust through peer reviews, technical training, and mentoring of less experienced staff.
• Conduct peer reviews and share knowledge through internal technical presentations and standards development.
• Complex technical responsibility to interpret, organize, execute, and coordinate assignments.
• Serve as lead verifier on projects that satisfy the client's scope of services and expectations.
• Make day-to-day decisions for a technical team or small to mid-size client.

• May telecommute up to 3 days a week.

Alternatively, the Employer will accept a Master's degree in Urban Planning, Transportation Planning, Environmental Planning and Policy, Environmental Engineering, or a related field of study and 6 years of experience as a Transportation Planner, Environmental Planner, or a related occupation.

• Experience with analytical processes and developing deliverables using GIS software such as ArcMap, ArcPro, and ArcGIS Online;
• Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign;
• Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Project;
• Complex understanding of NEPA and CEQA documentation and environmental clearance;
• Formulate comprehensive institutional funding strategies and draft formal grant applications and financial proposals to federal and state agencies;
• Experience facilitating cross-sector project presentations to public sector agencies, private sector entities, and elected officials;
• Data analytics and automation of transportation datasets using Python and SQL, and dashboarding using Power BI;
• Analyze and interpret travel demand modeling and transit service planning into summary documents and presentations; and
• Develop custom data analysis routines in Python, R, & C++.

And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

• Clear communication and presentation skills with senior stakeholders

• Experience partnering with sales teams to align on strategy and build pipeline

• Adept at using Marketo, Salesforce, and Claude; skilled at workflow design and change management

• Experience at high-growth technology companies

• Curiosity, resilience, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity and change

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or a related field

• Experience building or deploying AI agents, skills, or automations (for example, Claude, agent frameworks, or marketing automation AI features) in a marketing context

• Experience developing campaign playbooks and frameworks that help regional teams localize and execute with autonomy

• MBA or equivalent experience

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. jobs.title: Mobile Phlebotomist (Binghamton, NY)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Sprinter Health, our mission is to reimagine how people access care by bringing high quality care directly into the home.

Using the same technology that powers leading marketplace platforms, we deliver care where people are, especially those who need it most.

We’ve supported millions of patients across 22 states and consistently maintained a 90+ NPS, reflecting the quality and experience we strive to deliver every day.

Our clinical teams are at the center of making healthcare more accessible, connected, and personal.



Where patient experience isn’t a metric. It’s a standard.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Sprinter, you’ll bring healthcare directly to patients in the comfort of their homes. You’ll spend your day on the road providing a variety of preventative and diagnostic services, including blood draws, vitals, height and weight assessments, urine collection, support with Annual Wellness Visits, and more.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys independence, connecting with patients, and a workday that looks different from a traditional clinic setting.

What We Offer

 - Guaranteed daily hours

 - National Mileage reimbursement, currently $0.76/mile reimbursement starting at mile 31

 - Company paid healthcare premiums

 - 100% 401(k) contribution of 3%

 - Company provided equipment including iPhone, iPad, scrubs, and supplies


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Life as a Sprinter starts before the first patient visit. Your car becomes both your office and your lab on the go, so preparation and organization are everything.

 - Prepare for your day by reviewing your schedule and ensuring you have the proper supplies and PPE.

 - Travel to patients’ homes throughout your assigned service area.

 - Provide scheduled services including blood draws, vitals, height and weight measurements, urine collection, support with Annual Wellness Visits, and other preventative and diagnostic services.

 - Use your expert phlebotomy skills to make blood draws as comfortable as possible for each patient.

 - Create a warm, welcoming, and professional experience in every patient’s home.

 - Accurately document each patient visit using Sprinter technology.

 - Properly label, handle, and transport specimens for lab drop off or shipment.

 - Manage your time, supplies, and schedule independently as you move from patient to patient throughout the day.


SOUND LIKE YOU?


MASTER OF YOUR CRAFT

 - Do you have exceptional blood draw skills?

 - Have you been the “go to” for hard sticks?

 - Are you confident in drawing blood from a wide range of patients?

 - Are you comfortable learning and performing additional clinical services?


ROAD WARRIOR

 - Do you enjoy a change of scenery during your workday?

 - Are you comfortable spending a significant portion of your day on the road?

 - Are you willing to travel an hour or more to visit patients?

 - Can you comfortably drive before 7:00 a.m. when your first patient is scheduled at 7:00 a.m.?


PATIENT FOCUSED

 - Are you passionate about helping others?

 - Are you kind, empathetic, and an effective communicator?

 - Do you enjoy meeting new people and creating a great patient experience?


SEEN IT ALL BEFORE

 - Are you comfortable providing care in a variety of home environments, recognizing that each patient’s living conditions and standards may be different from your own?

 - Can you remain calm, adaptable, and professional when faced with challenging or unexpected situations?


COMMITTED TO EXCELLENCE

 - Do you pride yourself on being reliable, dependable, and trustworthy?

 - Are you solution oriented and able to think critically when challenges arise?

 - Is your mode of transportation as reliable as you are?


TECH PROFICIENT

 - Are you proficient using Apple iPhones and iPads beyond calling and texting?

 - Are you comfortable navigating apps, electronic health records, telehealth platforms, and other digital tools?

 - Can you confidently learn and navigate new technology independently?

If you’re nodding yes, you’re off to a great start. Here are a few more things you’ll need to be successful as a Sprinter.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Strong phlebotomy skills, including experience with challenging sticks

 - Patient facing healthcare experience as a Phlebotomist, Medical Assistant (MA), Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN), or Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) in home preferred

 - Current BLS certification

 - Valid driver’s license, current auto insurance, and personal, reliable vehicle

 - Availability Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.

 - Ability to drive before 7:00 a.m. to arrive at your first scheduled patient on time

 - Proficiency using Apple iPhones and iPads

 - Ability to meet applicable state specific certification or licensing requirements


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs.

 - Ability to spend prolonged periods driving between patient appointments

 - Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and carry medical supplies and equipment

 - Ability to safely navigate a variety of patient home environments, including locations with stairs

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Test and Evaluation team at Anduril works across the entire spectrum of products and business lines, as well as all flight operations and test range management. Our team conducts full system level development testing, new production acceptance testing, sub-component qualification testing and much more. In short, if it involves test, we support it. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded this a fantastic opportunity.

This position will be filled by a highly motivated Senior Test Pilot with a passion for developmental flight test and improving system capabilities. You will RC fly Group 3, fixed wing, runway dependent, aircraft carrying various developmental payloads. You will work heavily with program leadership and a wide spectrum of cross-departments to help assist the team focused on solving hard problems and changing the industry forever. This role will be responsible for assisting with planning, coordination, execution and reporting on all facets of the flight test program.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Maintain a high degree of professionalism including punctuality and culpability.

• Prepare mission cards and assist in planning the flight missions to meet Engineering requirements.

• Act as a safety pilot of a semi autonomous remote piloted target aircraft by means of a Futaba RC controller.

• Observing and directing crew/team members in their positions and actions to maintain a safe posture at all times.

• Perform duties as Pilot in Command during flight operations and manage the responsibilities associated with that position.

• Cross communicate with multiple teams, internal and external to Anduril, including Senior Leadership or Customers.

• Travel on short notice to fulfill operational needs if and when those needs arise.

• Maintain all required training and certifications required to perform your job, both internal and external such as FAA certifications.

• Provide training and professional developmental support to coworkers under the guidelines of Anduril as needed.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Ability to proficiently and safely fly and maintain Group 3 RC Aircraft.

• Willing to travel as required.

• Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

• Proficient with computer use (standard browser, word processing applications).

• Willing to be multi-capable. Which shall include some electronics troubleshooting and repair.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a fast paced, challenging work environment.

• Part 61 pilot license with Commercial Rating.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Instrument rating.

• 3 years of developmental test experience.

• 10 years RC experience.

US Salary Range

$147,000—$196,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Space Mission Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Space Mission Software Engineer is responsible for Varda's critical ground segment software, and the platform it runs on which enables spacecraft operations. We operate at the intersection of telemetry and commanding, data acquisition and distribution, mission control interfaces, simulation and test automation, with reliable deployment across lab, test range, and mission operations environments. You'll work hands-on with flight software, avionics, RF/ground systems, and mission ops.

Responsibilities

• Own Ground Segment Services: Develop and maintain high-reliability services for telemetry ingestion, scaling, distribution, and commanding. Ensure deterministic behavior for real-time operations and post-flight analysis.

• Mission Control Interfaces: Deliver operator-grade UIs and dashboards that optimize "ops time" and reduce cognitive load across integration, test, and on-orbit operations phases.

• Simulation and Test Automation: Build tools to run flight-software simulations, device emulators, and scenario-based automated tests - enabling fast, safe iteration for avionics, GNC, and operations teams.

• Build the Mission Platform: Design, implement, and productionize software for mission and ground software teams. Standardize CI/CD pipelines, artifact management, service templates, infrastructure-as-code, simulation and hardware-in-the-loop frameworks, test harnesses, and observability - all delivered as self-service tooling.

• Deployments Across Environments: Create robust deployment patterns for lab benches, test stands, and mission networks. Implement safe rollout/rollback strategies and air-gapped or limited-connectivity deployment approaches.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.

• 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.

• Expertise with development in Python, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.

• Have strong systems fundamentals: concurrency, networking, performance, reliability.

• Experience building real-time data acquisition, scaling, and distribution services - low-latency messaging, time-series and relational stores.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD, dependency/build systems, and infrastructure-as-code.

• End-to-end observability experience: logging, metrics, tracing.

• Docker/Kubernetes; release management, phased rollouts, and operational readiness for controlled networks.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Proficiency in C++, Ansible, and/or NiceGUI.

• Experience with DAQ and closed-loop control (lab/test control environments).

• Prior work on CI/testing/simulation/data tools integrated with flight software teams.

• Experience with requirements, test, and certification artifacts from safety-critical or certified workflows.

• Knowledge of ground systems standards; security in mission networks.

• Experience building mission-grade UIs with structured command workflows, alarming, and situational awareness.

jobs.title: Product Management Intern, Agentic AI
jobs.description:
ABOUT PARSPEC

Founded in 2021, Parspec is revolutionizing the materials supply chain for the $13 trillion USD construction industry by digitizing and organizing the industry's product data. Our proprietary AI technology maintains a current and comprehensive catalogue of millions of products, enabling our customers to instantly identify the products that best meet their needs. Trusted by top designers, builders, distributors, manufacturers, and sales agents, and backed by leading venture investors, Parspec is paving the way for a more innovative, connected, and sustainable future in construction.

Join us in building transformative technology that reshapes one of the world's oldest and largest industries.




THE OPPORTUNITY

What does it take to turn an AI agent into a product customers trust and pay for? That question sits at the heart of this internship.

We are looking for an intern to work alongside Parspec's product leadership on our AI quoting agent, the product at the center of how distributors and rep agencies build quotes. You will own a piece of it end to end, from customer discovery through an engineering-ready product spec, and help shape the business model behind it. Quoting is the beating heart of our customers' business. It is also messy, manual, and full of judgment calls, which is exactly what makes it both a hard and a valuable problem for an AI agent to take on.

This is not a shadowing role. You will talk to real customers, write requirements that engineers build against, and build prototypes. If you see yourself becoming an AI product leader or founding a company someday, this is a chance to work on the two problems that define AI product management right now: making agents reliable and making them commercially viable.




WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE AND KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Define what to build

 - Interview distributor and rep agency users to understand how quotes get built today, step by step, including the workarounds and judgment calls that never show up in a process diagram

 - Map the quoting workflow end to end and identify where an AI agent delivers the most value, and where human judgment needs to stay in the loop

 - Turn what you learn into a clear, prioritized view of what the agent should do next, backed by customer evidence rather than intuition

Prototype and validate

 - Build working prototypes to test agent workflows with real users before engineering commits to a full build

 - Translate customer needs into product requirements and an engineering-ready spec for your piece of the agent

 - Define the success metrics that tell us the agent is actually working: accuracy, time saved, trust, and adoption

 - Set the release criteria the agent must meet before it reaches customers, including how we evaluate reliability on real-world quoting scenarios

Shape AI pricing

 - Analyze the value the agent creates for customers, how usage actually behaves, and what it costs us to serve

 - Study how other AI products charge for agentic work, from seats to usage to outcomes, and what those models would mean for our customers and our margins

 - Recommend how Parspec should charge for AI-powered work, with the analysis to back it up, and present it to leadership




WHY THIS MATTERS

Every software company is racing to put AI agents in front of customers. Very few have figured out the two things that actually matter: making the agent reliable enough that customers trust it with real work, and pricing it so the business works. Parspec is live in the market with AI doing real quoting work for real customers, which means these are not thought experiments here. The quality bar you set shapes what customers experience, and the pricing model you recommend shapes how the company grows. Few internships put you that close to the decisions that matter.




WHO YOU ARE

You are curious about how products get built and sold. You like talking to users as much as you like working through data, and you can hold both the customer's reality and the business model in your head at the same time. You write clearly, you ask sharp questions, and you are comfortable forming a view on a problem nobody has fully solved yet. You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and go deep into a messy workflow to map complex processes and identify how AI can enhance them. You do not need to be an AI engineer, but you need to be genuinely curious about how AI agents work, what makes them fail, and what makes people trust them.




MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS

 - Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree (undergraduate or graduate) in Business, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field

 - Strong analytical skills, including comfort working through usage data, unit economics, and pricing trade-offs

 - Structured problem-solving ability: you can break an ambiguous question down into an answerable workplan

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to run a customer interview and write a spec an engineer can build from

 - A real ownership mentality: you have taken something from question to shipped result without being managed through it

 - Genuine interest in AI products: you have used them seriously, formed opinions on what works and what does not, and can articulate why




PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Prior professional experience in product management, consulting, software engineering, or a startup operating role

 - Hands-on experience building with or evaluating LLMs and AI agents, even on personal projects

 - Exposure to B2B SaaS business models, pricing and packaging work, or product discovery methods

 - Interest in construction, building materials, industrial distribution, or vertical SaaS businesses

 - Experience in fast-paced or early-stage startup environments



WHAT WE OFFER

 - Direct, sustained working exposure to Parspec's product leadership

 - Ownership of a live piece of an AI product that real customers use, with a spec and a pricing recommendation the company acts on

 - Hands-on experience with the two defining challenges of AI product management: making agents reliable and making them commercially viable

 - A strong foundation and a credible story for future roles in AI product management, product leadership, or founding

 - Flexible hybrid work environment




JOIN US AND LEAD THE TRANSFORMATION!

At Parspec, we recognize that traditional job descriptions don't always capture the full range of your unique abilities, and that's perfectly okay. You may not meet every requirement, but if you bring a mix of experiences, fresh perspectives, and a passion that aligns with our mission, we want to hear from you!


The Parspec team believes that varied backgrounds drive better outcomes and fuel innovation. We are a team of self-starters who lead from every seat. We think big, set a standard of excellence, and are committed to diversity and a discrimination-free workplace. We welcome applicants from all walks of life to join us and help shape the future of our industry.

Where You Will Work

Our corporate office is located in the Denver Tech Center. This position is based in-office five days per week and supports operational processes across our portfolio.

What We Offer

AIR offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to reward performance and support your success, including:

• $27.00 - $30.00 per hour
• 25% rent discount at eligible AIR Communities properties
• Professional development and career growth opportunities
• Additional benefits listed below

What You Will Do

• Review and approve applicant files, lease documentation, and business requests.
• Evaluate screening overrides, pricing adjustments, and ledger corrections.
• Process applicant deposit refunds within established guidelines.
• Ensure compliance with operational policies and procedures.
• Partner with Revenue Management, Field Support, Regional Property Managers, and other stakeholders to support business operations.

Who You Are

• Analytical, organized, and detail-oriented.

jobs.title: Associate Electrical, Instrumentation & Controls Engineer - Water Technologies
jobs.description:
Job Summary

As part of Electrical, Instrumentation & Controls (EI&C) Engineering, you will work collaboratively with a

cross-functional engineering team executing custom project designs, meeting customer expectations,

quality, schedule, budget and ensuring project risks are mitigated. The individual chosen for this role will

be developed and trained in all aspects of the EI&C design for a wide range of water technologies. This

role will include leading the design effort for Instrumentation, Electrical, Controls and Programming,

supporting our production facilities, participating in customer facing factory acceptance tests and

assisting through commissioning.

Key Characteristics

• Ability to collaborate cross-functional project team discussions and client meetings.
• Proven ability to develop and follow procedures and standards, while extrapolating new concepts from established standards.
• Knowledge of and/or demonstrated ability to learn equipment and processes related to Veolia products and systems.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Read, interpret and comment on engineering documents, including P&IDs, GAs, process design guidelines, return of experience, and engineering best practices guides.
• Perform required calculations and select the appropriate instrumentation for water treatment facilities as well as all supporting documentation (instrument lists, termination drawings, instrument datasheets, etc.).
• Design the complete detailed electrical design for water treatment facilities (single line diagrams, load lists, I/O lists, network architectures, panel design and schematics). Design the complete detailed process control documents (Control Philosophy, Control Logic & Sequence Charts) for plant operation, for assigned projects.
• Perform FAT’s, CVT’s and Commissioning support as required.
• Engage in the development of automation deliverables including test plans, programs, and network design.
• Manage budget, scope, schedule and proactively report risks and opportunities to project teams.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Excellent problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills (including coordinating, reporting, documentation, and presentations).
• Strong focus on customer relationships (external/internal). Understands balance between customer and Veolia teams.

Education & Experience

Required:

• Bachelor Degree in Engineering or equivalent from an accredited University or College.
• Valid passport and driver’s license.

Preferred:

• Understanding of hydraulics, water chemistry and fundamentals of fluid mechanics.
• Knowledge of and/or demonstrated ability to learn equipment and processes related to Veolia WTS products and systems.
• Experience with control systems, Programmable Logic Controllers, HMI and SCADA design and programming.
• Basic technical knowledge in the field of industrial control systems.
• Understanding of Low Voltage Power Distribution System design.
• Professional Engineer or EIT designation.

Working Conditions

• Occasional travel up to 25% for commissioning support, client meetings, FAT’s, customer site visits and/or visits to other Veolia offices/production facilities

At Veolia, we realize diverse teams make smarter decisions, deliver better results, and build stronger communities. We’re an organization that champions diversity and inclusion at every rung of the ladder and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

To ensure transparency and compliance with employment laws, we provide the following details regarding this position:

Compensation: The compensation range is tied to the market for similarly benchmarked roles. The range is not an absolute, but a guide, and offers will be based on the individual candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience and market conditions, as well as internal peer equity. Depending upon all the preceding considerations for the final selected individual candidate, the offer may be lower or higher than the stated range: $75,000 - $95,000 USD annually.

Benefits:

• Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance Starting Day 1!
• Life Insurance
• Paid Time Off
• Paid Holidays
• Parental Leave
• 401(k) Plan
• Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
• AD&D Insurance
• Disability Insurance
• Tuition Reimbursement

Artificial Intelligence (AI) Disclosure: We do not use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, or select applicants for this position.

Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Veolia does not accept unsolicited resumes from external recruiting firms. All vendors must have a current and fully executed MSA on file before submitting candidates. Any unsolicited resumes and candidate profiles will be deemed the property of the company and no fee will be due.

As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination.

jobs.title: Procurement Administrator
jobs.description:
Procurement Administrator

About Us:

BlackSky is a real-time intelligence company. We own and operate the world's most advanced space-based intelligence platform and provide customers satellite imagery, automated analytics and high-frequency monitoring of strategic locations, economic assets and events from around the globe. BlackSky is trusted by the most demanding allied military and intelligence organizations and commercial companies to deliver foresight into critical matters that affect national security and the economy. BlackSky's data enables governments and businesses to see, understand and anticipate change as it happens, giving them the ultimate strategic advantage so they can act quickly. Our global team works with cutting-edge technology to make a difference around the world and prides itself on being people-first, customer-focused and fun.

As part of the Legal & Contracts team at BlackSky, the Procurement Administrator will support our satellite manufacturing function to ensure a successful procurement strategy for projects through design, build, test, and operations. The Procurement Administrator will help guide the development of purchasing strategies, market research, RFPs, purchase orders, and terms and conditions. This position reports to the Director, Contracts.  A strong work ethic and commitment to success are critical attributes for a candidate’s success.

This position can be remote, but candidates Herndon, VA candidates who are willing to come into the office as needed are preferred.

Responsibilities:

• Evaluate, negotiate and execute a variety of contractual materials covering a range of procurement transactions with suppliers, to include: formal requests for proposals, master purchasing agreements, purchase orders, and related terms and conditions.

• Assist in the purchase of materials and services at competitive prices, considering quality and suitability, time constraints/requirements, and the benefits to the company, both short- and long-term.

• Evaluate business and cost risks and identify and implement contractual levers to manage risks for the life of the procurement.

• Create and maintain strong relationships with suppliers and serve as the singular point of contact for matters concerning associated procurements.

• Maintain records for correspondence and documentation in relation to established procurements and those in progress within the Company’s contract management system.

• Communicate and present information to internal stakeholders with regards to procurement related matters.

• Monitor Purchase Orders/Master Purchasing Agreements, as well as the close-out, extension or renewal according to the needs of the company.

• Solve procurement-related problems that may arise with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

• Support project teams in evaluation of supplier proposals and terms and conditions as the procurement subject matter expert.

• Establish ground rules for procurement agreement negotiation with project team and supplier.

• Monitor procurements, to include deliverables and supplier performance in conformance with requirements, coordinating with supply chain and project teams, and recommend, document, and implement modifications as needed/required.

• Lead prioritization of key procurement terms for negotiation according to unique project characteristics and collaborate with internal subject matter experts, to include: legal, finance, operations/supply chain and others to ensure a comprehensive review and approval of terms.

• Serve as key resource for accurately conveying commercial terms and negotiation points to various cross functional teams.

• Ensure procurement documentation is in accordance with BlackSky and legal requirements, specifications, and regulations.

• Other job-related duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

• At least five (5) years of experience in procurement and contract administration.

• Experience with supply chain and product manufacturing environment, ideally within the aerospace industry.

• Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Adobe Acrobat, SharePoint, and Microsoft Project.

• Strong negotiation skills including superior communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal.

• Strong interpersonal skills, including an ability to maintain calm and effective exchanges during stressful situations.

• Demonstrated success working to develop consensus from diverse opinions in a highly fluid and time constrained environment.

• Excellent organizational skills, including organizing processes and workflows for effective, efficient, and compliant outcomes, and comfort with autonomy as well as the ability to work effectively in cross-functional team settings.

• Demonstrated problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Familiarity with U.S. government contract flow-downs.

• Experience with Deltek/CostPoint and/or Plex.

Life at BlackSky for full-time benefits eligible, US-based, employees includes:

• Medical, dental, vision, disability, group term life and AD&D, voluntary life and AD&D insurance

• BlackSky pays 100% of employee-only premiums for medical, dental and vision and contributes $100/month for out-of-pocket expenses!

• 15 days of PTO, 11 Company holidays, four Floating Holidays (pro-rated based on hire date), one day of paid volunteerism leave per year, parental leave and more

• 401(k) pre-tax and Roth deferral options with employer match

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Employee Stock Purchase Program

• Employee Assistance and Travel Assistance Programs

• Employer matching donations

• Professional development

• Mac or PC? Your choice!

• Awesome swag

The anticipated base salary range for candidates in Herndon, VA is $95,000 - $115,000 per year. The final compensation package offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on specific background and education. BlackSky is a multi-state employer, and this pay scale may not reflect salary ranges in other states or locations outside of Herndon, VA.

BlackSky is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. #LI-Remote

jobs.title: Industry Principle, Multifamily
jobs.description:
A FOUNDATIONAL COMPANY 

Rilla builds the leading conversation intelligence software for offline commerce. 

Salespeople talk, our mobile app records the conversation, and our AI transcribes and analyzes it to make them better at their jobs. We’re bringing the technology of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the more than 10 million salespeople who work face to face.

We’ve grown from zero to $55M+ in ARR in four years, and we’re profitable. 

We sell to enterprises like The Home Depot, KKR, Neighborly, and PulteGroup. 

We’re backed by Google Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Crew Capital, and Broom Ventures.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We’re in-office because the best work happens when ambitious people are in the same room.

If you want to help multifamily operators recapture millions in NOI by coaching their teams more effectively, Rilla is the place to do it.




THE ROLE

Think Virginia Love https://linkedin.com/in/vcloveatlanta for Entrata. You'll be the face of Rilla in multifamily, working directly with our CEO, Sebastian, and Head of Market Development, Lisha, on market progress.

You'll have a massive unfair advantage: a brand our customers already love, NPS higher than the iPhone, and a product that sells itself once people see it.

This didn't happen by accident. We think most B2B software sucks, and the way it markets itself sucks even more. Our heroes are the consumer companies that capture attention and deliver some of the most widely used products in the world. 

Just because contracts are signed and people have to use software for work doesn't mean we can't bring the same care and creativity as Apple or Nike.

And you'll join one of the fastest-growing startups in the world while it's still early.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Be the face of Rilla in multifamily: speak at industry events, facilitate webinars, and host operator events and dinners (you will be traveling >60% of the time)

 - Work with Sales and CS to build and deliver value to multifamily operators: onsite visits, calls, and sales and CS enablement

 - Work with the Rilla growth team to build reports and case studies to share with operators

 - Build deeper win-win partnerships with other vendors in the space

 - Work directly with our CEO and Head of Market Development on market progress




WHO YOU ARE

 - A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply cares about delighting clients and solving their pains, not about vanity metrics.

 - An infinite learner. You are always looking to learn more and learn faster. You feel uneasy when you get complacent, and you’re constantly seeking discomfort.

 - A team player. You love giving and receiving feedback and learning and growing as a team.

 - Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail because it means you get a new opportunity to learn more.

 - Affinity for the unconventional. You get a kick out of rejecting conventional wisdom. And you’re not afraid to try weird, crazy, and quite possibly stupid ideas.

 - Extremely focused. You practice extreme focus in everything you do. You’re always looking to prioritize your time and resources to maximum efficiency.
   
   


WHAT YOU NEED

 - Deep multifamily experience and a network of operators, vendors, and industry connections you can bring with you (10+ years preferred)

 - You're comfortable on stage, on a webinar, or at a dinner table, and people remember you

 - You've sold, coached, or worked alongside leasing teams and understand the tour → lease journey

 - You turn data into stories: reports and case studies operators actually want to read

 - You build partnerships where both sides win

 - You'd rather be onsite with a customer than behind a desk

 - A hunger for a fast-paced environment where you ship in days, not quarters




BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks at the office

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Wellness / Gym benefits

 - Commuter benefits

 - Relocation assistance

 - Take what you need paid time off, not accrual-based

 - $1,000 stipend for learning and personal growth

 - $1,500 a month rent stipend

 - Tech equipment

 - Unlimited token budget

jobs.title: Human Resources Assistant
jobs.description:
Department: Human Resources

Position Summary:

The HR Assistant provides administrative, coordination, and operational support across Human Resources and Talent Acquisition. Working closely with the VP HR Manager and VP of Talent Acquisition, this role ensures the smooth execution of daily HR operations, recruiting, onboarding, employee engagement events, HRIS administration and department projects. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Create and maintain electronic and hard-copy employee and new hire files.

• Monitor candidate background check statuses and assist with tracking.

• Coordinate and schedule candidate interviews across departments.

• Assist with new hire orientation setup, including room reservations, attendee scheduling, and packet preparation.

• Perform regular employee file audits using checklists, follow up on missing documents, and log records in tracking spreadsheets.

• Audit medical/BenePoints records across spreadsheets and the HRIS platform.

• Audit departmental invoices and follow up on audit/open enrollment discrepancies.

• Conduct data entry and produce standard or customized reports within the HRIS.

• Provide calendar management, meeting coordination, and administrative support to the HR Generalist and Talent Acquisition teams.

• Provide back-up support to the Senior Administrative Assistant for the Executive Partner of Human Resources as needed.

• Partner with the HR Coordinator to plan and execute company events, employee engagement programs, and recognition drives.

• Track participation and completion rates for required HR programs and activities.

• Update and maintain designated HR web pages and tracking spreadsheets.

• Handle sensitive employee and applicant information with strict confidentiality.

• Perform general office maintenance, including scanning, filing, shredding, archiving, and organizing HR storage areas.

• Support HR research initiatives and special projects as needed.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Competencies:

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies to perform the essential functions of this position.

• Ability to work with and handle confidential information – the individual has a proven track record of handling sensitive employee, candidate, and compensation records with strict discretion and adherence to privacy standards.

• Detail orientated—the individual pays close attention to all the small particulars when working on a task or project

• Great follow up skills—the individual has demonstrated ability to pursue ongoing projects to keep tasks moving along to completion.

• Problem solving—the individual identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner and gathers and analyzes information skillfully

• Interpersonal Skills—the individual maintains confidentiality, remains open to others’ ideas, and exhibits willingness to try new things.

• Written Communication—the individual edits work for spelling and grammar, presents numerical data effectively and can read and interpret written information.

• Quality control—the individual demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness and monitors own work to ensure quality.

• Adaptability—the individual adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and can deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.

• Dependability—the individual is consistently at work and on time, follows instructions, responds to management direction, and solicits feedback to improve performance.

• Safety and security—the individual actively promotes and personally observes safety and security procedures, and uses equipment and materials properly.

Salary for this position ranges from $28.75 - $33.53 per hour. The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, and education. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

jobs.title: IT Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are seeking an IT Coordinator to provide administrative, organizational, and coordination support across ForTec Medical's Information Technology department. This role helps ensure that project information, team activities, meetings, documentation, and follow-up commitments are organized, maintained, and communicated effectively.  The individual in this role will work closely with IT leadership and the Systems Design & Intelligence (SDI) team, supporting consistent project tracking, timely status reporting, and effective collaboration across IT and business departments.

The IT Coordinator plays an important role in improving organizational efficiency, maintaining accessible information, and supporting continuity as the IT organization evolves. While initial responsibilities will emphasize SDI and IT leadership support, the position is intended to provide coordination and administrative assistance across the broader IT department, including Applications/Engineering and IT Operations.

Project and SDI Team Coordination:

• Maintain and organize project and strategic initiative tracking information, including project ownership, status, milestones, key dates, dependencies, and supporting documentation.
• Proactively collect project updates from SDI team members and other stakeholders, follow up on missing or incomplete information, and help ensure project records remain accurate and current.
• Coordinate the preparation of SDI team meetings, including agendas, status updates, supporting materials, meeting notes, decisions, and follow-up action items.
• Maintain organized records of project decisions, outstanding actions, blockers, and dependencies; monitor open items and follow up with responsible individuals to support timely resolution.
• Support the Strategic Initiative Brief (SIB) intake process by organizing submissions, tracking review and approval status, and maintaining related documentation.
• Assist in preparing project portfolio summaries, status reports, and presentation materials for IT leadership and executive management reviews.

IT Leadership and Team Support:

• Provide administrative and coordination support to the VP of IT and other IT leaders, helping organize priorities, activities, information, and outstanding commitments.
• Coordinate meetings and team activities, including scheduling, agendas, preparation of materials, meeting notes, action items, and follow-up communications.
• Collect and organize updates from IT leaders and team members, preparing clear and consistent summaries, reports, and presentation materials that provide visibility into activities, priorities, and outstanding issues.
• Maintain and follow up on leadership and team action items, proactively requesting updates, identifying overdue commitments, and escalating unresolved matters when appropriate.
• Assist with coordination and administrative needs across SDI, Applications/Engineering, and IT Operations, managing routine requests independently within established priorities.
• Support onboarding and organizational transitions by coordinating meetings, organizing reference materials, and maintaining accessible information for new IT leaders and team members.

Documentation, Knowledge and Continuity:

• Organize and maintain IT department information and documentation within SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and other approved collaboration platforms, ensuring materials are structured, accessible, and easy to locate.
• Help establish and maintain consistent organizational practices for shared documents, project materials, knowledge repositories, naming conventions, and related information, in collaboration with appropriate IT and SDI team members.
• Coordinate periodic reviews and updates of IT documentation and application knowledge materials, working with subject matter experts to identify outdated, incomplete, or missing information.
• Maintain organized records of key meetings, decisions, responsibilities, project history, and other information that supports knowledge sharing and organizational continuity.
• Assist with developing and maintaining onboarding and reference materials for IT leaders and team members, helping preserve institutional knowledge and support effective transitions.

Continuous Improvement:

• Identify opportunities to improve the organization, consistency, and efficiency of recurring administrative, coordination, and reporting activities.
• Recommend and implement practical improvements to project trackers, documentation structures, meeting processes, templates, and other coordination tools.
• Explore and apply approved Microsoft 365 tools, automation capabilities, and other technologies to streamline routine activities and reduce manual effort.
• Seek feedback from IT leadership and team members, continuously developing skills and adapting coordination practices to support evolving departmental needs.

Requirements

• Associate's degree or relevant postsecondary education in Business Administration, Information Systems, Office Administration, or a related field preferred. An equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant work experience will be considered.
• 1–3 years of relevant experience in administrative coordination, project support, business operations, or a related role preferred.
• Demonstrated hands-on experience maintaining project lists, task trackers, status reports, or other structured coordination tools, including tracking assignments, deadlines, and follow-up activities.
• Practical experience with Microsoft SharePoint, Teams, and Lists, or comparable project-tracking and collaboration platforms, including organizing and maintaining shared information.
• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 productivity applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
• Experience coordinating meetings, preparing agendas and meeting materials, maintaining action items, and communicating follow-up expectations.
• Familiarity with document management practices, shared knowledge repositories, and consistent organizational structures is beneficial.

What you need to be successful

• Previous experience supporting IT teams, project teams, or cross-functional business activities is helpful but not required.
• Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities, establish priorities, maintain accurate records, and consistently meet deadlines.
• Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently, anticipate needs, follow up on outstanding commitments, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities without continuous direction.
• Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and completeness when maintaining project information, organizing documentation, and preparing reports or other materials.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence and professionalism to request information, follow up on commitments, and collaborate with employees and leaders across departments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and resourcefulness, with the ability to recognize missing information, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend practical solutions.
• Adaptable, curious, and eager to learn, with the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems, business processes, and organizational practices while remaining receptive to feedback.
• Sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism, with the ability to handle confidential information appropriately, recognize when escalation is necessary, and maintain productive working relationships.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. As such, we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, citizenship, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, status as a member of the United States armed forces, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Pediatric Obesity Specialist - TX License
jobs.description:
Clarity Pediatrics http://www.claritypediatrics.com is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. After successfully launching our virtual clinic for ADHD and anxiety, we are expanding our pediatric care platform to address other common chronic conditions and are focused right now on Obesity and Overweight management. Our new clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and designed to deliver exceptional health outcomes that transform a child's trajectory.

 

We are seeking a passionate Pediatrician to join our multi-disciplinary clinical team as an Obesity Specialist. In this role, you will be at the forefront of our new program, providing virtual care centered around family-based behavioral therapy and individualized medical management for children and teens (ages 5-17).

 

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne https://www.linkedin.com/in/christina-lamontagne-a289152/, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer, Alesandro Larrazabal, MD https://www.linkedin.com/in/alesandro-larrazabal-m-d-7b4a9623/, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

 

What makes this role unique:

 - Integrated Care Model: Work within a multi-disciplinary team of physicians, nurse practitioners, Master’s level therapists and psychologists to provide integrated, evidence-based care.

 - Pioneer a New Program: Contribute directly to the development and iteration of our Obesity and Overweight care model, workflows, and clinical tools.

 - Professional Growth: We encourage clinicians to develop special areas of expertise and become leaders within the team. We provide ongoing training, guidance from experts, and stipends for professional development.

Responsibilities: 

 - Conduct 60-minute virtual intake appointments to screen for obesity/overweight and determine individualized treatment plans.

 - Provide comprehensive clinical services, including medication management (e.g., GLP-1s and other anti-obesity medications) and ordering/interpreting diagnostic labs.

 - Lead our "Positive Parenting for Healthy Weight" Shared Medical Appointment groups

 - Collaborate with behavioral health colleagues and refer to other services as appropriate
