jobs.title: Principal Research Strategist (San Francisco)
jobs.description:
PRINCIPAL RESEARCH STRATEGIST



Be the face of Conveo's Insight function in the US: the research expert our biggest clients call first, and the commercial partner who helps us win our largest deals. You'll be based near San Francisco, with regular in-person time with the West Coast team. Client travel expected.




ABOUT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.

 


THE CONTEXT

AI moderation is changing what research can do. Qual depth at quant scale, in days rather than months. Our US client base is growing fast, and the question our biggest clients now ask is no longer "does AI moderation work?" but "what can we do now that was never possible before?" Answering that question, rigorously and commercially, is how we win and grow our most important accounts.

That is why we're hiring a Principal Research Strategist for the US. You'll be the face of Conveo's Insight function in the market. Every major US client will know you. You'll touch all of them, their biggest projects, and their biggest initiatives. You'll work side by side with Sales on our largest deals, with Marketing to build our brand, with Product to invent new methodologies, and with our Research Impact team to crack the hardest client problems.

You’ll spend roughly 70% of your time winning and designing big client programmes with Sales, and ~30% on product, marketing and researcher support.

This is a role with a real say in the strategy of the whole business. It is not for someone looking for a 9-to-5. It's for someone who wants more impact than they've had at any company before.

 


YOUR MISSION


1. DESIGN RESEARCH THAT SETS THE STANDARD FOR AI MODERATION

You are the methodological authority. When a client has a hard research problem, you design the answer, and it is both innovative and rigorous.

 - Design methodologies for our clients' most important programs, especially ongoing listening programs and trackers

 - Bring quant rigor to AI-moderated research: sample composition, quotas, weighting, statistical testing, and consistency over time

 - Solve clients' most difficult research challenges within the context of Conveo's AI moderation platform

 - Combine approaches like MaxDiff, conjoint, price testing, JTBD, and A&U with AI moderation in ways that weren't possible before

 - Set the methodological bar for how Conveo research is designed, run, and reported


2. BECOME THE TRUSTED INSIGHT PARTNER TO OUR BIGGEST CLIENTS, AND HELP CLOSE OUR BIGGEST DEALS

You build relationships so close that clients come to you as their insight expert, whether the question is about Conveo or not.

 - Own senior relationships with insight leaders and executives at our largest US accounts, up to C-suite

 - Be involved in every major client's biggest projects and initiatives

 - Partner with Sales on our largest deals: discovery, solution design, pitching, and closing

 - Shape proposals that turn a first study into a multi-year, multi-team program

 - Spot expansion opportunities early and bring them to the commercial team


3. BUILD CONVEO'S BRAND AS THE MOST TRUSTED VOICE IN AI MODERATION

With Marketing, you make Conveo the name the US insights industry trusts when it comes to AI moderation.

 - Represent Conveo on stage at major industry conferences and events

 - Lead thought leadership: talks, webinars, articles, and points of view on the future of research

 - Publish research-on-research that proves the quality and validity of AI moderation

 - Build a personal profile in the US insights community that elevates Conveo with it


4. INVENT WHAT'S NEXT WITH PRODUCT AND RESEARCH IMPACT

You bring a creative, builder mindset to what research can become, and you raise the bar across the team.

 - Work with Product to build new features and invent brand-new methodologies that were never possible before

 - Bring the voice of our most sophisticated clients into the roadmap

 - Be the go-to resource for our Research Impact team: unblock client issues, solve the hardest problems, and level up the team's craft

 - Build our syndicated research offering: what it should look like, which topics we own, and how we commercialize it

 - Help drive the strategy of the entire Conveo business as part of the senior leadership group


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


MUST-HAVES

 - 10+ years in research and insights, ideally across both agency and client side (not a requirement)

 - In-depth knowledge of quant and qual techniques, including sample composition, weighting, statistical techniques, MaxDiff, conjoint, price testing, and ongoing tracking

 - Strong command of research frameworks such as Jobs to be Done, unmet needs, A&U, and innovation research

 - Hands-on experience with AI moderation, a clear understanding of the methodology, and real conviction about its future

 - Extensive experience working with senior stakeholders up to C-suite level

 - A charismatic presenter, someone people naturally gravitate towards

 - Strong commercial instinct, with a track record of helping win or grow significant business


MINDSET

 - High agency, low ego

 - Startup energy: you want to build something, not maintain something

 - Creative and inventive: new methodologies excite you, and you don't wait for permission to try them

 - Rigorous without being rigid: you know when precision matters and when speed does

 - AI-native: you use AI tools every day and see where research is going before others do


NICE TO HAVE

 - An existing network among insight leaders at major US brands

 - A track record of speaking at industry events or publishing thought leadership

 - Experience at a start up


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

After 6 to 12 months:

 - Every major US client knows you by name, and their insight leaders call you first when they have a hard question

 - You have played a direct role in closing several of our largest US deals

 - At least one flagship listening or tracking program you designed is live with a major client

 - Conveo has a visible presence on the main stage at key US industry events

 - You've shipped at least one new methodology or feature with Product that clients are using

 - The Research Impact team solves hard problems faster and better because you're there

 - Our syndicated offering has a clear shape, a commercial model, and a first product in market or in pilot


WHY JOIN CONVEO?

 - Own a high-impact senior role at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company

 - Competitive salary ($180k-$250k) and meaningful equity. 

 - Help define what great research looks like in the AI era, and be known for it

 - Direct access to founders and senior leadership, with a real voice in company strategy

 - Work with world-class enterprise clients 

 - Offices in London, Antwerp, and New York. This role is remote, but we expect you to be based close by to San Francisco for regular in-person meetings.

 - Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more.

 - Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to. Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal. 

 - Private health coverage (health, dental, vision)

 - 401(k) with 4% company match

 - 20 days vacation + US federal holidays

 - Refer someone great and earn up to $5,000.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Writer - Aviation
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Mission Success team is a cross-functional group that partners with every business line and supports all products that Anduril builds. Our responsibilities include product operations, training and adoption, and user documentation. We are seeking an experienced Technical Writer to create and maintain user documentation across our diverse business lines. We believe that the quality of our documentation should reflect the quality of products, which are world-class.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Aviation Technical Writer (also known internally as Senior Airframe Technical Writer), your mission is to partner with our numerous product and operations teams to deliver accurate, updated, and easy-to-understand documentation on how to use Anduril products. You will do whatever it takes to organize our engineering and program delivery functions in this mission. In this role, you will work closely with engineers, operations, and various subject matter experts to understand our products, identify user workflows, and use documentation to close the gap. As such, the Senior Airframe Technical Writer will play a foundational role in setting the bar for tone, voice, and quality across our written artifacts.

With Anduril’s focus on defense and national security, user documentation plays a critical role in ensuring front-line operators know how to leverage the “arsenal of democracy.” Your mission is to make the process of learning how to operate systems as easy and seamless as possible, with exceptionally well written and presented artifacts.

You will identify relevant stakeholders and lead them through a documentation roadmap with established key milestones and targets. You will engage subject matter experts at the right time, and you will guide them towards a finished user-facing document that plainly meets customer needs. Finally, you will work with our account teams to ensure that contract deliverables are accurate, on-time, and in the right format.

Written content artifacts under this charter may include things like: technical manuals, operational manuals, maintenance manuals, procedures, checklists, templates, user guides, troubleshooting guides, and release notes. You will partner with account, product, and engineering teams across all phases of product development to ensure users have the right documentation available.

Along with our commercial offerings outlined above, Anduril is pursuing programs with the government, which require documentation in standards such as MIL-STD-40051D, and S1000D, delivered via IADs. Familiarity with these standards and delivery methods, is highly desired.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Generate, review, and edit documentation that is user-focused. Work with engineering and operations to deliver task, conditions, standard-centric documentation.

• Evaluate and prioritize tasks required to successfully support product documentation efforts and keep them on track. Help drive the best decision for the company by using a data-driven approach and consider input from stakeholders to ensure well-informed decisions.

• Communicate and help manage expectations. Ensure risks are noted with adequate time, and shared with leadership.

• Help build a culture of technical documentation by contributing to the living documentation process, ensuring that those that come after you learn from your acquired Anduril experience.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years of demonstrated excellence generating technical documentation.

• Experience writing technical user-facing documentation.

• Experience reading and interpreting engineering documentation.

• Experience building content in a variety of formats (Word, XML, etc)

• Eligible to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

• Ability to relocate, if not already local, to be onsite in Ashville, OH

• In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Military exposure and experience, particularly with military technical documentation writing and formatting standards, guidelines, and verbiage (MIL-STD-40051, S1000D, etc)

• Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with emphasis on technical subjects.

• Passion for excellent documentation and user experience.

• Previous experience creating technical documentation in Aerospace and Defense (for DoD).

• Experience delivering content on fast-paced, complex projects with multiple stakeholders.

US Salary Range

$127,000—$170,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Data (USA)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Frontier AI labs are building coding agents that do real engineering work. Before these coding agents ship, Senior Engineers have to work a real problem from a codebase they know, step by step, to identify where a frontier model goes wrong then correct it.

Not just anyone can do this. It takes a select group of engineers with experience and taste.

Engineers who qualify join a fixed-pay contract: earn $6,000/wk for 40hrs of work ($150/hr). Work on your own schedule, paid weekly.



What you'll do

 - Judge the AI's work. Give an agent a real ticket, then review its output like a teammate's pull request: run it, evaluate it.

 - Pair with the AI on your own task. Work a real problem from a codebase you know, step by step, and flag where the model goes wrong.



What's in it for you

 - Senior-engineer pay. A weekly contract paying $6,000 for a 40-hour week. Work from anywhere, any time.

 - Work that lasts. This is not a two-week gig. The work is here month after month, and the 40 hours are yours every week you're on the team.

 - An elite, hand-picked team. You’ll have priority access to the projects frontier labs trust us with, the ones every engineer wants a seat on.

 - Problems that are actually hard. Your work on difficult tasks goes straight back to the labs training the next best-in-class models.

 - A seat at the table. You'll work directly with project leads from day one. Your read on where models fail and where the bar should sit shapes how we run these programs.

 - Ongoing, on your schedule. The contract renews every week while you meet quality standards. You set your hours. Exceptional engineers may be approved for additional hours, paid at $150/hr on top of your base earnings.

 - Support that meets your needs. A dedicated team, fast answers, and real feedback on your work.

How it works

 1. Pass a proctored coding assessment, without the use of AI tools. You’ll earn $100 when you pass. About 2 hours.

 2. Complete one paid trial task. You’ll earn $40 when you submit your first stage and $1,100 once it's approved through every review cycle. About 10 hours total.

 3. Join the team and continue working. We’ll provide 40 hours of work every week, totalling $6,000.



You're a fit if you have



 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience

 - A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science or a related field

 - US work authorization

 - Strong written English and 40 hours a week to give during your contract

 - No AI background needed. Your software engineering skills are the whole job.
   
   About Handshake

Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.

In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

Why join Handshake now:

 - Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel

 - Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions

 - Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders

 - Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

About Handshake AI

Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.

jobs.title: Phlebotomist
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a One Medical Phlebotomist (internally knowns as a Lab Services Specialist), you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. Reporting to the Operations Manager and collaborating closely with our diverse team of providers and administrative assistants, you’ll be an integral part of our patient’s primary care team both on a local office level and as a part of your larger district. You’ll utilize the highest quality standards to perform specimen collections and processing, while providing a personalized and calming experience for our patients. You will use a growth mindset to navigate the rapidly changing technology and workflows that keep us on the forefront of modern day healthcare, all while providing best in class, human-centered care to our patients.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you’ll work on:

• Provide best in class venipuncture services on a population ranging from pediatrics to geriatrics

• Perform and assist with extended scope duties such as, but not limited to non-blood specimen collection, EKGs/ECGs, vitals, ear lavages, vaccines, PPD tests, and swabs

• Maintain high standards of in-office care through proper specimen labeling, handling and processing, inventory upkeep, and tool sterilization

• Continue to care for our members beyond the lab room by answering patient messages, following up on lab cases and assisting our providers and virtual medical team with clerical duties such as, but not limited to biometric screening forms, medical record and consult review, billing inquiries, and DOH reporting

jobs.title: Social Media Engineering Intern (Winter/Spring 2027)
jobs.description:
Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Your Impact:

Communications and Social Media at Formlabs tells the story of our technology, our community, and the incredible things being built on our machines. We sit at the intersection of engineering, design, and digital content.

If you are a maker at heart who loves telling stories about awesome engineering - we want you as our Social Media Engineering Intern. In this role, you won't just talk about making things; you’ll print, film, edit, and publish stories that inspire millions of creators worldwide.

Internship Term: Winter/Spring (January 11-April 30)

Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)

Location: Onsite in Somerville, MA (in-person)

What You’ll Do:

• End-to-End Video Production: Own social video projects from pitch to hitting publish. Pitch trends/ideas, set up prints on Formlabs printers, film the process, edit high-energy videos, and distribute them across our channels.

• Operate Independently & Collaboratively: Work self-sufficiently on quick-turn stories while integrating seamlessly into the larger social media team to support broader marketing initiatives.

• Turn Tech into Content: Showcase physical parts, prints, and engineering projects in compelling, visual ways that resonate with engineers, artists, doctors, and makers alike.

• Data-Driven Strategy: Support reporting and analytics to measure content performance, refine strategies, and optimize for reach and engagement.

• Trendspotting: Spot real-time social trends, viral audio, and maker-community conversations, acting fast to translate them into relevant Formlabs content.

About You:

• Hands-on Creator: You have hands-on experience with video editing software (Premiere, DaVinci, Final Cut, etc.) and a knack for creating engaging video content.

• Storyteller: An eye for spotting incredible technical applications and turning them into compelling narratives that balance fun, humor, and professionalism.

Responsibilities:

jobs.title: Regional Manager of Operations, Mid-West Region
jobs.description:
As our Regional Manager of Operations, Mid-West, you'll play an important role in supporting and growing a diverse portfolio of emergency, specialty, and urgent care hospitals.

You'll work directly with Practice Managers, Hospital Administrators, Medical Directors, and veterinary partners to strengthen daily operations, improve financial performance, develop hospital leaders, and create exceptional experiences for clients, patients, and referring veterinarians.

This role combines hands-on operational leadership with regional business oversight. You'll spend time in hospitals, build relationships with teams, understand the challenges they face, and help develop practical solutions that improve performance.

You'll also partner closely with our Regional Vice President and central support teams to implement operational initiatives, support hospital growth, and identify opportunities across the region.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to manage hospitals from behind a spreadsheet. We're looking for someone who enjoys being in the field, coaching leaders, solving problems, and helping teams turn great ideas into measurable results.

Most importantly, we're looking for a leader who understands that successful hospitals are built through strong relationships, engaged teams, sound business decisions, and consistent execution.

What You'll Do

Lead Regional Hospital Operations

• Provide operational oversight and support for multiple specialty, emergency, and urgent care hospitals throughout the Mid-West region.
• Partner with hospital leadership to improve daily workflows, staffing efficiency, patient access, and overall operational performance.
• Establish consistent operational expectations while respecting each hospital's unique culture, clinical services, and business needs.
• Identify operational challenges early and work collaboratively with hospital teams to implement sustainable solutions.
• Maintain a strong field presence through regular hospital visits, leadership meetings, and ongoing communication.

Drive Financial & Business Performance

• Take ownership of regional financial performance, including revenue growth, EBITDA, labor management, expense control, and profitability.
• Partner with hospital leaders to develop and execute budgets, forecasts, and financial improvement plans.
• Monitor key performance indicators, including revenue, transactions, average transaction charges, labor costs, staffing productivity, and client experience metrics.
• Identify opportunities to improve hospital efficiency, manage expenses, and support sustainable growth.
• Translate financial data into clear, actionable priorities for hospital leadership teams.

Develop & Empower Hospital Leaders

• Coach and mentor Practice Managers, Hospital Administrators, and department leaders to strengthen their leadership and business management skills.
• Establish clear expectations, accountability, and consistent follow-through across hospital teams.
• Support leadership development, succession planning, and employee engagement initiatives.
• Partner with Human Resources and Talent Acquisition on recruiting, retention, performance management, and staffing strategies.
• Help hospital leaders navigate challenging conversations, organizational changes, and complex operational situations.

Support Emergency, Specialty & Urgent Care Operations

• Understand and support the different staffing, scheduling, workflow, and financial models across emergency, specialty, and urgent care hospitals.
• Partner with medical leadership to improve veterinarian scheduling, clinical support staffing, patient flow, and operational efficiency.
• Identify opportunities to improve appointment availability, service utilization, and access to veterinary care.
• Support hospital teams in managing the operational demands of extended hours, overnight services, and fluctuating caseloads.
• Collaborate with medical leaders to remove operational barriers while respecting clinical decision-making and medical autonomy.

Strengthen Veterinary Partnerships & Client Experience

• Build trusted relationships with Medical Directors, veterinary partners, and hospital leadership teams.
• Serve as a reliable operational resource who listens, communicates openly, and follows through on commitments.
• Partner with Marketing and hospital teams to strengthen community awareness, referring veterinarian relationships, and hospital reputation.
• Support initiatives that improve client communication, service accessibility, and the overall client experience.
• Help hospitals identify opportunities for referral growth, client retention, and stronger community relationships.

Support Regional Growth & Strategic Initiatives

• Partner with the Regional Vice President to execute regional priorities and operational improvement initiatives.
• Support new hospital integrations, leadership transitions, service expansions, and operational readiness as the region grows.
• Collaborate with Finance, Marketing, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, IT, and other central support teams to ensure hospitals receive timely and effective support.
• Share best practices across hospitals and contribute to the continued development of our Specialty, Emergency & Urgent Care network.
• Help shape operational processes and leadership resources that support long-term regional growth.

We're looking for an experienced, collaborative leader who understands the business of veterinary medicine and genuinely enjoys helping people succeed.

Required Experience & Qualifications

• 5+ years of progressive veterinary hospital operations experience, preferably within emergency, specialty, urgent care, or a combination of these environments.
• 2+ years of multisite leadership experience or comparable senior-level management experience within a large, complex veterinary hospital.
• Demonstrated success improving hospital financial performance, operational efficiency, and team engagement.
• Strong financial acumen, including P&L management, budgeting, labor management, forecasting, and expense control.
• Experience coaching and developing Practice Managers, Hospital Administrators, or other hospital leaders.
• Understanding of veterinary hospital staffing models, veterinarian productivity, clinical workflows, and operational performance metrics.
• Ability to build strong relationships with veterinary professionals, medical leadership, and hospital partners.
• Excellent communication, problem-solving, organizational, and leadership skills.
• Ability to manage competing priorities across multiple hospitals and geographic markets.
• Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, veterinary management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Willingness and ability to travel extensively throughout the assigned region.

Even Better If You Bring

• 7+ years of veterinary hospital leadership experience, particularly within specialty, emergency, or urgent care.
• Previous experience as a Regional Manager, Area Manager, Hospital Administrator, Director of Operations, or senior veterinary practice leader.
• Experience overseeing multiple hospitals, large multidisciplinary teams, or 24-hour emergency operations.
• Experience supporting hospital integrations, new hospital openings, service expansions, or operational turnarounds.
• Familiarity with veterinary practice management systems, financial reporting, and performance analytics.
• CVPM, MBA, MHA, or similar professional credentials.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Regional Managers at Alliance do more than oversee hospital performance. They build relationships, develop leaders, and help hospitals consistently move forward.

In this role, success means:

• Hospital leaders feel supported, empowered, and accountable for their results.
• Hospitals demonstrate measurable improvements in financial and operational performance.
• Teams are engaged, staffing is aligned with business needs, and employee retention remains a priority.
• Veterinary partners and Medical Directors view Operations as a trusted and valuable business partner.
• Client experience, referral relationships, and hospital reputation continue to strengthen.
• Regional priorities are executed consistently, with clear communication and follow-through.

Why Join Alliance Animal Health?

We recognize that great hospital operations start with great people.

At Alliance, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on hospitals, veterinary professionals, and the communities they serve.

You'll be part of an organization that values:

• Partnership: Work alongside veterinary professionals and hospital leaders who care deeply about their teams and the medicine they practice.
• Autonomy: Support hospitals that maintain their individual identities, cultures, and medical decision-making authority.
• Leadership: Develop talented hospital leaders and help them grow personally and professionally.
• Impact: Directly influence hospital performance, team engagement, and regional growth.
• Collaboration: Work alongside an experienced Specialty, Emergency & Urgent Care leadership team and dedicated central support partners.
• Growth: Join an expanding network with opportunities to contribute to new initiatives, hospital development, and the future of our organization.

We offer competitive compensation, performance-based bonus opportunities, comprehensive benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

Position Details

Position: Regional Manager of Operations, Mid-West Region

Division: Specialty, Emergency & Urgent Care

Employment Type: Full-Time

Territory: Nebraska, Iowa, Illinois, Missouri, Wisconsin, New York, and additional markets as the region expands.

Location: Regional / Field-Based. Candidates located within the Mid-West territory preferred. (Must live within these states, Chicago, IL ideal)

Travel: Significant regional travel required, including regular hospital visits and overnight travel.

Reports To: Regional Vice President, Specialty, Emergency & Urgent Care

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're an experienced veterinary operations leader who enjoys developing people, building strong relationships, and helping hospitals succeed, we'd love to meet you.

This is an opportunity to join a growing team, bring your ideas to the table, and make a meaningful difference in the future of specialty, emergency, and urgent care veterinary medicine.

Bring your experience, your leadership, and your passion for veterinary medicine to Alliance Animal Health.

Base Salary Range: $125,000 - $135,000

Alliance Animal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Mobile Phlebotomist (Rochester, NY)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Sprinter Health, our mission is to reimagine how people access care by bringing high quality care directly into the home.

Using the same technology that powers leading marketplace platforms, we deliver care where people are, especially those who need it most.

We’ve supported millions of patients across 22 states and consistently maintained a 90+ NPS, reflecting the quality and experience we strive to deliver every day.

Our clinical teams are at the center of making healthcare more accessible, connected, and personal.



Where patient experience isn’t a metric. It’s a standard.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Sprinter, you’ll bring healthcare directly to patients in the comfort of their homes. You’ll spend your day on the road providing a variety of preventative and diagnostic services, including blood draws, vitals, height and weight assessments, urine collection, support with Annual Wellness Visits, and more.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys independence, connecting with patients, and a workday that looks different from a traditional clinic setting.

What We Offer

 - Guaranteed daily hours

 - National Mileage reimbursement, currently $0.76/mile reimbursement starting at mile 31

 - Company paid healthcare premiums

 - 100% 401(k) contribution of 3%

 - Company provided equipment including iPhone, iPad, scrubs, and supplies


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Life as a Sprinter starts before the first patient visit. Your car becomes both your office and your lab on the go, so preparation and organization are everything.

 - Prepare for your day by reviewing your schedule and ensuring you have the proper supplies and PPE.

 - Travel to patients’ homes throughout your assigned service area.

 - Provide scheduled services including blood draws, vitals, height and weight measurements, urine collection, support with Annual Wellness Visits, and other preventative and diagnostic services.

 - Use your expert phlebotomy skills to make blood draws as comfortable as possible for each patient.

 - Create a warm, welcoming, and professional experience in every patient’s home.

 - Accurately document each patient visit using Sprinter technology.

 - Properly label, handle, and transport specimens for lab drop off or shipment.

 - Manage your time, supplies, and schedule independently as you move from patient to patient throughout the day.


SOUND LIKE YOU?


MASTER OF YOUR CRAFT

 - Do you have exceptional blood draw skills?

 - Have you been the “go to” for hard sticks?

 - Are you confident in drawing blood from a wide range of patients?

 - Are you comfortable learning and performing additional clinical services?


ROAD WARRIOR

 - Do you enjoy a change of scenery during your workday?

 - Are you comfortable spending a significant portion of your day on the road?

 - Are you willing to travel an hour or more to visit patients?

 - Can you comfortably drive before 7:00 a.m. when your first patient is scheduled at 7:00 a.m.?


PATIENT FOCUSED

 - Are you passionate about helping others?

 - Are you kind, empathetic, and an effective communicator?

 - Do you enjoy meeting new people and creating a great patient experience?


SEEN IT ALL BEFORE

 - Are you comfortable providing care in a variety of home environments, recognizing that each patient’s living conditions and standards may be different from your own?

 - Can you remain calm, adaptable, and professional when faced with challenging or unexpected situations?


COMMITTED TO EXCELLENCE

 - Do you pride yourself on being reliable, dependable, and trustworthy?

 - Are you solution oriented and able to think critically when challenges arise?

 - Is your mode of transportation as reliable as you are?


TECH PROFICIENT

 - Are you proficient using Apple iPhones and iPads beyond calling and texting?

 - Are you comfortable navigating apps, electronic health records, telehealth platforms, and other digital tools?

 - Can you confidently learn and navigate new technology independently?

If you’re nodding yes, you’re off to a great start. Here are a few more things you’ll need to be successful as a Sprinter.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Strong phlebotomy skills, including experience with challenging sticks

 - Patient facing healthcare experience as a Phlebotomist, Medical Assistant (MA), Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN), or Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) in home preferred

 - Current BLS certification

 - Valid driver’s license, current auto insurance, and personal, reliable vehicle

 - Availability Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.

 - Ability to drive before 7:00 a.m. to arrive at your first scheduled patient on time

 - Proficiency using Apple iPhones and iPads

 - Ability to meet applicable state specific certification or licensing requirements


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs.

 - Ability to spend prolonged periods driving between patient appointments

 - Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and carry medical supplies and equipment

 - Ability to safely navigate a variety of patient home environments, including locations with stairs

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer (FedD239)
jobs.description:
Senior Platform Engineer

AI Engineering | Forward Deployed Engineering

Role Description

Defense Unicorns is seeking a senior AI Agentic Engineer to embed with a government team and its technology partners building an emerging AI-powered engineering ecosystem.

This role will focus on designing, integrating, and operationalizing AI agents and agentic workflows within a secure enterprise environment. The engineer will work across large language models, agent frameworks, enterprise data, APIs, developer tooling, and platform services to turn AI capabilities into reliable, mission-relevant workflows.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who understands both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems and can rapidly translate emerging technologies into working solutions. They should be comfortable experimenting with new models and agent frameworks, integrating agents with enterprise systems and tools, evaluating performance and reliability, and working alongside platform engineers and commercial technology partners.

This is not a research-only role. The focus is on moving from AI concepts and prototypes to secure, useful, repeatable agentic capabilities that can operate in production environments.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, and integrate AI agents and multi-agent workflows using modern LLM and agentic technologies.

• Develop agent capabilities that interact with enterprise applications, APIs, data sources, developer tools, and mission systems.

• Integrate models, agents, tools, and enterprise data into secure workflows that can be deployed in controlled and classified environments.

• Work with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool/function calling, structured outputs, MCP, and related technologies.

• Develop mechanisms for agents to securely discover, access, reason over, and act upon approved enterprise data and services.

• Prototype and rapidly evaluate emerging models, agent frameworks, and AI capabilities to determine where they can create measurable mission or engineering value.

• Develop evaluation and testing frameworks for agent accuracy, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and task completion.

• Implement guardrails and policy controls governing agent behavior, tool access, data access, and human approval points.

• Integrate agentic capabilities with CI/CD and DevSecOps workflows to support repeatable development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management.

• Collaborate with platform engineers to operationalize AI workloads within Kubernetes/OpenShift environments.

• Work with commercial AI and technology partners to integrate their capabilities into the broader engineering ecosystem.

• Troubleshoot issues across models, agent frameworks, APIs, data sources, networking, identity, and infrastructure.

• Develop reusable patterns for agent deployment, configuration, observability, evaluation, and lifecycle management.

• Document architectures, integration patterns, agent specifications, evaluation results, and operational procedures.

• Identify recurring AI engineering challenges that can be standardized, automated, or productized into reusable capabilities.

• Stay current with rapidly evolving agentic AI technologies and assess their applicability to secure government environments.

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

• Active Top Secret clearance.

• Hands-on experience building applications or systems using large language models and generative AI.

• Experience designing and implementing AI agents or agentic workflows.

• Strong programming experience in Python and/or another modern programming language.

• Experience integrating AI systems with APIs, enterprise applications, databases, and external tools.

• Experience with one or more agent frameworks or orchestration approaches.

• Working knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and prompt engineering.

• Experience developing software in a Git-based, automated CI/CD environment.

• Ability to rapidly prototype, test, troubleshoot, and iterate in ambiguous environments.

• Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, version control, APIs, debugging, and system design.

• Ability to work effectively alongside platform engineers, government personnel, and multiple technology vendors.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

• Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and tool-based agent architectures.

• Experience with multi-agent systems and agent orchestration.

• Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, NVIDIA, or comparable foundation model ecosystems.

• Experience with NVIDIA NIM, NeMo, or similar AI inference/model-serving technologies.

• Experience with Red Hat OpenShift AI or Kubernetes-based AI platforms.

• Experience with agent evaluation and observability frameworks.

• Experience implementing AI guardrails, policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop workflows, or AI safety controls.

• Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or comparable frameworks.

• Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and enterprise search.

• Experience deploying AI systems in Secret or TS/SCI environments.

• Experience with disconnected or air-gapped AI environments.

• Experience integrating AI into developer/DevSecOps workflows.

• Familiarity with GitLab, Jira, Confluence, Xacta, or similar enterprise engineering and compliance tools.

• Experience working with GPUs, model serving, inference optimization, or AI infrastructure.

• Familiarity with UDS, Zarf, Pepr, Iron Bank, or similar secure software delivery technologies.

• Experience taking AI prototypes into repeatable, production-ready capabilities.

• Ability to evaluate new AI technologies quickly and make pragmatic build/buy/integrate decisions.

What Success Looks Like

• Agentic capabilities move from prototype to mission use quickly, with working agents integrated into real government workflows rather than remaining isolated demos.

• Agents reliably connect to approved enterprise data, tools, and services, with appropriate identity, permissions, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.

• AI capabilities are measurable and trustworthy, with repeatable evaluation methods for accuracy, reliability, task completion, security, and operational performance.

• Reusable agent patterns emerge, reducing the engineering required to build and deploy the next agent or AI-enabled workflow.

• AI integrates cleanly with the broader platform architecture, working effectively across the data, DevSecOps, Kubernetes/OpenShift, model, and application layers rather than creating another technology silo.

• The engineer becomes a trusted AI technical advisor to the Mission Hero, proactively identifying where agentic technology can create mission value—and equally important, where AI is not the right solution.

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA

$148,750—$201,250 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. jobs.title: Senior Space Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Space Flight Software Engineer is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves and operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. The team is responsible for all phases of development, starting from requirements capture through testing and flight operational support.

Responsibilities

• Develop reliable flight software that determine how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate throughout the entire mission.

• Write quality structured bare metal, RTOS, or Linux based software for embedded processors in C++.

• Own all aspects of software development, from design, testing, and integration.

• Scope projects including requirements capture and initial design trades given open-ended problems.

• Ensure system quality and performance through software test, verification, and validation (V&V) technique.

• Teamwork, communicate and problem solve in a collaborative environment.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.

• 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.

• Experience with development in C++, along with a strong understanding of the language concepts.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• End-to-end experience building and launching a spacecraft.

• Experience developing and testing real-time embedded systems.

• Experience with safety-critical software, especially for aerospace applications.

• Experience with CCSDS telemetry and telecommand system.

• Experience with F' or cFS framework.

• Experience with Python, or Rust.

• Knowledge of basic analog and digital electronics.

• Familiarity with SPI, I2C, CAN, EtherCAT.

Pay Range

• Salary range: Senior Software Engineer: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.

• You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

jobs.title: Account Director, Crypto
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM is on a mission to build a safer financial system for billions of people. We deliver a blockchain intelligence data platform to financial institutions, crypto companies, and governments to fight cryptocurrency fraud and financial crime. We consider our business — and our profit — as a way to move towards our mission sustainably and at scale. 

The Sales Account Director for crypto-first businesses will lead the go-to-market strategy to increase and strengthen our foothold in the space. We're looking for a customer-obsessed, consultative salesperson to own the entire sales process with new customers. This person will be knowledgeable about the cryptocurrency ecosystem and feel comfortable navigating both complex six-figure deals and fast-moving transactional deals. 

Responsibilities:

 - Own the end-to-end sales process with new customers -- from researching opportunities to tailoring their sales approach to prospects' needs to closing deals -- across crypto-first businesses.

 - Write client proposals (sometimes, from scratch) and negotiate contracts / SOWs.

 - Develop and leverage an in-depth understanding of client needs and key initiatives, tailor sales approach to specific business needs, and map these to TRM products.

 - Generate, maintain, and report against an ongoing pipeline of strategic opportunities to meet and exceed sales targets.

 - Actively seek to understand industry trends to help position against competitors.

 - Gather and distribute product feedback from clients and prospects to the sales and product teams to help us continually enhance our product offerings.

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience with a demonstrated ability to consistently deliver against net new sales targets.

 - Strong customer-facing presentation/listening skills with the aptitude to establish credibility with senior financial and compliance executives.

 - Natural storyteller with the capacity to understand customer needs and convey compelling value propositions.

 - Exceptional communication and problem-solving skills.

 - Strong knowledge of cryptocurrencies, digital assets, and/or blockchains.

 - Familiarity with regulatory initiatives and changes related to cryptocurrency; understanding of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) regulatory frameworks.

 - Previous experience working in a fast-paced, growing startup environment.

 - Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

 - Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

About the team:

 - The Private Sector Business Development team is made of independent sales leaders who take ownership and initiative of their territory and responsibilities. Because we’re a global team, each team member is a master of their own territory.

 - We work asynchronously to share intel, win strategies, and support one another when prospects cross time zones.

 - Knowing the impact that our work has on the future of TRM, we’re scrappy and find ways to get things done and overcome any challenges that come our way.

 - Each team member works according to typical business hours in their territory. At times, it’s necessary for the team to meet together a few hours earlier or later than an individual’s local business hours, but those occasions are planned in advance.

Compensation

The compensation range for this role is listed below:

 - For this role, the range provided is the role's On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

 - $276,666 - $343,334 USD

 - Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

 - Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

 - Returning prospect and customer communications within 24 hours at most, typically faster.

 - Raising any customer concerns to the relevant internal teams promptly and ensuring

 - Responding to internal requests (asks re: customer, prospect, and market information that can range from small to large projects) as quickly as possible.


APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

 - Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.




AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly

 - Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. 





PRIVACY POLICY AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.trmlabs.com/policies/privacy-policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc6e8jRCl2cQwgIzXLpIGQXtwvMQh__TcokvO2toAAkT44A6Q/viewform?usp=dialog. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSevmAzPxWOYm_7kMHb9lEJlX3tpdBeHvvvNWjsI_6xhUfnXjw/viewform?usp=dialog.




RECRUITMENT AGENCIES

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

jobs.description:

We are Axicom, part of WPP, an award-winning global communications agency for tech-driven brands. We bring together a diverse team of PR professionals passionate about integrated communications and telling the transformative stories of technology. With offices in the Netherlands, United States, United Kingdom, Spain, Italy, Germany, France, Sweden, Brazil, and Mexico, we are the largest global agency specializing in tech communication.

We're proud to be recently recognized as Agency of the Future, Disruptive Agency of the Year, and Best PR Network to Work For (EMEA). This underscores our commitment to innovation, growth, and fostering a collaborative culture. Since 1994, we've delivered ground-breaking campaigns for the world's most innovative tech companies, and we are always seeking new talent to join our team of Futurists.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

More about the role:

The stakes in technology storytelling today are higher than ever. Technology is reshaping how businesses operate, how people live and work, and how organizations build and protect reputation. Every innovation brings opportunity, but also greater complexity, scrutiny and rapidly evolving stakeholder expectations.

Want to help some of the world’s most influential technology companies navigate what’s next and shape the conversations defining the future?

As a team of Futurists, Axicom helps leading technology companies anticipate change, navigate complexity and build reputations that endure. We don’t simply react to conversations. We help clients see around corners, uncover emerging opportunities and shape the narratives driving the future of technology and business.

As a Vice President on our growing U.S. team, you’ll serve as a strategic counselor and client leader, guiding complex communications programs for technology brands operating in fast-moving, high-stakes environments. You’ll lead significant client relationships, set strategic direction across integrated teams, and help clients navigate an increasingly fragmented ecosystem of traditional media, independent journalists, creators, analysts and other influential voices.

You’ll also play an important role in the growth of our business, identifying opportunities to deepen client relationships, contributing to new business efforts and helping shape the next generation of Axicom’s technology communications offering.

We’re looking for an experienced, forward-thinking communications leader with deep curiosity about technology and the business forces shaping it. The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with strong client counsel, integrated communications expertise, people leadership and commercial acumen. They bring a clear point of view on where communications is headed and know how to turn emerging

What you'll do:

• Serve as a strategic counselor to clients, advising senior stakeholders on communications, reputation, positioning and complex business challenges.

• Lead significant client relationships and programs, setting strategic direction while ensuring teams deliver high-quality, impactful work against broader business objectives.

• Help clients anticipate emerging trends, navigate industry and reputational shifts, and identify opportunities to lead conversations shaping technology, business and culture.

• Develop and oversee integrated, insight-led communications strategies spanning earned, owned, social, executive visibility, analyst relations, influencer engagement and other relevant channels.

• Translate data, market intelligence, audience insights and emerging technologies into clear strategic recommendations and opportunities for clients.

• Provide senior oversight across major media and influence strategies, building and leveraging relationships with journalists, creators, independent voices, analysts and industry influencers shaping the technology ecosystem.

• Lead the development of thought leadership, executive positioning, corporate narratives and high-impact storytelling programs that strengthen client reputation and relevance.

• Mentor and develop high-performing account teams, creating clear direction, raising the quality of strategic thinking and building the next generation of client leaders.

• Oversee client budgets, staffing, scopes and account operations, balancing strong financial stewardship with exceptional client service and program performance.

• Drive organic growth across existing relationships, identifying unmet client needs and translating them into new opportunities, scopes and capabilities.

• Play an active leadership role in new business, including opportunity development, pitch strategy, senior-level presentations and articulating Axicom’s differentiated point of view.

• Contribute to the continued growth and evolution of Axicom’s U.S. Technology practice, helping strengthen our capabilities, talent, culture and market position.

Experience that contributes to success:

• 8–10+ years of experience in communications, public relations or integrated marketing communications, with significant experience counseling and leading work for technology brands.

• Meaningful experience working across at least two of the following areas: consumer electronics/hardware, enterprise technology and applications, AI, semiconductors, or emerging technologies such as robotics, quantum computing or advanced R&D.

• Demonstrated experience owning significant client relationships and serving as a trusted counselor to senior-level client stakeholders.

• Proven ability to develop and lead integrated, insight-led communications strategies that connect client business objectives with reputation, culture and industry conversations.

• Strong understanding of the evolving influence ecosystem, including traditional media, independent journalists, creators, analysts, podcasters and other voices shaping technology and business narratives.

• Experience using data, research, market intelligence and audience insights to inform strategy, strengthen decision-making and demonstrate communications impact.

• A track record of helping clients navigate industry disruption, emerging issues, reputational challenges and high-value opportunities in fast-moving environments.

• Experience leading executive thought leadership and positioning programs; experience with technology industry analyst relations is strongly valued.

• Demonstrated ability to lead large, integrated teams and multiple workstreams, providing strategic direction while empowering teams to execute at a high level.

• Strong people leadership skills with experience mentoring, developing and retaining talent and creating clear opportunities for team growth.

• Established relationships across technology, business, trade, analyst and influence communities, paired with the curiosity to continually build new connections as the ecosystem evolves.

• Demonstrated commercial acumen, including experience growing existing client relationships, expanding scopes and identifying new opportunities based on evolving client needs.

• Experience contributing meaningfully to new business development, including pitch strategy, proposal development and senior-level presentations.

• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technology and business issues and provide clear, confident counsel.

• Genuine curiosity about the future of technology, communications, media and culture, with a point of view on how emerging technologies and changing stakeholder behaviors will reshape reputation and influence.
