jobs.title: Senior Space Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Space Embedded Software Engineer on the Flight Software team is responsible for determining how our spacecraft behaves & operates in orbit and building reliable software to ensure it happens. They are responsible for all phases of development, starting from requirements capture through testing and flight operational support.

Responsibilities

• Develop reliable firmware to control how the spacecraft, satellite bus, and reentry capsule operate through the entire mission.

• Own all aspects of software development, from design, testing, and integration.

• Scope projects including requirements capture and initial design trades given open-ended problems.

• Write quality structured bare metal, RTOS, or Linux based software for embedded processors in C++.

• Build highly reliable and available software systems.

• Ensure system quality and performance through software test, verification, and validation (V&V) techniques.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, math, physics, engineering or equivalent technical experience in safety critical software.

• 5+ years of experience in the development of spacecraft or similar safety critical software.

• Experience developing and testing real-time embedded hardware / software systems.

• Experience with development in C++, along with a strong understanding of language concepts.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience with safety-critical software, especially for aerospace applications.

• Experience with additional programming languages such as Python or Rust.

• Strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, data structures, and computer networking.

Pay Range

• Salary range: Senior Software: $169,067 - $216,031/ per year.

• This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.

• Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.

• You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

E-Verify Statement

Varda Space Industries, Inc. participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program. The E-Verify program is an Internet-based employment eligibility verification system operated by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. Learn more about the E-Verify program.

jobs.title: Kinaxis Solution Architect - Supply Chain Planning
jobs.description:
Western Digital is building a world-class enterprise planning capability enabled through process transformation, connected data, and deployment of the Kinaxis Maestro platform. We are seeking a senior Kinaxis Architect to own the coherence, scalability and evolution of this business solution across demand, supply, capacity, material, procurement and factory-planning domains.

You will translate supply chain strategy and end-to-end planning requirements into an integrated solution architecture, governed design standards and a multi-release roadmap. This role combines hands-on platform depth with enterprise architecture judgment, cross-functional influence and the ability to build durable internal capability.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Own the end-to-end Kinaxis Maestro solution architecture, capability model and multi-release roadmap for the enterprise planning environment.
• Translate supply chain strategy, planning-process requirements and cross-functional use cases into integrated functional and technical designs in close collaboration with Business and Technology partners.
• Establish and govern solution standards for workbooks, scenarios, workflows, reports, hierarchies, planning parameters, closed loops, optimization logic, security and reusable design patterns.
• Lead architecture decisions and design reviews spanning demand, supply, capacity, material, procurement, master scheduling, factory scheduling and scenario-based decision support.
• Ensure design consistency across planning domains, resolve trade-offs and prevent local configurations from creating fragmentation, performance issues or unsustainable maintenance.
• Provide architectural direction to transformation engineers, functional and technical solution experts, IT teams and delivery partners throughout requirements, build, test and deployment.
• Partner with IT architecture and engineering to ensure integrations with Oracle Cloud ERP, MES, PLM, data platforms and downstream execution processes are coherent, performant, secure and supportable.
• Partner with business data leaders and data stewards to define authoritative data requirements, business rules, hierarchies, quality controls and planning-output governance.
• Guide optimization architecture, scenario design, planning policies and model tuning, validating changes against end-to-end planning outcomes and business acceptance criteria.
• Govern release architecture, environment strategy, configuration transport, regression testing, production readiness and design integrity across development, QA, training and production.
• Evaluate Kinaxis releases, APIs, extensibility, automation and emerging capabilities, translating relevant innovation into a prioritized roadmap and governed adoption plan.
• Build sustainable internal expertise through architecture documentation, design standards, coaching, communities of practice, certification pathways and structured partner knowledge transfer.
• Lead root-cause analysis for complex defects, performance concerns and design issues, prioritizing durable corrective actions over short-term workarounds.

Required qualifications

• Significant hands-on Kinaxis Maestro / RapidResponse experience in solution architecture, functional design, configuration or technical leadership across multiple planning domains.
• Demonstrated ability to architect enterprise-scale planning solutions spanning demand, supply, capacity, materials, procurement, manufacturing or master scheduling.
• Full solution lifecycle experience covering discovery, requirements, architecture, configuration oversight, testing, deployment, stabilization and continuous improvement.
• Strong understanding of integrated supply chain planning, planning hierarchies, scenarios, constraints, optimization concepts, planning policies and closed-loop execution.
• Experience establishing solution standards, design governance, architecture reviews and reusable patterns within a complex enterprise platform.
• Ability to connect business-process requirements with data, integration, security, performance and supportability considerations.
• Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing business leaders, process owners, IT architects, engineers, vendors and systems integrators without relying solely on formal authority.
• Strong analytical judgment and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex solution decisions to executive, business and technical audiences.
• A self-directed learning orientation and demonstrated habit of tracking platform releases, emerging capabilities and planning-industry practices.

Preferred qualifications

• Kinaxis certification in one or more functional, authoring, integration or architecture disciplines.
• Experience with concurrent planning, supply optimization, master scheduling, scenario management, workbook authoring, analytics, Control Tower or Command Center use cases.
• Experience integrating Kinaxis with Oracle Cloud ERP, MES, PLM, cloud data platforms, SQL-based environments, Power BI or Tableau.
• Experience with Kinaxis APIs, data models, extensibility frameworks, automation, custom logic or performance tuning.
• Experience in HDD, semiconductor, high-technology or complex discrete manufacturing supply chains.
• Experience transitioning platform ownership from a systems integrator to an internal Center of Excellence or product-oriented capability team.
• Exposure to AI-enabled planning, agentic workflows, decision intelligence or orchestration across multiple supply chain platforms.

jobs.title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $100k-$200k/yr (including equity)
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

 1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

 2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

 - Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

 - Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

 - Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

 - Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

 - Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS https://aiosmedical.notion.site


BEING A WEB DESIGNER AT AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryanhlwu/, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-m-33b79642/, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie https://www.linkedin.com/in/richard-cartwright/). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

 - Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

 - High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

 - Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

 - Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

 - Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

 - AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

 - Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

 - Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.


NEED TO HAVE

 - Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

 - User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

 - Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

 - Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

 - AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

 - Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

 - Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

 - Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.


NICE TO HAVE

 - CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

 - Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

 - Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

 - Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

 - Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

 - Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

 - SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.


OUR CULTURAL STANDARDS

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

 1.  Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

 2.  Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

 3.  Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

 4.  If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

 5.  Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

 6.  A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

 7.  Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

 8.  Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

 9.  Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

 10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

 - Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr including equity


BENEFITS

The stuff below is cool as well.

 - Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

 - Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

 - Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

 - Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

 - GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

 - Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

 - Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

 - Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

 - What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.


HOW TO APPLY

Apply via Ashby https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/aios/497f94b5-e527-40ae-901b-ec8745903a7a and be sure to include:

 - your resume and portfolio

 - 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

 - a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

jobs.title: Territory Sales Representative / Restaurant Specialist - Tinley Park, IL
jobs.description:
About SpotOn

We’re not just building restaurant tech, we’re giving independent restaurants the tools to compete and win. From our award-winning point-of-sale to AI-powered profit tools, everything we do helps operators boost profit, work smarter, and keep their best people. And every solution is backed by real humans who actually give a sh*t about helping restaurants succeed.

 - Named the #1 Restaurant POS by G2 (Summer 2026), based on ratings from real users

 - Rated the top-rated point-of-sale (POS) for restaurants, bars, retail, and small businesses by Capterra users

 - Awarded Great Places to Work and Built In’s Best Workplaces for multiple years running

We move fast, care hard, and fight for independent restaurant operators to do what they love, and love doing it. If you’re looking to make an impact with heart and hustle, SpotOn is the place for you.


TERRITORY SALES REPRESENTATIVE / RESTAURANT SPECIALIST

At SpotOn, you will be working in your local assigned territory and responsible for promoting our full product suite while building positive relationships with local businesses & restaurant owners to help take their businesses to the next level. We're looking for motivated individuals with an entrepreneurial spirit who excel at developing new relationships, deeply understand SMB's biggest challenges, and have the drive to make a significant impact in their local communities. 

Responsibilities: 

 - Be a local representative for SpotOn in your community by offering advanced technology to local business owners that will help run and grow their businesses

 - Travel to and from client sites within a designated geographical territory to prospect, build relationships, and sign up new local business owners and merchants

 - Manage the full sales cycle from start to finish with a growing portfolio of clients

 - Hit sales targets, with a particular focus on selling software & point-of-sale solutions along with payment processing

 - Work closely with our extended Sales Support team to help reach your monthly sales performance goals

Qualifications: 

Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend to apply to roles only when they check every box on a job description. We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our qualifications and if this role is aligned with your career trajectory.

 - 2+ years of B2B sales experience with an emphasis on small business owners, merchants, and restaurants

 - Proven track record delivering against sales goals with a metrics-oriented, need-to-win attitude

 - Excellent cold calling, prospecting, and territory buildout experience

 - Proficient in Salesforce as a CRM is a plus

 - Maintain and manage the client relationship in collaboration with our internal support teams to ensure the success & satisfaction of your customer portfolio

 - The ability to learn technology basics and apply them to business situations

 - Ability to embrace feedback and hold yourself accountable

Benefits:  

At SpotOn, we put people above everything else. We’re known for our innovative software and technology solutions, but we stand out because of the hard-working humans behind the tech. We can’t take care of our clients without taking care of our employees first, and that’s why we invest in you with a competitive benefits package which includes:

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 

 - 401k with company match

 - RSUs

 - Paid vacation, 10 company holidays, sick time, and volunteer time off

 - Employee Resource Groups to build community and inclusion at work

 - Monthly cell phone and internet stipend

 - Tuition reimbursement for up to $2,000 per calendar year to assist with your professional development

*These represent our full-time benefits. Part-time/hourly benefits may vary and will be shared upon request

Compensation:

 - A full-time, W2 position with an annual salary of $60,000 and total on-target earnings of up to $120,000-$275,000. Total on-target earnings are inclusive of base salary and commission potential.

 - Please note the earnings listed are just one component of a competitive compensation package, which includes company RSUs.

 - Commissions will be paid weekly for new accounts signed, bonuses earned for hardware and implementation, monthly production bonuses, and customer retention.

 - Offers will be reflective of the candidate’s location and experience.

Travel and Work Environment:

 - This role requires regular travel to client locations onsite for up to 6 hours per day, and the employee must have reliable transportation. Where driving is required, employees must hold a valid driver’s license, maintain a driving record that meets company standards, and have reliable transportation with active auto insurance. In dense urban territories (for example, Manhattan, NY), travel is typically by public transit or on foot, and driving may not be required. Working hours may vary based on client needs. The employee must be able to travel to and enter customer sites, which may include restaurants, retail spaces, warehouses, and construction environments, and to stand and walk for extended periods during site visits. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Coordinator
jobs.description:
General Job Description

The Regulatory Affairs (RA) Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the laboratory stays compliant with all regulatory, licensing, and accreditation requirements (e.g., CLIA, CAP, State DOH, FDA, ASHI, TGA, GHA, ISO etc). This role focuses specifically on regulatory readiness, documentation, and inspection support. This role involves ensuring adherence to all relevant standards, managing documentation, facilitating audits, and driving continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory setting.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Compliance and Monitoring

• Interprets and applies federal, state and local regulations and accreditation standards to laboratory operations.
• Regularly reviews and monitors evolving regulatory requirements and guidelines, implementing changes to ensure ongoing compliance.

Maintain Regulatory Readiness

• Maintains and tracks all necessary licenses, registrations and certifications for the laboratory and its testing activities.
• Maintains a calendar of inspection dates and licensing renewals.
• Manages and renews CLIA Certificates, State Lab Licenses, CAP and ASHI Accreditation paperwork, FDA Registrations.
• Maintains accurate facility, personnel, and test menu information in regulatory systems.
• Conducts readiness reviews and gap analyses in advance of inspections.

Audits and Inspections

• Coordinates and participates in external audits and inspections from regulatory/accrediting bodies (e.g., FDA, CAP, CLIA, etc.) and/or clients.
• Coordinates post-inspection responses and CAPAs with QA and leadership.
• Coordinates the Internal Audit schedule and assigns auditors as necessary to meet the scope and expectations of the schedule.
• Performs internal audits in auditor or lead auditor role to evaluate compliance and identify potential risks or noncompliance issues.

Policy and Document Control

• Ensure SOPs and policies are aligned with regulatory standards.
• Participates in SOP review cycles.
• Assists in aligning technical and administrative documents to agencies (e.g., CAP or ASHI Checklists, FDA expectations).

Reporting and Compliance Metrics

• Collect, compile, and analyze quality data to identify trends, issues and improvement opportunities.
• Prepare clear and comprehensive reports on quality metrics, audit findings, and compliance status for laboratory management and directors.
• Maintain dashboards or trackers for:Licensing statusesInspection readinessAudit findings and CAPA statuses

Training and Education

• Provide training and support to inter and intra departmental employees particularly of applicable regulatory standards as well as other Quality System elements including, but not limited to, organizational-wide training (e.g., Annual GMP Training), Good Documentation practices (GDP), Good Tissue Practices, Investigations, QMS components, Document & Record Management, Training Program.

Problem Solving and Improvement

• Investigate incidents, nonconformances, and vendor recall notices, communicating findings and resolutions to stakeholders.
• Serves as a consultant for internal and external customers; assist RA/QA management in addressing business needs in regulatory area by guiding identification of cause, finding best solution, supporting implementation and monitoring.

Additional Responsibilities

• In order to meet Eurofins DPT’s quality policy and goals/objectives, all employees are expected to meet basic expectations of Eurofins DPT’s quality management system including, but not limited to good workmanship, adherence to standard operational procedures, training, good documentation practices, and accurate recordkeeping.
• Exhibit support of Eurofins DPT’s business philosophy, leadership values, quality objectives, ethical behaviors, customer care and confidentiality standards at all times. Foster a positive work environment, modeling professional behavior.
• Pursue and actively participate in professional growth and development opportunities as they relate to and benefit the position and organization.

Minimum Educational Requirements

Education

• A Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Medical Technology, Clinical Laboratory Science, Chemistry, Biology) is typically required.

Experience

• 2-5 years of experience in a laboratory setting with specific experience in quality assurance and/or regulatory affairs.

Knowledge

• Extensive knowledge of laboratory regulations (e.g., CLIA, CAP, FDA,) and quality control principles.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certification in quality management (e.g., Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) or Six Sigma certification).
• 5-7 years of experience with regulatory and/or accrediting agencies (e.g. FDA, ISO, ASHI, CLIA).

Skills

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with an aptitude for data interpretation and statistical analysis.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with diverse staff and management.
• Proficiency with laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and Microsoft Office Suite.
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Potential Environmental Factors

• This laboratory carefully maintains all hazardous materials. All employees must abide by Eurofins DPT’s Safety and Exposure procedures. This includes using the provided safety clothing and equipment.
• For a list of potential chemical hazards, see appropriate SDS sheet.

Compensation:

• $85,000-$93,000 salary

What we offer:

• Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
• Life and disability insurance
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation and holidays

jobs.title: Supply Chain Transformation Program Manager

You will translate approved end-to-end designs into executable delivery plans and drive coordinated execution across requirements, design, build, testing, readiness, deployment, stabilization and transition to the run-the-business organization. This is an execution-focused leadership role for someone who can connect strategy to delivery, bring clarity to complex dependencies and move matrixed teams toward decisions and closure.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Lead the process, solution and technology delivery workstream for highly critical Supply Chain transformation initiatives.
• Convert integrated process and solution designs into practical program plans covering scope, milestones, deliverables, resources, dependencies, decision points and acceptance criteria.
• Coordinate planning and delivery across a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders & partners.

• Identify and actively manage risks, issues, assumptions and cross-workstream dependencies; escalate material decisions with clear options, impacts and recommendations.

jobs.title: Account Supervisor, Product & Corporate Communications
jobs.description:
About Us

We’re not your typical agency. In fact, we don’t want to be. At M Booth Health, we take pride in doing what’s right, not what’s easy. Asking the difficult questions and finding unexpected answers. We’ve been at the forefront of advancing some of the most urgent issues in public health and medicine for decades. Our teams are purpose-built to challenge the status quo and drive results, both for our clients and for the health and well-being of people around the world.

Who You Are:

We want people who are just as passionate about health as we are. People who are serious about the work, but not too serious to have some fun while doing it. Candidates who bring big thinking and even bigger ambition; who are willing to push boundaries and challenge norms. And most importantly, who lead with kindness and humanity above all else. Does that sound like you?

We are actively seeking an Account Supervisor, Product & Corporate Communications to join our team. This role focuses on supporting product communications for pharmaceutical and biotech clients, while also supporting broader corporate communications and reputation efforts. It is the perfect role for someone who understands how regulatory milestones, clinical data, and product narratives shape corporate brand and trust.

All candidates should bring at least 5 to 7 years of PR agency experience within health communications, along with experience managing multiple accounts and mentoring or managing a team.

Responsibilities

Client Leadership

• Support communications around clinical data readouts, regulatory submissions and decisions, approvals, label updates, and other major product milestones.

• Develop and execute corporate communications strategies and programs rooted in differentiated narratives and perspectives and designed to build and protect reputation.

• Actively provide strategic counsel and serve as a strategic day-to-day voice for the client

• Partner closely with medical, legal, regulatory, and compliance teams to ensure accuracy and adherence to regulatory requirements.

• Oversee development of core materials, including press releases, Q&A, backgrounders, messaging, and executive prep – ensuring consistency across product and corporate work.

Project Management

• Design clear, efficient workplans for programs and manage all workstreams

• Juggle multiple workstreams, clients, projects and deadlines

• Review and edit documents and collateral with minimal supervision; ensure all team work is client-ready before it goes to clients

Team Management

• Direct and manage the work of more junior team members

• Coach in real time and provide actionable feedback that adds value to the teammate and the work

• Be motivational and inspiring, contributing ideas that help build culture

• Challenge the status quo and act as a problem solver for the team, helping them find solutions

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5-7 years of experience in a public relations agency, with deep experience in pharmaceutical or biotech product and corporate communications.

• Demonstrated expertise in regulatory milestones, clinical data communications, and product launches.

• Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical regulatory environment and experience working with MLR partners.

• Ability to translate complex scientific information into clear, credible communications.

• Experience integrating product communications into broader corporate communications strategies.

• Strong client management, organizational, and leadership skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience managing teams and multiple workstreams in fast-paced environments.

• A demonstrated commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, and to creating environments where people can do their best work.

Our Qualifications:

Yes, you read that correctly. You deserve to know what we have to offer you as well. So here are a few things that define our employee experience at M Booth Health:

• A workplace that’s alive with courage, ideas, respect and humanity

jobs.title: Associate, Program
jobs.description:
Associate, Program

Tulsa, OK

In Person

This is an in-person role with the expectation that staff report to a CEO site, as the majority of participant interactions are conducted in person.

Anticipated deadline to submit application: November 18. Position may close early if application limit is met. Apply promptly for full consideration.

The Opportunity

The Associate, Program (ProsperOK) provides administrative and programmatic support for specific programs CEO offers to the job seekers we serve.

As part of our mission, we strongly encourage individuals who have lived experience of incarceration or involvement in the justice system to apply for this role.

Who We Are

The Center for Employment Opportunities (CEO) provides employment services to people recently released from incarceration. Across the United States, 8,000-9,000 people participate in CEO each year, transitioning to employment that supports themselves, their families, and their communities.

What began as a demonstration project of the Vera Institute of Justice in the 1970s to address employment barriers facing the formerly incarcerated following release in New York City has grown into the leading reentry employment organization in the country, where over 30,000 formerly incarcerated individuals have secured full-time employment since 1996.

Who You Are

Competencies

• You have a commitment to working for a social justice-focused, fast-paced, people-centered and results oriented nonprofit

• You have the ability to communicate effectively with individuals of varying backgrounds and experiences; skill or desire to present to groups of varying stakeholders

• You have the ability to build rapport and collaborate with colleagues and external partners

• You have strong organizational skills, able to prioritize multiple tasks and projects, and able to manage time effectively to meet project deadlines

• You are proactive communicator who actively loops others into project status and any challenges that arise

• You are a self-starter with the ability to anticipate problems and present solutions

• You are proficient with technology, including PowerPoint, Excel, Google Suite and Salesforce

• You have 2+ years of program implementation experience (program management experience preferred) in a fast-growing and results-oriented nonprofit environment

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Key responsibilities of the Associate, Program include but are not limited to:

Training Support

• Support with implementation and management of participant training projects as well as site-specific training initiatives

• Coordinate and implement advanced training pathway(s) for participants

• Support with evaluation and report out on project progress and outcomes

• Support creation and coordination of participant referral pipelines for advanced training opportunities, assessing internal and external referrals

• Create individualized participant training implementation plans for sites based on site goals and office metrics (e.g. office tenure, capacity, enrollments/census)

• Conduct meetings as needed with participants in training programs to support their successful completion of training, job readiness, and job placement

• Utilize reports to monitor training enrollments, participant trainee progress and quality of program service delivery (during participants training experience)

• Conduct outreach and sustain relationships with training providers, workforce development professionals, one-stop career centers and other organizations and agencies

• Research and identify training provider options and inquire about services and relevant details

Program Support

• Coordinate and provide support on key program projects & activities

• Assess effectiveness and determine impact of team and program activities, working to improve processes & activities to best support effective pilot management

• Collaborate to help produce best practices for piloting new innovations and rolling out new processes.

• Gather feedback from participants and staff to inform effective project design and implementation

• Ensure data is inputted with fidelity, and support reviews & report outs of key data to inform efficacy and scalability of pilot programs

• Communicate consistently with program delivery staff in local sites to support and ensure continued adoption of new initiatives

Team Support

• Support in the facilitation of professional development workshops in collaboration with other CEO teams

• Provide support to vocational staff overseeing participant trainees as needed

• Contribute to the development, creation, and implementation of centralized programing

• Support internal/external participant outreach and recruitment efforts

• Interview participants in training and gather marketing materials

• Support fuller team as needed

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $47,800. In an effort to be both equitable and transparent, CEO's compensation philosophy considers a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, internal equity, and home office location in making a final determination on our salary offer.

We recognize that salary is a part of the overall compensation package and also provide a comprehensive benefits package, including medical and dental coverage, as well as professional development opportunities and training, including regular training opportunities in Motivational Interviewing (MI). MI is one evidence-based skill that reentry and human service professionals can utilize when supporting participants to achieve their goals.

We also offer paid parental leave, participation in a retirement plan, sick and vacation leave, paid holidays and more. We are a workplace that promotes continual learning and teamwork, offering lunch and learns, team outings, holiday gatherings and more for our staff.

More About Us

Center for Employment Opportunities believes that everyone deserves the chance to shape a stronger future for themselves, their families, and their communities. People who are justice involved are highly encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels. CEO is committed to the CROWN Act, and creating an open space where our employees can present as their true authentic selves.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, gender, gender identity, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military status, prior record of arrest or conviction, citizenship status, current employment status, caregiver status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law. We value diverse experiences, including with regard to educational background and justice system contact.

The successful candidate will serve as the “eyes and ears” on project sites, helping to identify and mitigate risks, conduct site visits, and support a strong safety culture across active operations.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as on-site safety representative providing continuous field-level support and oversight.
• Conduct routine and unscheduled site visits to monitor compliance with safety policies and procedures.
• Serve as the “eyes and ears on the ground,” identifying hazards and working with field teams to implement corrective actions.
• Support and participate in incident investigations, including root cause analysis and documentation.
• Perform Pre-Startup Safety Reviews (PSSR) to ensure readiness and compliance prior to operational activities.
• Assist with safety audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance checks.
• Communicate safety expectations and reinforce best practices with field personnel and subcontractors.

Minimum Requirements

• High school diploma and 4+ years of experience supporting safety, health, and environment activities in field-based Oil & Gas or remediation projects or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass client-specific background and drug & alcohol screening.

Preferred Qualifications

• 8+ years of field safety experience in Oil & Gas, construction, or environmental remediation settings.
• Professional certifications such as OSHA 30, CHST, or equivalent.
• Hands-on experience conducting incident investigations and PSSR processes.
• Strong understanding of field safety practices, hazard recognition, and mitigation techniques.

jobs.title: Commercial Director - Program Management
jobs.description:
Provides leadership for the commercial strategy, architecture, and performance of major Programs. Accountable for designing and integrating commercial arrangements, procurement strategies, incentive mechanisms, commercial governance structures, and supply chain ecosystems that align stakeholders around shared Program outcomes.

Leads market engagement, commercial governance, value realization, and collaborative delivery across multiple contracts, partners, and delivery organizations to achieve target cost, schedule, risk, and enterprise value objectives.

Operating as a member of the Program Management Leadership Team, the role translates Program objectives into executable commercial frameworks that drive performance, transparency, innovation, and long-term value creation across the full delivery ecosystem.

This is not principally a contract administration, claims management, or procurement role. The primary accountability is creating and sustaining commercial value during delivery through integrated commercial leadership and collaborative supply chain performance management.

Core Accountabilities

• Define and lead the commercial architecture of a major, complex Program or collection of smaller programs. Establish the delivery models, contracting strategies, commercial frameworks, incentive mechanisms, and risk allocation structures required to align stakeholders the supply chain around common objectives and maximize long-term value. Ensure the commercial ecosystem supports integrated delivery, innovation, transparency, and high performance across the full portfolio of delivery partners, contracts, and suppliers.
• Lead market sounding and industry engagement to inform commercial strategy, delivery models, procurement approaches, and investment decisions. Assess market capability, capacity, competitiveness, and appetite to ensure commercial arrangements are aligned with market realities. Shape procurement and delivery partner strategies to secure the capability, innovation, resilience, and value required to achieve Program outcomes.
• Lead the development, validation, negotiation, and governance of target costs, pricing strategies, commercial incentives, contingencies, and risk provisions. Establish transparent commercial baselines informed by benchmarking, market intelligence, and delivery maturity to ensure commercial arrangements remain aligned with Program outcomes throughout execution.
• Provide executive leadership oversight of the Program's commercial ecosystem, ensuring commercial arrangements, incentives, and behaviors remain aligned with Program objectives. Drive collaboration, transparency, performance, innovation, and value realization across owners, delivery partners, contractors, suppliers, and joint ventures, taking action where necessary to optimize outcomes and protect enterprise value.
• Lead commercial governance and assurance across the Program, ensuring commercial decisions, risk allocation, change, forecasting, controls, and performance remain aligned with Program objectives. Identify emerging commercial exposures, provide independent challenge, and implement interventions to protect value, strengthen accountability, and improve delivery outcomes.
• Provide commercial leadership across the Program and its stakeholder community. Align commercial interests across owners, sponsors, delivery partners, suppliers, and functional leaders to support effective decision-making, collaborative delivery, and successful Program outcomes. Lead a high-performing commercial function focused on value creation, commercial excellence, and delivery performance.

Minimum Requirements

• 20+ years of relevant complex systems, major infrastructure, strategic commercial, procurement, and direct delivery leadership experience, including leadership responsibility on major capital programs.
• Leadership of complex collaborative commercial arrangements, complex procurements and collaborative negotiations through contract design, market engagement, award, implementation, delivery and close out.
• Direct accountability for establishing and managing target-cost or GMP arrangements.
• Substantial experience with collaborative alliances or similar hybrid collaborative structures, contractor joint ventures, integrated delivery organizations, and major subcontracting strategies.
• Evidence of measurable commercial value beyond initial contract award.
• Strong command of strategy, relational contracting, cost engineering, commercial risk, innovation to drive value, procurement governance, and executive level negotiations.
• Experience with NEC target-cost/alliancing arrangements, progressive design-build, or equivalent collaborative contracting frameworks.

jobs.title: BestDrive Commercial Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Build Relationships. Grow Business. Drive Results.

BestDrive is seeking a motivated, results-driven Sales Representative to grow our commercial tire and fleet solutions business. This is an outside sales role focused on developing new customer relationships, expanding existing accounts, and helping commercial fleets improve performance through innovative tire and service solutions.

If you thrive on building relationships, enjoy being in the field, and have the determination to overcome rejection and win new business, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact while building a rewarding career.

This is not a desk job. Successful candidates will spend the majority of their time meeting customers face-to-face, prospecting for new business, managing customer relationships, and identifying opportunities to expand BestDrive's products and services within their territory.

Position Summary

The Sales Representative is responsible for developing new business, growing existing customer relationships, and delivering commercial tire and fleet solutions within an assigned territory. This field-based role requires daily customer engagement, business development activities, and account management to achieve sales and profitability goals.

The position reports directly to the Area Manager and maintains a strong collaborative relationship with the National Sales Manager to support strategic sales initiatives, account growth, territory development, and overall commercial performance.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development

• Prospect and develop new commercial fleet and business customers through daily in-person visits.
• Generate leads through cold calling, referrals, networking, and territory development activities.
• Build relationships with fleet managers, business owners, maintenance managers, and purchasing decision-makers.
• Maintain consistent sales activity and follow-up efforts to drive revenue growth.
• Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities.

Account Management

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers.
• Identify opportunities to expand products and services within current accounts.
• Conduct regular customer visits to assess needs and strengthen partnerships.
• Provide solutions that help customers improve operational efficiency and reduce costs.
• Ensure exceptional customer service and responsiveness.

Sales & Solution Selling

• Assess customer needs and recommend commercial tires, retread solutions, and fleet service programs.
• Prepare quotes, proposals, and pricing recommendations.
• Negotiate within company guidelines to secure profitable business.
• Collaborate with store operations and service teams to ensure customer expectations are met.
• Promote the full range of BestDrive products and services.

Territory Management

• Develop and execute territory growth plans.
• Maintain an active pipeline of opportunities and target accounts.
• Utilize Salesforce CRM to document customer interactions, opportunities, and sales activities.
• Accurately forecast sales activity and business opportunities.
• Achieve established sales, gross profit, customer acquisition, and retention goals.

Compensation: This role offers an annual base salary of $60,000–$100,000, plus performance-based commissions, with target total annual earnings of $140,000 or more. Base salary is determined by relevant experience and qualifications. Actual total earnings vary based on sales results and the applicable commission plan.

Required

• High School Diploma or GED.
• Minimum of two years of outside sales, B2B sales, account management, or territory sales experience.
• Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
• Excellent organizational and time management skills.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems.
• Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.
• Ability to travel throughout an assigned territory daily.

Preferred

• Commercial tire industry experience.
• Fleet, transportation, automotive, industrial, or related sales experience.
• Knowledge of commercial trucking or fleet operations.
• Experience using Salesforce CRM.
• Existing relationships within the transportation, fleet, or commercial services industry.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?

The ideal candidate is resilient, competitive, and highly motivated to grow business. They are comfortable with daily prospecting, frequent customer visits, and overcoming rejection while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.

This role requires the stamina and discipline to be in the field five days a week, actively engaging customers, creating opportunities, and building long-term partnerships that drive results.

THE PERKS

• Competitive compensation and incentive opportunities
• Established brand and industry-leading products
• Strong support from operations and sales leadership
• Career advancement opportunities
• Comprehensive benefits package
• Company technology and sales tools
• Opportunity to make a direct impact on business growth
• Collaborative and team-oriented culture

Work Environment

This position requires regular travel throughout an assigned territory and frequent visits to customer locations, fleet operations, maintenance facilities, and BestDrive locations. Candidates must be comfortable working in industrial and outdoor environments and interacting with a wide variety of customers and decision-makers.

Join the BestDrive Team

If you are a driven sales professional who enjoys building relationships, creating opportunities, and delivering value to customers, we encourage you to apply today.

Join BestDrive and help drive growth, strengthen customer partnerships, and deliver industry-leading fleet and tire solutions.

Continental offers equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals, without regard to unlawful consideration to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Growth Merchant Lead - Emerging Markets (Tulsa, OK)
jobs.description:
About the Team

The Emerging Markets team promotes growth in local economies by building meaningful partnerships with merchants across underdeveloped, high-opportunity markets. We focus on T4–T5 geographies—one of DoorDash’s highest company priorities, representing over 40% of remaining restaurant opportunities as we expand beyond core cities and suburbs. Our team creates first connections with SMB restaurants and retailers, helping them grow and monetize through on-demand delivery.

This is a field sales opportunity with extensive travel within the region. You will need to live by or in proximity to a major airport.

About the Role

As a Growth Merchant Lead (GML), you will play a pivotal role in expanding DoorDash’s footprint by opening new markets and bringing new restaurant partnerships onto the platform. You will own a high-velocity, in-person sales cycle and spend the majority of your time developing Tier 4-5 (“emerging”) markets – some of DoorDash’s largest remaining areas of opportunity. This role requires extensive travel (70%+) and is ideal for someone who is energized by building new markets from the ground up and influencing market growth directly.

You’ll report to a Regional Sales Manager for the region and work cross-functionally with teams across the business. You’ll join a culture that prioritizes learning, ownership, and career development, with direct access to the support and resources you need to grow to the next level.

This is a field sales role with extensive travel within the region. You will spend most of your time traveling in the region meeting with merchants, with some time working remotely. In addition, this role will require the ability to travel as needed for in-person collaboration through trainings, offsites, team-building events, and other business related necessity.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Expand DoorDash’s presence by traveling to emerging markets and developing new restaurant partnerships.

• Lead end-to-end, in-person sales cycles– prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing.

• Sell business owners on DoorDash’s value and secure revenue-share agreements.

• Consistently execute high-volume field activity and close deals within days.

• Build scalable approaches and playbooks to accelerate market expansion.

• Shape DoorDash’s expansion strategy in rural economies.

• Have an outsized impact on growth in high-priority markets.

We're excited about you because…

• You have 4+ years of in-person, outside B2B sales experience (field experience is required)

• You have proven success running short, high-velocity, full sales cycles – including same-day closes.

• You have strong prospecting, hunting, and negotiation skills.

• You are energized by extensive travel – spending 70%+ of your time in the field, including overnight travel inside and outside of your home state.

• You are entrepreneurial, adaptable, and motivated building and scaling new markets.

• You have demonstrated success operating autonomously and thrive in environments where you will create the playbook, not follow one.

• You are comfortable using Salesforce, Google Workspace, and sales productivity tools.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024.

The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: Covey

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants and sales commission. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$93,840—$138,000 USD

The total on-target earnings (base + commissions) for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$156,400—$230,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

Notice Regarding Use of AI and Automated Tools: To streamline our hiring process, DoorDash utilizes an automated recruitment tool called Metaview.

How it works: Metaview assists our recruiting team by evaluating job related qualifications and characteristics in connection with hiring. The tool is designed and used to support - rather than replace - human decision-making; trained personnel make final decisions with meaningful human review and oversight, and DoorDash does not use Metaview or other AI-enabled tool  in a manner that has the effect of subjecting applicants or employees to discrimination based on any protected characteristic or proxy or for engaging in any protected activity under applicable law.

Data Retention, Privacy & Bias Audit: Data collected during this process is retained in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy https://help.doordash.com/en-us/legal/article/ax-privacy-notice and applicable state laws. In compliance with New York City Local Law 144, the independent bias audit summary for Metaview is publicly available for review at https://trust.warden-ai.com/metaview/application-review.

jobs.title: Wellness Administrative Assistant
jobs.description:
The Wellness Administrative Assistant (WAA) will report to the Health and Wellness Director.

Salary Range: $24.00 - $25.00 Hourly

Job Overview

Assists the Health and Wellness Director with the daily operations of the Wellness Department by providing administrative duties including but not limited to staffing scheduling (community specific), update service plans as needed (community specific), phone call assistance, scheduling appointments, ordering supplies, filing, and other duties as assigned.

Responsibilities and Duties

· Maintain the safety, comfort, dignity, and confidentiality of all residents, staff and families.

· Coordinates interviews and orientation for new team members.

· Ensures all assigned residents are clean, neatly dressed, groomed, safe, and fed during assigned shifts.

· Documents and updates the EHR as directed and under the supervision of the HWD.

· Appropriately utilizes and keeps electronic documentation “devices” safe and secure within the community.

· Participates in and attends all in-service training(s) as scheduled.

· Ensures compliance with all Federal, State, and local regulations, as well as community policies and procedures.

· Perform and oversee staffing scheduling (state specific).

· Assists with communication via telephone, facsimile and/or email with families, physicians, third party vendors and/or staff.

· Schedules appointments for residents as directed from the nursing staff.

· Other duties as assigned by supervisor and/or ED

· High School Diploma or GED. At least 1 year resident care experience required.

· Certified Nursing Assistant or Certified Home Health Aid a plus

· Knowledge and experience in working with the elderly population, preferred dementia experience

Valuing a connection to the community, we are creating a pedestrian-friendly front plaza which will offer art fairs, farmers markets, and festivals. Monarch believes its buildings serve residents, their families, and the Monarch team members. Therefore, they have created a team member and resident co-working space; art, creative, and performance spaces; and the WELL center (fitness, yoga, spa, and a fully-stocked juice bar) which can be used by all.

Additional Benefits for Full-time Team Members:

Benefits Offered (Full Time):

• Health Insurance: Medical/Rx, Dental, and Vision
• Ancillary Benefits: Life Insurance/AD&D, Short Term Disability and Long-Term disability
• Basic Life & Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
• FSA (Commuter/Parking)
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
• 401(k) Retirement with Company Match
• Paid Time Off (PTO) and Holidays
• Tuition Reimbursement

Other Compensation Programs:

• Employee Referral Bonus
• Resident Referral Bonus

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Monarch Communities and Brandywine Senior Living is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Mobile Phlebotomist (Buffalo, NY)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

At Sprinter Health, our mission is to reimagine how people access care by bringing high quality care directly into the home.

Using the same technology that powers leading marketplace platforms, we deliver care where people are, especially those who need it most.

We’ve supported millions of patients across 22 states and consistently maintained a 90+ NPS, reflecting the quality and experience we strive to deliver every day.

Our clinical teams are at the center of making healthcare more accessible, connected, and personal.



Where patient experience isn’t a metric. It’s a standard.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Sprinter, you’ll bring healthcare directly to patients in the comfort of their homes. You’ll spend your day on the road providing a variety of preventative and diagnostic services, including blood draws, vitals, height and weight assessments, urine collection, support with Annual Wellness Visits, and more.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys independence, connecting with patients, and a workday that looks different from a traditional clinic setting.

What We Offer

 - Guaranteed daily hours

 - National Mileage reimbursement, currently $0.76/mile reimbursement starting at mile 31

 - Company paid healthcare premiums

 - 100% 401(k) contribution of 3%

 - Company provided equipment including iPhone, iPad, scrubs, and supplies


WHAT YOU’LL DO

Life as a Sprinter starts before the first patient visit. Your car becomes both your office and your lab on the go, so preparation and organization are everything.

 - Prepare for your day by reviewing your schedule and ensuring you have the proper supplies and PPE.

 - Travel to patients’ homes throughout your assigned service area.

 - Provide scheduled services including blood draws, vitals, height and weight measurements, urine collection, support with Annual Wellness Visits, and other preventative and diagnostic services.

 - Use your expert phlebotomy skills to make blood draws as comfortable as possible for each patient.

 - Create a warm, welcoming, and professional experience in every patient’s home.

 - Accurately document each patient visit using Sprinter technology.

 - Properly label, handle, and transport specimens for lab drop off or shipment.

 - Manage your time, supplies, and schedule independently as you move from patient to patient throughout the day.


SOUND LIKE YOU?


MASTER OF YOUR CRAFT

 - Do you have exceptional blood draw skills?

 - Have you been the “go to” for hard sticks?

 - Are you confident in drawing blood from a wide range of patients?

 - Are you comfortable learning and performing additional clinical services?


ROAD WARRIOR

 - Do you enjoy a change of scenery during your workday?

 - Are you comfortable spending a significant portion of your day on the road?

 - Are you willing to travel an hour or more to visit patients?

 - Can you comfortably drive before 7:00 a.m. when your first patient is scheduled at 7:00 a.m.?


PATIENT FOCUSED

 - Are you passionate about helping others?

 - Are you kind, empathetic, and an effective communicator?

 - Do you enjoy meeting new people and creating a great patient experience?


SEEN IT ALL BEFORE

 - Are you comfortable providing care in a variety of home environments, recognizing that each patient’s living conditions and standards may be different from your own?

 - Can you remain calm, adaptable, and professional when faced with challenging or unexpected situations?


COMMITTED TO EXCELLENCE

 - Do you pride yourself on being reliable, dependable, and trustworthy?

 - Are you solution oriented and able to think critically when challenges arise?

 - Is your mode of transportation as reliable as you are?


TECH PROFICIENT

 - Are you proficient using Apple iPhones and iPads beyond calling and texting?

 - Are you comfortable navigating apps, electronic health records, telehealth platforms, and other digital tools?

 - Can you confidently learn and navigate new technology independently?

If you’re nodding yes, you’re off to a great start. Here are a few more things you’ll need to be successful as a Sprinter.


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Strong phlebotomy skills, including experience with challenging sticks

 - Patient facing healthcare experience as a Phlebotomist, Medical Assistant (MA), Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN), or Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) in home preferred

 - Current BLS certification

 - Valid driver’s license, current auto insurance, and personal, reliable vehicle

 - Availability Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m.

 - Ability to drive before 7:00 a.m. to arrive at your first scheduled patient on time

 - Proficiency using Apple iPhones and iPads

 - Ability to meet applicable state specific certification or licensing requirements


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs.

 - Ability to spend prolonged periods driving between patient appointments

 - Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and carry medical supplies and equipment

 - Ability to safely navigate a variety of patient home environments, including locations with stairs

jobs.description:
About the Team

The Emerging Markets team promotes growth in local economies by building meaningful partnerships with merchants across underdeveloped, high-opportunity markets. We focus on T4–T5 geographies—one of DoorDash’s highest company priorities, representing over 40% of remaining restaurant opportunities as we expand beyond core cities and suburbs. Our team creates first connections with SMB restaurants and retailers, helping them grow and monetize through on-demand delivery.

This is a field sales opportunity with extensive travel within the region. You will need to live by or in proximity to a major airport.

About the Role

As a Growth Merchant Lead (GML), you will play a pivotal role in expanding DoorDash’s footprint by opening new markets and bringing new restaurant partnerships onto the platform. You will own a high-velocity, in-person sales cycle and spend the majority of your time developing Tier 4-5 (“emerging”) markets – some of DoorDash’s largest remaining areas of opportunity. This role requires extensive travel (70%+) and is ideal for someone who is energized by building new markets from the ground up and influencing market growth directly.

You’ll report to a Regional Sales Manager for the region and work cross-functionally with teams across the business. You’ll join a culture that prioritizes learning, ownership, and career development, with direct access to the support and resources you need to grow to the next level.

This is a field sales role with extensive travel within the region. You will spend most of your time traveling in the region meeting with merchants, with some time working remotely. • Build scalable approaches and playbooks to accelerate market expansion.

• Shape DoorDash’s expansion strategy in rural economies.
